papers.title: Heavy-Ball Q-Learning with Residual Weighting Correction
papers.abstract_en: This paper proposes a corrected heavy-ball Q-learning method for reinforcement learning (RL) and establishes its convergence. It also identifies conditions under which the method is theoretically guaranteed to converge faster than standard Q-learning. The same construction is then extended to Q-learning with linear function approximation, where analogous convergence and acceleration statements are derived. The analysis is based on a switched linear system (SLS) representation of Q-learning algorithms and on the joint spectral radius (JSR) of the associated switching families. This SLS viewpoint is not commonly used in standard analyses of Q-learning, and it provides a complementary framework and new insight into how heavy-ball momentum can accelerate Q-learning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种带残差加权校正的重球Q学习（heavy-ball Q-learning）方法，并建立了收敛性证明。该方法的理论保证比标准Q学习更快收敛的条件被识别，并扩展到线性函数逼近的Q学习，得到类似的收敛和加速结论。分析基于切换线性系统（SLS）表示和联合谱半径（JSR），为理解重球动量加速Q学习提供了新视角。
Motivation: 标准Q学习收敛速度较慢，需要加速方法，但直接应用重球动量可能导致不稳定。本文旨在提出一种校正的重球Q学习以保证收敛并实现加速。
Method: 提出带残差加权校正的重球Q学习，利用切换线性系统（SLS）和联合谱半径（JSR）进行理论分析，推导收敛性和加速条件。
Result: 摘要建立了收敛性，并识别了比标准Q学习收敛更快的条件。在线性函数逼近设置下也得到类似结果。
Conclusion: 该SLS视角为标准Q学习分析提供了补充框架，揭示了重球动量如何加速Q学习。

papers.title: Application of LLMs to Threat Assessment of Foreign Peacekeeping Missions
papers.abstract_en: We present a novel approach for applying Large Language Models (LLMs) to threat assessment in the context of foreign peacekeeping missions. Building on the PINPOINT project and its use case, the EU Monitoring Mission in Georgia, we combine an interdisciplinary risk-model with OSINT-based media collection and LLM-supported threat extraction. The proposed workflow maps media contents to mission-relevant threats, extracts structured information and applies several additional LLM-based processing steps to improve relevance and grounding. An evaluation of threats extracted from media documents shows high agreement between automatically generated results and human judgment for core aspects such as threat and mission relevance. These results indicate that LLMs provide a promising approach to support analysts in the context of peacekeeping missions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将大语言模型（LLMs）应用于外国维和任务的威胁评估，结合PINPOINT项目和欧盟驻格鲁吉亚监测任务，利用多学科风险模型、OSINT媒体收集和LLM威胁提取。工作流程将媒体内容映射到任务相关威胁，提取结构化信息，并通过多个LLM处理步骤提高相关性和基础。评估显示，自动生成结果与人类判断在威胁和任务相关性等核心方面具有高度一致性。
Motivation: 维和任务中威胁评估依赖人工分析，效率低且主观性强，现有自动化方法难以处理非结构化媒体数据。
Method: 基于PINPOINT项目，结合跨学科风险模型与OSINT媒体收集，使用LLM进行威胁提取、结构化信息抽取和多步后处理以增强相关性和接地性。
Result: 在媒体文档的威胁提取评估中，自动结果与人类判断在威胁和任务相关性等核心指标上高度一致。
Conclusion: LLMs为支持维和任务中的分析人员提供了有前景的方法，但摘要未讨论局限性或泛化性。

papers.title: Transformer-Based Classification of Bacterial Raman Spectra with LOOCV
papers.abstract_en: Transformer-based models have recently attracted increasing attention for Raman spectral classification. In this study, a transformer-based approach was systematically evaluated using a nested leave-one-replicate-out cross-validation framework and compared with conventional machine-learning pipelines combining PCA or ICA with LDA, SVM, and Random Forest classifiers. A bacterial Raman dataset comprising 5,417 single-cell spectra from six bacterial species and nine independent measurement replicates was used. The transformer consistently achieved the highest classification performance across independent test replicates and significantly outperformed all conventional approaches. Analysis of the learned latent feature space revealed improved class separation compared with PCA- and ICA-based representations. Furthermore, the transformer maintained superior performance when applied directly to raw Raman spectra without preprocessing, demonstrating robust behavior across measurement replicates. These findings highlight the potential of transformer-based models for robust Raman spectral classification and emphasize the importance of replicate-aware validation for realistic model evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了Transformer模型在细菌拉曼光谱分类中的性能，使用嵌套留一重复交叉验证框架，并与PCA/ICA结合LDA、SVM和随机森林等传统方法对比。在包含5417个单细胞光谱（6种细菌、9个独立测量重复）的数据集上，Transformer一致取得最优分类性能，且无需预处理即可鲁棒地应用于原始光谱。
Motivation: 拉曼光谱分类中，传统机器学习方法依赖特征提取且泛化性有限，而Transformer模型虽受关注但缺乏系统的、考虑测量重复性的验证。
Method: 采用嵌套留一重复交叉验证（nested leave-one-replicate-out cross-validation）评估Transformer模型，并与PCA/ICA+LDA、SVM、随机森林等基线比较。
Result: Transformer在所有独立测试重复上超越传统方法，学习到的潜在特征空间比PCA/ICA表示具有更好的类分离；直接应用于未预处理的原始光谱仍保持高性能。
Conclusion: Transformer模型在拉曼光谱分类中具有鲁棒性和优越性，同时强调重复感知验证对模型现实评估的重要性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Data-Free Reservoir Features for Efficient Long-Horizon Cold-Start Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Cold-start exemplar-free class-incremental learning requires learning a growing set of classes without replay, external pretraining, or a large initial task. Existing cold-start methods typically either train the backbone throughout the stream and compensate for semantic drift, or freeze a backbone after the first task, producing features biased toward the initial classes. These choices also create a computational tension: drift-compensation methods require repeated backbone training and increasingly expensive updates as the task horizon grows, while frozen-backbone methods are cheap but weak under cold start. We study a third option: a feature extractor that is never fit to image data at all. We propose CIRCLE, a class-incremental classifier built from fixed bidirectional two-dimensional reservoir features, adapted from BiRC2D for image classification, and streaming linear discriminant analysis heads. CIRCLE groups multiple random reservoir instantiations into feature ensembles and averages the softmax outputs of independent SLDA heads, yielding a tunable bias-variance tradeoff between richer random features and prediction-level ensembling. Because the feature extractor is fixed and the head admits streaming closed-form updates, CIRCLE performs sample-wise training without replay, task-boundary information, or backbone backpropagation. On CIFAR-100, TinyImageNet, ImageNet-Subset, and ImageNet-1k, CIRCLE is competitive at 10-20 task splits and substantially outperforms strong CS-EFCIL baselines at 50, 100, and 500 task splits, while training much faster than trained-backbone drift-compensation methods. Ablations show that the BiRC2D-style extractor, SLDA head, and balanced feature/prediction ensembling each contribute to the final performance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对冷启动无样例类增量学习（CS-EFCIL）问题，提出CIRCLE方法。该方法使用从未在图像数据上训练的固定双向二维储层特征（BiRC2D），结合流式线性判别分析（SLDA）头，通过特征集成和预测级平均实现可调的偏差-方差权衡。在CIFAR-100、TinyImageNet、ImageNet-Subset和ImageNet-1k上，CIRCLE在10-20任务分割时具有竞争力，在50、100和500任务分割时大幅优于强基线，且训练速度远快于基于漂移补偿的方法。消融实验验证了各组件的贡献。
Motivation: 现有冷启动方法在计算效率和性能之间矛盾：漂移补偿方法需重复训练backbone且成本随任务数增长，冻结backbone方法在冷启动下性能弱。需要一种计算高效且性能好的方案。
Method: 提出CIRCLE，使用固定双向二维储层特征提取器（BiRC2D），组合多个随机储层实例化为特征集成，每个头为独立SLDA，通过平均softmax输出得到最终预测。特征提取器固定，头使用闭式流式更新，无需重放、任务边界或反向传播。
Result: 在CIFAR-100、TinyImageNet、ImageNet-Subset和ImageNet-1k上，CIRCLE在10-20任务分割时与基线相当，在50、100和500任务分割时大幅优于强CS-EFCIL基线，且训练速度远快于基于训练backbone的漂移补偿方法。消融实验表明BiRC2D提取器、SLDA头和平衡的特征/预测集成均对性能有贡献。
Conclusion: 本文表明完全固定的特征提取器（未在图像数据上拟合）可与流式分类器结合，在长任务序列冷启动增量学习中实现高效率和竞争力。局限性可能包括在短任务序列上性能一般，且依赖随机特征。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning Climate Variability from Scarce Data with Diffusion Models: A Test Case for ENSO
papers.abstract_en: Diffusion models are increasingly applied to climate emulation, but whether they capture the correct modes of variability remains unclear, a concern amplified by data scarcity at longer timescales. We investigate this using synthetic tropical Pacific SST fields from Linear Inverse Models (LIMs), whose known low-order structure bypasses the overlapping and confounding modes of real observations. With sufficient training data, our model recovers the correct structure of both Gaussian and non-Gaussian LIMs, including ENSO's Eastern/Central Pacific asymmetry. Yet an ablation study on the number of monthly training samples reveals that the 700 observations in ERSSTv5 fall an order of magnitude short of the 7,000 samples needed for convergence, and that not all diffusion parameterisations recover the correct low-order structure. Pre-training on CMIP6 with a learned model embedding, followed by fine-tuning on scarce observations, closes this gap, reproducing observed statistics more faithfully than both Gaussian and non-Gaussian LIMs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用合成热带太平洋SST数据（来自线性逆模型LIM）评估扩散模型在数据稀缺条件下再现气候变率模式的能力。研究发现，训练样本需约7000个才能收敛，而实际观测（如ERSSTv5）仅约700个，差距一个数量级。通过CMIP6预训练加微调策略，可弥补数据不足，使模型比高斯和非高斯LIM更忠实地再现观测统计特征，包括ENSO的东/中太平洋不对称性。
Motivation: 扩散模型在气候模拟中应用增多，但在数据稀缺（尤其是长周期数据）时能否正确捕捉气候变率模式尚不清楚，这对ENSO等关键现象的研究构成挑战。
Method: 使用来自线性逆模型LIM的合成SST场作为训练数据（其低阶结构已知，避免真实观测的模式混淆）；进行消融实验考查训练样本数量对模型收敛的影响；提出CMIP6预训练加微调的迁移学习策略以解决实际观测数据不足问题。
Result: 需约7000个训练样本才能收敛，而ERSSTv5仅提供约700个；并非所有扩散参数化都能恢复正确的低阶结构；CMIP6预训练加微调策略弥合了数据差距，在再现观测统计量上优于高斯和非高斯LIM。
Conclusion: 扩散模型在数据量充足时能正确恢复气候变率模式，但实际观测数据量不足；通过大规模预训练加微调可有效提升数据稀缺条件下的表现。

papers.title: Inherited Circuits, Learned Semantics: How Fine-Tuning Creates Evasion Vulnerabilities Invisible to Standard Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: LLMs fine-tuned for security classification are usually evaluated on held-out examples from the same distribution as their training data. We show that this can miss vulnerabilities introduced by fine-tuning itself: models can learn token-level indicator semantics that preserve canonical accuracy while failing under behavior-preserving transformations such as PowerShell alias substitution, command reconstruction, string construction, execution indirection, and case mutation. We study Foundation-Sec-8B-Instruct and its base model, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, on matched PowerShell classification cohorts. Causal interventions localize the classification circuit to a late-attention route inherited from Llama rather than created by fine-tuning. Fine-tuning concentrates and semantically specializes this inherited structure, improving baseline behavior while creating transformation-sensitive attack surfaces. A three-tier evasion benchmark finds Foundation-Sec misses on iwr substitution, Invoke-Expression reconstruction, and case-mutated Invoke-Expression/IEX variants that Llama does not share. We also derive a pre-deployment monitoring method: a linear probe at the classification boundary and an indicator-token sign test identify command families where canonical indicators change role after fine-tuning. These signals prioritize red-team variant generation using only canonical inputs, showing that security fine-tuning can improve task accuracy while expanding the evasion surface. These results caution against treating small task-specific fine-tunes as straightforwardly safer security classifiers: specialization can convert inherited model structure into brittle indicator rules that preserve held-out accuracy while expanding the evasion surface. Robust AI-enabled security will require specifying the full transformation space of the task and monitoring semantic drift through fine-tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了LLM经过安全分类微调后，在规范评估下表现良好，但面对行为保持性变换（如PowerShell别名替换、命令重构等）时会产生新的逃逸漏洞。作者通过因果干预定位分类回路，发现微调继承了基础模型的后期注意力路径，并使其语义专门化，从而创建了变换敏感的攻击面。实验以Foundation-Sec-8B-Instruct和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct为例，在三层逃逸基准中揭示了微调模型特有的漏洞。
Motivation: 现有LLM安全分类微调评估仅使用同分布留出样本，可能遗漏微调本身引入的漏洞，导致模型在保持规范准确率的同时，对行为保持性变换变得脆弱。
Method: 通过因果干预定位分类回路，使用线性探测和指示符符号检验监测微调后规范指示符角色的变化，并利用这些信号指导红队生成变体。
Result: Foundation-Sec-8B-Instruct在iwr替换、Invoke-Expression重构和大小写变体上存在逃逸，而Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct没有。微调集中并语义专化继承的结构，提升基线行为但扩大了逃逸面。
Conclusion: 安全微调可能将继承的模型结构转换为脆弱的指示符规则，在保持留出准确率的同时扩大逃逸面。鲁棒AI安全需要指定完整变换空间并监控微调中的语义漂移。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究了LLM经过安全分类微调后，在规范评估下表现良好，但面对行为保持性变换（如PowerShell别名替换、命令重构等）时会产生新的逃逸漏洞。作者通过因果干预定位分类回路，发现微调继承了基础模型的后期注意力路径，并使其语义专门化，从而创建了变换敏感的攻击面。实验以Foundation-Sec-8B-Instruct和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct为例，在三层逃逸基准中揭示了微调模型特有的漏洞。

summary_sections.method: 通过因果干预定位分类回路，使用线性探测和指示符符号检验监测微调后规范指示符角色的变化，并利用这些信号指导红队生成变体。
summary_sections.result: Foundation-Sec-8B-Instruct在iwr替换、Invoke-Expression重构和大小写变体上存在逃逸，而Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct没有。微调集中并语义专化继承的结构，提升基线行为但扩大了逃逸面。
summary_sections.conclusion: 安全微调可能将继承的模型结构转换为脆弱的指示符规则，在保持留出准确率的同时扩大逃逸面。鲁棒AI安全需要指定完整变换空间并监控微调中的语义漂移。

papers.title: Beyond Global Divergences: A Local-Mass Perspective on Bayesian Inference
papers.abstract_en: Global objectives, such as KL divergence and ELBO, are widely used in Bayesian inference for measuring distributional discrepancy. This paper studies their local-mass behaviour that is not directly captured by such objectives. We introduce and use two mathematical tools: (1) Mass Index for recording the polynomial and logarithmic decay scales of local mass, and (2) regularised extended KL (RE-KL), a set-localised divergence that can be formulated in the presence of singular components. Mass Indices help characterise how Bayesian updating changes local mass: (1) power-log likelihood factors shift it explicitly, and (2) parameter-dependent supports, or their smooth softenings, may change the local scale through the amount of mass that remains near the parameter value. Using local RE-KL, we prove absolute, relative, and directional inequalities for comparing local small-ball masses under the two KL directions. Together, these results provide a local theoretical account of local mass behaviour. Experiments provide controlled illustrations of the local behaviour. Code is available at https://github.com/Forsythia0604/Local-Mass-Framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究贝叶斯推断中全局目标（如KL散度、ELBO）无法直接捕获的局部质量行为。引入两个数学工具：质量指数（Mass Index）记录局部质量的幂律和对数衰减尺度，以及正则化扩展KL（RE-KL）——一种可在奇异成分存在时构造的集合局部化散度。利用局部RE-KL证明了比较局部小质量球的绝对、相对和方向性不等式，为局部质量行为提供了理论解释。实验提供了受控说明。
Motivation: 全局散度目标（如KL散度、ELBO）在贝叶斯推断中广泛使用，但它们无法直接反映局部质量行为，而局部行为对理解参数空间中的精细结构至关重要。
Method: 提出质量指数（Mass Index）和正则化扩展KL（RE-KL）两个工具。质量指数用于记录局部质量的幂律和对数衰减尺度；RE-KL是一种可处理奇异成分的集合局部化散度。利用这些工具推导局部小质量球的比较不等式。
Result: 证明了绝对、相对和方向性不等式，用于比较两个KL方向下的局部小质量球质量。实验提供了局部行为的受控说明。
Conclusion: 该工作为贝叶斯推断中的局部质量行为提供了理论框架，但实验仅限于受控场景，实际应用中的有效性有待进一步验证。

papers.title: TMP: Tree-structured Mixed-policy Pruning for Large-scale Image Generation and Editing
papers.abstract_en: Modern image generation model rapidly grows their sizes to meet high-fidelity image synthesis. However, they gradually become unaffordable for their enormous parameter consumption and computation budget that lead to massive resources requirement and gpu memory footprint. In this paper, we propose TMP, the first Tree-structured Mixed-policy Pruning framework that generalizes prevalent image tasks (T2I and TI2I) and architectures (Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) and Diffusion transformer (DiT)). It could be applied to the step-distilled models and contribute as the last stage. We perform experiments upon current open-sourced SOTA HunyuanImage-3.0 instruct and a popular efficient model Z-Image turbo. The proposed pruning framework manages to compress HunyuanImage 3.0 from 80B to 20B parameters at 75% reduction ratio, sacrificing limited generation quality. We also optimize to enable the inference of the pruned 20B version of HunyuanImage 3.0 on a single 24GB 4090 GPU by engineering skills. The inference script and model weight have been integrated into the existing HunyuanImage3.0 open-source github and huggingface repository. Besides, we prove the efficacy of TMP by compressing Z-Image turbo from 6B to 4B (33% reduction) with negligible degradation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TMP，首个树结构混合策略剪枝框架，适用于大规模图像生成和编辑任务（T2I 和 TI2I），支持混合专家（MoE）和扩散 Transformer（DiT）架构。在 HunyuanImage-3.0 上实现 80B 到 20B 的 75% 参数压缩，在 Z-Image turbo 上实现 6B 到 4B 的 33% 压缩，质量损失有限。
Motivation: 现代图像生成模型参数和计算成本急剧增长，导致资源需求和 GPU 内存占用过高，亟需有效的剪枝方法以降低部署门槛。
Method: 提出树结构混合策略剪枝框架 TMP，可应用于步骤蒸馏模型，通过树形结构组织和混合剪枝策略，同时兼容 MoE 和 DiT 架构。
Result: 在 HunyuanImage-3.0 上从 80B 压缩至 20B（75% 压缩比），质量损失有限；在 Z-Image turbo 上从 6B 压缩至 4B（33% 压缩），性能退化可忽略。
Conclusion: TMP 能显著压缩大规模图像生成模型，支持在单张 24GB 4090 GPU 上运行 20B 模型，已集成至开源仓库。

papers.title: SubdivAR: Autoregressive Next-Scale Prediction for Neural Mesh Subdivision
papers.abstract_en: Mesh subdivision is a fundamental operation for converting coarse, editable meshes into high-resolution surfaces, with broad applications in digital asset creation. Classical rule-based schemes rely on fixed local refinement rules and often produce over-smoothed surfaces. Recent neural subdivision methods improve detail synthesis, but remain constrained by local modeling and exhibit limited generalizability. We present SubdivAR, a neural mesh subdivision framework based on our proposed Mesh Autoregressive Representation (MAR). MAR arranges meshes at different subdivision levels into an ordered scale sequence, reformulating subdivision as autoregressive next-scale prediction. To support this formulation, we introduce a Hybrid Topology-Aware Transformer that combines global semantic attention with topology-constrained local feature aggregation. SubdivAR adopts a next-scale coordinate prediction paradigm, regressing vertex offsets at each refinement stage to preserve subdivision topology while recovering fine-grained geometric details. To enable reliable learning, we construct FII-40K, a curated dataset of nearly 40,000 high-quality meshes with multi-level subdivision supervision. Experiments show that SubdivAR outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, reducing Hausdorff Distance and Chamfer Distance by 18.8% and 14.2%, respectively, and demonstrates strong robustness on complex open-surface geometries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SubdivAR 是一种基于自回归下尺度预测的神经网格细分框架，通过提出的网格自回归表示（MAR）将细分任务转化为有序尺度序列的自回归预测，并引入混合拓扑感知 Transformer 结合全局语义注意力和拓扑约束局部特征聚合。在自建的 FII-40K 数据集上，该方法在 Hausdorff 距离和 Chamfer 距离上分别比现有最优方法降低 18.8% 和 14.2%，并在复杂开放曲面几何上表现出强鲁棒性。
Motivation: 传统规则基细分方法依赖固定局部规则，易产生过平滑表面；现有神经细分方法受限于局部建模且泛化能力有限，需要更有效的全局与拓扑感知的细分方案。
Method: 提出 Mesh Autoregressive Representation (MAR) 将不同细分层次的网格组织为有序尺度序列，将细分重新定义为自回归下尺度预测；设计 Hybrid Topology-Aware Transformer，融合全局语义注意力与拓扑约束的局部特征聚合；采用下尺度坐标预测范式，在每次细化阶段回归顶点偏移以保持细分拓扑并恢复细粒度几何细节。
Result: 在 FII-40K 数据集上，SubdivAR 相比最先进基线降低 Hausdorff 距离 18.8% 和 Chamfer 距离 14.2%，并在复杂开放曲面几何上表现强鲁棒性。
Conclusion: SubdivAR 通过自回归下尺度预测和拓扑感知 Transformer 有效提升了神经网格细分的细节合成能力和泛化性，但当前方法依赖于多级细分监督数据，未来可探索无监督或弱监督扩展。

papers.title: Pseudo-Text-Conditioned 3D Grounding DINO for Organ Localization in Abdominal CT
papers.abstract_en: Reliable organ localization in abdominal CT can provide spatial priors for downstream trauma analysis. We propose CT-3GDINO, a lightweight 3D detector that adapts a Grounding-DINO-style query-based architecture to fixed organ localization using frozen pseudo-text class tokens instead of a real text encoder. The model combines a Swin3D visual backbone, bidirectional feature enhancement, pseudo-text-guided query selection, and a cross-modality decoder to predict normalized 3D boxes for liver, spleen, left kidney, right kidney, and bowel. We train and evaluate on 193 matched RSNA/RATIC CT volumes with segmentation-derived boxes. The best multi-scale model, trained from scratch, achieves 0.5830 overall top-1 class-wise mAP over 3D IoU thresholds from 0.1 to 0.7, outperforming fixed- and trainable-backbone classification-pretrained variants with 0.5570 and 0.4657 mAP. Performance is strong for coarse localization, with 0.9649 AP at IoU 0.1, but remains limited for strict box alignment, with 0.1552 AP at IoU 0.7. These results establish CT-3GDINO as an open-source baseline for pseudo-text-conditioned 3D organ localization and motivate future work on localization-aware pretraining, richer multimodal conditioning, and injury-focused detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CT-3GDINO，一个轻量级 3D 检测器，用于腹部 CT 中的器官定位。该方法将 Grounding-DINO 的查询架构适配到固定器官定位，使用冻结的伪文本类标记代替真实文本编码器，结合 Swin3D 视觉骨干、双向特征增强和跨模态解码器。在 193 个 CT 体积上训练后，最佳模型在 3D IoU 阈值 0.1-0.7 上达到 0.5830 top-1 class-wise mAP，粗定位性能优异（IoU 0.1 时 AP 0.9649），但严格对齐仍有限（IoU 0.7 时 AP 0.1552）。该工作作为伪文本条件 3D 器官定位的开源基线。
Motivation: 可靠的腹部 CT 器官定位可为下游创伤分析提供空间先验。现有 3D 检测器多依赖真实文本编码器，本文探索用伪文本类令牌简化跨模态条件，降低模型复杂度。
Method: 提出 CT-3GDINO，基于 Grounding-DINO 的查询架构：使用 Swin3D 作为视觉骨干，通过双向特征增强融合多尺度特征，利用冻结的伪文本类令牌引导查询选择，最后由跨模态解码器输出归一化 3D 框。训练时从零开始，无需分类预训练。
Result: 在 193 个 RSNA/RATIC CT 体积上，最佳多尺度模型（从头训练）的 top-1 class-wise mAP 在 IoU 0.1-0.7 上为 0.5830，优于固定骨干预训练（0.5570）和可训练骨干预训练（0.4657）变体。粗定位效果强（IoU 0.1 时 AP 0.9649），但严格框对齐差（IoU 0.7 时 AP 0.1552）。
Conclusion: CT-3GDINO 可作为伪文本条件 3D 器官定位的简单开源基线，粗定位可靠但精确对齐不足，未来需研究定位感知预训练、更丰富的多模态条件以及损伤检测。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Finding Stationary Points by Comparisons
papers.abstract_en: We study the problem of finding stationary points of non-convex functions when access to the objective is provided only through a comparison oracle that, given two points, outputs which has the larger function value. For a twice differentiable $f\colon\mathbb R^n\to\mathbb R$ with Lipschitz gradient and Hessian, we develop an algorithm that visits an $ε$-stationary point using $\widetilde O(n^2/ε^{1.5})$ queries. Our approach uses a subroutine that estimates the normalized Hessian to accuracy $δ$ using $\widetilde O(n^2\log(1/δ))$ queries. We further study this problem with a quantum comparison oracle model where queries can be made in superpositions, and develop the first quantum algorithm that finds an $ε$-stationary point, which takes $\widetilde O(n/ε^{1.5})$ queries.
papers.comment: 41 pages, 4 figures. To appear in the Forty-Third International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在仅能通过比较预言机（给定两点返回函数值较大者）访问目标函数时，如何寻找非凸函数的平稳点。针对二阶可微且梯度与Hessian Lipschitz连续的函数，提出一种算法，使用O~(n^2/ε^{1.5})次查询即可达到ε-平稳点。进一步，在量子比较预言机模型下，首次提出量子算法，查询复杂度为O~(n/ε^{1.5})。
Motivation: 实际优化问题中有时无法直接获得梯度或函数值，只能通过成对比较获得相对信息。现有工作缺乏对比较预言机下非凸优化平稳点寻找的理论保证。
Method: 开发一个子程序用于估计归一化Hessian矩阵（精度δ，查询复杂度O~(n^2 log(1/δ))），并基于此设计主算法；在量子模型中，利用量子叠加态查询实现加速。
Result: 经典算法达到O~(n^2/ε^{1.5})查询复杂度，量子算法达到O~(n/ε^{1.5})，均实现ε-平稳点。
Conclusion: 该工作首次在比较预言机下系统研究非凸优化平稳点问题，并给出量子加速版本，但仅适用于二阶光滑函数，且查询复杂度仍高于梯度方法。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: 本文研究在仅能通过比较预言机（给定两点返回函数值较大者）访问目标函数时，如何寻找非凸函数的平稳点。针对二阶可微且梯度与Hessian Lipschitz连续的函数，提出一种算法，使用O~(n^2/ε^{1.5})次查询即可达到ε-平稳点。进一步，在量子比较预言机模型下，首次提出量子算法，查询复杂度为O~(n/ε^{1.5})。
summary_sections.motivation: 实际优化问题中有时无法直接获得梯度或函数值，只能通过成对比较获得相对信息。现有工作缺乏对比较预言机下非凸优化平稳点寻找的理论保证。
summary_sections.method: 开发一个子程序用于估计归一化Hessian矩阵（精度δ，查询复杂度O~(n^2 log(1/δ))），并基于此设计主算法；在量子模型中，利用量子叠加态查询实现加速。
summary_sections.result: 经典算法达到O~(n^2/ε^{1.5})查询复杂度，量子算法达到O~(n/ε^{1.5})，均实现ε-平稳点。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该工作首次在比较预言机下系统研究非凸优化平稳点问题，并给出量子加速版本，但仅适用于二阶光滑函数，且查询复杂度仍高于梯度方法。

papers.title: PanoImager: Geometry-Guided Novel View Synthesis and Reconstruction from Sparse Panoramic Views
papers.abstract_en: Panoramic sensing offers wide field-of-view coverage, yet 3D reconstruction from sparse panoramas remains challenging under rotation-dominant, weak-parallax motion. In such regimes, SfM/SLAM initialization is often ill-conditioned and unreliable. We present PanoImager, an SfM-free framework that combines feed-forward pose/depth priors, geometry-conditioned diffusion view completion, and depth-guided 3DGS optimization. Given only a few panoramic images, PanoImager decomposes them into local perspective views, synthesizes auxiliary observations to enrich sparse evidence, and stabilizes Gaussian optimization for improved cross-view consistency. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show improved stability under extreme sparsity, suggesting PanoImager as an offline/background component for map refinement when SfM/SLAM fails to initialize.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对稀疏全景图在旋转主导、弱视差运动下SfM/SLAM初始化不可靠的问题，提出PanoImager框架，该框架无需SfM，结合前馈姿态/深度先验、几何条件扩散视图补全和深度引导3DGS优化，通过将全景分解为局部透视视图并合成辅助观测，稳定高斯优化以增强跨视图一致性。实验表明在极端稀疏条件下重建稳定性显著提升。
Motivation: 稀疏全景图在旋转主导、弱视差运动下，传统SfM/SLAM初始化条件不良且不可靠，导致3D重建困难。
Method: 提出PanoImager，一种免SfM框架，包括前馈姿态/深度先验、几何条件扩散模型进行视图补全，以及深度引导的3D高斯泼溅优化。具体将全景图像分解为局部透视图，合成辅助观测来增强稀疏证据，并稳定高斯优化。
Result: 在多个基准上的实验表明，PanoImager在极端稀疏条件下具有更好的稳定性。
Conclusion: 该框架可作为SfM/SLAM初始化失败时的离线或背景地图精炼组件。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Parametric Open Source Games
papers.abstract_en: Open-source game theory studies agents whose behavior may depend on one another's decision procedures, but most existing models use discrete or symbolic programs. We introduce parametric open-source games, a continuous analogue of program equilibria in which players choose parameter vectors and semantics maps convert the full parameter profile into mixed actions in an underlying finite game. We establish equilibrium existence results, derive an exact coupling threshold at which selfish gradient ascent in symmetric $2\times2$ games switches from defection toward cooperation, and give a one-dimensional boundary test for parametric program Nash equilibria. We further extend the framework to a neural semantics class whose first-order cooperation condition is governed by the ratio of cross-player to self-player sensitivity. Across canonical games, the framework shows how access to internal parameterizations can qualitatively reshape learning dynamics and equilibrium structure, and how sufficiently strong open-source coupling can steer selfish optimization toward cooperative outcomes.
papers.comment: ICML Workshop New Frontiers in Game-Theoretic Learning-NExT-Game
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出参数化开源游戏（parametric open-source games），将博弈论中的开源游戏概念连续化：玩家选择参数向量，通过语义映射将全体参数向量转化为底层有限博弈的混合行动。论文证明了均衡存在性，推导了对称2×2博弈中自私梯度上升从背叛转向合作的精确耦合阈值，并给出了参数化程序纳什均衡的一维边界检验。在神经网络语义类上，一阶合作条件由跨玩家敏感度与自身敏感度的比率控制。该框架展示了内部参数化如何重塑学习动态和均衡结构，以及足够强的开源耦合如何引导自私优化走向合作结果。
Motivation: 现有开源博弈论模型多使用离散或符号程序，缺乏连续参数化表示，限制了在高维连续策略空间中的理论分析。本文旨在填补这一空白，建立一类连续参数化博弈模型。
Method: 提出参数化开源游戏框架：玩家选择连续参数向量，通过语义映射（semantics map）将全体参数向量转换为底层有限博弈的混合行动。文中分析了梯度动态的耦合阈值，并针对对称2×2博弈推导了合作转向条件。
Result: 摘要报告了均衡存在性定理，给出了对称2×2博弈中自私梯度上升从背叛转向合作的精确耦合阈值，以及一维边界检验。对于神经网络语义类，合作条件由跨玩家与自身敏感度之比决定。
Conclusion: 该框架表明，内部参数化可以定性重塑学习动态和均衡结构，而足够强的开源耦合能使自私优化导向合作结果。局限或范围未在摘要中明确提及。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: How to evaluate clustering with ground truth?
papers.abstract_en: External indexes can be used for cluster evaluation when ground truth is available. We review the most common external validity indexes focusing on set-matching-based measures. We recommend centroid index (CI), because it is an intuitive cluster-level measure with an explainable result. If we need a more fine-tuned, point-level measure, there are more choices. Pair-set index (PSI) provides a normalized score which is not biased by cluster sizes. If all points should matter equally, then clustering accuracy (ACC) or any other set-matching measure is suitable.
papers.comment: Preprint of a book chapter to appear: P. Fränti, "How to evaluate clustering with ground truth?", In Center-based clustering, Springer Nature, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文是《Center-based clustering》书中的一章，综述了基于真实标签（ground truth）的外部聚类评估指标，重点介绍基于集合匹配的度量。作者推荐质心指数（CI）作为直观的聚类级指标，并讨论了其他点级指标如对集指数（PSI）和聚类准确率（ACC）的适用场景。
Motivation: 聚类评估在真实标签可用时依赖外部指标，但现有指标众多且各有偏向，缺乏清晰的推荐指南。
Method: 综述并比较了常见的外部聚类有效性指标，特别是基于集合匹配的方法，通过理论分析和示例说明不同指标的性质。
Result: 推荐使用质心指数（CI）作为首选聚类级指标，因其直观且结果可解释；若需要更精细的点级度量，推荐对集指数（PSI）可提供无偏于簇大小的归一化分数。
Conclusion: 选择何种指标取决于具体需求：聚类级分析用CI，点级分析若要求公平则用PSI，若所有点等权则用ACC等集合匹配度量。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: NuclearQAv2: A Structured Benchmark for Evaluating Domain-Science Competence in Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance across a wide range of tasks, but ensuring their reliability in highly technical domains remains a significant challenge. In nuclear engineering, problem solving often requires not only factual knowledge but also quantitative reasoning and conceptual understanding. To address the need for systematic evaluation in this domain, we introduce NuclearQAv2, a benchmark for assessing LLMs on nuclear engineering knowledge. The benchmark comprises approximately 1,240 question-answer pairs spanning three categories: boolean, numeric, and verbal. NuclearQAv2 is constructed using a hybrid pipeline that combines expert-authored questions, existing datasets, and LLM-assisted generation from domain-specific technical corpora. By leveraging structured prompting for both automated question generation and response evaluation, the proposed framework enables scalable benchmark construction and evaluation. We evaluate a diverse set of LLMs using NuclearQAv2 and observe substantial performance differences across task types. While the models generally perform well on factual questions, quantitative reasoning and conceptual understanding remain considerably more challenging. These results highlight the importance of multi-faceted evaluation frameworks and establish NuclearQAv2 as a scalable benchmark for assessing LLM capabilities in technical domains.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NuclearQAv2 基准，用于评估大语言模型在核工程领域的知识掌握能力。该基准包含约 1,240 个问答对，涵盖布尔、数值和文字三类，通过混合管道（专家编写、现有数据集、LLM 辅助生成）构建。评估发现模型在事实性问题表现良好，但在定量推理和概念理解上仍面临挑战。
Motivation: 核工程领域的问题解决不仅需要事实知识，还需要定量推理和概念理解，但现有缺乏系统评估 LLM 在该领域能力的基准。
Method: 采用混合管道构建基准：结合专家编写的问题、现有数据集和基于领域技术语料的 LLM 辅助生成；同时使用结构化提示进行自动化问题生成和响应评估。
Result: 在 NuclearQAv2 上评估多种 LLM，发现模型在事实性问题表现良好，但定量推理和概念理解仍显著困难。
Conclusion: 多面评估框架对于评估 LLM 在技术领域的能力至关重要，NuclearQAv2 作为一个可扩展的基准可用于此目的。

papers.title: The Spec Growth Engine: Spec-Anchored, Code-Coupled, Drift-Enforced Architecture for AI-Assisted Software Development
papers.abstract_en: AI coding agents dramatically accelerate implementation speed but introduce two structural failure modes that existing spec-driven approaches do not fully solve: (1) context explosion -- the agent must reason over an entire repository at once, degrading output quality as the context window fills; and (2) silent spec-code drift -- code evolves, the specification does not, and the divergence becomes invisible until it is costly to repair. We present the Spec Growth Engine, a lightweight framework that addresses both failure modes through a machine-readable spec graph whose nodes carry explicit contract/design separation, a Spine context assembler that scopes agent context to an ownership path, a vertical-slice growth protocol that enforces hardest-first ordering, and a drift gate that makes spec-code divergence a blocking merge condition. The design synthesises well-established software engineering principles (Parnas information hiding, C4, ADRs, Walking Skeleton, Reflexion Models, Fitness Functions) into a lean, code-coupled, machine-enforced whole -- without the overhead of heavy-weight frameworks such as RUP or MDA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Spec Growth Engine，一个轻量级框架，通过机器可读的spec图、Spine上下文组装器、垂直切片增长协议和漂移门，解决AI编码代理中上下文爆炸和spec-code静默漂移两个结构性问题。
Motivation: 现有AI编码代理存在上下文爆炸和spec-code漂移问题，导致输出质量下降和修复成本高昂。
Method: 提出一种包含spec图、Spine上下文组装器、垂直切片增长协议和漂移门的轻量级框架，整合Parnas信息隐藏、C4、ADR等软件工程原则。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验结果，仅描述框架设计。
Conclusion: 该框架通过机器可读的spec图和代码耦合机制，强制spec-code一致性，避免重量级框架开销。

papers.title: State Representation Matters in Deep Reinforcement Learning: Application to Energy Trading
papers.abstract_en: Energy trading decisions depend not only on current market prices, but also on expected future market conditions, and operational constraints. This makes the state representation given to a reinforcement learning agent an important design choice. We study this in HydroDam, a pumped-storage arbitrage environment, using a fixed Double DQN agent. The environment, action space, reward function, network, and training protocol are kept fixed; only the market features are changed. We compare absolute price/calendar features, relative features that compare current prices with recent market history, forecast features, and all combinations of these three feature families. Policies are trained and selected using 2007--2011 Belgian day-ahead prices and evaluated on two test settings: a later same-market test set from 2012--2025 and 39 other ENTSO-E market zones. Absolute features only reaches 28.8% on the test set and a median 5.7% across zones. Relative-only and forecast-only states also stay below a rolling price-score heuristic in the cross-zone median. Combining feature families is much stronger: absolute + relative reaches 49.9% on the test set and a 39.8% cross-zone median, while absolute + relative + forecast reaches 55.6% and 47.5%. These results suggest that state representation is not a minor preprocessing choice in storage-trading RL, but a central part of the policy design: robust transfer requires combining price scale, recent relative price context, and short-horizon forecast information, rather than relying on any single feature family.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在抽水蓄能套利环境HydroDam中，固定Double DQN智能体，系统比较了不同状态表示（绝对价格特征、相对特征、预测特征及其组合）对策略性能的影响。实验表明，组合特征（绝对+相对+预测）在测试集和跨市场泛化中显著优于单一特征，说明状态表示是深度强化学习用于能源交易的关键设计因素。
Motivation: 能源交易决策依赖当前价格和未来市场条件及运行约束，状态表示的选择至关重要，但此前缺乏系统性的比较研究。
Method: 在HydroDam环境中，保持智能体架构、动作空间、奖励函数和训练协议不变，仅改变市场特征（绝对、相对、预测及其组合），使用2007-2011年比利时日前价格训练，并在2012-2025同一市场及其他39个ENTSO-E区域测试。
Result: 绝对特征测试集仅28.8%，跨市场中位5.7%；绝对+相对达到49.9%和39.8%；绝对+相对+预测达到55.6%和47.5%，超过滚动价格启发式基准。
Conclusion: 状态表示是存储交易强化学习的核心环节，稳健的跨市场迁移需要同时包含价格尺度、近期相对价格和短期预测信息。

papers.title: Symplectic Neural Networks for learning Generalized Hamiltonians
papers.abstract_en: Hamiltonian Neural Networks (HNNs) integrate physical priors into neural models by learning a system's Hamiltonian, improving generalization and sample efficiency. Identifying the system Hamiltonian from noisy observations of state variables is a challenging task. For simulations to faithfully reflect the long-term behavior of Hamiltonian systems, especially energy conservation, it is essential to use symplectic integrators, which preserve the system's geometric structure. This fidelity comes at a cost: implicit symplectic integrators are more computationally intensive and make backpropagation through the ODE solver non-trivial. However, by leveraging the fact that symplectic discretizations of the adjoint system yield the same sensitivities associated by backpropagation, we obtain an efficient method of training the Neural Network parameters. In our work, we explore this alternate method of HNN training under noisy observation of trajectories with our HNN model based on an implicit symplectic integrator. Computationally, a predictor-corrector based ODE solver and fixed point iteration help to mitigate the computational cost of the implicit timestepping, resulting in more efficient generation of gradient updates. We showcase the numerical advantage, in experiments, in system identification and energy preservation on a range of non-separable, chaotic systems and the efficient computation and memory complexity of our method. We also observe that the post-processing of the learned Hamiltonian using backward error analysis yields a modified Hamiltonian that is a more accurate approximation of the true Hamiltonian without the need to use more accurate discretizations of the flow map.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于隐式辛积分器的哈密顿神经网络（HNN）训练方法，利用伴随系统的辛离散化与反向传播的等价性实现高效梯度计算，并通过预测-校正ODE求解器和不动点迭代降低隐式时间步进的计算成本。实验表明该方法在非可分混沌系统的系统辨识和能量守恒方面具有数值优势，且通过后向误差分析可得到更精确的修正哈密顿量。
Motivation: 从带噪声的状态变量观测中识别系统哈密顿量具有挑战性；传统HNN使用显式积分器可能破坏辛结构，而隐式辛积分器计算成本高且反向传播复杂。
Method: 利用伴随系统的辛离散化与反向传播的等价性来训练HNN参数，结合预测-校正ODE求解器和不动点迭代以减少隐式时间步进的计算开销。
Result: 在非可分混沌系统上，该方法在系统辨识和能量守恒方面优于基线，且计算和内存复杂度更低。后向误差分析得到的修正哈密顿量比直接学习更准确。
Conclusion: 所提方法为学习哈密顿系统提供了一种高效且几何保结构的训练范式，尤其适用于长时间模拟和能量守恒要求高的场景。

papers.title: ShareLock: A Stealthy Multi-Tool Threshold Poisoning Attack Against MCP
papers.abstract_en: With the rapid evolution of LLM-driven agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP), an open protocol bridging LLMs with external tools, has quickly become foundational to modern agent ecosystems. However, the expanding adoption of MCP has also introduced novel security concerns such as Tool Poisoning Attack (TPA), which exploit LLM-server interactions to inject malicious prompts. Existing poisoning schemes typically adopt a monolithic plaintext embedding paradigm, which fails to withstand manual inspection or automated detectors. Current research still lacks a systematic analysis on multi-tool poisoning, where multiple tools can be exploited cooperatively to disperse detection risk. In this paper, we introduce ShareLock, a multi-tool threshold poisoning framework that utilizes Shamir's threshold scheme to ensure exceptional stealth and fault tolerance. ShareLock distributes the malicious instruction as benign-looking secret shares across multiple tool descriptions, achieving both information-theoretic secrecy and attack robustness against moderate auditing. After a covert reconstruction trigger is planted during server update, the aggregated shares reconstruct the hidden instruction, resulting in critical breaches of system assets or private data. To evaluate the realistic threat of ShareLock, we constructed a comprehensive benchmark encompassing four multi-tool scenarios and conducted extensive experiments across mainstream LLMs on two distinct MCP clients. Our results demonstrate that ShareLock significantly outperforms existing single-tool poisoning strategies in tool description-based detection while maintaining an average attack success rate exceeding 90%.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ShareLock，一种基于Shamir阈值方案的多工具阈值投毒攻击框架，针对LLM驱动的代理中的MCP协议。该框架将恶意指令分割为多个看似无害的秘密份额，分布到多个工具描述中，实现信息论上的保密性和抗审查鲁棒性，在服务器更新时植入隐蔽重构触发器后，聚合份额重建隐藏指令，导致系统资产或私密数据泄露。实验表明ShareLock在工具描述检测上优于现有单工具投毒策略，平均攻击成功率超过90%。
Motivation: 现有工具投毒攻击（TPA）采用单一明文嵌入范式，无法抵御人工审查或自动检测；缺乏对多工具协同投毒的系统分析，即利用多个工具分散检测风险。
Method: 提出ShareLock框架，利用Shamir阈值方案将恶意指令分割为秘密份额，分布到多个工具描述中，在服务器更新时植入隐蔽重构触发器，攻击者通过聚合份额重建指令。
Result: 在包含四种多工具场景的基准测试中，跨主流LLM和两个MCP客户端进行实验，ShareLock在工具描述检测上显著优于现有单工具投毒策略，平均攻击成功率超过90%。
Conclusion: ShareLock展示了多工具阈值投毒的有效性和隐蔽性，但未提及防御措施；局限性在于需要攻击者能够控制多个工具描述和服务器更新流程。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Just how sure are you? Improving Verbalized Uncertainty Calibration in Medical VQA
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) applied to Medical Visual Question Answering (VQA) tend to produce overconfident outputs regardless of actual correctness, and existing verbalized confidence calibration methods, developed primarily for text only LLMs, do not account for the multimodal nature of medical image understanding. This work proposes a training based framework that finetunes MLLMs to improve their calibration using a composite loss function combining a Brier style calibration term, an anchor regularizer that prevents confidence collapse toward extreme values, a contrastive image text alignment term, and a KL based model stabilization term. The alignment signal is derived from a $2 \times 2$ factorial perturbation design that crosses image presence with text integrity, probing the reliance of the model on visual modality input versus language priors. Finally, a top K KL divergence regularizer is used to protect the answering ability of the model during finetuning. Across three Medical VQA benchmarks and two architectures (MedGemma 4B IT and Qwen2 VL 7B Instruct), our method reduces calibration error by 60% or more, and improves discrimination by 26% or more, while preserving predictive accuracy. On average across benchmarks, the technique outperforms prompting based, sampling based, and training based approaches, and ablation experiments confirm that each component of the loss function is indeed necessary for improving the calibration. All code for the experiments is publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对医学视觉问答（Medical VQA）中多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）过度自信的问题，提出一种基于训练的校准框架。该框架使用复合损失函数，包括Brier型校准项、锚定正则化（防止置信度极端化）、对比图文对齐项（通过2×2因子扰动设计：图像存在与否×文本完整性）、基于KL的模型稳定性项以及top-K KL散度正则化（保护回答能力）。在三个医学VQA基准和两种架构（MedGemma 4B IT、Qwen2 VL 7B Instruct）上，校准误差降低60%以上，判别力提升26%以上，同时保持预测准确率，优于现有的基于提示、采样和训练的方法。消融实验表明每个损失组件对校准都是必要的。代码已公开。
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型在医学VQA中往往输出过度自信的结果，而现有的言语化置信度校准方法主要针对纯文本LLM，未考虑医学图像理解的多模态特性。
Method: 提出一个训练框架，使用复合损失函数微调MLLM，包括Brier型校准项、锚定正则化、基于2×2因子扰动（图像存在×文本完整性）的对比图文对齐项、KL模型稳定项以及top-K KL散度正则化。
Result: 在三个医学VQA基准（MedGemma 4B IT和Qwen2 VL 7B Instruct）上，校准误差降低60%以上，判别力提升26%以上，预测准确率保持不变，性能优于基于提示、采样和训练的方法。
Conclusion: 每个损失组件对校准都是必要的，且框架在多个架构和基准上均有效代码已公开。

papers.title: On-board Remote-Sensing Foundation Models for Unsupervised Change Detection of Disaster Events
papers.abstract_en: Remote Sensing Foundation Models (RSFMs) have emerged as a powerful alternative to supervised models for Earth Observation, allowing satellites to autonomously trigger high-resolution captures or adjust tasking parameters upon detecting an anomaly, thereby maximizing the utility of the mission's limited power and computational resources. RSFMs are versatile, unified encoders that optimize onboard storage for multiple orbital applications while ensuring high-fidelity feature extraction. In particular, unsupervised change detection with RSFMs offers a well-informed and transformative path for disaster monitoring without expensive labels. In this paper, we present a novel unsupervised detection method based on ResNet (RSFM) + FPN which identifies a wide spectrum of anomalies by detecting subtle semantic shifts in the latent space between successive orbital passes. By relying on an untrained FPN architecture and its intrinsic priors, the system achieves efficient image-level generation and higher resolution mapping with minimal effort (training-free) compared to previous proposals (patch-based, trained). And by replacing tailored models with RSFMs, we can achieve comparable results through an approach that eliminates the need for bespoke training and extensive development effort and adds customization, while ensuring high-performance generalization across diverse terrains and sensors.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于ResNet（RSFM）+FPN的无监督变化检测方法，用于卫星在轨处理，无需标注即可识别灾害事件。该方法利用未训练的FPN架构和内在先验，实现无训练的高分辨率映射，并替换定制模型，在多种地形和传感器上保持高性能泛化。
Motivation: 传统监督变化检测需要昂贵标注，而遥感基础模型（RSFM）可作为统一编码器，但如何高效进行无监督检测仍需探索。
Method: 基于ResNet（RSFM）+FPN的架构，通过检测连续轨道通过之间潜在空间的语义偏移来识别异常，FPN未训练，利用内在先验实现高效生成和高分辨率映射。
Result: 摘要声称与之前基于补丁、需训练的方法相比，本方法无需训练即可生成图像级结果，并达到可比性能，同时避免定制训练和开发努力。
Conclusion: 本文方法通过RSFM替代定制模型，消除对特定训练的需求，并在多种地形和传感器上实现高性能泛化。

papers.title: A Generalization Theory for JEPA-Based World Models
papers.abstract_en: Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for world modeling by learning predictive dynamics in a latent space rather than generating future observations at the input level. Despite their empirical success, the theoretical understanding of JEPA-based world models remains limited. In this paper, we develop the first generalization theory for JEPA-based world models. We formulate JEPA pretraining as a conditional spectral graph learning problem and show that the JEPA objective is equivalent to a low-rank factorization of an action-conditioned co-occurrence matrix. Building on this characterization, we establish a connection between JEPA pretraining error and downstream planning regret, leading to a finite-sample generalization bound for JEPA-based world models. Our analysis reveals an inherent trade-off between approximation and sample errors with respect to the latent dimension, providing theoretical insights into the advantages and limitations of latent predictive models compared with input-level predictive approaches.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次为基于联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的世界模型建立了泛化理论。作者将JEPA预训练形式化为条件谱图学习问题，证明JEPA目标等价于对动作条件共现矩阵进行低秩分解，并在此基础上推导出预训练误差与下游规划遗憾之间的有限样本泛化界。分析揭示了潜在维度上近似误差与样本误差之间的固有权衡，从理论上阐明了潜在预测模型相较于输入级预测方法的优势与局限。
Motivation: 尽管JEPA在世界建模中取得了经验成功，但其理论基础——尤其是泛化性能的保证——仍然缺乏。
Method: 将JEPA预训练重新表述为条件谱图学习，证明其目标等价于动作条件共现矩阵的低秩分解，进而建立预训练误差与规划遗憾之间的联系，并导出有限样本泛化界。
Result: 推导出JEPA世界模型的泛化界，揭示了潜在维度选择中近似误差与样本误差之间的权衡，并提供了对潜在预测模型优势与局限的理论洞察。
Conclusion: 该理论为JEPA世界模型提供了首个泛化保证，有助于理解其内在特性，但未涉及具体应用领域（如气象）的适配性。

summary_sections.result: 推导出JEPA世界模型的泛化界，揭示了潜在维度选择中近似误差与样本误差之间的权衡，并提供了对潜在预测模型优势与局限的理论洞察。
summary_sections.conclusion: 该理论为JEPA世界模型提供了首个泛化保证，有助于理解其内在特性，但未涉及具体应用领域（如气象）的适配性。

papers.title: Semantic Early-Stopping for Iterative LLM Agent Loops
papers.abstract_en: Multi-agent large language model (LLM) loops, for example a Writer that drafts and a Critic that revises, are almost always terminated by a fixed iteration cap (max_iterations). This is a syntactic kill-switch: it is blind to whether the answer is still improving, so it over-spends tokens on easy inputs and truncates hard ones. We study semantic early-stopping: the loop halts when consecutive draft embeddings stop changing in meaning (cosine distance with a patience window) and the answer's measured quality stops improving. Our work makes three contributions. First, an honest theoretical footing: we prove deterministic termination and well-definedness and machine-check these claims, while treating the convergence of the distance sequence as an empirically tested conjecture rather than a (previously over-claimed) Banach contraction. Second, a judge-efficient evaluation protocol: we generate each question's full trajectory once, replay every stopping policy over the identical drafts, and cache every LLM-judge call, yielding a strictly paired efficiency-versus-quality comparison at low cost; we further separate operational tokens (charged to a policy) from evaluation tokens (a measurement instrument). Third, an empirical study on multi-hop retrieval-augmented question answering (HotpotQA). On the 60-question test split, a judge-free semantic stopper reduces operational tokens by 38% relative to max_iterations at parity quality (Delta-IS = -0.004, p = 0.81), whereas the full quality-gated variant is counter-productive because its per-round judging dominates cost. An oracle that selects the best round attains +0.115 Information Score over every practical policy (p ~ 4e-11), reframing the problem from "when to stop" (easy) to "which round is best" (open).
papers.comment: 7 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Open implementation, machine-checked theory, and reproducible harness: github.com/SahilShrivastava-Dev/semantic-halting-problem
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多代理LLM循环的语义早停问题，提出基于嵌入语义变化和答案质量改进的停机条件，理论上证明确定性终止，在HotpotQA上实验表明无评判器的语义停机能减少38%操作token且质量不变。
Motivation: 现有LLM代理循环使用固定迭代上限，浪费token且对难例不够充分，缺乏语义感知的停机制。
Method: 提出语义早停：连续草稿嵌入的余弦距离超过耐心窗口且答案质量不再改进时停止；提供理论证明和高效评估协议。
Result: 在HotpotQA上，无评判器语义停机相比固定上限减少38%操作token，质量持平；质量门控变体因评判开销而效果不佳；最优轮次Oracle比任何实际策略高出+0.115信息分数。
Conclusion: 语义早停在保持质量的同时节省token，但最优轮次选择问题比停机时机更具挑战性。

papers.title: Adaptive Utility driven Resource Orchestration for Resilient AI (AURORA-AI)
papers.abstract_en: Modern AI systems are increasingly deployed under non-stationary computational, demographic, and operational conditions in which static resource allocation strategies degrade both predictive performance and human-centric properties such as fairness and explainability. This paper presents AURORA-AI, an Adaptive Utility-driven Resource Orchestration framework for Resilient AI that unifies Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman feedback control, Lyapunov-based stability monitoring, and a fairness-aware composite utility into a single closed-loop policy.The framework continuously redistributes computational budget across a population of heterogeneous AI models so that the global utility, defined jointly over predictive performance, demographic parity, cost, latency, robustness, and interpretability, remains maximised under disruption. The framework is evaluated in a stress-rich discrete-time simulation that concurrently injects demographic bias shocks, gradual concept drift, and abrupt black-swan disruptions, and is compared against five established controllers including Static, Round Robin, Greedy, LinUCB, and a deep reinforcement-learning agent based on Proximal Policy Optimisation. AURORA-AI achieves immediate recovery from the black-swan event compared to eighty-eight time steps for the Static baseline and twenty-two for Proximal Policy Optimisation, lifts the alpha-quantile and the super-quantile by twenty-nine and twenty-five percent respectively, simultaneously reduces the mean and maximum demographic parity gap, and increases the fraction of Lyapunov-stable operating steps. These results indicate that fairness-aware adaptive orchestration grounded in stability theory is a practical and theoretically motivated path toward resilient human-centric AI deployment.
papers.comment: Accepted at IEEE Research and Technologies for Society and Industry 2026 conference
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出AURORA-AI框架，利用Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman反馈控制、Lyapunov稳定性监控和公平感知复合效用，在非平稳条件下动态分配计算资源，以最大化全局效用（包括预测性能、人口统计公平性、成本、延迟、鲁棒性和可解释性）。在模拟中，与静态、轮询、贪婪、LinUCB和PPO等控制器相比，AURORA-AI表现出快速从黑天鹅事件恢复、提升分位数、减少人口统计公平性差距等优势。
Motivation: 现代AI系统在非平稳条件下静态资源分配策略会导致预测性能下降和公平性、可解释性等以人为本的属性退化。
Method: 提出一个统一Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman反馈控制、Lyapunov稳定性监控和公平感知复合效用的闭环策略，持续在异构AI模型间重新分配计算预算。
Result: 在模拟中，AURORA-AI从黑天鹅事件立即恢复，而静态基线需要88步、PPO需要22步；将alpha分位数和超级分位数分别提升29%和25%；同时降低平均和最大人口统计公平性差距，增加Lyapunov稳定运行步数比例。
Conclusion: 结果表明，基于稳定性理论的公平感知自适应编排是实现有弹性的以人为本AI部署的实用且理论基础扎实的方案。

papers.title: Inverse Design of Compact and Wideband Inverted Doherty Power Amplifiers Using Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a deep learning-assisted methodology for the inverse synthesis of a compact, wideband inverted Doherty power amplifier (PA). Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and genetic algorithms (GAs) are jointly employed to generate pixelated Doherty combiner networks that integrate load modulation, impedance matching, power combining, and phase compensation into a single structure. As a proof of concept, we design and fabricate a GaN HEMT Doherty PA with a pixelated output combiner. The prototype achieves a measured peak drain efficiency of 51%-63% and a 6-dB back-off efficiency of 48%-54% over 1.9-2.5 GHz. Within the same frequency range, the measured output power is 44+/-0.3 dBm. Furthermore, with digital predistortion (DPD) applied, the prototype circuit demonstrates an adjacent channel leakage ratio (ACLR) better than -53.2 dBc.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于深度学习（CNN和遗传算法）的逆合成方法，用于设计紧凑、宽带的倒置Doherty功率放大器。该方法将负载调制、阻抗匹配、功率合成和相位补偿集成为像素化合路网络。基于GaN HEMT的样机在1.9-2.5 GHz频率范围内实现了峰值漏极效率51%-63%、6-dB回退效率48%-54%，输出功率44±0.3 dBm，且经数字预失真后邻道泄漏比优于-53.2 dBc。
Motivation: 现有Doherty功率放大器设计通常需要手动优化复杂的合路网络，难以同时实现紧凑结构、宽带宽和高效率。
Method: 联合使用卷积神经网络（CNN）和遗传算法（GA），通过逆合成方式生成像素化Doherty合路网络，该网络集成了负载调制、阻抗匹配、功率合成和相位补偿功能。
Result: 样机在1.9-2.5 GHz频段内测得峰值漏极效率51%-63%，6-dB回退效率48%-54%，输出功率44±0.3 dBm，数字预失真后ACLR优于-53.2 dBc。
Conclusion: 该方法能够高效设计紧凑型宽带倒置Doherty功率放大器，验证了深度学习在射频功率放大器逆向设计中的潜力。

papers.title: Uncertainty quantification via conformal prediction in data assimilation
papers.abstract_en: Quantifying the evolution of uncertainty is critical to both probabilistic forecasting and data assimilation in numerical weather prediction. In this study, we investigate the applicability of conformal prediction (CP), a recent machine learning (ML) method, to quantify uncertainty in a controlled, idealized setting. We use the one dimensional modified shallow water model, designed to mimic the convective process. CP provides a set of possible outcomes with a chosen confidence level. Here, we compare and evaluate the average empirical coverage, the average interval length, miss low, miss high and average interval score loss (AISL) for three variants of CP, namely a) Standard CP, b) Normalized CP and c) Conformalized Quantile Regression. We further compare these CP-based uncertainty estimates with traditional ensemble-based measures such as standard deviation intervals and ensemble spread. In addition, we investigate the integration of CP-derived uncertainty within the data assimilation cycle through CP perturbations. Our results highlight the strengths and limitations of each approach, providing insight into the effectiveness of CP to complement common ensemble-based uncertainty quantification in simplified atmospheric models.
papers.comment: Submitted to Quarterly Journal of the Royal Meteorological Society
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨将保形预测（CP）这一机器学习方法应用于数值天气预报中的数据同化不确定性量化。在一维修正浅水模型（模拟对流过程）上，比较了标准CP、归一化CP和保形分位数回归三种变体，并与传统集合方法（如标准差区间和集合离散度）进行对比。结果表明CP方法在平均经验覆盖和区间长度等指标上各有优劣，并研究了将CP不确定性融入同化循环的可行性。
Motivation: 数值天气预报中，概率预报和数据同化都需要精确的不确定性演化信息，传统集合方法计算成本高且存在偏差，而保形预测作为一种新兴的机器学习不确定性量化工具，尚未在气象数据同化领域得到充分验证。
Method: 采用一维修正浅水模型作为理想化试验台，实现标准CP、归一化CP和保形分位数回归三种保形预测方法，并与基于集合标准差和离散度的传统不确定性度量进行对比。进一步，通过CP扰动将CP衍生的不确定性集成到数据同化循环中。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值，但指出不同CP方法在平均经验覆盖、平均区间长度、miss low、miss high和AISL等指标上表现各异，突出了每种方法的优势和局限性，为CP补充传统集合不确定性量化提供了见解。
Conclusion: 保形预测在简化大气模型中展现出作为集合不确定性量化补充工具的潜力，但其实际应用效果受方法选择影响，需进一步在更复杂模型中验证。

papers.title: RolloutPipe: Overlapping Pipelined Rollout and Training in Disaggregated On-Policy LLM Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) post-training for reasoning increasingly relies on reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), where models learn from ground-truth feedback on mathematical, logical, and scientific tasks. To enable flexible resource allocation and support heterogeneous training setups, modern RLVR systems adopt disaggregated architectures that decouple rollout generation and policy training across independent GPU pools. However, existing synchronous on-policy GRPO (Group Relative Policy Optimization) RLVR systems finish an entire rollout before starting training, leaving the trainer GPU pool idle while rollout is still ongoing. Asynchronous RL pipelines overlap the two stages, but at the cost of training on stale data. To address these challenges, we propose RolloutPipe, a post-training framework for disaggregated RLVR systems, which turns the fixed-weight rollout into a complete-group pipeline where trainable groups move to the trainer while later groups are still being generated. RolloutPipe achieves this through two techniques including complete-group pipelining (CGP) and frontier-group dispatch (FGD). CGP dispatches each trainable complete group to the trainer FIFO as soon as group materialization finishes, and FGD is an admission policy on the Rollout node that first admits requests for the frontier groups needed to form the next training batch, so that trainer-ready groups arrive earlier and more steadily. The design starts training before the rollout completes while maintaining on-policy correctness. Evaluated on Qwen3-1.7B across four reasoning and science benchmarks and twelve rollout settings, RolloutPipe shortens the rollout-to-train-end time by 30.7%-42.3%, and lowers the trainer waiting ratio by 37%-76% compared to Slime, a state-of-the-art rollout and training system.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 2026 International Conference on Cognitive Computing (ICCC 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对解耦式 on-policy RLVR 系统中 rollout 与训练无法重叠导致的 GPU 空闲问题，提出 RolloutPipe 框架，通过 complete-group pipelining (CGP) 和 frontier-group dispatch (FGD) 两项技术，在保证策略正确性的前提下实现 rollout 与训练的重叠执行。实验表明，相比 Slime 系统，rollout-to-train-end 时间缩短 30.7%-42.3%，训练器等待比率降低 37%-76%。
Motivation: 现有同步 on-policy RLVR 系统中，rollout 完成后才开始训练，导致训练 GPU 池在 rollout 期间闲置；异步方法虽能重叠但使用陈旧数据。需要一种既能重叠又保持 on-policy 正确性的方案。
Method: 提出 RolloutPipe，采用 complete-group pipelining (CGP) 将每个可训练的完整组在物化完成后立即按 FIFO 顺序发送至训练器，以及 frontier-group dispatch (FGD) 作为 rollout 节点上的准入策略，优先处理构建下一训练批次所需的前沿组请求，使训练器就绪的组更早且更稳定到达。
Result: 在 Qwen3-1.7B 模型、四个推理/科学基准和十二种 rollout 设置下，RolloutPipe 相比最新系统 Slime 将 rollout-to-train-end 时间缩短 30.7%-42.3%，训练器等待比率降低 37%-76%。
Conclusion: RolloutPipe 通过流水线化和智能调度实现了解耦 RLVR 系统中 rollout 与训练的高效重叠，同时保持 on-policy 正确性，显著降低了训练器空闲时间和整体训练时间。

papers.title: Event-Aware Instructed Assistant for Referring Video Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Existing referring video segmentation methods often treat a video as a single event consisting of multiple images, overlooking the fact that a video typically contains multiple distinct events. Under such a mechanism, the model needs to directly understand all the complex content in the video and text, which can easily lead to confusion and hallucinations. To address this issue, we propose to decompose a video to a set of simple events by learnable Event Query, and understand complex video content in an event-by-event, easy-to-understand manner. This is based on the observation that natural language expressions often divide a video into distinct, text-related segments, each representing a separate event within a compound event. We introduce EVIS, an Event-Aware Video Instructed Segmentation Assistant, which utilizes text-guided Event Queries to partition a video into simple events, extracting event-aware visual-text features to achieve a hierarchical understanding of the video. Additionally, we propose Object-Pixel-Hybrid Learning, which enables the MLLMs to track targets in long-term videos by integrating fine-grained pixel features with prior object queries. Extensive experimental results on 5 public benchmarks demonstrate EVIS's strong performance in addressing the referring video segmentation task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对指代视频分割中模型常将视频视为单一事件、忽略多事件结构导致混淆的问题，提出事件感知的指代分割助手EVIS。通过可学习的事件查询将视频分解为简单事件，并引入目标-像素混合学习实现长视频目标跟踪。在5个公开基准上取得强性能。
Motivation: 现有指代视频分割方法将视频视为单一事件，忽略了视频包含多个独立事件的事实，导致模型直接理解复杂内容时易产生混淆和幻觉。
Method: 提出EVIS框架，利用文本引导的事件查询（Event Query）将视频分解为简单事件，提取事件感知的视觉-文本特征实现层级理解；并提出目标-像素混合学习，结合细粒度像素特征与目标先验查询，使多模态大语言模型能跟踪长视频目标。
Result: 在5个公开基准数据集上，EVIS在指代视频分割任务中取得强性能，具体数值未在摘要中给出。
Conclusion: 通过事件分解和层级理解，EVIS有效缓解了复杂视频内容理解中的混淆问题，并提升了长视频目标跟踪能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Enabling self-supervised learned primal dual with Noise2Inverse
papers.abstract_en: X-ray computed tomography reconstruction is an ill-posed inverse problem, particularly in low-dose and sparse-angle settings where measurements are noisy and incomplete. While learned reconstruction methods such as the Learned Primal-Dual algorithm achieve strong performance, they typically rely on supervised training with access to ground-truth data, which is often unavailable in practice. In this work, we propose a self-supervised reconstruction method by extending the Noise2Inverse framework to the Learned Primal-Dual algorithm. The resulting approach, called Noise2Inverse Learned Primal-Dual (N2I-LPD), enables training of a learned iterative reconstruction operator without ground-truth images by exploiting the statistical independence of noise in distinct measurements with respect to angular rotation of the CT-scan. We compare the proposed method with classical reconstruction methods, as well as neural network-based approaches such as a U-Net trained within the same N2I framework. The results demonstrate that N2I-LPD achieves improved reconstruction quality, highlighting the potential of combining learned reconstruction operators with self-supervised training strategies for practical CT imaging scenarios where ground-truth data is unavailable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种自监督学习方法Noise2Inverse Learned Primal-Dual (N2I-LPD)，将Noise2Inverse框架扩展到Learned Primal-Dual算法，用于X射线CT重建，无需真实图像。在低剂量和稀疏角度设置下，N2I-LPD相比于经典方法和同框架下的U-Net取得了更好的重建质量。
Motivation: 有监督学习需要真实数据，在实际CT成像中难以获得。本文旨在实现无真实图像的自监督训练。
Method: 利用Noise2Inverse框架，通过角度旋转下不同测量噪声的统计独立性，训练Learned Primal-Dual迭代重建算子。
Result: 与经典重建方法以及在Noise2Inverse框架下训练的U-Net相比，N2I-LPD提高了重建质量。
Conclusion: 结合学习重建算子与自监督训练策略，在无法获取真实图像的CT成像场景中具有潜力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Decision-Aligned Evaluation of Uncertainty Quantification
papers.abstract_en: Uncertainty estimates in machine learning are typically evaluated using generic metrics such as the negative log-likelihood and expected calibration error, yet good performance on such metrics does not necessarily imply high utility in downstream decisions. We introduce decision-alignment, a criterion that reveals which evaluation metrics meaningfully align with downstream utilities. Applying this framework, we show that many widely used uncertainty metrics are either misaligned with common decision problems or encode pathological prior beliefs about the downstream task. We then propose prior-weighted utility metrics, a special class of proper scoring rules that provides decision-aligned uncertainty evaluation. Across benchmark experiments and real-world case studies, our metrics consistently align with realized decision utility, while conventional metrics do not. Our results surface flaws in the current UQ evaluation protocol and offer a principled extension of existing metrics toward decision-relevant UQ evaluation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出决策对齐（decision-aligned）评估准则，用于判断哪些不确定性量化（UQ）指标真正与下游决策效用一致。研究发现许多常用指标（如负对数似然、期望校准误差）要么与决策问题错位，要么编码了病态先验。作者提出先验加权效用度量，作为一类特殊的适当评分规则（proper scoring rules），在基准实验和实际案例中与决策效用一致，而传统指标不一致。
Motivation: 当前UQ评价依赖通用指标（如NLL、ECE），但这些指标在决策任务中未必有用，缺乏与下游效用的对齐。
Method: 提出决策对齐准则，并据此设计先验加权效用度量，属于适当评分规则的特殊子类。
Result: 在基准实验和真实世界案例中，所提指标与决策效用一致，而传统指标不一致。
Conclusion: 论文揭示了现行UQ评估协议的缺陷，并提供了向决策相关的UQ评估扩展的原则性方法。
Relevance: 20

papers.title: Where Do Models Find Happiness? Emotion Vectors in Open-Source LLMs
papers.abstract_en: Recent work identified emotion vectors in Claude Sonnet 4.5, which are internal representations that encode emotion concepts, causally influence behavior, and exhibit geometry mirroring human psychological structure. We test the generality of these findings in two open-weight models, Apertus-8B-Instruct-2509 and Gemma-4-E4B-it, extracting emotion contrast vectors across all layers, using two model-generated corpora. We recover valence geometry for both models, with peak PC1--valence correlations of $r = 0.76$ and $r = 0.83$, approaching the $r = 0.81$ reported for Claude.Beyond replication, we observe notable differences in how valence representations emerge across model depth. In Gemma-4-E4B-it, valence is strongly encoded in early layers but collapses towards later layers, whereas Apertus-8B-Instruct-2509 exhibits the opposite pattern, with valence representations absent in early layers, but emerging at mid depths. Arousal encoding, in contrast, is sensitive to the extraction corpus: both models show stronger PC2--arousal alignment with Gemma-generated stories ($r$ up to $0.45$) than Apertus-generated ones ($r \leq 0.21$), suggesting arousal-relevant cues are unevenly distributed across generated corpora. We open-source our experiment code and dataset for reproducible investigation of emotion representations across language model architectures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文检验了近期在Claude Sonnet 4.5中发现的情感向量在开源大语言模型中的普适性。通过提取Apertus-8B-Instruct-2509和Gemma-4-E4B-it各层的情绪对比向量，发现两种模型均再现了效价几何（valence geometry），但效价表征随深度的出现模式相反；唤醒度编码则依赖于生成语料库。
Motivation: 验证闭源模型中识别出的情感向量是否在开源模型中普遍存在，并探索不同架构间情感表征的异同。
Method: 从两个开源模型（Apertus-8B-Instruct-2509和Gemma-4-E4B-it）的所有层提取情绪对比向量，使用两个模型生成的语料库进行测试。
Result: 两种模型均再现了效价几何（peak PC1–valence correlations分别为0.76和0.83，接近Claude的0.81）；但效价表征在Gemma中早期层强而后期层弱，Apertus中早期弱而中期强；唤醒度编码受语料影响（Gemma故事下r达0.45，Apertus故事下r≤0.21）。
Conclusion: 开源模型中存在类似的情感向量，但其层内分布和语料敏感性存在差异，代码和数据集已开源。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: ReaORE: Reasoning-Guided Progressive Open Relation Extraction Empowered by Large Reasoning Models
papers.abstract_en: Open Relation Extraction (OpenRE) requires a model to extract unseen relations between head and tail entities from unstructured text for real-world applications. The core challenge of OpenRE lies in achieving reliable generalization to unseen relation types. Current OpenRE approaches either employ clustering techniques, which cannot generate relation labels and suffer from poor generalization, or rely on direct relation label generation via Large Language Models (LLMs), which lack sufficient discriminative capacity to distinguish easily confused relations. To address these limitations, we propose Reasoning-guided progressive OpenRE (ReaORE), a framework for performing relation extraction through coarse-to-fine relation reasoning. Specifically, ReaORE consists of two key stages: (i) relation filtering, which reasons over multiple aspects to understand relations and instances, yielding an initial relation set, and further supplements and filters relations via embedding-based similarity to ensure the target relation is included; (ii) relation prediction, which aims to predict the target relations from the above set via fine-grained comparative reasoning to better distinguish easily confused relations. Extensive experiments on two widely used OpenRE datasets demonstrate that ReaORE outperforms existing baselines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出ReaORE框架，通过粗到细的两阶段推理（关系过滤与关系预测）实现开放关系抽取，解决现有方法无法生成关系标签或区分易混淆关系的局限，在两个数据集上超越基线。
Motivation: 现有开放关系抽取方法要么依赖聚类无法生成关系标签且泛化差，要么使用大语言模型直接生成但缺乏区分易混淆关系的能力。
Method: 包含两个阶段：(i)关系过滤——多角度推理理解关系和实例，获得初始关系集，再通过嵌入相似度补充过滤确保目标关系包含在内；(ii)关系预测——通过细粒度比较推理从上述集合中预测目标关系，更好区分易混淆关系。
Result: 在两个广泛使用的开放关系抽取数据集上，ReaORE优于现有基线。
Conclusion: 粗到细推理策略能有效提升开放关系抽取的泛化性和区分能力。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Unison: Benchmarking Unified Multimodal Models via Synergistic Understanding and Generation
papers.abstract_en: Unified multimodal models capable of both understanding and generation have achieved remarkable strides. However, despite their unified designs, existing evaluations typically assess understanding and generation capabilities in isolation, overlooking the synergy between comprehension and generation. To bridge this gap, we introduce Unison, a comprehensive benchmark comprising 2,169 high-quality unified task samples, designed to evaluate joint understanding and generation in unified multimodal models. Unison offers three key strengths: 1) Comprehensive Dimensions: Unison encompasses internal consistency, understanding-guided generation, generation-guided understanding, and mutual enhancement to enable holistic evaluation. 2) Diagnostic Evaluation: it provides both unified and decoupled tracks for understanding and generation, allowing fine-grained attribution of failure modes and quantitative analysis of the gains from unified modeling. 3) Human Alignment: we also introduce Unison-Judge, an evaluation model well aligned with human judgments to ensure reliable assessment. Based on systematic evaluations of state-of-the-art models on Unison, we uncover critical limitations in current unified multimodal systems and highlight promising directions for future research. Codes, Unison and Unison-Judge are publicly available at https://github.com/FudanCVL/Unison.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Unison基准，包含2169个高质量样本，用于评估统一多模态模型在理解与生成任务上的协同能力。该基准涵盖内部一致性、理解引导生成、生成引导理解和相互增强四个维度，并提供统一与解耦的评估轨道以进行诊断分析。基于对当前最先进模型的系统评估，揭示了现有统一多模态系统的关键局限性，并指明了未来研究方向。
Motivation: 现有统一多模态模型虽然设计上融合了理解与生成，但评估方法通常将二者分离，忽略了它们之间的协同作用。
Method: 构建包含2169个样本的Unison基准，设计内部一致性、理解引导生成、生成引导理解和相互增强四类任务，并提供统一和解耦两种评估轨道，同时引入与人类判断对齐的Unison-Judge评估模型。
Result: 对当前最先进统一多模态模型的系统评估揭示了其在协同理解与生成方面的关键局限性。
Conclusion: Unison基准为诊断统一多模态模型的协同能力提供了有效的评估框架，并指出了改进方向。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Auditing Framing-Sensitive Behavioral Instability in Large Language Models for Mental Health Interactions
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being integrated into mental health support tools and other psychologically sensitive conversational applications. In such settings, behavioral stability and consistency are important for trustworthy human-AI interaction. However, semantically similar concerns can be presented through different contextual framings, potentially eliciting different model responses. Such framing-sensitive variability may challenge user expectations regarding system behavior and complicate the assessment of AI reliability. While prior studies have primarily examined such effects at the behavioral level, less is known about how framing-related variation is reflected in the internal representations of aligned language models. In this work, we investigate these effects using controlled matched prompts spanning multiple contextual framing conditions across several instruction-tuned model families. Across architectures, framing systematically alters interpretive response tendencies. Layer-wise probing analyses show that behavior-associated information remains decodable throughout transformer depth, with architecture-dependent variation in decoding strength. Moreover, held-out framing probes remained consistently above chance across architectures despite strong lexical baselines. Activation steering experiments further suggest that framing-associated representational directions can partially modulate downstream behavioral outcomes. Finally, these findings indicate that robustness to contextual variation may represent an important consideration when evaluating the consistency and trustworthiness of conversational AI systems deployed in mental-health-oriented interactions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究大语言模型在心理健康对话中因不同语境框架（framing）导致的响应不稳定性。通过匹配提示词、分层探测和激活引导实验，发现语境框架系统性地改变模型的解释性响应倾向，且行为相关信息在Transformer各层均可解码。研究表明，对语境变化的鲁棒性是评估心理健康对话AI可靠性的重要考虑因素。
Motivation: 心理健康支持工具中，大语言模型的行为稳定性对可信赖的人机交互至关重要，但同一语义问题可通过不同语境框架呈现，可能引发模型响应差异，现有研究缺乏对内部表征层面框架相关变异的理解。
Method: 使用跨多个指令微调模型族的受控匹配提示词，包括分层探测（layer-wise probing）、保持框架探测（held-out framing probes）和激活引导（activation steering）实验。
Result: 不同架构下，框架系统改变解释性响应倾向；分层探测显示行为相关信息在Transformer各层均可解码，且解码强度因架构而异；保持探测始终高于随机水平；激活引导可部分调节下游行为。

papers.title: In-Context Model Predictive Generation: Open-Vocabulary Motion Synthesis from Language Models to Physics
papers.abstract_en: Synthesizing human motion from textual descriptions is essential for immersive digital applications, yet existing methods face a persistent trade-off between semantic fidelity and physical realism. Large language model (LLM)-based approaches can interpret diverse open-vocabulary instructions and compose high-level action plans, but they often generate motions that violate physical constraints. Physics-aware models improve realism through simulation or control, but they struggle with semantic complexity, fine-grained instructions, and novel concepts. To address this gap, we propose In-Context Model Predictive Generation (ICMPG), a framework that integrates language-model planning with inference-time physical feedback. ICMPG reformulates motion synthesis as a Model Predictive Control (MPC)-like process with two modules. The Context-Aware Motion Generation (CAMG) module uses an LLM as a planner to decompose textual commands and generate candidate motion sequences from motion tokens. The Model Predictive Generation (MPG) module evaluates these candidates through physical simulation and semantic alignment, estimates a composite reward, and selects the best sequence to guide subsequent generation steps. Unlike open-loop generation, this closed-loop refinement enables ICMPG to adapt motions to both the input semantics and the simulated physical environment without task-specific policy retraining. Extensive experiments across standard and zero-shot open-vocabulary settings show that ICMPG generalizes robustly to diverse commands and produces motions that are more physically plausible and semantically faithful than representative baselines on the evaluated benchmarks. The framework bridges semantic interpretation and physical simulation while remaining flexible enough to incorporate different LLM backbones, enabling more versatile and controllable text-driven motion synthesis.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出ICMPG框架，将语言模型规划与推理时物理反馈结合，用于开放词汇的动作合成。方法包括上下文感知动作生成（CAMG）和模型预测生成（MPG），通过闭环优化提高语义忠实度和物理合理性。实验表明在标准及零样本设置下优于基线。
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的方法生成动作语义丰富但违反物理约束，物理感知模型则难以处理复杂语义和细粒度指令，两者存在权衡。
Method: 提出ICMPG框架，包含CAMG模块（LLM作为规划器，从文本生成候选动作序列）和MPG模块（通过物理仿真和语义对齐评估候选，用复合奖励选择最佳序列，实现闭环优化）。
Result: 在标准及零样本开放词汇设置下，ICMPG生成的比基线动作更物理合理且语义忠实。
Conclusion: ICMPG桥接语义解释和物理仿真，可灵活集成不同LLM骨干，实现可控文本驱动动作合成。

papers.title: XMSE-Aware Adaptive Empirical Bayes Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Empirical Bayes (EB) estimators can match the first-order asymptotic risk of maximum likelihood (ML) while behaving very differently at second order: recent excess mean squared error (XMSE) analysis shows that kernel-based EB estimation may be worse than ML when the kernel is poorly aligned with the true parameter. This paper turns that diagnostic into a design principle. We propose an XMSE-aware mixed estimator that interpolates between ML and EB shrinkage. Its fixed-weight XMSE is a scalar quadratic, yielding a closed-form oracle mixing weight that is no worse than both ML and the base EB estimator at the XMSE scale. A plug-in implementation based on finite-sample XMSE approximations is proved consistent, with a second-order oracle regret rate for an interior oracle weight. We further establish a transfer of the regret bound to the fixed-weight risk curve evaluated at the selected weight, a thresholded boundary rule, and extensions to compact kernel families and to finite and growing kernel dictionaries with high-probability oracle bounds. Finite impulse response simulations with SURE-tuned, hard-selection, and trace-corrected baselines, together with the public Silverbox and Cascaded Tanks benchmarks, show that the proposed estimator retains most of the benefit of regularization when it is helpful and retreats toward ML under kernel misspecification, with an identified finite-de analyzed on the benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种XMSE感知的自适应经验贝叶斯（EB）混合估计器，在最大似然（ML）和EB收缩之间插值，通过闭式oracle混合权重实现优于两者的XMSE风险。基于有限样本XMSE近似的插件估计量被证明一致，具有二阶oracle遗憾率，并扩展到紧核族和有限/增长核字典。仿真和基准测试表明，该估计器在核匹配良好时保留正则化收益，在核误指定时退回到ML。
Motivation: 现有kernel-based EB估计在核与真实参数不对齐时可能比ML更差，XMSE诊断揭示了这一缺陷。本文旨在将XMSE诊断转化为设计原则，构建一个自适应混合估计器，自动在EB和ML之间权衡。
Method: 提出XMSE感知的混合估计器，其固定权重XMSE为标量二次型，导出了闭式oracle混合权重。采用有限样本XMSE近似进行插件实现，并证明了估计量的一致性和二阶oracle遗憾率。还讨论了阈值边界规则、紧核族扩展以及有限和增长核字典的高概率oracle界。
Result: 在SURE-tuned、硬选择、迹校正基线以及Silverbox和Cascaded Tanks基准上的仿真显示，所提估计器在正则化有益时保留大部分收益，在核误指定时退向ML，并在基准上具有明确的有限样本分析。
Conclusion: 该工作提供了一个自适应框架，使EB估计在核误指定时不会劣于ML，同时保留了EB在良好指定时的优势。未来可应用于更广泛的统计模型。

papers.title: Geometric Gradient Rectification for Safe Open-Set Semi-Supervised Learning
papers.abstract_en: Open-set semi-supervised learning aims to leverage unlabeled data that may contain out-of-distribution outliers while maintaining performance on in-distribution classes. Existing methods mainly follow two paradigms: filtering suspicious samples or incorporating unlabeled objectives with soft weighting. We argue that both face a common trade-off: aggressive filtering can discard informative but hard ID samples, whereas utilization can introduce auxiliary gradients that conflict with supervised learning when pseudo labels are wrong. We therefore shift the focus from sample selection to gradient-level control. We propose \textit{Geometric Gradient Rectification} (GGR), a plug-in framework that uses the supervised gradient as an anchor and projects conflicting auxiliary gradients onto an admissible region in gradient space. This makes the applied auxiliary update first-order non-opposing within the rectified coordinate block while preserving orthogonal components that may still carry useful representation signals. We further extend GGR with subspace-aware rectification to stabilize the anchor under noisy mini-batch gradients. Experiments on CIFAR and ImageNet benchmarks show that GGR improves representative OSSL baselines in most settings and yields gains in both closed-set generalization and open-set robustness. Code will be available at https://github.com/JiaheChen2002/GGR.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出几何梯度矫正（GGR）框架，用于安全开放集半监督学习。GGR将监督梯度作为锚点，将冲突的辅助梯度投影到可容许区域，使得辅助更新在矫正坐标块内非对抗，同时保留可能携带有用表征信号的正交分量。在CIFAR和ImageNet基准上，GGR改进了代表性OSSL基线，并在闭集泛化和开集鲁棒性上取得了提升。
Motivation: 现有开放集半监督学习方法在过滤可疑样本或使用软权重融合未标注目标时面临共同权衡：激进过滤会丢弃困难但信息丰富的样本，而使用错误伪标签的辅助梯度会与监督学习产生冲突。
Method: 提出几何梯度矫正（GGR），一种即插即用框架。它利用监督梯度作为锚点，将冲突的辅助梯度投影到梯度空间的一个可容许区域，使辅助更新在矫正坐标块内一阶非对抗，同时保留正交分量。还扩展了子空间感知矫正以稳定噪声小批量梯度下的锚点。
Result: 在CIFAR和ImageNet基准上，GGR在大多数设置下改进了代表性OSSL基线，并在闭集泛化和开集鲁棒性上获得增益。
Conclusion: GGR通过梯度级控制而非样本选择解决开放集半监督学习中的冲突，代码将公开。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: Computer Vision for MOBA Analytics: A Dataset and Baseline for Visibility Analysis in Dota 2
papers.abstract_en: Introduction: Most Multiplayer Online Battle Arena (MOBA) analytics studies rely on structured data, which does not directly capture what each team could actually see during a match. Objective: This work introduces Dota2-Vis, a video-based dataset, and a baseline pipeline for visibility analysis in professional Dota 2 matches. Methodology: The dataset comprises all 144 matches from The International 2025, recorded from both team perspectives, totaling 288 Full HD videos, together with 2,477 manually annotated minimap images. We evaluate multiple variants of a modern object detector for player-icon detection and use the best-performing model to estimate opponent-visible player presence over time. Results: YOLO11l (large) achieved the best overall performance, reliably identifying player icons even in dense and visually cluttered minimap scenes. The resulting visibility curves reveal player, hero, role, and team-level patterns that complement conventional MOBA analytics, highlighting behavioral differences that are difficult to obtain from structured data alone. The dataset and code are publicly available at https://github.com/RicardoRCarvalho/dota2-vis/.
papers.comment: Accepted for presentation at the 2026 Simpósio Brasileiro de Jogos e Entretenimento Digital (SBGames)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Dota2-Vis数据集，包含2025年国际邀请赛全部144场比赛的双视角全高清视频及2477张手动标注的小地图图像，用于MOBA游戏中可见性分析。使用YOLO11l检测小地图上的玩家图标，生成可见性曲线，揭示玩家、英雄、角色和团队层面的模式，补充传统结构化数据分析的不足。数据集和代码已公开。
Motivation: 现有MOBA分析研究大多依赖结构化数据，无法直接反映比赛中各队实际可见的信息。
Method: 构建Dota2-Vis视频数据集，从双视角录制144场比赛，并手动标注小地图图像。评估多种YOLO11变体用于玩家图标检测，选用最优模型YOLO11l估计对手可见的玩家存在时间。
Result: YOLO11large在小地图密集场景下可靠检测玩家图标，生成的可见性曲线揭示了结构化数据难以获取的行为差异。
Conclusion: 基于视觉的可见性分析能补充传统MOBA分析，提供更丰富的战术洞察。

papers.title: Einstein World Models
papers.abstract_en: Does intelligence require the ability to reason about phenomena beyond direct experience? It is natural to suspect that some complex thought cannot be captured through language alone. However, of particular concern to this work, is whether visualising counterfactual events can complement language as a mechanism for complex thought. We ask whether LLMs can be trained to utilise such visualisation mechanisms, in a way that benefits their reasoning abilities. Motivated by this question, we propose Einstein World Models. EWMs are a blueprint for LLM-based reasoning systems that place visual-temporal rollouts inside the reasoning trace, allowing them to reason in ways that text alone may not support well. In an EWM, the LLM calls a world-module (not to be confused with a world model), to produce short rollouts of scenes under consideration. The returned rollout is treated not as the answer, but as an inspectable hypothesis that can support later reasoning. Einstein World Models extend the capability of LLMs for tool calling (such as web search or code execution), into the domain of visual thought experiments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出Einstein World Models (EWM) 框架，让LLM在推理过程中调用世界模块（world-module）生成场景的视觉时间推演（visual-temporal rollouts），并将推演结果视为可检验的假设来支持后续推理，从而扩展LLM的工具调用能力到视觉思想实验领域。
Motivation: 探索是否可以通过可视化反事实事件来补充语言作为复杂思考的机制，以及是否能够训练LLM利用这种可视化机制提升推理能力。
Method: EWM是一种蓝图，LLM在推理轨迹中调用世界模块产生场景的短时间推演，推演结果不作为最终答案，而是作为可检验的假设辅助后续推理。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验结果或定量指标。
Conclusion: EWM将LLM的工具调用能力（如网络搜索、代码执行）扩展到视觉思想实验领域。
