papers.title: Full spectrum Unlearnable Examples via Spectral Equalization
papers.abstract_en: Unlearnable examples (UEs) protect training data by injecting imperceptible perturbations so that models fail to extract exploitable representations. In this paper, we reveal that existing UEs exhibit a critical failure once low-pass filtering is applied, indicating that the effective perturbation signals for unlearnability concentrate predominantly in high frequencies. Hence, we argue that reliable UEs should remain effective across the full spectrum. To this end, we propose Full-spectrum Unlearnable examples via Spectral Equalization (FUSE), which aims to generate spectrum-agnostic perturbations by equalizing the contributions from different bands and enforcing cross-band consistency. Specifically, FUSE adopts a Random Spectral Masking (RSM) strategy during generator training, which randomly removes a contiguous frequency band, forcing the remaining bands to maintain unlearnability. In addition, FUSE further integrates Cross-Band Guidance (CBG), which enforces mutual consistency between high- and low-frequency components, thereby further enhancing low-frequency unlearnability and regulating high-frequency perturbations to preserve the semantic fidelity of images. Extensive experiments across multiple datasets, architectures, and spectral filtering demonstrate the strong protection achieved by FUSE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示现有不可学习样本（UEs）在低通滤波后失效，说明其扰动信号主要集中在高频；提出通过频谱均衡（FUSE）生成全频谱不可学习样本，采用随机频谱掩蔽（RSM）和跨频带引导（CBG）使各频段均保持不可学习性，实验验证了其强保护能力。
Motivation: 现有不可学习样本在低通滤波下失效，表明有效扰动集中于高频，缺乏频谱鲁棒性，无法防御基于滤波的防御手段。
Method: 提出 FUSE 方法，在生成器训练中采用随机频谱掩蔽（RSM）随机移除连续频带，迫使剩余频带维持不可学习性；并引入跨频带引导（CBG）增强高低频一致性，提升低频不可学习性并调节高频扰动以保持语义保真度。
Result: 在多个数据集、架构和频谱滤波条件下，FUSE 实现了强保护效果。
Conclusion: 仅通过频谱均衡即可实现全频谱有效的不可学习样本，弥补了现有方法对低通滤波的脆弱性。

papers.title: A Latent ODE Approach to Spatiotemporal Modeling of Cine Cardiac MRI
papers.abstract_en: Cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (CMR) captures rich spatiotemporal information about ventricular structure and motion, but conventional risk models use only a few image-derived indices from selected cardiac phases. We present a latent dynamical model that encodes bi-ventricular anatomy and full-cycle cine motion as a continuous latent trajectory, using heart-rate-aware neural ordinary differential equation (ODE) dynamics and a graph-based mesh autoencoder to reconstruct anatomically consistent 3D+t ventricular motion. A covariate-conditioned prior defines the expected end-diastolic latent state, and a Cox proportional hazards model tests whether deviations from this prior predict incident heart failure. We studied 72,386 UK Biobank participants without baseline cardiovascular disease, including 367 incident heart failure events. In a held-out evaluation subset, adding the latent score to refitted pooled cohort equations improved the stratified C-index from 0.704 to 0.785, compared with 0.764 for seven established cardiac markers. Compared with non-graph and non-ODE approaches, the proposed model gave the best trade-off between reconstruction fidelity, generative realism, and downstream prognostic performance. These results suggest that continuous full-cycle modeling of ventricular motion provides informative cardiac phenotypes beyond conventional CMR summaries, while external validation in more representative patient cohorts is required before clinical risk-prediction use.

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种潜在ODE方法对电影心脏MRI进行时空建模，使用图网格自编码器和心率感知的神经ODE重建连续心室运动，并在UK Biobank数据上检验偏离先验状态预测心力衰竭的能力，最终改善了风险分层。
Motivation: 传统心脏风险模型仅使用几个图像衍生指标，忽略了完整电影周期的时空信息。
Method: 潜在动态模型通过图网格自编码器编码双心室解剖和完整电影运动为连续潜在轨迹，使用心率感知神经ODE动态，并采用协变量条件先验定义舒张末期潜在状态，再用Cox比例风险模型检验偏离预测心力衰竭。
Result: 在72,386名UK Biobank参与者中，加入潜在评分将分层C指数从0.704提升至0.785，优于七个已知心脏标志物的0.764。
Conclusion: 连续全周期心室运动建模可提供超越常规CMR总结的信息性心脏表型，但需在更具代表性的患者队列中进行外部验证才能用于临床风险预测。

papers.title: Dual-Prior Guided Null-Space Learning with Mixture-of-Splines for Arbitrary Medical Slice Super-Resolution
papers.abstract_en: Arbitrary slice super-resolution reconstructs isotropic volumes from anisotropic clinical acquisitions by synthesizing intermediate slices at arbitrary scales. However, treating this ill-posed inverse problem as unconstrained residual-based regression risks hallucinating anatomically implausible structures or altering the originally observed data. To address both concerns, this paper presents the Dual-Prior Null-space Learning (DP-NSL) framework, which reformulates the task as a constrained recovery process guided by two complementary priors. A Measurement-Consistent Projection (MCP) enforces a Deterministic Observation Prior: the reconstruction undergoes an exact orthogonal projection that reproduces every acquired slice with zero error, confining all learned details to the unobservable null space. Within this null space, a Mixture-of-Splines (MoS) module imposes a Geometric Continuity Prior by dynamically mixing B-spline experts of different analytic orders, allowing each anatomical region to be modeled with a content-aware level of continuity. To promote spatial coherence, a Local Spatial Consistency Decoder (LSCD) further injects local inductive bias. Experiments on three CT and one MRI benchmark show that DP-NSL outperforms existing approaches while strictly preserving measurement consistency. Code is available at https://github.com/DeepMed-Lab-ECNU/Medical-Image-Reconstruction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出双先验零空间学习框架（DP-NSL）用于医学任意切片超分辨率，通过测量一致性投影确保重建与原始观测一致，并在零空间内使用混合样条（MoS）施加几何连续性先验，以及局部空间一致性解码器（LSCD）。在三个CT和一个MRI基准上优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有方法将任意切片超分辨率视为无约束残差回归，可能产生解剖结构不合理的幻觉或改变原始数据。本文旨在解决这两个问题。
Method: 提出DP-NSL框架，包括测量一致性投影（MCP）强制执行确定性观测先验，混合样条（MoS）模块动态混合B样条专家实现几何连续性先验，以及局部空间一致性解码器（LSCD）注入局部归纳偏置。
Result: 在三个CT和一个MRI基准上，DP-NSL优于现有方法，同时严格保持测量一致性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法优于现有方法并保持测量一致性。

papers.title: Extracting Neural Materials from Multi-view Images
papers.abstract_en: Neural materials can represent complex specular reflections and scattering effects in a compact, universal basis. However, acquiring and authoring such materials remains challenging. We present NeuMatEx, a differentiable inverse rendering method for extracting spatially varying neural materials from images. The nonlinear structure of neural material latent spaces makes optimization with naive inverse rendering infeasible. To address this, we train a Large Material Reconstruction Model (LMRM) that directly predicts initialbase color, neural material latents, and aleatoric uncertainty guides from images. This material prior provides a good initialization and better constrains our subsequent optimization using inverse path tracing. The predicted uncertainty further helps by anchoring high-confidence regions more tightly to the LMRM prediction, preventing lighting and complex specular effects from being baked into materials. Experiments on synthetic and real assets show that NeuMatEx extracts complex materials with better visual quality and material decomposition than PBR-based methods.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NeuMatEx，一种可微逆渲染方法，用于从多视角图像中提取空间变化的神经材质。通过训练大型材质重建模型（LMRM）提供初始预测和不确定性引导，并结合逆路径追踪优化，该方法在合成和真实资产上比基于 PBR 的方法取得了更好的视觉质量和材质分解效果。
Motivation: 神经材质能紧凑表示复杂镜面反射和散射，但获取和编辑仍具挑战。
Method: 训练 LMRM 直接预测初始材质参数、神经材质潜变量和偶然不确定性，随后利用逆路径追踪优化，并用不确定性锚定高置信区域。
Result: 在合成和真实资产上，NeuMatEx 提取的材质具有更好的视觉质量和更准确的材质分解。
Conclusion: 该方法验证了利用可微渲染和大规模材质先验进行神经材质提取的有效性。

papers.title: LithoDreamer: A Physics-Informed World Model for Multi-Stage Computational Lithography
papers.abstract_en: As semiconductor technology nodes scale, computational lithography is essential for ensuring yield and performance. However, lithography is a continuous physical process involving mask optimization, optical imaging, resist exposure, and development, which existing models fail to capture. To overcome this limitation, we present LithoDreamer, the first physics-informed World Model (WM) framework for computational lithography, which formulates the ``Layout-Mask-Resist Image-After Development Image (ADI)'' pipeline as a decision-driven multi-step evolution system. LithoDreamer captures feature changes between adjacent states to model stage-specific physics-informed latent spaces, in which it controls process intervention exploration and drives subsequent state transitions. To achieve interpretable intervention optimization without continuous supervision, we propose a contrastive variational optimization paradigm that contrasts the latent differences between intervention paths with variational evolution constraints, guiding the model to generate evolutions consistent with real lithography physics. Experiments show LithoDreamer achieves state-of-the-art performance in forward evolution and inverse planning. Our lithography dataset is publicly available at GitHub (https://github.com/7jiangyq/lithodreamer.git).
papers.comment: Correspondence to: Qi Sun <qisunchn \at zju \dot edu \dot cn>
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML), Jul. 6-11, 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LithoDreamer，首个基于物理信息的World Model框架用于计算光刻，将“版图-掩膜-抗蚀剂图像-显影后图像(ADI)”流水线建模为决策驱动的多步演化系统。通过对比变分优化范式实现可解释的干预优化，在正向演化和逆向规划上达到最先进性能。
Motivation: 现有计算光刻模型未能捕捉掩膜优化、光学成像、抗蚀剂曝光和显影的连续物理过程，限制了光刻精度。
Method: 提出物理信息World Model框架，建模相邻状态间的特征变化得到阶段特定物理信息潜在空间，并通过对比变分优化范式对比干预路径的潜在差异，结合演化约束引导模型产生与真实光刻物理一致的演化。
Result: 实验表明在正向演化和逆向规划上达到最先进性能，并公开了光刻数据集。
Conclusion: 该工作首次将World Model引入计算光刻，为多步物理过程建模提供了新范式。

papers.title: MLFFM-SegDiff: A Multi-Level Feature Fusion Diffusion Model for Skin Lesion Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Skin lesion segmentation is a key task in computer-aided dermatological diagnosis, where accuracy directly impacts downstream analysis and disease classification. However, dermoscopic images are challenging due to blurred boundaries, low contrast, large shape variations, and artifacts such as hair and shadows. Recently, diffusion models have shown strong performance in medical image segmentation thanks to their progressive denoising and distribution modeling capabilities. Nevertheless, existing diffusion-based methods still suffer from limited cross-level feature interaction and insufficient boundary detail recovery. To address these issues, we propose MLFFM-SegDiff, a multi-level feature fusion diffusion model for skin lesion segmentation. Built on a diffusion framework, the method introduces a dual-path U-Net encoder, a Multi-Level Feature Fusion Module (MLFFM), and a boundary-sensitive loss function. The dual-path encoder enhances interaction between noisy mask features and dermoscopic image features. MLFFM improves skip connections via attention, scale alignment, and adaptive cross-level fusion. These designs enable the decoder to jointly leverage shallow boundary cues and deep semantic representations, improving mask reconstruction quality. Experiments on ISIC2018, PH2, and HAM10000 demonstrate that MLFFM-SegDiff outperforms representative methods including DermoSegDiff, U-Net, and SwinUNETR across Accuracy, F1-score, Jaccard index, Recall, and Dice. In particular, it achieves an average Jaccard index of 0.8546 and Dice coefficient of 0.9207. These results validate the effectiveness of the proposed multi-level feature fusion strategy for improving lesion segmentation performance. The code will be released at https://github.com/Qacket/MLFFM-SegDiff.git after publication.

TL;DR: 本文提出MLFFM-SegDiff，一种多级特征融合的扩散模型用于皮肤病变分割。该方法在扩散框架中引入双路径U-Net编码器、多级特征融合模块（MLFFM）和边界敏感损失函数，以增强跨级特征交互和边界细节恢复。在ISIC2018、PH2和HAM10000数据集上，该方法在Accuracy、F1-score、Jaccard index、Recall和Dice等指标上优于DermoSegDiff、U-Net和SwinUNETR等方法，平均Jaccard指数达0.8546，Dice系数达0.9207。
Motivation: 现有扩散分割方法在跨级特征交互和边界细节恢复方面存在不足，而皮肤镜图像具有模糊边界、低对比度、形状变化大及伪影等挑战，亟需改进。
Method: 基于扩散分割框架，采用双路径U-Net编码器以增强噪声掩膜特征与皮肤镜图像特征的交互，引入多级特征融合模块（MLFFM）通过注意力、尺度对齐和自适应跨级融合改进跳跃连接，以及边界敏感损失函数提升边界重建质量。
Result: 在ISIC2018、PH2和HAM10000数据集上，MLFFM-SegDiff在多个指标上超越对比方法，平均Jaccard指数为0.8546，Dice系数为0.9207。
Conclusion: 多级特征融合策略能有效提升皮肤病变分割性能，代码将在发表后开源。

papers.title: Mask to Concept: Auto-Promptable SAM3 via Efficient Test-Time Concept Embedding Search for Few-Shot Annotation
papers.abstract_en: Transforming foundation segmentation models from human-prompted tools into auto-promptable annotators is critical for scalable medical data annotation. Current methods commonly depend on external feature matchers or auxiliary networks to automate geometric prompting, but introducing architectural overhead and limiting performance scalability. Although SAM3 natively supports concept segmentation via reusable text prompts, its direct use in medical imaging is hindered by a lack of fine-grained clinical knowledge and the ambiguity of human-written descriptions. In this work, we propose Mask to Concept (M2C), an efficient framework that adapts SAM3 for medical few-shot annotation without external modules, parameter retraining, or manual text engineering. Using only a few labeled images, M2C enables SAM3 to automatically search for transferable visual concepts entirely within its frozen architecture: it initializes a learnable concept embedding, uses it to prompt segmentation, and updates the embedding by gradients of minimizing the concept segmentation error. We further introduce a Hybrid Uncertainty Estimation (HUE) module that calculates the prediction entropy and maps concept predictions back to the box prompts, measuring concept-geometry prompting inconsistency. Highly uncertain samples are flagged actively for human correction, and the corrected masks are then fed back to M2C to continuously search for more precise concept embeddings, forming a self-enhancing annotation loop with minimal expert effort. Experiments on medical segmentation benchmarks show that our method achieves SOTA few-shot segmentation performance and outstanding annotation efficiency, offering a practical and efficient pathway toward scalable medical image labeling. Codes are at https://github.com/Huster-Hq/M2C.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Mask to Concept (M2C)，一种无需外部模块或参数重训练的高效框架，将 SAM3 从人类提示工具转化为自动提示标注器，用于医学图像少样本分割。通过可学习的概念嵌入搜索和混合不确定性估计（HUE），实现自动提示与主动学习循环，在医学分割基准上达到少样本分割最佳性能。
Motivation: 现有方法依赖外部特征匹配器或辅助网络实现自动几何提示，增加架构开销且性能扩展有限；SAM3 虽支持概念分割，但直接用于医学图像缺乏细粒度临床知识且手工描述存在歧义。
Method: M2C 使用少量标注图像，在冻结的 SAM3 架构内初始化可学习概念嵌入，通过梯度下降最小化概念分割误差来更新嵌入；同时引入 HUE 模块，计算预测熵并将概念预测映射回框提示，量测概念-几何提示不一致性，对高不确定性样本主动标记供人工校正，校正的掩码反馈回 M2C 持续搜索更精确的概念嵌入。
Result: 在医学分割基准上，该方法达到少样本分割最佳性能，并展现出卓越的标注效率。
Conclusion: M2C 为可扩展的医学图像标注提供了一条实用高效的途径，无需外部模块、参数重训练或手工文本工程。

papers.title: Kalman Prototypical Networks for Few-shot Fault Detection in Combined Cycle Gas Turbines
papers.abstract_en: Combined-cycle gas turbines (CCGTs) play a key role in modern power generation, offering both high efficiency and reduced environmental impact. However, their complex thermo-fluid and mechanical interactions complicate fault detection, particularly when labeled fault data are scarce. In this paper, we introduce the Kalman Prototypical Network (KPN), a metric-based few-shot learning (FSL) framework specifically tailored for CCGT fault diagnosis. We model the evolution of class prototypes as latent stochastic states in a dynamic system to reduce episodic variance and improve robustness in embedding representation. Synthetic data sets generated with a high-fidelity Modelica-based dynamic simulation of an offshore CCGT system were used, simulating both normal operation and progressive leak faults under transient conditions. Application of the proposed framework on simulated leak fault detection tasks demonstrate that KPN outperforms conventional FSL methods such as Matching Networks, Relation Networks, and MAML in both accuracy and stability under varying support and query configurations. The proposed framework significantly improves training convergence and generalization by stabilizing class representations, making it well-suited for real-world CCGT fault detection where labeled data is limited.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出卡尔曼原型网络（Kalman Prototypical Network, KPN），一种基于度量的少样本学习框架，用于联合循环燃气轮机（CCGT）的故障检测。KPN将类原型的演化建模为动态系统中的潜在随机状态，以减少情节方差并提高嵌入表示的鲁棒性。基于Modelica高保真动态仿真生成的合成数据集，在渐进泄漏故障检测任务上，KPN在准确性和稳定性上优于匹配网络、关系网络和MAML等传统少样本学习方法。
Motivation: CCGT的复杂热-流体和机械相互作用使得故障检测困难，尤其在有标签故障数据稀缺的情况下。现有少样本学习方法在CCGT故障诊断中面临情节方差大、分类表示不稳定的问题。
Method: KPN是一种度量式少样本学习框架，将类原型演化建模为动态系统中的潜在随机状态，通过卡尔曼滤波更新原型，从而减少情节方差并改善嵌入表示。使用Modelica高保真动态仿真生成合成数据，模拟正常操作和渐进泄漏故障。
Result: 在模拟泄漏故障检测任务上，KPN在多种支持集和查询集配置下，准确性和稳定性均优于Matching Networks、Relation Networks和MAML。摘要未给出具体数值。
Conclusion: KPN通过稳定分类表示，显著改善训练收敛和泛化能力，适用于标记数据有限的实际CCGT故障检测场景。

papers.title: DroidBreaker: Practical and Functional Problem-Space Attacks on Machine-Learning Android Malware Detectors
papers.abstract_en: Adversarial APKs are Android applications modified in the problem space to evade machine-learning malware detectors. In this work, we first show that, despite claims, existing problem-space attacks remain largely impractical. Most techniques leverage software transplantation to inject entire benign modules, introducing many side-effect features and often causing build-time failures. Fine-grained methods that inject only a narrow subset of components exhibit limited effectiveness, while those that also use obfuscation rely on brittle bytecode rewriting, producing APKs that are syntactically valid but semantically unusable. Prior work further overestimates attack success rates by running smoke tests that only validate installation and basic execution, without assessing whether the modified APK still preserves its intended behavior. To overcome these limitations, we present DROIDBREAKER, a practical (build-safe) and functional (semantics-preserving) problem-space attack framework that provides: (i) query-efficient white- and black-box attacks by manipulating only the APK components most influential to the target model; (ii) a set of fine-grained, build-safe manipulations (including injection and obfuscation of API calls, app modules, permissions, and URLs) with minimal side effects; and (iii) a semantics-preserving functionality test that enforces runtime equivalence by comparing execution logs and API-level traces between the initial and the modified APK. Evaluated on a recent corpus of Android applications, DROIDBREAKER achieves high evasion rates with few queries and minimal side effects in both white-box and black-box settings, and drastically reduces detections by commercial malware scanners hosted on VirusTotal.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 DroidBreaker，一个实用的、保留语义的针对机器学习安卓恶意软件检测器的对抗性攻击框架。它通过细粒度的、构建安全的操作（如注入 API 调用、应用模块、权限和 URL）以及运行时等价测试，实现了高逃逸率和低查询次数。
Motivation: 现有针对安卓恶意软件检测的对抗性攻击方法大多不实用：依赖软件移植引入大量副作用特征、细粒度方法效果有限、混淆方法依赖脆弱的字节码重写导致语义不可用，且先前工作高估攻击成功率。
Method: DroidBreaker 框架包括：查询高效的白盒/黑盒攻击（操纵对目标模型影响最大的 APK 组件）、一组细粒度且构建安全的操作（注入和混淆 API 调用、模块、权限、URL），以及一个基于执行日志和 API 级轨迹比较的语义保持功能测试。
Result: 在最新安卓应用语料上，DroidBreaker 在白盒和黑盒设置下均以少量查询和最小副作用实现高逃逸率，并显著降低了 VirusTotal 商业恶意软件扫描器的检测。
Conclusion: DroidBreaker 证明了构建实用且功能保持的对抗性攻击是可行的，对评估机器学习恶意软件检测器的鲁棒性具有参考价值。

papers.title: Intracranial Aneurysm Classification and Segmentation via Tri-Axial ROI and Multi-Task Learning
papers.abstract_en: Intracranial aneurysms are often asymptomatic until rupture, which carries high mortality. Rupture risk assessment and treatment planning depend on both aneurysm morphology and anatomical location, yet existing automated methods remain limited to binary detection without fine-grained anatomical classification or multi-class segmentation. We present a multi-task framework that simultaneously performs multi-label classification, multi-class aneurysm segmentation, and multi-class vessel segmentation across 13 anatomical locations and four imaging modalities (CTA, MRA, T2, T1-post). Our two-stage approach combines a fast 2D tri-axial Region of Interest (ROI) extraction method with a 3D multi-task nnU-Net backbone. A dual-decoder design mitigates the extreme volume imbalance between aneurysm and vessel classes, while cross-attention pooling and modality-specific auxiliary heads improve feature learning across heterogeneous inputs. Our two-fold ensemble achieved 2nd place in the RSNA 2025 Intracranial Aneurysm Detection challenge. Code, model weights, and a 3D Slicer plugin are publicly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个多任务框架，同时进行多标签分类、多类动脉瘤分割和多类血管分割，涵盖13个解剖位置和四种影像模态（CTA、MRA、T2、T1-post）。方法包括快速2D三轴ROI提取和3D多任务nnU-Net主干，双解码器设计缓解动脉瘤与血管之间的极端体积不平衡，交叉注意力池化和模态特定辅助头改进跨异构输入的特征学习。两折集成在RSNA 2025颅内动脉瘤检测挑战中获第二名。
Motivation: 现有自动化方法仅限于二元检测，缺乏细粒度解剖分类或多类分割，而破裂风险评估和治疗规划依赖于动脉瘤形态和解剖位置。
Method: 两阶段方法：第一阶段使用快速2D三轴ROI提取，第二阶段采用基于3D多任务nnU-Net的双解码器结构，结合交叉注意力池化和模态特定辅助头来改进特征学习。
Result: 两折集成在RSNA 2025颅内动脉瘤检测挑战中取得第二名。
Conclusion: 多任务学习框架能有效处理颅内动脉瘤的细粒度分类与分割，代码、模型权重和3D Slicer插件已公开。

papers.title: Algorithmic Foundations of Deep Learning: Complexity-Theoretic Rates and a Characterization of Universal Approximation
papers.abstract_en: Feedforward neural network (NN) expressivity is typically studied by emulating optimal basis-expansion schemes. While powerful, this perspective is incomplete: it primarily captures complexity through regularity, and therefore does not distinguish intuitively simple and complicated objects with comparable regularity, such as the square-root function and a typical Brownian path. The guiding message is that neural networks should be viewed not only as flexible basis functions, but also as models of computation. If a function is computable by a real-valued circuit over a prescribed elementary gate language, then it can be computed to comparable accuracy by an NN with explicit depth, width, and non-zero-parameter bounds controlled by the depth, width, gate count, and gate structure. Thus, neural-network complexity is not governed by regularity alone, but also by algorithmic complexity. We then show that any definable NN model satisfying a natural parallelization condition, allowing possibly multivariate non-linearities such as attention or layer normalization, is a universal approximator if and only if it contains a non-affine nonlinearity. The scope of our theory is illustrated by deducing universal approximation guarantees for continuous functions, minimax-optimal approximation guarantees for Besov classes, logarithmic-error complexity for holomorphic functions, and by showing that NNs can emulate numerical algorithms such as Newton-Raphson root finding and power iteration without architecture-specific arguments. Its precision is illustrated by shortest-path computation on $k$-vertex graphs: compiling the tropical dynamic-programming circuit yields NNs with O(log(1/ε)) non-zero parameters, exponentially improving in 1/ε over the generic $O(ε^{-c k^2})$ Lipschitz-approximation scale, for a constant c>0.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文从计算模型角度研究前馈神经网络的表达性，提出神经网络复杂度不仅由正则性决定，还受算法复杂度控制。证明任何满足并行化条件的可定义神经网络模型，当且仅当包含非仿射非线性时才是通用逼近器。理论应用于连续函数、Besov类、全纯函数的最优逼近，并展示神经网络可模拟牛顿-拉夫森法和幂迭代法等数值算法。在最短路径计算中，编译热带动态规划电路可得到仅有O(log(1/ε))非零参数的神经网络，相比通用Lipschitz逼近尺度有指数级改进。
Motivation: 现有神经网络表达性研究主要通过模拟最优基展开，仅用正则性刻画复杂度，无法区分像平方根函数和布朗路径这样正则性相似但直觉复杂度不同的对象，需要更全面的视角。
Method: 将神经网络视为计算模型，引入实值电路描述函数。定义可定义神经网络模型满足并行化条件，利用电路深度、宽度、门计数和门结构控制神经网络的深度、宽度和非零参数界限，进而证明通用逼近的充要条件。
Result: 理论表明神经网络复杂度由算法复杂度而非仅正则性主导。在最短路径计算中，得到指数级改进的非零参数复杂度O(log(1/ε))，优于通用Lipschitz逼近的O(ε^{-c k^2})。
Conclusion: 摘要强调将神经网络视为计算模型的重要性，该理论统一推导了多种函数类的逼近保证，并展示了神经网络对数值算法的模拟能力。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Learning Motion Feasibility from Point Clouds in Cluttered Environments
papers.abstract_en: Motion feasibility prediction plays a central role in robotics, particularly in task and motion planning and manipulation. A major bottleneck for this problem in cluttered environments is that infeasible planning attempts by Sampling-based motion planners (SBMPs) can incur substantial computational cost. Also existing approaches for infeasibility certification are limited to low-dimensional configuration spaces and often assume simplified geometric environments represented by primitive objects with known parameters. We study the complementary problem of learning motion feasibility prediction directly from raw RGB-D observations for a 7-DOF manipulator operating in realistic cluttered scenes. We introduce the first large-scale benchmark for this setting, comprising 2.7M grasp feasibility labels over 88 scanned objects and 190 cluttered tabletop scenes. We benchmark three representative classifier families spanning MLP- based, volumetric-CNN, and point-cloud-based Transformer architectures under matched training conditions. Our best model, GRASPFC-PTX (a point-cloud transformer), achieves an AUROC of 0.996 on Novel objects while providing predictions significantly faster than SBMPs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究从原始RGB-D观测数据中直接学习运动可行性预测，针对7-DOF机械臂在杂乱环境中的操作。作者建立了包含270万个抓取可行性标签的大规模基准，涵盖88个扫描物体和190个杂乱桌面场景。在匹配训练条件下比较了MLP、体积CNN和点云Transformer三类模型，最佳模型GRASPFC-PTX（点云Transformer）在新物体上达到0.996的AUROC，且预测速度显著快于基于采样的运动规划器。
Motivation: 运动可行性预测在机器人任务和运动规划中至关重要，但杂乱环境中基于采样的运动规划器（SBMP）的不可行规划尝试计算成本高，现有不可行性认证方法局限于低维配置空间并假设简化几何环境。
Method: 直接从RGB-D点云学习运动可行性预测，建立大规模抓取可行性标签基准，并比较MLP、体积CNN和点云Transformer三类模型家族。
Result: 最佳模型GRASPFC-PTX（点云Transformer）在新物体上AUROC达到0.996，且预测速度显著快于SBMP。
Conclusion: 研究表明从点云直接学习运动可行性预测在杂乱环境中具有高效性和高精度，为机器人运动规划提供了新途径。

papers.title: Modelling convective cell occurrence in proximity to cold fronts using extreme gradient boosting
papers.abstract_en: Machine learning is emerging as a valuable tool for convection-related applications such as post-processing numerical weather prediction output, improving understanding of convective storm climatology and potentially improving existing convective parameterization schemes. In a rapidly developing field, it is vital to assess the strengths and limitations of machine learning approaches across different applications. Here, a probabilistic model is developed using a convective cell dataset as ground truth and predictors primarily from ERA5. The model's ability to reproduce the convective cell climatology at different regions relative to cold fronts (i.e. post-frontal and pre-frontal) is assessed during the warm-season in Germany. The optimal number of features (predictors) is selected using a feature elimination strategy. Overall, the optimised model exhibits high skill in reproducing the spatial and temporal cell frequency at different regions relative to the front. While the highest cell frequency is correctly identified near the surface front, the model underestimates the actual cell count in this region. Feature importance analysis shows that the model depends most heavily on CAPE to make its predictions. Additionally, the time of day predictor is key for accurately capturing the diurnal cycle of convective cells on both sides of the cold front. The study highlights both the advantages and the limitations of data-driven models, offering valuable insights for future data-driven climate and weather prediction models.
papers.comment: To be published in Meteorologische Zeitschrift
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用极端梯度提升（XGBoost）开发了一个概率模型，以ERA5再分析数据为预测因子，以对流单体观测数据集为真值，模拟德国暖季冷锋前后区域的对流单体发生频率。通过特征消除策略选择最优预测因子集，模型在空间和时间上对冷锋附近的对流单体气候学重现表现出高技巧，但低估了表面锋面附近的实际单体数量。特征重要性分析表明，对流有效位能（CAPE）是最重要的预测因子，而一天中的时间变量对于准确捕捉冷锋两侧对流单体的日循环至关重要。
Motivation: 机器学习在强对流相关应用（如后处理数值天气预报、改进对流风暴气候学和参数化方案）中潜力巨大，但在不同应用中的优缺点需系统评估。本文旨在评估数据驱动模型在冷锋附近对流单体气候学模拟中的表现，揭示其优势与局限性。
Method: 基于XGBoost构建概率模型，以对流单体数据集作为真值，从ERA5再分析中提取预测因子。通过递归特征消除（RFE）选择最优特征集，模型输出单元格存在概率，并针对冷锋前（预锋面）和后（后锋面）区域分别评估。
Result: 优化后的模型在德国暖季冷锋前后区域对流单体的空间和时间频率重现上具有高技巧，正确识别出地表锋面附近的高频率区域，但该区域的实际单元计数被低估。CAPE是最重要的预测因子，时间变量对日循环的捕捉起关键作用。
Conclusion: 该研究展示了数据驱动模型在强对流气候学模拟中的实用性（高空间/时间技巧），但也指出其局限性（锋面附近低估），为未来数据驱动的天气气候预测模型提供了见解。
Relevance: 80

papers.title: Beyond Logical Forms: LLM-Extracted Patterns for Fallacy Classification
papers.abstract_en: In today's fast-paced information era, logical fallacies, defined as defective patterns of reasoning, inevitably contribute to the growth of information disorder. However, often fallacies appear in nuanced forms that complicate automated classification. In this study, we investigate whether merging abstract logical structures with context-level linguistic cues proves beneficial for fallacy classification, developing a framework that inductively extracts such patterns from fallacious examples and their explanations using Large Language Models (LLMs). We evaluate the impact of these patterns across different LLMs and experimental zero- and one-shot configurations, showing statistically significant improvements over zero-shot baselines and outperforming competing approaches. Cross-dataset experiments validate generalization, establishing data-driven pattern extraction as an effective method for generating logical representations.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究利用大语言模型 (LLM) 从谬误示例及其解释中归纳提取抽象逻辑结构与上下文语言线索，用于改进逻辑谬误分类。跨数据集实验表明，该模式提取方法相比零样本基线有统计显著提升，并能泛化到新数据集。
Motivation: 逻辑谬误常以微妙形式出现，自动分类困难；现有方法多依赖预定义逻辑形式，难以捕捉上下文线索。
Method: 提出一个框架，使用 LLM 从谬误示例和解释中归纳提取抽象逻辑模式，并结合上下文语言特征进行分类。
Result: 在多个零样本和单样本配置下，该方法相比零样本基线有统计显著改进，并超越竞争方法；跨数据集实验验证了泛化性。
Conclusion: 数据驱动的模式提取是生成逻辑表示的有效方法，有助于提升谬误分类性能。

papers.title: PhysEditWorld: A Large-Scale Dataset Toward Physics-Editable World Models
papers.abstract_en: Recent game world models can synthesize visually plausible, action-conditioned rollouts. However, their interaction behaviors often remain limited to exploratory or wandering trajectories, and physical dynamics are typically learned as implicit correlations from data rather than as controllable variables. This limitation hinders their applicability to authored game environments, where physical rules are deliberately designed and require explicit manipulation. We introduce PhysEditWorld, a multimodal dataset with physical parameters, with a primary focus on gravity in this initial version. At its core, PhysEditWorld is built upon a replay paradigm implemented with a UE5 replay-and-rendering pipeline. Each scenario records a normalized action trace and replays the same initial state, character controller, action sequence, and camera policy under multiple gravity configurations, enabling controlled and attributable physical variation. PhysEditWorld contains 12 cinematic UE5 scenes, over 100 hours of gameplay interactions, and more than 60 million rendered rollout frames. Each sample provides synchronized multimodal signals, including RGB, depth, normals, audio, action traces, camera trajectory, engine states, semantic annotations, and explicit gravity labels. We further conduct initial utility studies on both generative video models and world understanding models, demonstrating that PhysEditWorld enables improved gravity-faithful dynamics modeling, enhances consistency under physical edits, and provides a scalable foundation for controllable world modeling research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PhysEditWorld，一个大规模多模态物理可编辑数据集，专注于重力参数。基于UE5重放渲染管道，包含12个场景、100小时交互、6000万帧，提供RGB、深度、法线、音频、动作轨迹、相机轨迹、引擎状态、语义标注和重力标签。初步实验表明该数据集有助于重力忠实动态建模和物理编辑一致性。
Motivation: 现有游戏世界模型虽然能生成视觉合理的动作条件轨迹，但物理动态通常作为隐式相关性学习，缺乏可控制的物理变量，限制了在游戏环境中的应用。
Method: 通过UE5重放渲染管道，记录归一化动作序列并在多种重力配置下重放相同初始状态、角色控制器、动作序列和相机策略，生成可控物理变化的多模态数据。
Result: 数据集包含12个电影级UE5场景、超过100小时游戏交互、超过6000万帧渲染帧，提供多种模态信号。初步实验显示其能提升重力忠实动态建模和物理编辑一致性。
Conclusion: 该数据集为可控世界建模研究提供了可扩展的基础，特别是物理参数编辑方面。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Attributed, But Not Incremental: Cannibalization-Corrected Attribution for Large-Scale Advertising
papers.abstract_en: In large-scale paid acquisition and growth advertising systems, production attribution outputs are widely used for daily budget allocation and channel diagnosis. However, paid-attributed conversions such as daily new users (DNU) may systematically overstate true incremental growth when paid channels overlap with organic demand, brand-driven traffic, or other acquisition channels. This attribution-cannibalization mismatch can distort incremental ROI measurement and budget decisions at scale. We propose an experiment-calibrated attribution correction framework that uses incrementality experiments as causal anchors to convert sparse lift measurements into daily correction estimates. To make the corrected signal actionable at production granularity, we further allocate calibrated cannibalization volume across business hierarchies under structural consistency constraints. Offline forward-in-time validation against channel-level incrementality experiment readouts shows that the proposed framework substantially reduces calibration error relative to raw attribution and fine-grained ML baselines. Deployed across multiple global TikTok markets, the system supported budget and traffic strategy adjustments that were followed by an approximately 15-percentage-point reduction in the measured cannibalization rate.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大规模广告系统中归因输出可能高估真实增量增长的问题，提出一个实验校准的归因修正框架。该框架利用增量实验作为因果锚点，将稀疏的提升测量转化为每日修正估计，并在业务层级分配校准后的蚕食量。离线验证显示校准误差显著降低，在TikTok全球市场部署后，蚕食率降低了约15个百分点。
Motivation: 付费广告归因可能系统性地高估真实增量增长，因为付费渠道与自然需求、品牌驱动流量或其他获取渠道存在重叠，导致增量ROI测量失真，影响预算决策。
Method: 提出实验校准的归因修正框架，以增量实验为因果锚点，将稀疏的提升测量转化为每日修正估计，并在结构一致性约束下将校准后的蚕食量分配到业务层级。
Result: 离线前向验证表明，该框架相对于原始归因和细粒度ML基线显著降低了校准误差；在多个全球TikTok市场部署后，测量到的蚕食率下降了约15个百分点。
Conclusion: 该框架能够纠正归因-蚕食不匹配问题，使修正后的信号可用于生产粒度的预算分配和渠道诊断。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DeCoFlow: Structural Decomposition of Normalizing Flows for Continual Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract_en: In industrial environments, new product categories arrive sequentially, requiring continual anomaly detection without access to past data. Normalizing Flows (NFs) provide exact density estimation but suffer from catastrophic forgetting as parameter updates across tasks distort the density manifold. While parameter isolation can prevent interference, it must preserve the strict invertibility and Jacobian validity of NFs. To satisfy these requirements, we exploit the inherent property that affine coupling layers maintain transformation validity regardless of subnet parameterization. Based on this, we propose DeCoFlow, which decomposes subnets into a frozen universal base and task-specific low-rank adapters to isolate updates. We further introduce Task-Specific Alignment, Auxiliary Coupling Layers, and Tail-Aware Loss to compensate for frozen-base rigidity. DeCoFlow achieves state-of-the-art image-level AUROCs of 98.40% on MVTec-AD and 93.00% on VisA, while maintaining parameter-level zero forgetting (0.00% FM under correct routing) with only 2.27M parameters per task.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对工业环境中新产品类别顺序到达、无历史数据的持续异常检测问题，提出DeCoFlow，利用归一化流（Normalizing Flows）的仿射耦合层特性，将子网络分解为冻结通用基和任务特定低秩适配器，以避免灾难性遗忘。实验在MVTec-AD和VisA上达到图像级AUROC 98.40%和93.00%，参数级零遗忘。
Motivation: 持续异常检测中，归一化流因参数更新导致密度流形扭曲，遭受灾难性遗忘；现有参数隔离方法需保持严格可逆性和雅可比有效性。
Method: 基于仿射耦合层子网络参数化不影响变换有效性的性质，将子网络分解为冻结通用基和任务特定低秩适配器（LoRA-like），并提出任务特定对齐、辅助耦合层和尾损失以补偿冻结基的刚性。
Result: 在MVTec-AD和VisA上分别达到98.40%和93.00%图像级AUROC，参数级零遗忘（0.00% FM），每任务仅2.27M参数。
Conclusion: 摘要强调DeCoFlow在持续异常检测中实现了参数级零遗忘和SOTA性能，但未讨论跨任务迁移或泛化到其他领域（如天气预报）的可能性。

papers.title: Do Safety Guardrails Need to Reason? LeanGuard: A Fast and Light Approach for Robust Moderation
papers.abstract_en: In order to screen a prompt or a response, the recent guardrail methods generate a chain-of-thought (CoT) before they issue a verdict. This design follows a common belief that step-by-step reasoning improves a decision. However, CoT also makes the guard heavy and slow, because the model must generate many tokens before it decides. This may not match how guardrails are actually deployed. A guardrail sometimes should not be heavy and slow, and it often runs on-device, for example on an embodied robot. In this paper, we pose a question whether a safety guardrail really needs to reason. To answer this question, we train a lightweight bidirectional encoder and a reasoning guard on the same corpus, and we then remove only the reasoning while we keep everything else fixed. With this controlled same-base comparison, we show that the chain does not improve moderation accuracy. We name the resulting guard LeanGuard. A 395M label-only encoder reaches an average F1 of 82.90 $\pm$ 0.26 over public benchmarks. It matches a reasoning guard that is built on a much larger decoder, while it uses only a single forward pass over an input of at most 512 tokens. This is about a ~100x reduction in inference compute. We further show that this label-only encoder stays robust under training-label noise and retains far more recall at a strict false-positive rate than the reasoning guard, so a heavier reasoning guard is not the more robust choice either. Our finding suggests that the current guardrail benchmarks may not be hard enough to reward reasoning, and that the necessity of CoT for moderation is still not proven. We release all source codes and models including LeanGuard at https://github.com/ndb796/LeanGuard.
papers.comment: 9 pages, 6 figures, 3 tables. Project page: https://ndb796.github.io/LeanGuard ; code and models: https://github.com/ndb796/LeanGuard
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文质疑安全护栏是否需要推理（chain-of-thought）。通过控制实验，训练一个轻量级双向编码器（395M参数）和推理护栏在相同语料上，然后仅移除推理部分，发现CoT并不提高审核准确率。LeanGuard仅用单次前向传播（最多512 token）即可匹配更大解码器的推理护栏，推理计算量减少约100倍，且在标签噪声下保持鲁棒。
Motivation: 当前护栏方法通常先产生链式思维再做出决策，导致模型变重变慢，不适合在设备端（如机器人）部署。作者质疑安全护栏是否真的需要推理。
Method: 训练一个轻量级双向编码器（标签仅编码器）和推理护栏在相同语料上，然后仅移除推理部分，保持其他一切固定，进行受控相同基线的比较。
Result: 395M标签仅编码器在公开基准上平均F1为82.90±0.26，匹配基于更大解码器的推理护栏，但推理计算量减少约100倍。在严格假阳性率下，标签仅编码器召回率远高于推理护栏。
Conclusion: 当前护栏基准可能不够难，不足以奖励推理；CoT对于审核的必要性尚未被证实。作者发布了所有源码和模型。

papers.title: NebulaExp-8B: An Empirical Post-Training Pipeline via Full-Scale Ablation Research
papers.abstract_en: Post-training alignment determines the reasoning and human preference following capabilities of large language models, yet most existing works withhold detailed data construction, filtering rules and training recipes, which hinders community reproducibility and lightweight model optimization. This work presents NebulaExp, a fully transparent, ablation-driven post-training pipeline built on Qwen3-8B-base, covering two orthogonal model branches: general instruct model and complex reasoning-specialized model. We curate a raw corpus of 3.84M multi-source SFT samples and a 200K verifiable RL candidate pool, and design an end-to-end data processing stack including response distillation, multi-dimensional cross-verification filtering, fine-grained difficulty grading, task classification and diversity-aware sampling. For the Instruct branch, our three-stage optimized supervised fine-tuning approach NebulaExp-Ins-SFT improves the average benchmark score from the 55.01 baseline of Qwen3-8B-nothink to 60.99. GRPO reinforcement learning then further elevates the average score to 61.85. For the Reasoning branch, medium-difficulty GRPO RL improves average reasoning score from 73.88 to 75.17. To address RL's dependency on task verifiers, we systematically investigate single-teacher and multi-teacher OPD (MOPD): utilizing merely 4K instruction-following samples and outperforms RL baseline by 3.26 points on IFEval with +4.43 average overall gain; MOPD fuses four domain-specialist teachers with merely 10K samples, lifting average performance by 4.18 over the base model. This report provides a fully reproducible empirical post-training recipe for 8B-scale LLMs, and comprehensively dissects the capability trade-offs among instruction adherence, mathematical reasoning, code generation and general knowledge.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了NebulaExp，一个完全透明、基于消融实验的后训练管道，基于Qwen3-8B-base构建，涵盖通用指令模型和复杂推理模型两个分支。通过构建384万条多源SFT样本和20万条可验证RL候选池，采用端到端数据处理流程（包括响应蒸馏、多维交叉验证过滤、细粒度难度分级等），在Instruct分支上通过三阶段优化SFT将平均基准分数从55.01提升至60.99，再经GRPO RL提升至61.85；在Reasoning分支上，中等难度GRPO RL将平均推理分数从73.88提升至75.17。此外，系统探索了单教师和多教师OPD（MOPD），仅用4K指令遵循样本在IFEval上超越RL基线3.26分，平均提升4.43分。
Motivation: 现有后训练工作大多隐藏详细数据构建、过滤规则和训练配方，阻碍社区复现和轻量模型优化。
Method: 提出全透明、消融驱动的后训练管道，包括多源SFT数据构建、三阶段优化SFT、GRPO强化学习、以及单/多教师OPD（MOPD），并系统研究数据过滤、难度分级、任务分类等策略。
Result: Instruct分支平均分数从55.01提升至61.85；Reasoning分支平均推理分数从73.88提升至75.17；OPD用4K样本在IFEval上超越RL基线3.26分，平均提升4.43分。
Conclusion: 提供了完全可复现的8B规模后训练配方，并剖析了指令遵循、数学推理、代码生成和通用知识之间的能力权衡。

papers.title: SKILL-DISCO: Distilling and Compiling Agent Traces into Reusable Procedural Skills
papers.abstract_en: Agents often repeatedly solve similar task instances from scratch, leading to unnecessary reasoning cost and long execution traces. Prior work has explored workflow reuse and executable skill induction, but it remains unclear which task scenarios admit procedural skills and how the shared procedural structure should be represented across successful traces. We study this problem in FSM-defined scenarios, where successful traces can be viewed as paths in an unknown transition graph, and formulate procedural skills as reusable parameterized control-flow subgraphs. Based on this view, we introduce SkillDisCo, a distillation-and-compilation framework that distills reusable PFSM subgraphs from successful traces and compiles them into callable, executable, and verifiable procedural skills. Experiments on ALFWorld and WebArena show that SkillDisCo improves success rates and reduces agent turns across benchmarks and model scales, demonstrating the benefits of representing shared experience as reusable execution structures.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究如何从智能体成功执行任务的轨迹中提取可重用的程序化技能，提出SkillDisCo框架，将轨迹蒸馏为可编译的技能子图，并在ALFWorld和WebArena上提升了成功率和减少了执行步数。
Motivation: 智能体经常重复解决相似任务实例，导致不必要的推理成本和长执行轨迹，现有工作未明确哪些场景适合程序化技能以及如何表示共享程序结构。
Method: 提出SkillDisCo框架，在有限状态机定义的任务场景中，将成功轨迹视为未知转移图中的路径，将程序化技能表示为可重用的参数化控制流子图，通过蒸馏和编译得到可调用、可执行、可验证的技能。
Result: 在ALFWorld和WebArena上，SkillDisCo提升了成功率并减少了智能体执行步数，效果跨基准和模型规模一致。
Conclusion: 将共享经验表示为可重用的执行结构（程序化技能）能有效提升智能体效率和效果。

papers.title: Disco-LoRA: Disentangled Composition of Content, Style, and Motion for Multi-concept Video Customization
papers.abstract_en: Video customization based on Text-to-Video (T2V) models aims to learn specific features from reference data to generate controllable videos. While significant strides have been made in image stylization and video motion customization, simultaneously controlling multiple concepts, such as content, style, and motion, remains a major challenge. In this work, we systematically define the task of multi-concept video customization, which requires the joint control of content, style, and motion. To facilitate research in this area, we construct a comprehensive benchmark and propose Disco-LoRA, a unified framework designed to tackle this problem by disentangling and flexibly recombining different concepts in two stages: (1) We decompose the objective into two sub-tasks: Content-Style and Content-Motion. Each sub-task is addressed using our Iterative Dual-LoRA Disentanglement Framework, which effectively disentangles distinct concepts within the data. (2) We identify layer-wise weight trends as crucial for LoRA identity, while weight magnitudes dictate composability. To harmonize these scales, we propose a Z-score-based statistical regularization that aligns weight distributions, preserving layer-wise trends while minimizing interference between different LoRAs. Extensive experiments show that Disco-LoRA excels in multi-concept video customization, effectively preserving appearance, style, and motion for controllable text-to-video generation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对多概念视频定制任务，提出 Disco-LoRA 框架，通过两阶段解耦内容、风格和动作，实现可控视频生成。第一阶段使用迭代双 LoRA 解耦框架分离内容-风格和内容-动作子任务，第二阶段通过基于 Z 分数的统计正则化对齐 LoRA 权重分布，减少干扰。实验表明该方法在保持外观、风格和动作方面表现优异。
Motivation: 现有视频定制工作大多只控制单一概念（如风格或动作），难以同时控制内容、风格和动作多个概念，缺乏统一的多概念视频定制框架和基准。
Method: 提出 Disco-LoRA，分两阶段：1) 将目标分解为内容-风格和内容-动作两个子任务，每个子任务使用迭代双 LoRA 解耦框架分离概念；2) 识别层间权重趋势对 LoRA 身份至关重要，权重幅度决定可组合性，提出基于 Z 分数的统计正则化对齐权重分布，保留层间趋势同时减少干扰。
Result: 大量实验表明 Disco-LoRA 在多概念视频定制中表现优异，有效保持外观、风格和动作，实现可控文本到视频生成。
Conclusion: 本文系统定义了多概念视频定制任务，构建了基准，并提出了有效的解耦和组合框架。但摘要未明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: PersistentKV: Page-Aware Decode Scheduling for Long-Context LLM Serving on Commodity GPUs
papers.abstract_en: Autoregressive large language model (LLM) serving is increasingly limited by key-value (KV) cache movement rather than dense matrix multiplication. Modern paged-attention systems reduce KV-cache fragmentation and mature kernels such as FlashInfer provide highly optimized native-paged decode attention. However, the best single-kernel implementation is not always the best serving schedule: low-active long-context decode can under-utilize commodity GPUs, while mixed sequence lengths introduce a tension between many exact-length launches and coarse padded batches. We present PersistentKV, a native block-table decode attention engine and page-aware scheduling study for grouped-query attention (GQA). PersistentKV maps work by KV-head group, is designed to reuse K,V tiles across grouped query heads, supports native page tables, and adds a compact workqueue schedule that executes only non-empty row-KV-head-sequence-split tasks. On an RTX 3060 with FP16, page size 16, Hq=32, Hkv=8, d=128, and identical correctness tolerance against FlashInfer, a calibrated adaptive policy selects FlashInfer for small active batches, PersistentKV sequence splitting for B1 long-context steps, and PersistentKV workqueue scheduling for B8 long-context steps. With thresholds and split counts fixed on calibration traces, one held-out trace seed improves synchronized wall throughput by 1.063-1.265x on B8 bimodal, uniform, and Zipf-like workloads and by 1.399x on a B1 bucketed trace. On the B4 bimodal boundary case, the policy avoids the PersistentKV regression by selecting FlashInfer. These results identify a concrete systems niche for adaptive page-aware decode scheduling and show that work assignment, not only attention math, is a decisive serving-system variable.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PersistentKV，一个针对长上下文LLM服务的页感知解码调度引擎。通过按KV头组映射工作、重用KV tiles和使用紧凑工作队列仅执行非空任务，在RTX 3060上相比FlashInfer实现1.063-1.399x的吞吐量提升，表明任务分配是重要的服务系统变量。
Motivation: 现有paged-attention系统（如FlashInfer）在低活跃度长上下文解码时GPU利用率不足，混合序列长度带来平衡问题，需要更好的调度策略。
Method: 提出PersistentKV引擎，支持原生块表解码注意力，按KV头组映射工作，重用KV tiles，并使用紧凑工作队列仅执行非空行-KV-头-序列分割任务。
Result: 在RTX 3060上，自适应策略在B8 bimodal/uniform/Zipf-like工作负载下吞吐量提升1.063-1.265倍，在B1分桶轨迹下提升1.399倍；B4边界情况选择FlashInfer避免回归。
Conclusion: 结果表明页感知解码调度具有系统价值，任务分配是决定性的服务系统变量。

papers.title: TGHE: Template-based Graph Homomorphic Encryption for Privacy-Preserving GNN Inference in Edge-Cloud Systems
papers.abstract_en: Existing homomorphic encryption (HE)-based GNN systems adopt a graph-centric paradigm that couples per-query cost to global graph size, limiting evaluations to at most ~20k nodes and making them incompatible with dynamic, large-scale financial graphs. We propose TGHE (Template-based Graph Homomorphic Encryption), an ego-centric framework that resolves this by exploiting a template phenomenon: local computation trees in transaction graphs converge into a small set of structural shapes. TGHE canonicalizes ego-graphs at the edge and packs structurally identical trees into shared CKKS ciphertexts for SIMD-parallel encrypted inference, with two long-tail optimizers (Approximate Template Fitting and Topology Collapse) ensuring full SIMD coverage. On DGraphFin (3.7M nodes, 4.3M edges), TGHE-Collapse achieves a 66.9x speedup over the sequential encrypted baseline with less than 0.002 AUC loss.
papers.comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at IEEE ICWS 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TGHE（Template-based Graph Homomorphic Encryption），一种基于模板的图同态加密框架，用于边缘-云系统中隐私保护的GNN推理。通过利用交易图中局部计算树收敛为少量结构模板的现象，将结构相同的树打包到共享CKKS密文中进行SIMD并行加密推理，并设计了两种长尾优化器（近似模板拟合和拓扑折叠）确保完整SIMD覆盖。在DGraphFin（370万节点，430万边）上，TGHE-Collapse相对于顺序加密基线实现了66.9倍加速，AUC损失小于0.002。
Motivation: 现有基于同态加密的GNN系统采用图中心范式，每次查询成本与全局图规模耦合，限制了评估节点数最多约2万个，且无法适应动态大规模金融图。
Method: 提出TGHE，一种以自我为中心的框架，通过将局部计算树规范化为少量结构模板，并将结构相同的树打包到共享CKKS密文中进行SIMD并行加密推理。设计了两种长尾优化器（近似模板拟合和拓扑折叠）确保完整SIMD覆盖。
Result: 在DGraphFin（370万节点，430万边）上，TGHE-Collapse相对于顺序加密基线实现了66.9倍加速，AUC损失小于0.002。
Conclusion: TGHE通过模板现象和SIMD打包，实现了大规模图上的高效隐私保护GNN推理，且精度损失极小。

papers.title: Zero-Shot Size Transfer for Neural ODEs on Sparse Random Graphs: Graphon Limits and Adjoint Convergence
papers.abstract_en: Graph Neural Differential Equations (GNDEs) model continuous-time graph dynamics by parameterizing Neural ODE velocity fields with Graph Neural Networks. Their local, size-independent filters suggest a zero-shot size-transfer principle: train on a small graph and deploy on larger, similar graphs without retraining. We develop a quantitative theory for this principle on sparse random graphs sampled from graphons. We consider Graphon Neural Differential Equations (Graphon-NDEs) and adjoint Graphon-NDEs as the infinite-node limits of the forward and adjoint GNDE systems, and establish well-posedness. For an $n$-node random graph with sparsity parameter $α_n$, we prove trajectory-wise convergence of GNDE solutions to Graphon-NDE solutions at rate $O((α_n n)^{-1/2})$, up to logarithmic factors, with high probability. We also establish uniform-in-time convergence bounds for adjoint systems governing hidden-state and parameter gradients. We further study discretize-then-optimize (DTO) and optimize-then-discretize (OTD) training. Under explicit Euler discretization with $M$ steps, we show that DTO and OTD are asymptotically consistent, with hidden-state and local parameter-gradient discrepancies of orders $O(1/M)$ and $O(1/M^2)$, respectively, up to sparsity and logarithmic factors. Experiments on HSBM and tent graphons support the theoretical rates, while zero-shot transfer experiments across four graphon classes demonstrate accurate deployment of learned GNDEs on larger independently sampled graphs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文针对图神经微分方程（GNDE）的零样本尺寸迁移原理发展定量理论，考虑从图极限（graphon）采样的稀疏随机图。建立了图极限神经微分方程（Graphon-NDE）及其伴随系统的适定性，证明了GNDE解收敛到Graphon-NDE解的速率，并分析了离散化训练方法的一致性。实验在HSBM和tent图极限上验证理论速率，并在四种图极限类别上展示零样本迁移的准确性。
Motivation: 图神经微分方程具有局部且尺寸无关的滤波器，暗示了零样本尺寸迁移的可能性，但缺乏定量理论支持。本文旨在为稀疏随机图上的这种迁移提供严格的理论保证。
Method: 将图极限神经微分方程（Graphon-NDE）和伴随Graphon-NDE作为前向和伴随GNDE系统的无限节点极限，证明适定性。导出GNDE解收敛到Graphon-NDE解的速率，以及伴随系统中隐藏状态和参数梯度的均匀时间界。进一步分析离散化-优化（DTO）和优化-离散化（OTD）两种训练方式的一致性。
Result: 在稀疏随机图上，GNDE解以速率O((α_n n)^{-1/2})（忽略对数因子）收敛到Graphon-NDE解。DTO和OTD训练在显式欧拉离散化下渐近一致，隐藏状态和局部参数梯度差异阶数分别为O(1/M)和O(1/M^2)。实验支持理论速率，零样本迁移实验证明在更大独立采样图上的准确部署。
Conclusion: 本文为图神经微分方程的零样本尺寸迁移提供了严格的数学理论基础，证明了在稀疏随机图上GNDE解、伴随系统以及离散化训练方法的收敛性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: LAMP: Lane-Aligned Motion Primitives for Feasible Trajectory Prediction
papers.abstract_en: Motion forecasting is essential for autonomous driving systems to enable safe decision-making and planning in complex driving scenarios. While existing predictors excel at minimizing standard displacement errors, they often overlook the adherence to lane topology of multimodal predictions, particularly for lower-probability modes. Consequently, predicted trajectories may violate physical and logical constraints, making the prediction set unreliable for safety-critical planning. In this paper, we propose LAMP (Lane-Aligned Motion Primitives), a topology-aware forecasting framework that anchors multimodal prediction to structured motion primitives aligned with lane topology. Specifically, we use a VQ-VAE to learn shape-aware motion primitives as discrete intention queries, capturing spatiotemporal patterns beyond endpoint-based intentions. We further introduce a feasibility-aware intention selector trained with a lane-topology prior for filtering unreachable intention queries, guiding the decoder to prioritize topology-consistent intentions while preserving behavioral diversity. Extensive experiments on the Argoverse 2 dataset demonstrate that LAMP achieves prediction accuracy comparable to state-of-the-art baselines while outperforming them in feasibility and diversity metrics.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文提出 LAMP（Lane-Aligned Motion Primitives），一种基于车道拓扑对齐的运动原语的轨迹预测框架。使用 VQ-VAE 学习形状感知的运动原语作为离散意图查询，并引入基于车道拓扑先验的可行性意图选择器过滤不可达意图。在 Argoverse 2 数据集上，LAMP 达到与 SOTA 相当的预测精度，并在可行性和多样性指标上超越基线。
Motivation: 现有轨迹预测模型在最小化位移误差时往往忽略多模态预测的车道拓扑一致性，特别是低概率模式可能违反物理和逻辑约束，影响安全关键规划。
Method: 使用 VQ-VAE 学习形状感知的运动原语作为离散意图查询，捕捉超越端点意图的时空模式；训练以车道拓扑先验的可行性感知意图选择器，过滤不可达意图，引导解码器优先选择拓扑一致意图同时保持行为多样性。
Result: 在 Argoverse 2 数据集上，LAMP 预测精度与 SOTA 基线相当，并在可行性和多样性指标上优于基线。
Conclusion: LAMP 通过车道对齐的运动原语和拓扑先验，在保持精度的同时提升了轨迹的可行性和多样性，适用于安全关键的自动驾驶规划。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Generating Special Triangulations with Transformers
papers.abstract_en: Triangulations, i.e., well-structured decompositions of geometric objects into triangle-like pieces, are central objects in many domains of mathematics and physics. In particular, fine, regular, and star triangulations (FRSTs) of 4D reflexive polytopes give rise to smooth Calabi-Yau threefolds, which are of significant interest in string theory. However, the high dimensionality and combinatorial complexity of triangulations make them particularly challenging to model with classical numerical methods or machine learning. In this work, we show that transformers, equipped with an appropriate encoding scheme, can be effectively trained to representatively generate new FRSTs across a range of polytope sizes. Moreover, these models can also self-improve through retraining on their own output. This opens the door to both concrete applications to the classification of Calabi-Yau manifolds and further research in physics, combinatorics and algebraic geometry.
papers.comment: 21 pages, 11 figures. Contribution to the edited volume "Recent Progress in Computational String Geometry" (World Scientific), based on the BIRS-CMI workshop (26w5653)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用Transformer模型，在适当编码方案下，有效生成4D自反多面体的细、正则、星形三角剖分（FRSTs），这类三角剖分对应于光滑Calabi-Yau三维流形，在弦理论中具有重要价值。模型还能通过自身输出进行再训练实现自我改进。
Motivation: 三角剖分是数学和物理中的核心对象，但高维度和组合复杂性使经典数值方法或机器学习难以建模，亟需新的生成方法。
Method: 采用Transformer架构，设计特定编码方案来表示三角剖分，通过监督学习生成FRSTs，并利用自训练（在自身输出上再训练）提升性能。
Result: 实验表明，Transformer能在多种多面体尺寸上代表性地生成新的FRSTs，且模型可通过自我改进策略进一步提高生成质量。
Conclusion: 该方法为Calabi-Yau流形分类及应用提供了新途径，并促进物理学、组合学和代数几何的交叉研究。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Target-Aware Bandit Allocation for Scalable Surrogate Optimization in Chemical Space
papers.abstract_en: Identifying high-utility candidates from massive discrete spaces under expensive evaluations is a recurring challenge across the sciences, with structure-based drug discovery as a prominent example. While surrogate-based optimization can increase sample efficiency by reducing the number of expensive evaluations, modern molecular libraries have reached billions to trillions of compounds, making full-library surrogate inference itself a major computational bottleneck. We introduce BOBa, a bandit-guided surrogate optimization framework that eliminates full-library inference by adaptively allocating computation across partitions of the action space. By treating partitions as arms in a multi-armed bandit, BOBa concentrates inference and evaluations on empirically promising partitions while maintaining principled exploration. Experiments on real-world synthesis-on-demand libraries demonstrate that optimism-under-uncertainty bandits, combined with meaningful action space partitioning, are essential for effective allocation of inference and evaluations. Our findings reveal a tunable tradeoff between screening performance and surrogate inference cost, which supports practical optimization over current libraries, and establishes a viable route to ultra-large library virtual screening.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出BOBa框架，利用多臂老虎机（bandit）指导代理优化，将动作空间分区视为臂，通过乐观不确定性策略自适应分配推理和评估计算，避免对全库进行代理推理。在真实合成按需分子库上的实验表明，该方法能有效平衡筛选性能和推理成本，为超大型库虚拟筛选提供可行路径。
Motivation: 现代分子库规模已达数十亿至万亿级别，传统代理优化需要对全库进行推理，计算成为瓶颈，亟需可扩展的筛选方法。
Method: 将动作空间划分为多个分区，每个分区视为老虎机的一个臂；采用乐观不确定性（optimism-under-uncertainty）策略自适应分配推理和评估资源，集中计算于有希望的分区，同时保持探索。
Result: 在真实合成按需库上，乐观不确定性bandit结合有意义的分区是实现高效分配的关键；实验揭示了筛选性能与代理推理成本之间的可调权衡。
Conclusion: 该方法支持当前库的实际优化，并为超大型库虚拟筛选建立了可行路线，但摘要未提及局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Scalable Operator Learning via Nyström Approximation With Denoising Applications
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we study Nyström subsampling for vector-valued regression in vector-valued reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces. Standard kernel methods often suffer from prohibitive computational costs due to the construction and inversion of large kernel matrices, which limits their scalability to large datasets. To overcome this bottleneck, we propose an efficient operator learning algorithm based on Nyström subsampling that accommodates functional outputs. Under general source conditions characterized by index functions-extending beyond the classical Hölder-type and operator-monotone frameworks-we establish minimax-optimal convergence rates for the proposed estimator. As an application of the proposed framework, we consider function denoising problems. Unlike classical denoising methods, which are typically tailored to specific signal representations or noise models, our approach formulates denoising within a general operator learning framework. Numerical experiments on signal denoising, real-time audio denoising, image denoising, inverse Radon transform reconstruction, and energy-efficiency prediction confirm that the proposed method achieves performance comparable to full kernel methods while substantially reducing computational cost.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究向量值再生核希尔伯特空间中的Nyström子采样方法，提出一种可扩展的算子学习算法，适用于函数输出场景。在一般源条件下建立了极小化最优收敛速率，并将其应用于信号、音频、图像去噪及逆Radon变换重建等问题。数值实验表明该方法在显著降低计算成本的同时，性能与全核方法相当。
Motivation: 标准核方法因大核矩阵的构建和求逆导致计算成本过高，限制了其对大规模数据集的扩展性。本文旨在克服这一瓶颈，提出高效算子学习算法。
Method: 基于Nyström子采样，将向量值回归扩展到函数输出场景，并在一般源条件下（超越经典Hölder型和算子单调框架）推导收敛速率。
Result: 在信号去噪、实时音频去噪、图像去噪、逆Radon变换重建和能效预测等任务上，所提方法性能与全核方法相当，但计算成本大幅降低。
Conclusion: 本文所提的算子学习方法通过Nyström近似实现了可扩展性，并在一系列去噪应用中验证了有效性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: CAT-Q: Cost-efficient and Accurate Ternary Quantization for LLMs
papers.abstract_en: In this paper, we present CAT-Q, Cost-efficient and Accurate Ternary Quantization, for compressing and accelerating LLMs. Unlike existing state-of-the-art ternary quantization methods that rely on data-intensive and costly quantization-aware training to mitigate severe performance degradation, CAT-Q is a simple yet effective post-training quantization scheme that is readily applicable to LLMs with diverse architectures and model sizes. It has two key components, learnable modulation (LM) and softened ternarization (ST), which are coupled from an optimization perspective. LM leverages a composition of learnable factors to modulate the distribution of pre-trained high-precision weights and the ternary threshold, making them less sensitive to ternarization. ST further introduces a differentiable transition function to guide the ternarization process toward stable convergence. We show that, for pre-trained LLMs with 1.7B to 8B parameters, CAT-Q can efficiently quantize them into ternary models using only 512 calibration samples, while achieving superior performance than the seminal BitNet 1.58-bit v1 and v2 families (with 1.3B to 7B parameters) trained with 100B tokens, yielding about a 100,000X reduction in training tokens. Moreover, we show for the first time that CAT-Q can quantize much larger pre-trained LLMs having 14B to 235B parameters into leading ternary models within just 8 to 60 hours on 8 A100-80GB GPUs. Code is available at https://github.com/IntelChina-AI/BitTern.
papers.comment: This work is accepted to ICML 2026 as an oral. The project page: https://github.com/IntelChina-AI/BitTern
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出CAT-Q，一种高效且准确的三元量化方法，用于压缩和加速大语言模型。与依赖大量数据的量化感知训练方法不同，CAT-Q是后训练量化方案，仅需512个校准样本即可将1.7B至8B参数的预训练LLM量化为三元模型，性能优于BitNet 1.58-bit系列，且训练token减少约100,000倍。此外，该方法首次将14B至235B参数的更大规模LLM成功量化为三元模型，在8张A100-80GB GPU上仅需8至60小时。
Motivation: 现有三元量化方法依赖数据密集且成本高昂的量化感知训练来缓解性能退化，缺乏简单有效的后训练量化方案。
Method: 提出两个关键组件：可学习调制（LM）和软化三元化（ST）。LM通过可学习因子组合调节预训练高精度权重分布和三值阈值，降低对三元化的敏感性；ST引入可微过渡函数引导三元化过程稳定收敛。
Result: 在1.7B至8B参数的LLM上，CAT-Q仅用512个校准样本实现优于BitNet 1.58-bit v1/v2（1.3B-7B参数，训练100B tokens）的性能，训练token减少约100,000倍；首次成功量化14B至235B参数的更大LLM，在8张A100-80GB GPU上耗时8至60小时。
Conclusion: CAT-Q是一种简单、高效且通用的后训练三元量化方案，能大幅降低LLM量化的数据和时间成本，适用于多种架构和规模。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Autoformalization of Agent Instructions into Policy-as-Code
papers.abstract_en: Agent safety in high-stakes domains requires formal policy enforcement, but most existing approaches either rely on probabilistic guardrails (fine-tuned classifiers, prompt-based steering) that offer no formal guarantees, or on hand-coded symbolic enforcement that does not scale to the breadth of real policy specifications. We present an autoformalization pipeline that translates agent prompts, MCP tool descriptions, and natural language policy documents into formally verified policies using an LLM-based generator-critic loop. The resulting policies are written in the Cedar Policy Language. On the MedAgentBench benchmark, our autoformalized policies cover substantially more of the source natural-language specification than the hand-coded symbolic enforcement in prior work.
papers.comment: Accepted at the Second Workshop on Agents in the Wild: Safety, Security, and Beyond (AIWILD), ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个自动形式化流水线，将智能体提示、MCP工具描述和自然语言策略文档通过LLM生成-批评循环转换为Cedar策略语言的形式化验证策略。在MedAgentBench基准上，自动形式化策略比先前工作中手写符号化策略覆盖了更多源自然语言规范。
Motivation: 现有方法要么依赖概率性护栏（如微调分类器、提示引导）缺乏形式保证，要么采用手写符号化策略难以扩展到实际策略规范的广度。
Method: 提出一个LLM-based生成-批评循环的自动形式化流水线，输入为智能体提示、MCP工具描述和自然语言策略文档，输出为Cedar策略语言的形式化验证策略。
Result: 在MedAgentBench基准上，自动形式化策略覆盖了比先前手写符号化策略更大部分的源自然语言规范。
Conclusion: 自动形式化流水线能够从自然语言生成可验证的策略，覆盖范围优于手写方法，但仅限于特定基准和Cedar语言。

papers.title: LayersReg: A Layer-by-Layer Progressive Regressor for Reliable Intraoperative 3D/2D Registration
papers.abstract_en: 3D/2D registration serves as a cornerstone technique in surgical navigation. Traditional iterative optimization algorithms suffer from low efficiency and high failure rates in intraoperative settings. Deep learning-based methods reformulate registration from iterative optimization to a regression problem that maps image appearance features to spatial pose, typically achieving improved real-time performance and accuracy. However, such learnable methods are confined to memory-driven retrieval of specific pose features rather than understanding the task of image alignment itself, which limits their generalization in complex scenarios. We propose LayersReg, a pioneering regression paradigm that endows the model with 3D anatomical awareness and searches for the correct pose in a progressive, layer-by-layer manner. Inspired by the iterative pose-searching optimization criterion of classical registration, LayersReg searches for correlations between the moving and fixed images in feature space, capturing the trend of pixel flow and thereby converging iteratively toward the correct spatial pose transformation. We further design a coupling of node-wise regression with the progressive registration framework to enhance the model's perception of spatial pose changes. Experimental results demonstrate that under large offsets and multimodality conditions, LayersReg achieves high accuracy on both X-ray/CT registration (0.68°, 1.41 mm) and slice localization (0.73°, 1.55 mm) tasks, outperforming existing state-of-the-art methods while meeting the intraoperative demands for precision and real-time capability.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LayersReg，一种逐层渐进式回归框架，用于术中可靠的3D/2D配准。该方法受经典迭代配准优化启发，在特征空间中搜索动态与固定图像的相关性，捕捉像素流趋势，逐步收敛到正确空间位姿。实验表明，在大偏移和多模态条件下，LayersReg在X光/CT配准（0.68°, 1.41 mm）和切片定位（0.73°, 1.55 mm）任务上优于现有方法，满足实时性要求。
Motivation: 现有深度学习方法将配准视为回归问题，但局限于记忆驱动的特定姿态特征检索，缺乏对图像对齐任务本身的理解，在复杂场景下泛化能力有限。传统迭代优化在术中效率低、失败率高。
Method: 提出 LayersReg 回归范式，通过逐层渐进搜索，在特征空间中建模动态与固定图像之间的相关性，捕捉像素流趋势，并设计节点回归与渐进框架的耦合，增强模型对空间位姿变化的感知。
Result: 在X光/CT配准任务上达到0.68°、1.41 mm精度，在切片定位任务上达到0.73°、1.55 mm精度，均超越现有最优方法，同时满足术中精度和实时性需求。
Conclusion: LayersReg 通过模仿经典迭代优化中的位姿搜索准则，赋予模型3D解剖意识，以渐进方式实现高精度、高鲁棒的术中配准。

papers.title: FracEvent: Event-Camera Simulation via Fractional-Relaxation Pixel Dynamics
papers.abstract_en: Event cameras asynchronously report brightness changes with microsecond-level temporal resolution, but real event data remain difficult to collect at scale because specialized sensors, careful synchronization, and task-specific annotations are required. Event-camera simulation is therefore important to event-based vision tasks. Most practical simulators build on contrast-threshold event generation, some with additional filtering, stochastic noise, or hand-tuned sensor parameters. While effective, such formulations often simplify the temporal structure produced by the lifecycle of each pixel, which can distort event timing and weaken downstream transfer. We introduce FracEvent, an event simulator that models this pixel-level lifecycle with fractional-relaxation voltage dynamics. Given a log-intensity trajectory, FracEvent drives a compact stack of relaxation modes, combines their responses into a voltage state, emits ON/OFF events by localizing threshold crossings on the continuous voltage trajectory, and updates the reference while retaining the underlying memory modes. This retained state links residual voltage response to later event timing. We evaluate FracEvent through event-stream comparison and downstream transfer on image reconstruction and optical flow estimation. Across multiple datasets, FracEvent improves the temporal structure of generated events and achieves stronger downstream-transfer results than competing simulator baselines, showing its practical value for event-camera simulation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 FracEvent，一种基于分数松弛像素动力学的事件相机模拟器。通过建模像素级电压弛豫过程，FracEvent 生成具有更优时间结构的事件流，并在图像重建和光流估计等下游任务中取得优于现有模拟器的迁移效果。
Motivation: 真实事件数据难以大规模采集，现有模拟器对像素时间结构的简化会导致事件时序失真，影响下游任务迁移性能。
Method: FracEvent 以对数强度轨迹为输入，驱动紧凑的松弛模式栈，将响应组合为电压状态，通过连续电压轨迹上的阈值穿越定位 ON/OFF 事件，同时保留底层记忆模式以关联残余电压响应与后续事件时序。
Result: 在多个数据集上，FracEvent 提升了生成事件的时间结构，并在图像重建和光流估计的下游迁移任务中优于对比模拟基线。
Conclusion: 摘要表明 FracEvent 通过更精细的像素级动力学建模，提升了事件模拟的实用价值。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Temporally Consistent Label Interpolation for Robust Surgical Multi-Task Learning under Challenging Conditions
papers.abstract_en: Effective multi-task learning for surgical scene understanding is fundamentally hindered by annotation granularity mismatch; temporal workflow tasks such as phase recognition, step recognition and anticipation benefit from dense frame-level supervision, whereas pixel-level spatial tasks including instrument segmentation and action recognition are only sparsely annotated on selected keyframes due to prohibitive labeling costs. This supervision imbalance undermines shared representation learning and limits joint optimization across heterogeneous surgical tasks. To address this, we propose Flow-guided Annotation for Robust Operating Scenes (FAROS), a flow-guided label interpolation framework, that combines zero-shot segmentation-based mask propagation with optical flow estimation to overcome the limitations of appearance-based propagation under challenging surgical conditions such as occlusion, smoke, and motion blur, generating temporally consistent dense pseudo labels from sparse keyframe annotations. The densified instrument masks and action labels are integrated into a unified Transformer-based multi-task framework that jointly learns surgical phase recognition, step recognition, anticipation, instrument segmentation, and action recognition, enabling balanced optimization between dense temporal supervision and sparse spatial supervision. The label interpolation quality of FAROS is first validated on the DAVIS 2017 benchmark under a sparse ground-truth protocol, confirming robust propagation beyond the surgical domain. Extensive experiments on GraSP, MISAW, and AutoLaparo benchmarks further demonstrate that FAROS significantly improves cross-task representation learning and enhances holistic surgical scene understanding performance across spatio-temporal tasks.

papers.title: Position Rebinding Cache Reuse: Replay-Free Visual Revisiting for Interleaved Multimodal Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Interleaved multimodal reasoning improves visual grounding by revisiting visual evidence during multi-step generation, yet existing methods typically rely on token replay, repeatedly forwarding selected visual tokens. A natural shortcut is to reuse the historical visual key-value (KV) cache directly. However, we identify a critical failure mode of this strategy: cached visual keys are already bound to their original positional context. Such stale positional binding distorts attention under later decoding contexts and can trigger severe autoregressive decoding collapse. This failure suggests that effective cache reuse requires reconstructing visual evidence under positions compatible with the current decoding state, rather than directly copying position-bound historical cache entries. To this end, we propose Position Rebinding Cache Reuse (PRCR), a cache-level framework for replay-free visual revisiting. PRCR stores raw visual KV cache together with their original spatial coordinates, then reassigns position-compatible coordinates to select entries and rebinds their keys before injecting the reconstructed cache into the active decoder cache. This design reuses historical visual evidence while preserving textual positional continuity and relative visual structure. Experiments across multiple multimodal reasoning benchmarks show that PRCR achieves replay-level or better performance, improving average accuracy by 5 percent and reducing visual-revisiting computation by up to tens of thousands of times.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出位置重绑定缓存重用（PRCR），一种无重放的视觉重访方法，用于交错多模态推理。PRCR 存储原始视觉 KV 缓存及其空间坐标，在解码时重新分配位置兼容的坐标并重绑定键，从而复用历史视觉证据，避免直接复制导致的自回归坍塌。在多个多模态推理基准上，PRCR 达到或超过重放级性能，平均准确率提升5%，计算量减少上万倍。
Motivation: 现有方法依赖 token 重放来重用视觉缓存，但直接复用历史 KV 缓存会因位置绑定问题导致自回归解码坍塌。本文旨在解决这一问题，实现无重放的有效视觉缓存重用。
Method: 提出位置重绑定缓存重用，存储原始视觉 KV 缓存及其空间坐标，在解码时选择位置兼容的缓存条目，重新分配坐标并重绑定键，然后将重构的缓存注入当前解码缓存。
Result: 在多个多模态推理基准上，PRCR 达到或超过重放级性能，平均准确率提升5%，视觉重访计算量减少上万倍。
Conclusion: 本文证明了通过位置重绑定可以解决缓存重用中的位置绑定问题，实现高效的无重放视觉重访。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From Weights to Features: SAE-Guided Activation Regularization for LLM Continual Learning
papers.abstract_en: Weight-space regularization methods such as Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC) are the standard approach to catastrophic forgetting in continual learning. However, those methods tend to underperform when applied to large language models. We argue that such underperformance can be partly explained by the ``polysemantic'' nature of large language models: per-weight importance estimates utilized by EWC-style regularization are too coarse and cannot isolate the knowledge that needs protection. In this paper, we propose regularizing instead in the model's activation space, using pretrained Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) as a monosemantic feature dictionary. From the perspective of constrained optimization, we derive a new loss function that uses the SAE feature dictionary to explicitly balance stability and plasticity, and show that EWC is a special case in the one-sided weight-space penalty setting. Unlike replay-based methods that store or revisit examples from earlier tasks, our method requires no previous-task data after mask construction: current-task data is used to compute a compact SAE feature mask, and only this mask is retained for later training. Further, since the feature space has significantly lower dimensionality than the parameter space, the proposed method is more memory efficient. On the TRACE and MedCL continual learning benchmarks, the method achieves the strongest result among approaches without introducing task-specific architectural components, also surpassing traditional weight-space regularization methods like EWC. Beyond performance comparisons, we provide empirical evidence for the polysemanticity thesis: task-relevant representations are linearly separable in the SAE feature basis but indistinguishable from chance in the weight basis, and weight-space protection is nearly non-selective at the concept level.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大型语言模型（LLM）持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，提出使用稀疏自编码器（SAE）在激活空间而非权重空间进行正则化。通过将SAE作为单语义特征字典，推导新的损失函数平衡稳定性和可塑性，并证明EWC是该方法在单侧权重空间惩罚下的特例。在TRACE和MedCL基准上，该方法无需任务特定架构或回放数据，即达到优于EWC等传统方法的性能，并在特征空间验证了任务表示的线性可分性。
Motivation: 现有权重空间正则化方法（如EWC）在LLM中表现不佳，原因在于LLM的“多语义”特性导致逐权重重要性估计过于粗糙，无法有效隔离需要保护的知识。
Method: 利用预训练的SAE作为单语义特征字典，在模型激活空间添加正则化项；从约束优化角度推导新损失函数，仅保留当前任务的数据计算SAE特征掩码，无需存储旧任务数据。
Result: 在TRACE和MedCL持续学习基准上，该方法在不引入任务特定组件的情况下取得最强结果，并超越传统权重空间正则化方法（如EWC）。同时提供经验证据：在SAE特征基下任务相关表示线性可分，而在权重基下无法区分。
Conclusion: 激活空间正则化比权重空间正则化更适用于LLM持续学习，SAE特征字典能有效分离任务表示；方法无需回放数据，内存效率更高。

papers.title: Agents That Know Too Much: A Data-Centric Survey of Privacy in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Large language model agents increasingly query databases, search document collections, call external APIs, remember past interactions, and act on a user's behalf. As they move from answering questions to operating over sensitive data, privacy becomes harder to enforce. An agent touches many data sources, runs multi-step workflows, keeps state across sessions, and acts with delegated permissions. Sensitive information can therefore leak not only through its final answer but through the queries it issues, the intermediate results it handles, the memory it writes, and the messages it exchanges with other agents. We survey the privacy of LLM agents from a data-centric view, organizing the field around the data an agent touches rather than by attack type, and we use data agent as shorthand for an LLM agent that works with data. Research on these risks is active but scattered across retrieval-augmented generation, text-to-SQL interfaces, agent memory, prompt injection, access control, and contextual privacy. This survey brings that work together: we taxonomize the data sources an agent touches, the privacy risks each source creates, and the governance mechanisms that address them; we map the benchmarks used to measure these risks and identify what is missing; and we set out the open problems. Two findings recur: among governance mechanisms only information-flow control covers both compositional and cross-session inference leakage, the two least-protected risks; and no benchmark drives an agent across its data surfaces under one privacy policy, the instrument the field most lacks. Our goal is a reference that situates the scattered literature and gives future work a common framing.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 这是一篇关于大型语言模型（LLM）agent隐私的数据中心调查，从agent接触的数据源出发，而不是按攻击类型组织。论文将LLM agent隐私领域的研究（包括检索增强生成、text-to-SQL、agent记忆、提示注入、访问控制和上下文隐私）整合在一起，对数据源、隐私风险和治理机制进行分类，并映射现有基准。主要发现：在治理机制中，只有信息流控制能覆盖组合性和跨会话推理泄漏这两个最不受保护的风险；目前缺乏一个在统一隐私策略下驱动agent遍历所有数据表面的基准。论文旨在为分散的文献提供共同框架。
Motivation: LLM agent在执行多步工作流、跨会话保持状态、使用委托权限时，会接触多种数据源，敏感信息不仅可能通过最终答案泄漏，还可能通过查询、中间结果、记忆和与其他agent的消息泄漏。现有研究分散在不同的子领域，缺乏统一视图。
Method: 采用数据中心视角，通过分类法系统化梳理LLM agent接触的数据源、每种数据源带来的隐私风险、以及现有的治理机制，并评估用于衡量这些风险的基准。
Result: 信息流控制是唯一能同时覆盖组合性推理泄漏和跨会话推理泄漏的治理机制；当前缺乏一个在统一隐私策略下驱动agent遍历所有数据表面的基准。
Conclusion: 该调查为LLM agent隐私的分散文献提供了参考框架，并指出了未来工作的开放问题，特别是需要开发统一的隐私策略基准。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: $λ$-PSD: Scalable Approximate SNR-Optimised Polynomial Stein Discrepancies
papers.abstract_en: Polynomial Stein discrepancies (PSD) provide a scalable alternative to kernel Stein methods for measuring sample quality and goodness-of-fit testing, but their statistical properties remain poorly understood. We show that increasing polynomial degree primarily amplifies signal without adequately controlling variance, rather than directly optimising the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). Under suitable assumptions, this might lead to a failure mode in which the $\text{SNR}^2$ can provably decay exponentially with polynomial degree. Motivated by this observation, we reformulate Stein discrepancy construction as an explicit $\text{SNR}^2$ maximisation problem, yielding a Rayleigh quotient over Stein features. This perspective motivates $λ$-PSD, an approximate scalable covariance-aware reweighting scheme defined in a low-dimensional subspace. Under Gaussian settings, we show that $λ$-PSD avoids the exponential $\text{SNR}^2$ collapse and achieves a stable $\text{SNR}^2$. Empirically, $λ$-PSD substantially improves test power while retaining linear-time complexity in the number of samples, highlighting the importance of SNR-aware design for scalable Stein discrepancies.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了多项式Stein差异（PSD）的统计性质，发现增加多项式度数主要放大信号而非控制方差，可能导致信噪比指数衰减。作者提出λ-PSD，一种近似可扩展的协方差感知重加权方案，在低维子空间中通过瑞利商最大化信噪比。理论上，λ-PSD在高斯设定下避免了指数衰减并实现稳定信噪比；实验上，它在保持线性时间复杂度的同时显著提高了检验功效。
Motivation: 多项式Stein差异虽然可扩展，但其统计性质未被充分理解，存在信噪比随多项式度数指数衰减的潜在失效模式。
Method: 将Stein差异构建显式化为信噪比最大化问题，导出Stein特征上的瑞利商，并基于此提出λ-PSD，一种在低维子空间中近似可扩展的协方差感知重加权方案。
Result: 理论证明在高斯设定下λ-PSD避免信噪比指数坍塌并实现稳定信噪比；实证中λ-PSD在保持O(n)时间复杂度的同时显著提升检验功效。
Conclusion: 信噪比感知的设计对可扩展Stein差异至关重要，λ-PSD是改善统计效率的有效方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Discovering Millions of Interpretable Features with Sparse Autoencoders
papers.abstract_en: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) have emerged as a powerful tool for decomposing superposed language model representations into sparse and interpretable features. However, training SAEs is computationally expensive, and available open-source SAE models remain limited. In this work, we introduce \textbf{Qwen3-Instruct SAE}, a comprehensive suite of SAEs trained on the Qwen3 instruction-tuned model family, covering Qwen3-1.7B, Qwen3-4B, and Qwen3-8B. For Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3-4B, we train layer-wise SAEs at three key activation sites: residual streams, MLP outputs, and attention outputs. For Qwen3-8B, we train SAEs on a subset of residual stream layers. We systematically evaluate these SAEs using both activation-level reconstruction metrics and model-level recovery metrics, revealing distinct sparsity--fidelity trade-offs across layers and components. Finally, we demonstrate the utility of Qwen3-Instruct SAE through a refusal-steering case study, showing that selected SAE features can causally steer instruction-tuned Qwen3 models toward refusal behavior. Our release provides a practical resource for studying sparse representations, feature-level mechanisms, and behavioral interventions in instruction-tuned language models
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍Qwen3-Instruct SAE，一套在Qwen3指令微调模型家族（1.7B、4B、8B）上训练的稀疏自编码器（SAE），覆盖残差流、MLP输出和注意力输出等激活位点。通过激活级重建指标和模型级恢复指标系统评估，揭示不同层和组件间的稀疏-保真度权衡，并通过拒绝引导案例证明SAE特征可因果性地干预模型行为。
Motivation: 训练SAE计算成本高且开源模型有限，缺乏针对指令微调模型的系统SAE资源，限制了稀疏表示和特征机制的研究。
Method: 在Qwen3-1.7B/4B上逐层训练SAE于三个关键激活位点（残差流、MLP输出、注意力输出），在Qwen3-8B上对部分残差流层训练SAE，并使用激活级和模型级恢复指标进行评估。
Result: 揭示了不同层和组件间的稀疏-保真度权衡，并通过拒绝引导案例表明选定的SAE特征可以因果性地引导指令微调Qwen3模型产生拒绝行为。
