summary_sections.result: 所有LRM在错误时比正确时花费更多令牌（Cohen's d = 1.47-3.13 on H-ARC），而人类呈现相反趋势。两种模式在跨项目难度相关性上表现一致，仅在固定项目身份后出现分歧。
summary_sections.conclusion: 人类模式体现为参与 vs 放弃（期望解决则坚持，否则放弃），LRM模式体现为不确定性驱动的令牌增长（模型不确定时更可能失败且链更长）。两种停止策略共享难度信号但实现相反的控制，仅通过项目内分析可区分。

papers.title: Mean-Field PhiBE: Continuous-Time Mean-Field Reinforcement Learning from Discrete-Time Data
papers.abstract_en: This paper addresses model-free continuous-time mean-field control in a setting where the population dynamics evolve continuously according to an unknown McKean-Vlasov stochastic differential equation, while only discrete-time transition data are available. In the model-based formulation, policy evaluation is naturally described by a stationary Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation on $\mathcal P_2(\mathbb R^d)$, but this equation involves the drift and diffusion coefficients of the controlled McKean-Vlasov dynamics, which are not identifiable when only discrete-time data are available. On the other hand, a direct reduction to a time-discrete Bellman equation avoids the non-identifiability issue but loses the differential equation structure. To bridge these two viewpoints, we introduce a Mean-Field-PhiBE (MF-PhiBE), which incorporates discrete-time transition information into a continuous-time PDE on the Wasserstein space. The MF-PhiBE replaces the unknown infinitesimal drift and covariance in the policy-evaluation equation by one-step estimators computed from data, while preserving the generator structure of the McKean-Vlasov HJB equation. We also derive a policy-gradient theorem for entropy-regularized randomized feedback policies, expressing the actor direction through an action-wise infinitesimal advantage and the score of the policy. Combining these two ingredients yields a model-free actor-critic method. We prove a first-order consistency estimate showing that the value induced by an optimal MF-PhiBE policy approximates the optimal continuous-time value with an error of order $Δt$. In the linear-quadratic case, we show our approximation achieves second-order accuracy with only one-step data. Numerical experiments on an LQR benchmark and a crowd-aversion problem illustrate the proposed framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对连续时间平均场控制问题，在仅能获取离散时间数据的情况下，提出了一种模型无关的演员-评论家方法。通过引入 Mean-Field PhiBE (MF-PhiBE)，将离散时间转移信息整合到 Wasserstein 空间上的连续时间偏微分方程中，替代策略评估方程中未知的无穷小漂移和协方差。证明了最优 MF-PhiBE 策略诱导的值函数估计误差为 Δt 阶，在线性二次情形下达到二阶精度。
Motivation: 连续时间平均场控制中，策略评估需解包含未知漂移和扩散系数的 HJB 方程，而离散时间数据无法直接识别这些系数；直接使用离散时间 Bellman 方程则丧失微分方程结构。
Method: 提出 MF-PhiBE，利用离散时间数据的一步估计器替代连续时间 PDE 中的未知无穷小漂移和协方差，保留 McKean-Vlasov HJB 方程的生成元结构；并推导熵正则化随机反馈策略的策略梯度定理，组合成模型无关的演员-评论家方法。
Result: 理论上，最优 MF-PhiBE 策略的值函数逼近连续时间最优值，误差为 Δt 阶；线性二次情形下仅需一步数据即达二阶精度。数值实验验证了 LQR 基准和人群规避问题上的有效性。
Conclusion: MF-PhiBE 框架弥合了离散数据与连续时间 PDE 之间的鸿沟，为模型无关的连续时间平均场控制提供了可行方案。

papers.title: Learning Probabilistic Filters with Strictly Proper Scoring Rules
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian filtering of partially and noisily observed dynamical systems seeks to infer the evolving conditional distribution of the state of a dynamical system, given observations, in an online fashion. This Bayesian filtering distribution is the natural object for uncertainty quantification, but it is rarely available as a supervised learning target. However, one can often use the forecast model to generate synthetic system trajectories, along with synthetic observations. We introduce the proper scoring ensemble filter (PSEF), an ensemble data assimilation method based on training an analysis map to approximate the filtering distribution using only synthetic state--observation trajectories. The analysis step is represented as a permutation-invariant, transformer-based map that takes as input a forecast ensemble and observations, producing an analysis ensemble. Training is based on strictly proper scoring rules -- with the energy score used in our implementation -- so that probabilistic accuracy is rewarded over the whole probability distribution. We prove that, under a realizability assumption, the population objective is minimized by the true Bayesian filtering distribution. We also derive the finite-ensemble empirical objective used in training and relate its single state--observation trajectory form to the population objective, using a mean-field consistency argument. Numerical experiments show that the learned filter accurately approximates challenging filtering distributions, including nonlinear, non-Gaussian, and multi-modal posteriors, and achieves stronger performance in data assimilation tasks than classical methods or learning-based methods with mean-squared-error objectives. For close-to-Gaussian problems, learning a correction to the EnKF is the best approach, while for highly non-Gaussian problems an end-to-end approach that discards this inductive bias is superior.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于严格适当评分规则（strictly proper scoring rules）的集成滤波方法——适当评分集成滤波器（PSEF），通过训练一个置换不变的Transformer网络来逼近贝叶斯滤波分布。该方法仅使用合成状态-观测轨迹进行训练，证明了在可实现假设下总体目标由真实滤波分布最小化。实验表明，PSEF在非线性、非高斯和多模态问题上准确近似滤波分布，在数据同化任务中优于经典方法（如EnKF）和基于均方误差的学习方法。
Motivation: 贝叶斯滤波分布是量化不确定性的自然对象，但通常无法作为监督学习目标。现有方法要么依赖线性高斯假设（如EnKF），要么使用均方误差损失无法捕捉完整概率分布。需要一种能逼近一般滤波分布且无需真实分布标注的方法。
Method: 提出PSEF，其分析步骤由置换不变的Transformer网络实现，输入为预报集成和观测，输出分析集成。训练采用严格适当的评分规则（energy score），确保在整个概率分布上奖励概率准确性。推导了有限集成的经验目标并与总体目标建立均场一致性。
Result: 在非线性、非高斯和多模态后验分布上准确近似滤波分布。数据同化任务中，PSEF优于经典方法（如EnKF）和基于均方误差的学习方法。对于接近高斯问题，学习EnKF的修正效果最佳；对于高度非高斯问题，端到端方法（丢弃归纳偏置）更优。
Conclusion: 严格适当评分规则与Transformer架构结合可以学习到准确的滤波分布，为数据同化提供了一种通用且性能更强的概率方法。
Relevance: 90

papers.title: Clinical Harness for Governable Medical AI Skill Ecosystems
papers.abstract_en: Medical AI remains organized around isolated models, whereas clinical care requires accountable capabilities that persist across time. We propose clinical AI skills and the Clinical Harness: a runtime governance architecture for registering, orchestrating, guarding and monitoring AI-enabled clinical capabilities. Using osteoporosis as an exemplar, we show how knowledge-driven, data-driven and physics-enhanced skills can support lifecycle care under runtime governance.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出临床AI技能（clinical AI skills）和Clinical Harness运行时治理架构，用于注册、编排、监控和防护AI临床能力。以骨质疏松为例，展示知识驱动、数据驱动和物理增强的技能如何在运行时治理下支持全生命周期护理。
Motivation: 当前医疗AI以孤立模型组织，而临床护理需要随时间持续可靠的能力，缺乏运行时治理机制。
Method: 提出Clinical Harness架构，包括注册、编排、防护和监控模块，并定义三类AI技能：知识驱动、数据驱动和物理增强。
Result: 通过骨质疏松案例展示该架构在生命周期护理中的可行性。
Conclusion: Clinical Harness为可治理的医疗AI技能生态系统提供了运行时基础，但需更多临床验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Evaluation-Strategy Gap in Fault Diagnosis of Deep Learning Programs
papers.abstract_en: Deep Learning (DL) programs can fail during training for many reasons, and diagnosing the cause is a costly and time-consuming maintenance task. Techniques for diagnosing such failures are commonly assessed using within-program cross-validation, which may be inadequate for deployment settings involving previously unseen programs. It is therefore necessary to assess how performance differs across these settings and to identify the causes of any performance gap in established fault diagnosis techniques for DL. We investigate this gap using DynFault, a corpus of 5,542 fault-injected training traces from 38 real-world DL programs. We found a gap of 0.190 in balanced accuracy for existing fault diagnosis techniques between within-program evaluation and holding out whole programs. We also found the gap comes from program-level structure in the features, which led us to examine two runtime feature sets, curvature features and optimizer features, and their behavior on unseen programs. We found that curvature features are useful for instability detection on unseen programs, while optimizer and activation features help only on programs seen during training.
papers.comment: Accepted research track paper in the 42nd IEEE International Conference on Software Maintenance and Evolution (ICSME 2026)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文研究深度学习（DL）程序故障诊断技术的评估策略差距，发现现有技术在程序内交叉验证与跨程序泛化之间存在 0.190 的平衡准确率差距，原因在于特征中的程序级结构。实验基于包含 5,542 个故障注入训练轨迹的 DynFault 语料库，分析了曲率特征和优化器特征在未见程序上的表现。
Motivation: 现有 DL 故障诊断技术多采用程序内交叉验证评估，但实际部署需要面对未见过的程序，评估策略的差距可能影响诊断效果，因此需要量化差距并分析原因。
Method: 利用 DynFault 语料库（38 个真实 DL 程序的 5,542 个故障注入轨迹），对比程序内交叉验证与留出整个程序的评估方式，分析平衡准确率差距，并探讨曲率特征、优化器特征和激活特征在未见程序上的表现。
Result: 存在 0.190 的平衡准确率差距，差距源于特征的程序级结构。曲率特征对未见程序的稳定性检测有用，而优化器和激活特征仅对训练期间见过的程序有帮助。
Conclusion: 论文强调评估策略对 DL 故障诊断技术泛化性能的重要影响，指出特征选择在跨程序场景下的关键性。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: An Empirical Study of LLM-Generated Specifications for VeriFast
papers.abstract_en: Static verification tools can assure industrial scale software, but require significant human labor to write specifications. This is particularly true of static verifiers based on separation logic (SL verifiers), which excel at verifying heapmanipulating programs, but require many complex auxiliary specifications to reason about heap structure. Recent work applies large language models (LLMs) to generate code, tests, and proofs, including specifications for verifiers, but mostly targeting non-SL verifiers. To address this gap, this paper thoroughly evaluates how well LLMs perform when prompted to generate specifications for verifying 303 C functions with the SL verifier VeriFast. We explored eight prompting approaches, ten LLMs, and three input types in two stages. Quantitative and qualitative analyses are used to assess the LLM-generated code and specifications for functional behavior, verifiability and errors. The results show that LLMs preserve functional behavior in source code and specifications (both over 91%), but achieve modest verification success (31.4%). Using Gemini 2.5 Pro and providing formal contracts lead to higher success rates in our setting. Moreover, most errors (94%) come from LLMs' mistakes in the domainspecific knowledge of SL verifiers such as VeriFast. These findings provide guidance for optimizing LLM-generated specifications for SL verifiers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估了大型语言模型（LLM）为分离逻辑验证器VeriFast生成规范的能力。在303个C函数上测试了8种提示方法、10个LLM和3种输入类型，结果表明LLM能保持功能正确性（超过91%），但验证成功率仅31.4%，主要错误源于对VeriFast领域知识的缺乏。
Motivation: 分离逻辑验证器虽然能验证堆操作程序，但需要大量人工编写复杂辅助规范。现有工作主要针对非SL验证器，缺乏对LLM生成SL规范的全面评估。
Method: 在VeriFast场景下，使用303个C函数，探索8种提示方法、10个LLM和3种输入类型，进行两阶段实验，结合定量与定性分析评估功能行为、可验证性和错误类型。
Result: LLM生成的代码和规范功能保持率均超过91%，但验证成功率仅31.4%；Gemini 2.5 Pro和提供形式化契约可提高成功率；94%的错误来自LLM对VeriFast领域知识的错误。
Conclusion: LLM生成SL规范仍有较大局限，主要瓶颈在于缺乏对分离逻辑验证器专门知识的理解；结果可为优化LLM生成规范提供指导。

papers.title: What Survives When You Compress a Recursive Reasoner for the Edge?
papers.abstract_en: Recursive reasoning models can solve complex structured tasks with only a few million parameters by repeatedly updating a latent state. Deploying these models on edge hardware requires significant compression, but unlike conventional sequence models, quantization errors compound across recursive reasoning cycles rather than across output tokens. As a result, standard intuitions about compression fail to apply. In this work, we ask what survives when recursive reasoners are compressed. Across a full precision sweep, three tasks, and two recursive architectures, we find that aggressive compression preserves local prediction but destroys global reasoning: cell accuracy holds while puzzle-exact accuracy collapses to zero under naive INT4 pruning, distillation, and linear attention alike. Token-level objectives, including quantization-aware training, cannot repair it. The collapse is architectural -- it strikes MLP-mixing recursion but not attention on the same task -- and we reverse it with per-channel calibrated INT4 without retraining. We also introduce carry-trajectory fidelity, the cosine similarity to the full-precision reasoning path, as a label-free signal that predicts this damage and its recovery before a task evaluation. The combined result is a deployment recipe: flash-streamed embeddings remove a 99.4MB bottleneck, INT8 at one cycle matches full-depth accuracy at 6x fewer FLOPs (8MB SoC), and calibrated INT4 fits a 4MB microcontroller.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究了递归推理模型在边缘设备上压缩时，量化误差在递归循环中累积导致全局推理能力崩溃的现象。通过对全精度扫描、三个任务和两种递归架构的实验，发现激进压缩（如INT4剪枝）保留局部预测但破坏全局推理，而逐通道校准的INT4无需重训练即可恢复。提出了携带轨迹保真度作为无标签信号预测损伤，并给出了部署方案。
Motivation: 递归推理模型在边缘硬件部署需要压缩，但标准压缩直觉不适用，因为量化误差在递归循环中累积而非输出token间累积。
Method: 进行全精度扫描实验，对比不同压缩方法（INT4剪枝、蒸馏、线性注意力），引入携带轨迹保真度指标，并开发逐通道校准的INT4量化。
Result: 激进压缩下局部预测保留但全局推理崩溃；逐通道校准INT4无需重训练恢复全局推理；INT8单周期匹配全深度精度且FLOPs减少6倍；校准INT4适配4MB微控制器。
Conclusion: 递归推理模型压缩需特别关注全局推理能力，携带轨迹保真度可作为预测指标；给出了具体部署方案。

papers.title: Speaking Numbers to LLMs: Multi-Wavelet Number Embeddings for Time Series Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are attractive for context-aware time series forecasting because they can integrate heterogeneous textual signals, yet their discrete, language-oriented tokenization and embedding interfaces are misaligned with continuous numerical values, often harming numerical ordering and forecasting reliability. We propose TempoWave, a plug-and-play temporal wavelet digit interface that maps each scalar observation into digit-wise embeddings constructed from multi-wavelet, multi-scale coefficients. By directly overriding standard token representations, TempoWave seamlessly exposes both fine-grained local fluctuations and macro global structures in a transformer-compatible form, ensuring that precise numerical formatting, distinct digit identity, and robustness to common normalization operations are maintained throughout the LLM pipeline. Experiments across five context-enriched forecasting benchmarks demonstrate that TempoWave consistently improves LLM-based forecasters over standard numeric tokenization and alternative embedding interfaces, achieving a new state-of-the-art. These results highlight the numeric interface as a key bottleneck and suggest that principled multi-resolution embeddings can better couple LLMs' contextual reasoning with precise forecasting. Our code is available at https://github.com/DC-research/TempoWAVE and our model can be accessed at https://huggingface.co/Melady/TempoWAVE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TempoWave，一种即插即用的多小波数字嵌入接口，用于改进大语言模型（LLM）在时间序列预测中的数值表示。TempoWave 将每个标量观测值映射为基于多小波、多尺度系数的数字级嵌入，直接覆盖标准令牌表示，从而在保持数值顺序和鲁棒性的同时，使 LLM 兼容细粒度局部波动和宏观全局结构。在五个上下文丰富的预测基准上，TempoWave 一致优于标准数值分词和其他嵌入接口，达到新的最优结果。
Motivation: LLM 的离散、语言导向的分词和嵌入接口与连续数值不对齐，常破坏数值顺序和预测可靠性，阻碍了 LLM 在上下文感知时间序列预测中的应用。
Method: 提出 TempoWave 接口，通过多小波变换将标量观测分解为多尺度系数，再编码为数字级嵌入，替换标准令牌嵌入，以保持精确数值格式、数字身份并对归一化操作具有鲁棒性。
Result: 在五个上下文丰富的预测基准上，TempoWave 一致提升基于 LLM 的预测器性能，达到新的最优结果。
Conclusion: 数值接口是 LLM 时间序列预测中的关键瓶颈，原则性的多分辨率嵌入能更好结合 LLM 的上下文推理与精确预测。
Relevance: 25

papers.title: Adaptive Evaluation of Out-of-Band Defenses Against Prompt Injection in LLM Agents
papers.abstract_en: Recent work (2024 to 2026) has converged on a strategy for defending tool-using LLM agents against indirect prompt injection: rather than training the model to refuse malicious instructions, enforce security outside the model with a deterministic policy that mediates the agent's actions. Systems such as CaMeL, FIDES, Progent, RTBAS, and FORGE realize this with capabilities, information-flow labels, and reference monitors, and several report near-elimination of attacks on the AgentDojo benchmark. We make two contributions. First, we organize these out-of-band defenses as instances of classical integrity protection (Biba), reference monitoring, and least privilege, yielding a structured comparison of what they do and do not cover. Second, we warn that every one of them is validated only on static benchmarks (a fixed set of injection attempts), the same methodology that made in-band defenses look strong until adaptive, defense-aware attacks broke twelve of them at over 90% success; we specify the threat model and protocol an adaptive evaluation requires. We then run that protocol as an independent reproduction and extension of Progent's own adaptive-attack analysis, on AgentDojo, with an open-weight agent (Qwen2.5-7B) self-hosted on a single H200, a setting its authors did not test. Averaged over three runs, the defense held: Progent cut mean attack success roughly sixfold (25.8% to 4.2%), and a hand-crafted adaptive attack did not raise it (2.6%). This is one small-scale data point on a weak model with a single black-box attack template; a stronger optimized (white-box GCG) attack remains open. The result is consistent with, but does not establish, the hypothesis that deterministic out-of-band enforcement is a harder target for an adaptive attacker than in-band detection.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统梳理了针对LLM智能体（agent）的间接提示注入（indirect prompt injection）的带外（out-of-band）防御方法，将其统一为经典完整性保护、引用监视器（reference monitor）和最小权限原则的实例。作者指出当前所有防御仅在静态基准上评估，缺乏自适应攻击考验，并独立复现了Progent的防御效果——在AgentDojo基准上使用Qwen2.5-7B模型，平均攻击成功率从25.8%降至4.2%，手工自适应攻击未显著提升（2.6%）。但该结果仅基于小规模弱模型和单一黑盒攻击模板，更强优化攻击（白盒GCG）仍为开放问题。
Motivation: 现有针对提示注入的带外防御（如CaMeL、FIDES、Progent、RTBAS、FORGE）仅在静态基准上验证，缺少对自适应攻击（adaptive attack）的评估，作者认为这可能导致防御效果被高估。
Method: 首先从经典安全理论（Biba完整性保护、引用监视器、最小权限）对现有带外防御进行结构化比较；然后提出自适应评估的威胁模型和协议，并独立复现Progent的防御效果，使用开放权重模型Qwen2.5-7B在AgentDojo上运行自适应攻击实验。
Result: 在单H200上运行的三次平均结果：Progent将平均攻击成功率从25.8%降低至4.2%，手工自适应攻击下的成功率为2.6%。该数据点仅基于弱模型和单一黑盒攻击模板。
Conclusion: 确定性带外强制执行可能比带内检测更难以被自适应攻击突破，但当前结果尚不能确立该假设，更强优化攻击（白盒GCG）的评估仍是开放问题。

papers.title: Retrieval-Warmed Energy-Based Reasoning: A Five-Arm Ablation Methodology for Diffusion-as-Inference on Structured Reasoning Tasks
papers.abstract_en: Warm-started diffusion samplers accelerate iterative inference, but it is rarely clear which part of the pipeline carries the gain. We study \textbf{retrieval-warmed energy-based reasoning (RW-EBR)} -- an IRED energy-based diffusion model \cite{du2024ired} augmented with a Modern Hopfield trajectory memory -- and contribute a \textbf{five-arm ablation methodology} (oracle, best-constant, per-query-random, shuffled, aligned) that separates three confounded effects: class-prior bias shift, stochastic warm-starting, and graph-aligned value reuse. The diagnostic decomposition is adapted from LLM-RAG evaluation \cite{ru2024ragchecker}. On \textbf{connectivity-2} (Erdős--Rényi all-pairs reachability), the aligned-vs-shuffled-oracle swing reaches \textbf{$+35$\,pp} balanced accuracy on a fixed 1{,}000-graph validation-set diagnostic, with value distribution and retrieval mechanics fixed, only per-graph alignment destroyed, while per-query random initialisation falls below cold -- per-graph alignment, not bias shift or stochasticity, dominates. Yet the \emph{deployable} cold-prediction pipeline misses the acceptance gate at stored-value quality. The same diagnostic logic, stopped at the key-quality screen, applied to \textbf{Sudoku} with a task-specific key encoder produces a clean negative at a \emph{different} component -- key quality, under the current setup. The decomposition names the first blocking component on each task. The setting -- graph reachability refined by an iterative diffusion sampler, with explainability of failure modes as the lens -- places the work within structured and spatio-temporal reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出检索预热能量基推理（RW-EBR），结合IRED能量基扩散模型与Hopfield轨迹记忆，并贡献一种五臂消融方法，用于解耦类先验偏移、随机预热和图对齐值重用三种效应。在连通性-2任务上，消融实验显示图对齐比偏移或随机性更关键，但在Sudoku任务上则归因于键质量。
Motivation: 现有热启动扩散采样器在结构化推理中加速迭代，但增益来源不明确，三种混淆效应（类先验偏移、随机预热、图对齐值重用）难以分离。
Method: 提出检索预热能量基推理（RW-EBR），并设计五臂消融方法（oracle, best-constant, per-query-random, shuffled, aligned）来隔离三种效应，借鉴LLM-RAG评估诊断。
Result: 在连通性-2任务上，对齐与乱序oracle之间的平衡准确率摆动达+35个百分点，且随机初始化低于冷启动；在Sudoku上则显示键质量为当前瓶颈。
Conclusion: 该方法命名了每个任务的首个阻塞组件，强调图对齐在结构化推理中的主导作用，但键质量在不同任务中可能成为关键限制。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Localizing RL-Induced Tool Use to a Single Crosscoder Feature
papers.abstract_en: Fine-tuning through RL reshapes the internal representations of language models to enable agentic behaviors such as tool use, yet the mechanistic basis of these changes remains poorly understood. While RL substantially improves structured tool-call generation, it is unclear which features emerge, which are preserved, and whether identified features can be leveraged for retraining-free behavioral control. In this work, we show that $\textit{Dedicated Feature Crosscoders (DFC)}$ isolate a compact set of RL-specific features that mediate tool-calling capability in $\texttt{Qwen2.5-3B}$. Across a $48$-crosscoder hyperparameter sweep, encode-decode reconstruction improves the RL model's tool correctness by $+31.1 \pm {9.7}$ pp and passively transfers tool-calling ability to the frozen base model by $+6.8 \pm 5.0$ pp which we call a $\textit{capability spillover}$. Our findings show that DFC partitioning concentrates RL-introduced capability into a minimal, steerable feature set that enables runtime behavioral control of agentic LLMs.
papers.comment: Accepted as a spotlight at the ICML 2026 Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过专用特征跨编码器（DFC）隔离RL微调引入的工具调用能力相关特征，在Qwen2.5-3B模型上实现无重训练的行为控制，并观察到能力向基础模型的溢出效应。
Motivation: RL微调使语言模型获得工具使用等agent行为，但其内部表征变化机制尚不明确，且缺乏无需重训练即可控制这些行为的方法。
Method: 提出专用特征跨编码器（DFC），通过编码-解码重建从RL微调模型的隐藏状态中分离出紧凑的RL特定特征集，并评估其对工具调用正确性和基础模型能力转移的影响。
Result: 在48组超参数扫描中，DFC将RL模型的工具正确性平均提升31.1±9.7个百分点，并向冻结的基础模型被动转移6.8±5.0个百分点（能力溢出）。
Conclusion: DFC能够将RL引入的能力浓缩到最小可操纵特征集，实现运行时行为控制，但研究仅限于特定模型和工具调用场景。

papers.title: When Does Quality-Aware Multimodal Fusion Matter? A Leakage-Safe Diagnostic for Decision-Level Dependence
papers.abstract_en: Many multimodal systems estimate the reliability of each modality and weight their contributions to the final prediction. However, it remains unclear whether these scores influence model decisions or merely correlate with performance. We propose a simple diagnostic to test whether reliability information is used during inference. After training, the model and inputs are fixed while reliability scores are permuted across test examples. If predictions depend on these scores, performance should degrade. Experiments on StressID for stress recognition and CMU-MOSEI for sentiment analysis show that permuting reliability scores leaves performance unchanged despite substantial potential gains from selecting the best modality per example. In positive controls where reliability signals identify the correct modality, the same frozen fusion rules yield significant improvements, indicating that reliability signals influence fused decisions only when they reliably predict unimodal correctness.
papers.comment: Accepted to INTERSPEECH 2026. 5 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种诊断方法，用于测试多模态融合中的可靠性分数是否真正影响模型决策。通过在StressID和CMU-MOSEI上的实验，发现打乱可靠性分数不影响性能，表明模型并未有效利用这些分数。正面控制实验表明，只有当可靠性信号能准确预测单模态正确性时，融合规则才会受益。
Motivation: 现有多模态融合方法常估计每个模态的可靠性并加权，但难以判断这些分数是否真正被模型利用，还是仅与性能相关。
Method: 提出一种简单诊断：在训练后固定模型和输入，随机置换测试样本的可靠性分数，观察性能是否下降。若下降则表明分数被利用；否则未利用。
Result: 在StressID和CMU-MOSEI上，置换可靠性分数后性能不变，尽管存在通过选择最佳模态获得较大提升的潜力。正面控制中，当可靠性信号准确指示正确模态时，融合规则带来显著改进。
Conclusion: 可靠性分数仅在能可靠预测单模态正确性时才会影响融合决策；否则模型可能忽略这些分数。

papers.title: Epiphany-Aware KV Cache Eviction Without the Attention Matrix
papers.abstract_en: As reasoning models emit chains of thought tens of thousands of tokens long, KV cache increasingly becomes a deployment bottleneck. Existing cache eviction methods rank tokens by attention weight, which is a noisy importance proxy in long reasoning traces, and prohibits the use of fused kernels in production inference by forcing the model to materialize the attention matrix. In this work, we instead score tokens with a metric we term the epiphany score: the change in the model's internal representation, read directly from the forward pass with no attention matrix and negligible extra state. Our resulting cache eviction method, EpiKV, requires no training, classifier, or custom kernel, and can be used directly in FlashAttention inference stacks unchanged -- scaling to a 16x longer feasible context than attention-based scoring. upper-mid layers negatively) and remove a positional trend with a causal rolling z-score. At a 4096-token cache EpiKV reaches 72% on MATH-500, matching the strongest attention-based baseline (ThinKV 71%, H2O 67%); a lag-normalized KV variant reaches 37% on AIME-2024 at 8192 tokens against the best of them (33%), at up to 2.8x the speed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对长推理链中KV缓存成为部署瓶颈的问题，提出一种无需注意力矩阵的缓存驱逐方法EpiKV。它通过从模型前向传播中直接读取内部表示变化（称为epiphany score）来评估token重要性，无需训练、分类器或自定义内核，可直接集成到FlashAttention推理栈中。实验表明，在MATH-500上使用4096 token缓存时EpiKV达到72%准确率，与最强注意力基线ThinKV（71%）持平；在AIME-2024上使用8192 token缓存时达到37%，优于最佳基线33%，且速度提升至2.8倍。
Motivation: 现有KV缓存驱逐方法依赖注意力权重排名，但在长推理轨迹中注意力权重是噪声重要性代理，且需要显式计算注意力矩阵，阻碍了融合内核在生产推理中的应用。
Method: 提出epiphany score，即模型在正向传播中内部表示的变化量，无需注意力矩阵和额外状态；基于此设计EpiKV驱逐策略，采用因果滚动z-score消除位置趋势，无训练/分类器/自定义内核，可直接用于FlashAttention。
Result: 在MATH-500上，4096 token缓存时EpiKV准确率72%，匹配ThinKV（71%）并超过H2O（67%）；在AIME-2024上，8192 token缓存时达到37%，优于最佳基线33%，速度提升至2.8倍。
Conclusion: EpiKV通过直接读取内部表示变化替代注意力权重，实现了无需修改推理栈的高效KV缓存驱逐，在长上下文场景下兼顾性能与速度。

papers.title: A Causal Foundation Model for Structure and Outcome Prediction
papers.abstract_en: We introduce TabPFN-CFM, a causal foundation model that can handle multiple causal problems. TabPFN-CFM predicts both causal structure and outcomes from observational data, supports queries on all three levels of Pearl's Causal Hierarchy and uses known graph structure when available to improve predictions. TabPFN-CFM is trained on synthetic datasets, and generalises to real datasets, demonstrating improved performance over both structural and outcome prediction baselines.
papers.comment: 20 pages, 7 figures, 17 tables, 43rd ICML Workshop on Foundation Models for Structured Data
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TabPFN-CFM，一个因果基础模型，能够同时预测因果结构和结果，支持Pearl因果层次的所有三个级别查询，并能在已知图结构时利用其改进预测。模型在合成数据上训练，泛化到真实数据，在结构和结果预测上优于基线。
Motivation: 现有因果模型通常只能处理单一因果问题（如结构学习或结果预测），缺乏统一的因果基础模型。
Method: TabPFN-CFM通过基于Transformer的架构，在合成因果数据上训练，学习端到端的因果推理，输出包括因果图和反事实结果。
Result: 在合成和真实数据集上，TabPFN-CFM在结构学习和结果预测任务上均优于现有基线。
Conclusion: 因果基础模型可以统一多种因果任务，且合成数据训练可泛化到真实场景。

papers.title: 3D Spatial Pattern Matching
papers.abstract_en: Spatial pattern matching is the process of matching query entities and constraints with database entities and relations. It has many applications, including similar region search, housing market search, landmark search, and road network matching. To our knowledge, all existing spatial pattern matching approaches frame the problem in a 2 dimensional space, where entities lie in a cartesian plane and relationships defined between them are contained in 2 dimensions. However, this problem framing has significant limitations when searching for real world entities that have height in addition to position. To address this limitation, we extend spatial pattern matching to 3 dimensions and provide a generalized definition of the problem. We describe a subgraph matching algorithm capable of resolving 3D spatial patterns over distance relations and release two 3D spatial pattern matching datasets, one synthetic and one containing real 3D building data from the city of Hamburg, Germany. We test our subgraph matching algorithm on both datasets and present results as a baseline for future methods to build upon.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文扩展了空间模式匹配问题到三维空间，提供了一般化定义，并提出一种能够处理距离关系的子图匹配算法。作者创建了两个3D空间模式匹配数据集（一个合成数据集，一个来自德国汉堡的真实3D建筑数据），并在其上测试算法，给出了基线结果。
Motivation: 现有空间模式匹配方法局限于二维空间，无法有效处理具有高度属性的现实世界实体。
Method: 提出三维空间模式匹配的一般化定义，并设计子图匹配算法以解析距离关系。
Result: 在合成数据集和汉堡真实建筑数据集上测试了算法，并提供了基线结果。
Conclusion: 论文为三维空间模式匹配提供了基础框架和数据集，但未与现有方法对比，未来需进一步优化算法性能。

papers.title: In-Context World Modeling for Robotic Control
papers.abstract_en: Modern Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models often fail to generalize to novel setups, such as altered camera viewpoints or robot morphologies, because they are typically conditioned only on current observations and language instructions. By ignoring the underlying system configuration as a variable, these models implicitly assume a fixed execution context encountered during training, necessitating data-intensive fine-tuning for any new environment. In this work, we introduce In-Context World Modeling (ICWM), a framework that treats system identification as an in-context adaptation problem. ICWM enables robot policies to autonomously infer essential system variables from a short history of self-generated, task-agnostic interactions. Unlike traditional In-Context Learning that uses demonstrations to specify what task to perform, ICWM leverages the context window to understand how the system operates. By processing these interactions before task execution, the model implicitly captures the world dynamics of the current system, enabling adaptation to novel configurations without parameter updates. Extensive experiments in simulation and on real-world robot platforms demonstrate that ICWM significantly outperforms standard VLA baselines on novel camera viewpoints.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出上下文世界建模（ICWM）框架，将系统识别视为上下文自适应问题，使机器人策略从自身生成的任务无关交互历史中推断系统变量，从而适应新相机视角等变化。模拟和真实实验表明，ICWM显著优于标准VLA基线。
Motivation: 现代VLA模型通常只基于当前观测和语言指令，忽略了底层系统配置，导致对新环境泛化差，需要数据密集的微调。
Method: ICWM框架，通过处理任务执行前的一小段自交互历史，隐式捕获当前系统的世界动力学，实现无需参数更新的上下文适应。
Result: 在模拟和真实机器人平台上，ICWM在新型相机视角下显著优于标准VLA基线。
Conclusion: ICWM使机器人策略能够从自生成交互中推断系统变量，实现对新配置的适应，无需参数更新。

papers.title: Autodata: An agentic data scientist to create high quality synthetic data
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Autodata, a general method that enables AI agents to act as data scientists who build high quality training and evaluation data. We show how to train (meta-optimize) such a data scientist agent, so that it learns to create even stronger data. We describe the overall formulation, and a specific practical implementation, Agentic Self-Instruct. We conduct experiments on computer science research tasks, legal reasoning tasks and reasoning with mathematical objects, where we obtain improved results compared to classical synthetic dataset creation methods. Further, meta-optimizing the data scientist agent itself delivers an even larger performance uplift. Agentic data creation provides a way to convert increased inference compute into higher quality model training. Overall, we believe this direction has the potential to change the way we build AI data.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Autodata，一种让 AI 智能体充当数据科学家来构建高质量训练和评估数据的通用方法。通过元优化训练数据科学家智能体，使其学会创建更强大的数据，并在计算机科学研究、法律推理和数学对象推理等任务上取得优于经典合成数据集创建方法的结果。
Motivation: 高质量训练数据的缺乏是限制 AI 模型性能的关键瓶颈，现有的合成数据创建方法效果有限。
Method: 提出 Autodata 方法和具体实现 Agentic Self-Instruct，通过元优化训练一个数据科学家智能体，使其能够迭代生成更高质量的数据。
Result: 在计算机科学研究、法律推理和数学对象推理任务上，Autodata 生成的数据显著优于经典合成数据集方法；元优化数据科学家智能体本身带来更大的性能提升。
Conclusion: 智能体驱动的数据创建能将推理计算转化为更高质量的训练数据，有望改变 AI 数据构建方式。

papers.title: MiniOpt: Reasoning to Model and Solve General Optimization Problems with Limited Resources
papers.abstract_en: Achieving strong optimization generalization across diverse optimization problems while requiring limited training resources remains a challenging problem for optimization-oriented large language models (LLMs). Existing approaches typically rely on large-scale supervised datasets, costly reasoning annotations, and expensive intermediate step verification, resulting in substantial training overhead. To address these challenges, we propose MiniOpt, a reinforcement learning framework that learns to solve optimization problems through an "reasoning-to-model-and-solve" paradigm. MiniOpt decomposes optimization reasoning into structured optimization modeling and executable solver generation. Building upon this paradigm, we introduce OptReward, a reward function with hierarchical score structure that jointly evaluates formulation and solution, enabling effective policy learning without expert demonstrations. We further develop an optimization-oriented policy optimization strategy that improves exploration efficiency and stabilizes reinforcement learning for compact models. Extensive experiments show that MiniOpt-3B exhibits strong optimization generalization across various optimization types, problem scenarios, and task domains. For models with fewer than 10B parameters, MiniOpt series achieves the highest average solving accuracy (SA). For models with more than 10B parameters, MiniOpt still shows competitive performance. These results suggest that optimization-oriented reward design and reinforcement learning provide an effective pathway for developing compact optimization-specialized language models with strong optimization generalization capabilities. The code is available at https://github.com/Hsiang-1/MiniOpt.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MiniOpt，一个强化学习框架，通过“推理到建模与求解”范式学习解决优化问题，无需大规模监督数据和专家演示。OptReward奖励函数和面向优化的策略优化提高了小模型的探索效率和训练稳定性。实验表明MiniOpt-3B在多种优化类型和场景上展现出强泛化能力。
Motivation: 现有面向优化的大语言模型需要大规模监督数据和昂贵的中间步骤验证，训练开销大。本文旨在以有限训练资源实现强优化泛化。
Method: 提出MiniOpt框架，将优化推理分解为结构化优化建模和可执行求解器生成；引入层次化评分奖励函数OptReward，联合评估建模和求解质量；开发面向优化的策略优化方法提高探索效率。
Result: 在参数少于10B的模型中，MiniOpt系列达到最高平均求解准确率（SA）；对于大于10B的模型，MiniOpt仍具竞争力。
Conclusion: 摘要认为，面向优化的奖励设计和强化学习为开发紧凑型优化专用语言模型提供了有效途径。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Cliff Tokens: Identifying Single-Token Failure Triggers in LLM Mathematical Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) reach high accuracy in mathematical reasoning, but individual traces on the same problem diverge; some arrive at the correct answer while others fail. Prior work analyzes failure at the step, chunk, or sentence level, or at tokens where failure has already occurred. Neither identifies the precise token that triggers the shift toward failure. We introduce the cliff token, a token where the token-wise potential drops significantly under an adaptive threshold that scales with the local token-wise potential, based on a one-sided two-proportion z-test. Across seven models and three mathematical reasoning benchmarks (GSM1K, MATH500, AIME 2025), cliff tokens act as failure triggers; deleting the first cliff token and resampling recovers pass@64 to 1.0, while keeping it limits recovery to between 0.71 and 1.00. We further introduce a cliff taxonomy of deterministic, uncertain, and sampled-off cliffs, defined by greedy choice and token entropy. Each type has distinct probabilistic characteristics, and the taxonomy generalizes across model scales. Finally, we validate the taxonomy via single-token preference optimization at cliff positions (Cliff-DPO). Trained on GSM8K, Cliff-DPO improves accuracy across benchmarks by up to +6.6. Optimizing at uncertain and sampled-off cliffs improves reasoning, while deterministic cliffs do not.

papers.title: How Reliable Is Your Jailbreak Judge? Calibration and Adversarial Robustness of Automated ASR Scoring
papers.abstract_en: Almost every paper on LLM jailbreaks and prompt injection reports an attack-success rate (ASR), and that number is assigned not by people but by an automated judge: either a safety classifier trained for the task, or a general chat model prompted to grade. The judge is rarely checked. We check it. Using 596 human-labeled completions from the HarmBench classifier validation set, we compare the two judge families against human majority votes and then attack them. The two families fail in opposite ways. The dedicated classifier over-flags (precision 0.835, recall 0.974); three different LLM-as-judges keep high precision (0.81 to 0.94) but show erratic recall (0.06 to 0.65), so the same responses produce very different ASR depending on which judge scores them. The two families also differ sharply in robustness. Wrappers that leave the harmful text untouched and only add benign framing flip every LLM-judge between 57% and 100% of the time, and a single prepended refusal sentence accounts for much of this (39% to 88%). The dedicated classifier resists these surface attacks (at most 6.7%), but a white-box GCG attack on its open weights flips 70% of confident true positives (21 of 30; 95% CI 54 to 86%) even at a small optimization budget. A two-annotator audit confirms the attacks leave the harm intact: every one of 80 sampled flips still contained the harmful content. Because a large and growing share of reported ASR comes from LLM-judges, many such numbers are unreliable both on average and under deliberate pressure. We recommend that papers report judge precision and recall on a human-labeled slice, report ASR corrected for judge precision, and include an adversarial check of the judge. Our code is released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统检查了LLM越狱攻击成功率的自动评判器可靠性。通过比较专用安全分类器和LLM评判器，发现两者均存在缺陷：专用分类器精确率低（0.835），召回率高（0.974）；LLM评判器精确率高（0.81-0.94）但召回率极不稳定（0.06-0.65）。简单包装攻击即可翻转57%-100%的LLM判断，白盒攻击也能翻转70%的专用分类器判定。实验证实攻击后有害内容未变。
Motivation: 现有越狱论文普遍依赖自动评判器报告ASR，但评判器本身未被验证，导致ASR数据可能不可靠。
Method: 使用596条人工标注的HarmBench验证集，比较专用安全分类器与三个LLM评判器（如GPT-4）与人类多数投票的一致性，随后实施包装攻击和GCG白盒攻击。
Result: 专用分类器召回率0.974但精确率仅0.835；LLM评判器精确率0.81~0.94但召回率仅0.06~0.65。包装攻击使LLM评判器翻转57%-100%的判断，GCG攻击翻转专用分类器70%的置信真阳性（21/30）。所有攻击保留有害内容。
Conclusion: 许多报告的ASR因评判器缺陷而不可靠，建议论文报告评判器的精确率和召回率，并增加对抗性检查。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: The Generalization Spectrum: A Chromatographic Approach to Evaluating Learning Algorithms
papers.abstract_en: Traditional evaluations measure a learning algorithm's final performance on an i.i.d. test set, reducing learning to a single aggregate score. This approach obscures a fundamental question: to what extent does learning from a specific example generalize to others? Such per-sample generalization, akin to learning by analogy in human cognition, captures how far the knowledge extracted from one example can transfer, yet remains invisible to standard benchmarks. We introduce the Generalization Spectrum, an evaluation framework designed to expose this hidden dimension. For each training example, we construct a controlled suite of test variants arranged by increasing transfer distance, from exact recall to implementation transfer across languages, context transfer under complete narrative re-framing, category-matched in-domain problems, and an unpaired baseline. By tracking performance across these distances, we reveal not just whether an algorithm learns, but how far that learning extends. We instantiate this framework on competitive programming, using a selection-and-synthesis pipeline seeded with recent problems to mitigate contamination. We first compare three canonical learning paradigms under matched memorization. RL converts memorization into near-transfer more efficiently than SFT-family baselines, while ICL exhibits strong but correspondence-dependent transfer. We then use the Spectrum to diagnose within-family variants. The resulting profiles show that local gains need not expand the generalization radius: abstractions and hints mainly lift local transfer, RFT preserves a stronger far-transfer tail than reference SFT, and self-distillation or hint-assisted RL can reduce far transfer even when local transfer or optimization improves.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出“泛化谱”（Generalization Spectrum）评估框架，对每个训练样本构造一系列按迁移距离递增的测试变体，以揭示算法学习的泛化范围。在编程竞赛任务上比较了SFT、RL、ICL等范式，发现RL在将记忆转化为近迁移方面更高效，但局部增益不必然扩大泛化半径。摘要未报告具体数值。
Motivation: 传统评估仅用i.i.d.测试集上的最终性能衡量算法，无法回答“从特定样本中学到的知识能迁移多远”这一基本问题。
Method: 提出Generalization Spectrum框架，为每个训练样本构造受控的测试变体（精确回忆、跨语言实现迁移、上下文转移、类别匹配的领域内问题等）。在编程竞赛任务上通过选择和合成流水线实例化。
Result: RL比SFT基线更高效地将记忆转化为近迁移；ICL表现强但依赖对应关系。抽象和提示主要提升局部迁移，RFT保留更强的远迁移尾，自蒸馏或提示辅助RL可能减少远迁移。
Conclusion: 泛化谱揭示了传统评估隐藏的泛化维度，表明局部增益不一定扩大泛化半径。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Geometry-Anchored Transport Framework for Exemplar-Free Class-Incremental Learning
papers.abstract_en: Exemplar-free class-incremental learning (EFCIL) requires stable decision boundaries within a shifting feature space. While maintaining class-conditional Gaussian statistics provides a principled classification strategy, these parametric summaries remain sensitive to anisotropic representation drift. Existing methods often transport these statistics across tasks using a decoupled, post-hoc paradigm: optimizing a backbone without explicit geometric constraints can distort the legacy manifold, limiting the precision of retroactive alignment. In this paper, we formulate feature transport as an endogenous training constraint rather than a separate post-task step, presenting the Geometry-Anchored Transport Framework. First, we derive an Analytic Geometric Anchor via Mahalanobis-aligned regression to mitigate macroscopic anisotropic drift. Second, we introduce a Topology-Aware Evolution objective that regularizes localized manifold degradation while calibrating a residual network against the analytic prior. By coupling manifold evolution with transport constraints during the primary training phase, our framework mitigates evaluation errors without requiring decoupled fine-tuning. Experiments across CIFAR-100, TinyImageNet, and ImageNet-100 demonstrate that the proposed framework consistently improves upon existing post-hoc alternatives under strict exemplar-free constraints.
papers.comment: Accepted to ECCV 2026. 17 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Code: https://github.com/HXuSz11/GATF_ECCV2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出几何锚定传输框架（Geometry-Anchored Transport Framework），用于无样本类增量学习（EFCIL）。通过将特征传输建模为内生训练约束，利用解析几何锚定缓解各向异性漂移，并引入拓扑感知进化目标正则化局部流形退化。在CIFAR-100、TinyImageNet和ImageNet-100上的实验表明，该方法在严格无样本约束下优于现有后处理替代方案。
Motivation: 现有无样本类增量学习方法在特征空间漂移下难以维持稳定决策边界，尤其是后处理传输范式因缺乏几何约束而导致流形扭曲，影响对齐精度。
Method: 提出几何锚定传输框架：1）通过马氏对齐回归推导解析几何锚定，缓解宏观各向异性漂移；2）引入拓扑感知进化目标，在训练中正则化局部流形退化，同时校准残差网络以匹配解析先验。
Result: 在CIFAR-100、TinyImageNet和ImageNet-100数据集上，所提框架在严格无样本约束下持续优于现有后处理替代方法。
Conclusion: 将流形进化与传输约束耦合到主训练阶段，可缓解评估误差，无需解耦微调。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Wan-Streamer v0.1: End-to-end Real-time Interactive Foundation Models
papers.abstract_en: We present Wan-Streamer, a native-streaming, end-to-end interactive foundation model designed from the ground up for real-time, low-latency, full-duplex audio-visual interaction. Wan-Streamer seamlessly models language, audio, and video as both input and output within a single Transformer, where the sequence is represented as interleaved visual, audio, and text input tokens together with visual, audio, and text output tokens, coordinated by block-causal attention for incremental streaming. Unlike cascaded interactive systems that rely on separate VAD, ASR, language, TTS, audio-driven animation, or video-generation modules, Wan-Streamer does not rely on external language, speech, avatar, or video-generation modules: perception, reasoning, generation, response timing, turn management, and cross-modal synchronization are learned jointly within one unified model, reducing pipeline latency and error accumulation. To support natural audio-visual responsiveness, we redesign the entire stack around streamability, including causal encoders, causal decoders, block-causal attention, and low-latency multimodal token scheduling, enabling streaming units as short as 160 ms at 25 fps. Wan-Streamer achieves approximately 200 ms model-side response latency and approximately 550 ms total interaction latency when combined with 350 ms bidirectional network latency, supporting sub-second duplex audio-visual communication. These results position Wan-Streamer as a unified, end-to-end, multimodal interactive foundation model for low-latency streaming interaction.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Wan-Streamer 是一个原生流式、端到端的交互基础模型，专门为实时、低延迟、全双工的视听交互设计。该模型在一个 Transformer 中统一建模语言、音频和视频的输入与输出，通过块因果注意力实现增量流式处理，无需外部模块。模型侧响应延迟约200ms，总交互延迟约550ms（含双向网络延迟），支持亚秒级双工视听通信。
Motivation: 现有级联交互系统依赖独立的 VAD、ASR、语言模型、TTS、音频驱动动画或视频生成模块，导致流水线延迟和错误累积。
Method: 提出原生流式架构，包括因果编码器、因果解码器、块因果注意力和低延迟多模态令牌调度，实现了160ms（25fps）的流式单元。
Result: 模型侧响应延迟约200ms，总交互延迟约550ms（含350ms双向网络延迟），支持亚秒级双工视听通信。
Conclusion: Wan-Streamer 作为一个统一的端到端多模态交互基础模型，实现了低延迟流式交互，无需外部模块。

papers.title: Noise-Aware Boundary-Enhanced Generative Learning for Ultrasound Speckle Reduction
papers.abstract_en: Ultrasound is a non-invasive, real-time, and cost-effective imaging technique widely used in clinical diagnosis. However, its diagnostic efficacy is often compromised by inherent speckle noise that degrades image quality and obscures underlying anatomical structures. Existing speckle reduction methods tend to over-smooth tissue boundaries and generalize poorly to heterogeneous noise levels. To address these limitations, we propose a Noise-Aware Boundary-Enhanced Generative Learning (NBGL) framework for ultrasound speckle reduction, which simultaneously preserves annotated anatomical boundaries and adapts to varying noise levels. The NBGL framework consists of a speckle reduction branch and a boundary enhancement branch. The former leverages generative learning to suppress speckle noise, while the latter learns boundary-sensitive representations to preserve target anatomical structures. Furthermore, a noise-aware interaction weight generation (NIWG) module estimates the speckle noise level via 3D Laplacian filtering and a median absolute deviation estimator, and translates it into an adaptive interaction weight. This weight is incorporated into a weighted feature-wise linear modulation (wFiLM) module to adaptively modulate cross-branch feature coupling, thereby improving robustness to varying noise levels. Extensive evaluations on 141 3D transvaginal ultrasound volumes demonstrate that NBGL consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in speckle reduction and structural preservation across six noise levels, while maintaining consistency with annotated anatomical boundaries.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种噪声感知边界增强生成学习（NBGL）框架用于超声斑点噪声抑制。该框架包含斑点抑制分支和边界增强分支，并通过噪声感知交互权重生成模块（NIWG）估计噪声水平，利用加权特征线性调制（wFiLM）自适应调节跨分支特征耦合，以保留解剖结构。在141个3D经阴道超声容积上的实验表明，NBGL在六种噪声水平下均优于现有方法。
Motivation: 超声斑点噪声降低了图像质量和诊断效能，现有去噪方法易过度平滑组织边界且对不同噪声水平泛化差。
Method: 提出NBGL框架，包括一个基于生成学习的斑点噪声抑制分支和一个学习边界敏感表示的增强分支；通过NIWG模块（基于3D拉普拉斯滤波和中位绝对偏差估计）估计噪声水平，生成自适应交互权重，用于wFiLM模块调整跨分支特征耦合。
Result: 在141个3D经阴道超声容积上，NBGL在六个噪声水平下均优于现有SOTA方法，在斑点抑制和结构保持方面表现更佳，且与标注的解剖边界一致性更好。
Conclusion: 所提出的噪声感知和边界增强生成学习框架能有效适应不同噪声水平，同时保留超声图像中的解剖边界。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Scalable Peptide Design via Memory-Efficient Equivariant Transformer
papers.abstract_en: Target-specific peptide design requires sequence and structure co-design under full atom geometric constraints. Latent generative frameworks offer an effective route for this problem by compressing fine grained atomic structures into block level latent representations and performing conditional generation in a compact latent space. However, the scalability of such systems depends heavily on the geometric backbone used throughout their encoding, decoding, and denoising components. We introduce MEET (Memory Efficient Equivariant Transformer), an E(3) equivariant backbone for scalable atomistic peptide modeling. MEET maintains coupled invariant scalar and equivariant vector feature streams, while reformulating geometric computation around memory efficient attention. It initializes vector features through global coordinate aggregation, incorporates pairwise distances through augmented query and key dot products, and injects covalent bond information through sparse bond adaptation. Integrated into a VAE and latent diffusion pipeline for full atom peptide generation, MEET achieves linear memory scaling with atom count and improves generation quality over existing peptide design methods. Experiments on large scale AFDB derived datasets further show that the proposed backbone supports systematic model and data scaling, leading to better binding affinity, physical validity, and sample diversity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MEET（Memory Efficient Equivariant Transformer），一种E(3)等变骨干网络，用于可扩展的原子级肽建模。MEET通过解耦不变标量和等变向量特征流，重构几何计算以实现内存高效注意力，支持线性内存缩放。集成到VAE和潜在扩散流水线中，在全原子肽生成任务上优于现有方法，并在大规模AFDB衍生数据集上展示了模型和数据扩展性。
Motivation: 现有肽设计方法在处理全原子几何约束时，基于潜在生成框架的骨干网络可扩展性不足，导致内存和计算瓶颈。
Method: 提出MEET，保持耦合的不变标量和等变向量特征流，通过全局坐标聚合初始化向量特征，利用增广查询-键点积引入配对距离，并通过稀疏键适配注入共价键信息。集成到VAE和潜在扩散框架中实现全原子肽生成。
Result: MEET在肽生成任务上实现了线性内存缩放，优于现有方法；在AFDB大规模数据集上，支持系统性的模型和数据缩放，提升了结合亲和力、物理有效性和样本多样性。
Conclusion: MEET作为一种内存高效的等变骨干网络，为肽设计中的可扩展性提供了有效方案，并可通过VAE和潜在扩散流水线实现高质量全原子生成。

papers.title: Counting Trees from Satellite Imagery with Noisy Supervision
papers.abstract_en: Counting individual trees is a fundamental task for environmental monitoring, yet remains largely unexplored with satellite imagery. At these resolutions, isolated trees may still be identifiable, but crown boundaries become ambiguous in dense forests, making the notion of an individual tree inherently ill-defined. Moreover, large-scale manual annotations of individual trees are prohibitively expensive. While scalable supervision can be derived from airborne LiDAR, the resulting annotations are noisy and difficult to exploit effectively. We address these challenges by formulating tree counting as a spatial density matching problem supervised through Unbalanced Optimal Transport. This formulation naturally accommodates both precise localization of isolate trees and robust density estimation in dense forests. We further introduce a self-correction mechanism that leverages transport residuals to progressively refine noisy supervision during training. We evaluate our approach on TinyTrees, a new benchmark spanning three continents and three satellite sensors, comprising over 216 million tree annotations (including 639k manually verified instances) across $25\,890$ km$^2$. Our method consistently outperforms detection-based, regression-based, and transport-based distribution-matching baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of unbalanced transport and reliability-aware supervision for large-scale tree counting from satellite imagery. Code, data and models are available at https://github.com/dgominski/treematch.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对卫星图像中的树木计数问题，提出了一种基于不平衡最优传输（Unbalanced Optimal Transport）的密度匹配方法，并引入自校正机制利用传输残差逐步改进噪声监督。在覆盖三大洲、三种卫星传感器、超过2.16亿个树注释（含63.9万手动验证实例）的新基准TinyTrees上，该方法优于基于检测、回归和传输分布匹配的基线。
Motivation: 卫星图像中树木计数存在两个主要挑战：茂密森林中树冠边界模糊导致树木个体定义不确定，以及大规模手工标注成本过高，而来自机载LiDAR的可扩展监督存在噪声且难以有效利用。
Method: 将树木计数建模为通过不平衡最优传输监督的空间密度匹配问题，并设计自校正机制，利用传输残差在训练过程中逐步修正噪声监督。
Result: 在TinyTrees基准上，该方法在所有指标上持续优于检测、回归和传输分布匹配基线，展示了不平衡传输和可靠性感知监督在大规模卫星图像树木计数中的有效性。
Conclusion: 摘要强调不平衡最优传输和自校正机制能有效处理噪声监督，为大规模树木计数提供了可行方案。

papers.title: Agentic Collaborative Cognition for Zero-Shot 3D Understanding
papers.abstract_en: Recent advancements have explored agentic zero-shot 3D understanding by reformulating it as video keyframe understanding with Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). However, existing methods face an intrinsic bottleneck due to the finite observation perspectives inherent in videos and the implicit perception of 3D scenes. In this paper, we propose a collaborative multi-agent framework that assigns a Planning Agent to handle high-level viewpoint planning and supplement novel perspectives, and a Perception Agent to explicitly summarize the 3D scene into a structured holistic cognitive map. Specifically, Planning Agent first analyzes this cognitive map to determine query-relevant viewpoints and supplements missing critical perspectives to ensure comprehensive observation. Subsequently, Perception Agent documents object-level attributes from these views by assigning consistent instance identifiers across viewpoints, thereby integrating fragmented observations into the holistic cognitive map. In parallel, it provides feedback to filter out mismatched candidate objects and guide subsequent viewpoint planning. Through this closed-loop iterative process, two agents collaboratively figure out candidates until Perception Agent determines that sufficient information has been captured to complete the task. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on 6 benchmarks, with improvements of 11.1\% Acc@0.5 on ScanRefer, 14.6 BLEU-1 on 3D-assisted dialog, and 2.1 EM on SQA3D.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种协作式多智能体框架，用于零样本3D理解。通过规划代理（Planning Agent）处理视角规划并补充新视角，感知代理（Perception Agent）将3D场景显式总结为结构化整体认知地图，两代理通过闭环迭代协作选出候选对象。在6个基准上取得了最先进性能，例如ScanRefer上Acc@0.5提升11.1%，3D辅助对话中BLEU-1提升14.6%，SQA3D上EM提升2.1。
Motivation: 现有基于视频关键帧理解的方法受限于视频的有限观测视角和对3D场景的隐式感知，存在固有瓶颈。
Method: 提出协作多智能体框架：规划代理根据认知地图确定查询相关视角并补充缺失视角；感知代理从这些视角文档化对象级属性，通过跨视角分配一致实例标识符，将碎片化观测整合为整体认知地图，并提供反馈过滤不匹配候选对象以引导后续规划。
Result: 在6个基准上达到最先进性能：ScanRefer Acc@0.5提升11.1%，3D辅助对话BLEU-1提升14.6%，SQA3D EM提升2.1。
Conclusion: 该方法通过显式构建认知地图和多智能体协作，克服了视角有限和隐式感知的瓶颈，显著提升了零样本3D理解性能。

papers.title: Visualizing "We the People": Bridging the Perception Gap through Pluralistic Data Storytelling
papers.abstract_en: Traditional visual data storytelling relies on binary graphics that depict two simplified groups in conflict. This can increase political polarization by oversimplifying intra-group disagreements and erasing ambiguity and shared ideas or values. This can inadvertently foster "us versus them" thinking. Intentional, pluralistic design choices for AI-enabled digital platforms can produce visualizations that emphasize nuance, opinion distribution, and intergroup commonalities. To demonstrate this potential, we examine deliberative technologies that map high-dimensional opinion spaces and highlight areas of both consensus and dissensus. The paper highlights the We the People deliberation conducted by Jigsaw and the Napolitan Institute in September 2025, which engaged over 2,400 Americans across all 435 congressional districts in an AI-supported, asynchronous dialogue regarding freedom and equality. By utilizing AI to synthesize long-form, text-based participant inputs into interactive "opinion landscapes," the initiative provided an alternative format for pluralistic data storytelling that humanized diverse viewpoints and revealed hidden areas of substantial broad consensus. The paper concludes that shifting from divisive, contrast-heavy visual frameworks to distribution-focused, interactive models represents a highly scalable, low-cost intervention capable of bridging perceptual gaps and cultivating a more resilient, collaborative democratic culture.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出传统二元可视化数据叙事会加剧政治极化，提出通过多元数据叙事（pluralistic data storytelling）设计AI驱动的数字平台，展示观点分布和群体共同点。以2025年Jigsaw和Napolitan Institute开展的“We the People”审议为例，该活动利用AI将超2400名美国公民的文本输入合成交互式“意见景观”，揭示隐藏的广泛共识。
Motivation: 传统数据可视化常采用二元对立图形，简化群体内部分歧，忽略模糊性和共享价值观，可能加剧“我们vs他们”的极化思维。
Method: 提出有意采用多元设计选择（pluralistic design choices）的AI数字平台，通过将高维意见空间映射为交互式“意见景观”，展示共识与分歧区域。
Result: 以2025年9月覆盖美国435个选区的2400多人参与的AI异步对话为例，展示了多元数据叙事如何人性化不同观点并揭示隐藏的广泛共识。
Conclusion: 从分裂、对比突出的视觉框架转向分布聚焦、交互模型，是一种高可扩展、低成本干预方式，能缩小感知差距并培养更具韧性的合作民主文化。

papers.title: MORL-A2C: Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning Reranker for Optimizing Healthiness in MOPI-HFRS
papers.abstract_en: Unhealthy dietary behavior continues to be a persistent public health issue in the United States, exacerbated by recommendation systems that prioritize user preference without considering nutritional health. The Multi-Objective Personalized Interpretable Health-aware Food Recommendation System (MOPI-HFRS), from which this work extends, addresses this by jointly optimizing preference, health, and diversity through Pareto-based optimization. However, this approach relies on static, per-step tradeoff solutions that fail to capture the sequential nature of dietary decision-making. We introduce MORL-A2C, a sequential decision-making extension to MOPI-HFRS targeting the health-preference axis. Leveraging frozen GNN embeddings, MORL-A2C formulates recommendation as a K-step reranking problem using an Advantage Actor-Critic algorithm with a scalarized relevance/health reward. The policy is warm-started via behavior cloning against a dot-product ranker derived from frozen embeddings. We also identify and correct a non-trivial bug in the MOPI-HFRS evaluation pipeline that understated baseline performance; all results are reported against the corrected baseline. On the macro-nutrient benchmark, MORL-A2C achieves a modest reduction in ranking quality (Recall@20: 25.64% to 23.61%, NDCG@20: 23.52% to 20.64%) in exchange for a substantial improvement in health alignment (H-Score@20: 46.05% to 69.57%), with consistent trends on the full-nutrient benchmark. These findings validate that policy-driven sequential optimization can effectively navigate the health-preference trade-off in multi-objective food recommendation.
papers.comment: Accepted at the International Workshop on Resource-Efficient Learning for Knowledge Discovery (RelKD) at ACM SIGKDD 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出MORL-A2C，一种基于强化学习的序列决策方法，作为MOPI-HFRS的扩展，用于优化食物推荐中的健康与偏好权衡。摘要显示在宏营养素基准上，MORL-A2C在牺牲部分排序质量（Recall@20从25.64%降到23.61%）的基础上，显著提升了健康对齐（H-Score@20从46.05%提升到69.57%）。
Motivation: 现有MOPI-HFRS使用静态每步权衡，无法捕捉饮食决策的序列性质，需要一种能动态优化健康-偏好权衡的序列决策方法。
Method: 将推荐建模为K步重新排序问题，使用Advantage Actor-Critic算法，奖励函数为标量化的相关性与健康分数；策略通过行为克隆从固定嵌入的点积排序器进行热启动；修复了基线评估中的一个bug。
Result: 在宏营养素基准上，Recall@20从25.64%降至23.61%，NDCG@20从23.52%降至20.64%，但H-Score@20从46.05%升至69.57%；全营养素基准上趋势一致。
Conclusion: 验证了策略驱动的序列优化可以有效导航多目标食物推荐中的健康-偏好权衡。

summary_sections.method: 将推荐建模为K步重新排序问题，使用Advantage Actor-Critic算法，奖励函数为标量化的相关性与健康分数；策略通过行为克隆从固定嵌入的点积排序器进行热启动；修复了基线评估中的一个bug。

summary_sections.conclusion: 验证了策略驱动的序列优化可以有效导航多目标食物推荐中的健康-偏好权衡。

papers.title: Learning Stable Canonical Worlds for Novel View Synthesis and Beyond
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward Gaussian splatting (FFGS) facilitates real-time novel view synthesis, yet current methods often remain tied to view-dependent predictions. As more input views are added, they may accumulate noisy or redundant evidence instead of converging to a stable scene representation. In this paper, we introduce CanonicalGS, a feed-forward pipeline that maps cluttered multi-view observations into a stable, scene-centric representation. CanonicalGS first extracts view-centric evidence from depth, semantic features, and uncertainty estimates, and then aggregates this evidence in a canonical latent world using uncertainty-aware fusion. By emphasizing reliable observations while suppressing uncertain or redundant ones, CanonicalGS produces representations that scale more effectively for novel view synthesis and transfer to downstream visual perception tasks. Experiments show up to a $2.5$ dB improvement in peak signal-to-noise ratio for synthesizing novel views and an $11\%$ gain in semantic segmentation accuracy.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CanonicalGS，一种前馈高斯泼溅 (feed-forward Gaussian splatting) 方法，通过从多视图观测中提取深度、语义特征和不确定性估计，并以不确定性感知融合方式在规范隐空间中聚合，得到稳定、场景中心的表示。实验表明，该方法在新视图合成中峰值信噪比提升高达 2.5 dB，语义分割准确率提高 11%。
Motivation: 现有前馈高斯泼溅方法依赖视图相关预测，随着输入视图增加，可能积累噪声或冗余证据，无法收敛到稳定的场景表示。
Method: CanonicalGS 首先从每个视图提取深度、语义特征和不确定性估计，然后将这些视图中心证据通过不确定性感知融合聚合到一个规范隐空间中，强调可靠观测并抑制不确定或冗余信息。
Result: 摘要报告新视图合成峰值信噪比提升最多 2.5 dB，语义分割准确率提升 11%。
Conclusion: 该方法生成的稳定场景表示不仅有利于新视图合成，还能有效迁移到下游视觉感知任务。

papers.title: CoVStream: Edge-Cloud Collaboration for Understanding of Long Video Streams
papers.abstract_en: Long, continuous video streams are an increasingly critical driver of multimedia intelligence. Existing efforts often handle long videos with a sample-encode-reason approach using large models. However, they overlook a crucial deployment fact: the stream is often produced by computationally constrained devices. This forces an untenable compromise: cloud offloading unlocks strong reasoning but incurs prohibitive bandwidth overhead, while on-device processing remains limited by edge hardware capacity. Therefore, we propose CoVStream, the first edge-cloud collaborative framework for understanding long video streams. The edge node distills raw video streams into compact visual features and semantic captions for transmission to the cloud, minimizing bandwidth costs, while the cloud server integrates this data into an entity graph and global visual context, activating the heavy reasoning model only when a user query arrives. Experiments on VideoMME-Long, LVBench, and RTV-Bench show that CoVStream reduces bandwidth usage by 87.6% while retaining 99.2% of the cloud baseline accuracy on LVBench.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CoVStream 提出首个边缘-云端协作框架用于理解长视频流。边缘节点将原始视频流压缩为紧凑视觉特征和语义描述传输到云端，最小化带宽开销；云端将这些数据整合为实体图和全局视觉上下文，仅在用户查询时激活重推理模型。实验表明，该方法在 LVBench 上降低 87.6% 带宽使用，同时保留 99.2% 的云端基线准确率。
Motivation: 现有长视频处理方法（采样-编码-推理）忽略了一个关键部署事实：视频流通常由计算受限设备产生。云端卸载带来强推理能力但带宽开销过大，而设备端处理受限于边缘硬件能力。
Method: 提出 CoVStream 边缘-云端协作框架：边缘节点将视频流提炼为紧凑视觉特征和语义描述，传输至云端；云端构建实体图和全局视觉上下文，仅在用户查询时激活大模型推理。
Result: 在 VideoMME-Long、LVBench 和 RTV-Bench 上评估，CoVStream 在 LVBench 上减少 87.6% 带宽使用，同时保持 99.2% 的云端基线准确率。
Conclusion: CoVStream 实现了带宽与推理能力的有效平衡，为长视频流理解提供了实用的边缘-云端协作方案。

papers.title: PolicyTrim: Boosting Intrinsic Policy Efficiency of Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models provide a unified paradigm for robotic manipulation, yet their real-world deployment is often bottlenecked by execution efficiency. While existing efforts predominantly focus on compute-centric efficiency to reduce per-step inference latency, the intrinsic \textbf{policy efficiency} of these models remains largely unexplored. Policy efficiency is fundamentally affected by two factors, namely the effective executable length of predicted action chunks and the total physical steps required to complete a task. These two factors jointly determine the total number of forward inference calls during execution. We observe that current VLA policies struggle with planning unreliability and action redundancy, suffering from severe prediction degradation at the tail of action chunks and tending to generate unnecessarily redundant physical steps. To address this, we propose \textbf{PolicyTrim}, a reinforcement learning-based post-training framework that extends the reliable action chunk length and reduces redundant physical steps. For reliable chunk extension, we employ a dynamic exploration strategy that explicitly rewards the successful completion of longer executable lengths, progressively pushing the trustworthy prediction horizon to its empirical limit. For step efficiency, we design a redundancy-aware reward that directly favors successful task completions with fewer steps while penalizing unreproducible shortcuts, effectively eliminating redundant physical actions. Extensive experiments across three benchmarks and three VLA models demonstrate that PolicyTrim improves action chunk utilization by 3$\times$ and reduces physical execution steps by 51.4\%. Ultimately, our framework delivers up to a 5.83$\times$ end-to-end deployment speedup without compromising task success rates.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出PolicyTrim，一种基于强化学习的后训练框架，旨在提升视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）的内在策略效率。该框架通过动态探索策略扩展可靠的动作块执行长度，并通过冗余感知奖励减少物理执行步骤。实验表明，PolicyTrim将动作块利用率提升3倍，物理执行步骤减少51.4%，端到端部署速度提升5.83倍，且不降低任务成功率。
Motivation: 现有VLA模型部署受限于执行效率，尤其是内在的策略效率（有效动作块长度和总物理步骤）未被充分探索，存在规划不可靠和动作冗余问题，导致推理调用次数过多。
Method: 提出PolicyTrim，一个强化学习后训练框架，包含两部分：1）动态探索策略，通过奖励成功完成更长可执行长度来扩展可靠预测范围；2）冗余感知奖励，直接偏好少步骤成功完成任务并惩罚不可重现的捷径。
Result: 在三个基准测试和三个VLA模型上，动作块利用率提升3倍，物理执行步骤减少51.4%，端到端部署速度提升5.83倍，且任务成功率未下降。
Conclusion: PolicyTrim有效解决了VLA模型中的策略效率瓶颈，显著加速实际部署，且无需修改模型架构。

papers.title: NegAS: Negative Label Guided Attention and Scoring for Out-of-Distribution Object Detection with Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Out-of-Distribution (OOD) detection is essential for ensuring the robustness and reliability of object detection systems deployed in safety-critical applications. While prior research has mainly focused on uni-modal detectors or vision-language model (VLM) based classifiers, the potential of VLM-based object detectors in OOD scenarios remains underexplored. In this work, we take the first step toward building OOD object detection methods upon VLMs. We identify two challenges specific to VLM detectors: (i) their text-guided attention enhances foreground with ID labels but treats background uniformly, leaving potential OOD regions unexploited for separating in-distribution (ID) from OOD instances; and (ii) their sigmoid-based multi-label outputs are incompatible with softmax-based OOD scores, calling for scoring functions consistent with VLM probabilistic outputs. Hence, we introduce Negative Label Guided Attention and Scoring (NegAS). To address (i), we propose a negative label guided attention module (NegA), where LLM-generated, visually-similar but semantically-different negative labels are used to guide attention toward potential OOD background regions. To address (ii), we introduce a novel sigmoid-based OOD scoring function (NegS) that leverages both ID and negative labels, producing strong responses for ID instances and suppressed responses for OOD ones. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach improves OOD detection performance by a large margin while maintaining ID accuracy, e.g., reducing the FPR95 by 11.4% on the COCO dataset and 25.5% on the OpenImages dataset compared to the baseline model. While initially designed for dense VLM detectors like YOLO-World, we successfully adapt NegAS to Grounding DINO, a query-based VLM transformer and achieve significant improvements, demonstrating the generalizability of our framework.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次将视觉语言模型（VLM）用于目标检测中的分布外（OOD）检测，提出NegAS方法，包括负面标签引导注意力模块（NegA）和基于sigmoid的OOD评分函数（NegS），在COCO和OpenImages上显著降低FPR95。
Motivation: 现有OOD检测主要针对单模态检测器或VLM分类器，VLM目标检测器的OOD能力未被探索；VLM检测器存在两个问题：文本引导注意力只增强前景，背景区域未被利用；sigmoid多标签输出不兼容softmax OOD评分。
Method: 提出NegAS，包含NegA模块（利用LLM生成的视觉相似但语义不同的负面标签引导注意力关注潜在OOD背景区域）和NegS评分函数（基于sigmoid，利用ID和负面标签，对ID强响应，OOD抑制）。
Result: 在COCO数据集上FPR95降低11.4%，在OpenImages上降低25.5%，同时保持ID准确率；成功迁移到Grounding DINO等查询式VLM检测器。
Conclusion: 本文首次探索VLM目标检测器的OOD检测，提出的NegAS方法有效且具泛化性。

papers.title: MMGist: A Comprehensive Multimodal Benchmark for 2027
papers.abstract_en: We conduct a systematic study of 18 widely used vision-language benchmarks and identify three major issues: 1) many items do not rely on visual cues and therefore fail to effectively measure multimodal understanding; 2) many items are already close to performance saturation for current LVLMs, which limits their discriminative power; 3) a small number of anomalous items affect the reliability of evaluation results. To this end, we propose MMGist, a curated benchmark that covers seven capability dimensions and contains 7,262 items. MMGist is constructed through a three-stage pipeline, which sequentially combines text-ablation filtering, cross-model saturation filtering, and anomaly detection filtering. We conduct extensive experiments on 27 leading LVLMs and compare MMGist with the raw pool of 23,250 items. The results show that MMGist preserves model rankings with high fidelity, with Spearman $ρ= 0.98$, while reducing evaluation items by 69\% and improving cross-model discrimination by 78\%. Further results indicate that Visual Logic remains a systematic weakness of current LVLMs, while knowledge-intensive dimensions such as Expert Knowledge dimensions remain important factors for distinguishing closed-source models from open-source models. These findings suggest that high-quality evaluation should prioritize visual dependency, discriminative power, and reliability, rather than simply pursuing benchmark scale.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统性分析了18个广泛使用的视觉-语言基准，发现三个主要问题：许多样本不依赖视觉线索、接近性能饱和、存在异常样本。为此提出MMGist基准，涵盖7个能力维度，包含7,262个样本，通过文本消融过滤、跨模型饱和过滤和异常检测过滤三阶段构建。在27个LVLM上实验，MMGist以69%的样本减少实现了模型排名高保真（Spearman ρ=0.98）和跨模型区分度提升78%。进一步发现视觉逻辑是当前LVLM的系统性弱点，专家知识维度是区分闭源与开源模型的关键。
Motivation: 现有视觉-语言基准存在视觉依赖不足、性能饱和和异常样本问题，导致评估结果不可靠且无法有效区分模型能力。
Method: 提出三阶段过滤流程：文本消融过滤移除不依赖视觉的样本，跨模型饱和过滤移除接近饱和的样本，异常检测过滤移除异常样本，最终得到MMGist基准。
Result: MMGist在27个LVLM上评估，与原始23,250样本池对比，Spearman ρ=0.98，样本减少69%，跨模型区分度提升78%；视觉逻辑是系统性弱点，专家知识维度区分闭源与开源模型。
Conclusion: 高质量评估应优先视觉依赖性、区分能力和可靠性，而非单纯追求基准规模。

papers.title: Improving Reasoning in Vision-Language Models via Perception Verified Self-Training
papers.abstract_en: Achieving human-like reasoning in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) remains a long-standing challenge. Recent approaches leverage Chain-of-Thought (CoT) rationales generated by human annotators or proprietary models to improve reasoning, which is costly and difficult to scale. Self-training offers a promising alternative by using models own outputs as supervision. However, existing methods often suffer from visual hallucinations -- where rationales describe non-existent visual content, and language shortcuts -- where predictions rely on textual priors rather than true visual grounding, as rationales are typically filtered only by answer correctness without verifying visual perception. To address this limitation, we propose a perception-verified self-training framework that enforces visually grounded reasoning. First, our method employs a CoT template (caption-reasoning-conclusion) that disentangles perception from reasoning, enabling independent verification of visual understanding. To compensate for the absence of ground-truth captions, we propose PerceptEval, an unsupervised method that evaluates caption quality based on its alignment with visual and textual elements present in the image. Using caption verification together with answer correctness, we partition the data into three subsets: easy (correct caption and conclusion), medium (correct caption but incorrect conclusion), and hard (incorrect caption). Building on this partitioning, we design a two-stage curriculum learning strategy. In Stage 1, the model is trained on easy examples and subsequently in Stage 2, medium samples are incorporated through a caption-guided reasoning enhancement procedure that regenerates reasoning conditioned on verified captions. Only regenerated samples with the correct conclusions are retained.

TL;DR: 本文针对视觉语言模型（VLM）推理中的视觉幻觉和语言捷径问题，提出感知验证自训练框架。该方法使用描述-推理-结论（caption-reasoning-conclusion）的CoT模板，并设计PerceptEval无监督评估描述质量。基于描述和结论正确性将数据分为易、中、难三类，采用两阶段课程学习：先训练易样本，再在第二阶段通过描述引导推理增强处理中样本。最终保留结论正确的重新生成样本。
Motivation: 现有CoT推理方法依赖人工或专有模型生成推理链，成本高难扩展；自我训练方法仅根据答案正确性过滤推理，导致视觉幻觉和语言捷径问题，推理缺乏视觉基础。
Method: 提出感知验证自训练框架：1）使用描述-推理-结论模板分离感知与推理；2）PerceptEval无监督评估描述与图像的对齐质量；3）根据描述和结论正确性将数据分为易（正确描述和结论）、中（正确描述但错误结论）、难（错误描述）；4）两阶段课程学习：阶段1训练易样本，阶段2对中样本进行描述引导推理增强，仅保留结论正确的再生样本。
Conclusion: 通过感知验证和课程学习，模型能够生成更基于视觉的推理，减少对文本先验的依赖。

papers.title: Learning Cross-View Semantic Priors for Single-Reference Unseen Object Pose Estimation
papers.abstract_en: Single-reference unseen object 6D pose estimation reduces object onboarding by estimating poses of arbitrary novel objects from only one reference view. Recent correspondence-based pipelines have achieved robust performance with vision foundation model (VFM) features. However, they typically treat these features as intra-view descriptors, leaving dense visual-semantic cues, including appearance, structure, and context, insufficiently exchanged across views before geometric decoding. Consequently, the decoded point features may lack joint semantic and geometric discriminability, making correspondence estimation still difficult in challenging cases. Instead of processing features independently, we build the correspondence pipeline around an early cross-view semantic prior. Specifically, cross-view semantic interaction (CVSI) enables dense query and reference VFM tokens to exchange semantic context and form a cross-view prior. Nevertheless, direct CVSI may disturb the VFM token structure, while the resulting semantic prior still needs 3D representation consistency for rigid correspondence. To make this CVSI prior reliable for 3D correspondence learning, we introduce two complementary training-time constraints: the intra-view structure preservation (IVSP) loss preserves the original intra-view token affinity structure during interaction, while the reference-anchored geometric consistency (RAGC) loss enforces spatial representation consistency of decoded point features. The final pose is recovered from learned correspondences through weighted SVD. We further construct a challenging view-pair protocol from the BOP Challenge datasets YCB-V and TUD-L to evaluate robustness in difficult matching scenarios. Extensive experiments on six benchmarks under different view-pair settings show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance while maintaining comparable inference speed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对单参考视图下的未见物体6D位姿估计问题，提出一种基于跨视图语义先验的对应关系估计方法。通过早期跨视图语义交互（CVSI）使查询和参考视图的VFM特征进行语义交换，并引入两个训练约束（IVSP损失和RAGC损失）保持特征结构和几何一致性。在BOP基准的YCB-V和TUD-L数据集上，该方法在多种视图对设置下达到最先进性能，且推理速度相当。
Motivation: 现有基于对应关系的管道通常将VFM特征视为视图内描述符，在几何解码前缺乏跨视图的密集语义交流，导致对应估计在困难情况下仍不准确。
Method: 构建早期跨视图语义先验的对应管道：使用跨视图语义交互（CVSI）使密集查询和参考VFM令牌交换语义上下文；同时引入视图内结构保持（IVSP）损失保持令牌结构，以及参考锚定几何一致性（RAGC）损失保证解码点特征的空间一致性；最终通过加权SVD恢复位姿。
Result: 在6个基准（包括YCB-V和TUD-L）的多种视图对设置下，该方法达到最先进性能，并保持与现有方法相当的推理速度。
Conclusion: 早期跨视图语义先验结合结构保持和几何一致性约束能有效提升单参考未见物体位姿估计的鲁棒性，尤其适用于困难匹配场景。

papers.title: How Should a Simulation-to-Reality Transfer Budget Be Spent?
papers.abstract_en: Simulation-to-reality transfer, often called sim-to-real transfer, is a central challenge in robot learning. Yet, the tradeoff between measuring a system more accurately and training over a broader range of simulated dynamics is still poorly understood. In this work, we focused on the allocation of real-robot measurement time between system identification and domain randomization. We studied this tradeoff in a controlled sim-to-sim pendulum setting, where a hidden-parameter model stands in for the physical robot, and the experiment sweeps identification rollouts against the width of the randomization distribution. Across the reality gaps and noise levels we tested, the measurement budget did most of the work. A small number of identification rollouts closed most of the transfer gap, and once any real data was available, policies performed best when trained at the estimated parameters rather than over a widened randomization band. Broad randomization that contained the true system still did not substitute for measurement. These results hold in a benign regime where the dynamics are identifiable and only two parameters are unknown, so structural model mismatch remains the setting where randomization breadth may become more valuable. Overall, our results suggest that sim-to-real pipelines should first measure the parameters they can and reserve randomization for the uncertainty that remains.
papers.comment: Both authors contributed equally and share first authorship. Submitted to IEEE IROS First Workshop on Sim2Real and Classical Control 2026. Code is available: https://github.com/YTomar79/sim2real_budget
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在仿真到现实（sim-to-real）迁移中，如何分配真实机器人测量预算：是用于系统辨识（更精确地测量系统参数）还是用于域随机化（覆盖更广的动力学范围）。在受控的sim-to-sim摆锤实验中，使用隐藏参数模型模拟真实机器人，通过扫描辨识轨迹与随机化分布宽度来研究这一权衡。实验表明，测量预算承担了大部分工作：少量辨识轨迹即可弥合大部分迁移差距；一旦有真实数据，在估计参数上训练的策略优于在宽随机化带上训练的策略；即使包含真实系统的宽随机化也无法替代测量。这些结果在动力学可辨识且仅有两个未知参数的良好条件下成立，因此结构模型失配可能是随机化广度更有价值的场景。
Motivation: 在机器人学习中，sim-to-real迁移中的测量预算分配（系统辨识 vs. 域随机化）尚不明确，缺乏对两者权衡的定量理解。
Method: 采用受控的sim-to-sim摆锤实验，用隐藏参数模型代替真实机器人，系统性地扫描不同数量的辨识轨迹和不同宽度的随机化分布，评估策略迁移性能。
Result: 少量辨识轨迹（如几次真实测量）便能弥合大部分迁移差距；当拥有真实数据时，在估计参数上训练的策略优于在包含真实系统的宽随机化分布上训练的策略；宽随机化不能替代直接测量。
Conclusion: 在动力学可辨识且参数少的情况下，sim-to-real管道应优先测量可辨识的参数，将随机化保留给剩余的不确定性；结构模型失配时随机化广度可能更重要。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Geometric and Information Compression of Representations in Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: Deep neural networks transform input data into latent representations that support a wide range of downstream tasks. These representations can be characterized along information-theoretic and geometric dimensions, but their relationship remains poorly understood. A central open question is whether low mutual information (MI) between inputs and representations necessarily implies geometrically compressed latent spaces and vice versa. We investigate this question using class-wise clustering as a measure of geometric compression and theoretically sound MI estimation in conditional entropy bottleneck (CEB) networks and continuous dropout networks. We evaluate the interplay between MI, geometric compression, and generalization on classification tasks under controlled noise injection schemes. Our findings show that low MI does not reliably correspond to geometric compression, and that the connection between the two is more nuanced than often assumed. Indeed, our experiments reveal a negative and nonlinear relationship that can reverse when varying training setup. Our results put forward a hypothesis that generalization acts as a potential confounder in this connection rather than being their direct consequence.
papers.comment: Published at ECML PKDD 2026; Dataset: https://doi.org/10.17877/RCTRUST-2026-DWMJTZ. Code: https://github.com/link-er/information_geometric_compression
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探究深度神经网络中潜在表示的信息论维度（互信息）与几何维度（类内聚类程度）之间的关系。作者在条件熵瓶颈网络和连续dropout网络中使用理论合理的互信息估计，发现低互信息并不必然对应几何压缩，两者之间存在非线性负相关，且可能受泛化能力的混淆。
Motivation: 深度表示可以在信息论和几何维度上刻画，但两者关系尚不清楚，特别是否低互信息必然意味着几何压缩。
Method: 使用类内聚类作为几何压缩的度量，在条件熵瓶颈网络和连续dropout网络中估计互信息，通过控制噪声注入研究互信息、几何压缩和泛化之间的相互作用。
Result: 实验发现低互信息并不可靠地对应几何压缩，两者关系呈非线性负相关，且可能反转；泛化能力可能是一个混淆因素。
Conclusion: 表示的信息压缩与几何压缩之间的关联比通常假设的更微妙，泛化可能作为混淆因素影响这种关系。

papers.title: Geometry-Aware Superpixel Graph Transformer with Metadata for Skin Lesion Classification
papers.abstract_en: Automated skin cancer classification from dermoscopic images remains challenging due to heterogeneous lesion structure, strong intra-class variability, and subtle visual differences between benign and malignant cases. Existing CNN/ViT pipelines typically rely on global or patch-level features and often combine patient metadata via late fusion, which limits spatially grounded multimodal reasoning. We present a novel region-based graph learning framework that explicitly models lesions as graphs of spatially coherent superpixel regions represented as frozen CNN features. To capture fine-grained lesion arrangements, we encode inter-regional geometry as edge attributes and introduce a dedicated metadata context node connected to all regions, providing structured integration of demographic/clinical variables within the same relational space. Node representations are updated using our edge-aware graph transformer followed by attention-driven propagation, and a final graph-level embedding for benign-malignant classification. Experiments on four public benchmarks demonstrate that explicit region-level relational modeling and graph-native multimodal fusion yield consistent gains over the state-of-the-art. Consequently, we establish a new graph-centric perspective in which CNN features are modeled as relational nodes and improved through contextual integration, yielding more expressive and robust classifications.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于区域级图学习的框架，将皮肤镜图像中的病灶建模为超像素节点图，利用几何感知图Transformer和元数据上下文节点实现多模态融合，在四个公开基准上取得优于现有方法的分类性能。
Motivation: 现有CNN/ViT模型依赖全局或补丁级特征，且患者元数据通常通过后期融合方式引入，缺乏空间层面的多模态推理能力，难以处理皮肤病变的异质结构和类内变异。
Method: 将CNN特征提取的超像素区域作为节点，区域间几何关系作为边属性，并引入一个连接所有区域的元数据上下文节点，使用边缘感知图Transformer进行节点更新和注意力传播，最终进行图级良恶性分类。
Result: 在四个公开基准数据集上，显式的区域级关系建模和图原生多模态融合相比现有方法取得一致提升。
Conclusion: 本文建立了一种新的图中心视角，将CNN特征建模为关系节点并通过上下文整合增强表达，实现了更鲁棒的分类。

papers.title: Prompt, Plan, Extract: Zero-Shot Agentic LLMs Workflows for Lung Pathology Extraction from Clinical Narratives
papers.abstract_en: Information extraction from pathology reports is essential for cancer staging, tumor registry population. Yet key data remains embedded in narrative reports, making manual extraction labor-intensive and error-prone. Traditional supervised Natural Language Processing pipelines address this through fully supervised Named Entity Recognition and Relation Extraction, but require expensive manual annotation and suffer cascading failures when upstream entities are missed. In this study, we developed a zero-shot, agentic workflow, and evaluated five open-source generative Large Language Models (LLMs) to populate 13 College of American Pathologists synoptic fields from lung resection pathology reports. We compared them against a state-of-the-art supervised GatorTron NER-RE baseline using a novel, registry-aligned evaluation framework. The baseline achieved Micro-F1of 0.960, while the best zero-shot model (GPT-OSS-20B) achieved Micro-F1 of 0.893 (recall: 0.949), accurately extracting complex relations like Pathologic Stage without task-specific training. These results suggest that open-source, zero-shot agentic LLMs show great potential as a low-cost solution for extracting lung pathology information.
