papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种零样本、自主代理式工作流（agentic workflow），利用开源大语言模型从肺切除病理报告中提取13个美国病理学家学会（CAP）结构化字段。在自行构建的符合肿瘤登记标准的评估框架下，最佳模型GPT-OSS-20B达到Micro-F1 0.893（召回0.949），接近监督式GatorTron NER-RE基线的0.960，表明零样本方法可作为低成本替代方案。
Motivation: 病理报告中的关键信息以叙述形式存在，手动提取耗时易错；监督式NLP需大量人工标注且上游实体遗漏会导致级联失败。
Method: 设计了一个零样本自主代理工作流，包含提示（Prompt）、规划（Plan）和提取（Extract）三个阶段，使用五种开源大语言模型（LLMs）直接从原始文本中填充结构化字段，无需任务特定训练。
Result: 最佳零样本模型GPT-OSS-20B在Micro-F1上达到0.893（召回0.949），而监督基线GatorTron为0.960（Micro-F1）。零样本模型能准确提取Pathologic Stage等复杂关系。
Conclusion: 开源零样本LLMs在肺病理信息提取中展现了接近监督方法的性能，可作为低成本、无需标注的可行方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Visual-OPSD: Cross-Modal On-Policy Self-Distillation for Efficient Unified Multimodal Reasoning
papers.abstract_en: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) interleave generated ''visual thoughts'' (VTs) with text reasoning to improve spatial tasks. This incurs roughly an order-of-magnitude inference cost from multi-step diffusion. We find this cost yields limited direct benefit. On ThinkMorph, removing or noising VTs barely changes accuracy across nine benchmarks. Once rendered, attention concentrates on the VT regardless of content. Yet a KL diagnostic shows that conditioning on a privileged VT trace shifts the model's completion distribution. This suggests the generation pathway encodes useful reasoning beyond the rendered pixels. Motivated by this gap, we propose Visual On-Policy Self-Distillation(Visual-OPSD). Teacher and student share identical weights but differ in context: the teacher sees privileged VTs while the student sees only the question. Token-level JSD distillation on on-policy student trajectories transfers the teacher's reasoning to a text-only student. Across nine benchmarks, Visual-OPSD improves over its generative teacher by $+3.40$pp with $14.3\times$ speedup (10.0s vs. 142.8s per sample) and outperforms same-scale VLMs by $+63.83$pp on VSP. A Gaussian-noise control ($+0.40$pp vs. $+10.28$pp for real VTs) and $58.4\%$ closure of the KL gap confirm that gains come from the semantic content of the generation pathway.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现统一多模态模型（UMMs）中生成的“视觉思考”（VTs）虽增加推理成本但直接贡献有限，然而生成路径蕴含有用推理信息。据此提出视觉在线策略自蒸馏（Visual-OPSD），让教师模型使用特权VTs，学生仅见文本，通过token级JSD蒸馏将教师推理转移至纯文本学生。在九个基准上，学生模型相比教师模型提升+3.40个百分点，推理速度提升14.3倍，在VSP上超越同级VLM 63.83个百分点。
Motivation: UMMs在空间推理任务中插入多步扩散生成的“视觉思考”导致推理成本增加一个数量级，但去除或扰动VT后准确率几乎不变，说明VT的像素贡献有限，而其生成路径包含有用推理信息。
Method: 提出Visual-OPSD：教师和学生共享相同权重，但教师输入包含特权VT，学生仅见问题；在策略学生轨迹上进行token级JSD蒸馏，将教师推理能力转移至纯文本学生。
Result: 学生模型在九个基准上平均提升+3.40个百分点，推理速度提升14.3倍（每个样本10.0秒 vs 142.8秒）；在VSP基准上超越同规模VLM 63.83个百分点；高斯噪声对照实验（+0.40 pp vs 真实VT的+10.28 pp）和58.4%的KL散度闭合证明增益来自生成路径的语义内容。
Conclusion: Visual-OPSD有效利用UMMs中VT生成路径的语义信息，实现高效推理，大幅节省计算成本。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: R2D-RL: A RoboCup 2D Soccer Environment for Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: Robot soccer is a challenging testbed for multi-agent reinforcement learning because it combines partial observability, cooperative and adversarial interaction, sparse rewards, and long-horizon tactical behavior. RoboCup 2D Soccer Simulation (RCSS2D) provides a mature robot-soccer platform, but its competition-oriented server-client architecture is difficult to use directly with modern Python-based MARL workflows. We introduce R2D-RL, a reinforcement learning environment that connects RCSS2D and HELIOS-based player clients to a Python MARL interface through shared-memory communication and cycle-level synchronization. R2D-RL supports full-field and scenario-based training with configurable opponents, Base discrete and Hybrid parameterized action spaces, action masks, expected possession value (EPV)-based reward shaping, and parallel execution. We provide front-goal scenarios and an 11-vs-11 full-field benchmark, together with baseline results.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: R2D-RL是一个基于RoboCup 2D足球仿真平台的多智能体强化学习环境，通过共享内存和循环级同步连接HELIOS客户端和Python MARL接口，支持全场和场景训练、离散和混合动作空间、动作掩码、基于EPV的奖励塑形及并行执行。
Motivation: RoboCup 2D足球仿真平台架构面向竞赛，难以直接用于现代Python多智能体强化学习工作流，需要桥接环境。
Method: 通过共享内存通信和循环级同步，将RCSS2D服务器和HELIOS客户端封装为Python MARL接口，支持全场比赛和特定场景训练，提供可配置对手、离散/混合动作空间、动作掩码、EPV奖励塑形和并行执行。
Result: 提供了前门球场景和11对11全场比赛基准，并给出基线实验结果。
Conclusion: R2D-RL为多智能体强化学习提供了一个高效、灵活的RoboCup 2D足球仿真环境，便于战术研究。

papers.title: MetaboNet-Bench: A Multi-modal Benchmark for Glucose Forecasting in Type 1 Diabetes
papers.abstract_en: Glucose forecasting algorithms are an important aspect of glycemic control management in type 1 diabetes. So far, the research community has developed numerous algorithms and models for forecasting. However, it is well-recognized that the lack of standardized model performance evaluation benchmarks makes fair comparison difficult and hinders further innovation, and thus benchmark standardization is in urgent need. Furthermore, many published glucose forecasting algorithms are limited to CGM data alone, ignoring other multimodal signals such as insulin dosing and carbohydrate intake. Here, we introduce MetaboNet-Bench, a benchmark for multimodal glucose forecasting for patients with type 1 diabetes that provides an extensible open-source evaluation framework for comparison of glucose forecasting algorithms that leverage glucose, insulin, and carbohydrate data. We then demonstrate its utility by benchmarking several recently published glucose forecasting models and a custom multimodal time-series model, representing different model architectures. The results show that the benefit of adding data modalities is conditioned on the complexity of the model and that incorporating more clinical metrics helps identify meaningful gaps to fill for future research.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍MetaboNet-Bench，一个针对1型糖尿病患者的多模态血糖预测基准，提供可扩展的开源评估框架，整合血糖、胰岛素和碳水化合物数据。通过基准测试多个最新模型，发现添加数据模态的好处依赖于模型复杂度，并指出结合更多临床指标有助于识别未来研究差距。
Motivation: 目前血糖预测算法缺乏标准化评估基准，公平比较困难，且多数算法仅依赖CGM数据，忽略了胰岛素和碳水化合物等多模态信号。
Method: 构建一个开源、可扩展的评估框架，支持使用血糖、胰岛素和碳水化合物数据的多模态血糖预测模型，并基准测试了多个近期模型和一个自定义多模态时序模型。
Result: 结果显示，添加数据模态带来的性能提升与模型复杂度相关；纳入更多临床指标能够揭示有意义的研究空白。
Conclusion: MetaboNet-Bench为血糖预测算法的公平比较和多模态研究提供了标准化平台，有助于推动该领域的进一步发展。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: DynFS-MoE: Dynamic Functional-Structural Mixture-of-Experts for Post-Traumatic Epilepsy Diagnosis
papers.abstract_en: Post-traumatic epilepsy (PTE) is a severe complication of traumatic brain injury (TBI). Yet, early identification remains challenging due to the complex structural and functional alterations it induces in the brain. To address this, we propose a dynamic multimodal Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) framework that integrates functional and structural connectivity through time-aware functional-structural encoding and class-conditioned expert routing. Within this framework, modality-specific and cross-modal experts learn complementary representations, while a Modality-Class MoE (MCoE) module dynamically adjusts expert weights according to each classification objective. Experimental results across three binary classification tasks demonstrate that the framework consistently outperforms static fusion baselines, and high-interpretability analyses further reveal meaningful regions of interest (ROIs) interactions. This dynamic multimodal expert framework effectively captures class-dependent brain interaction patterns and provides an interpretable approach for PTE diagnosis and risk stratification.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出动态功能-结构混合专家（DynFS-MoE）框架，用于创伤后癫痫（PTE）诊断。该框架通过时间感知的功能-结构编码和类别条件专家路由整合多模态脑连接数据，并利用模态-类别MoE模块动态调整专家权重。实验在三个二分类任务上优于静态融合基线，可解释性分析揭示了有意义的脑区交互模式。
Motivation: 创伤后癫痫是脑外伤的严重并发症，但早期诊断困难，因为大脑结构性和功能性改变复杂。现有方法难以捕捉类相关的动态脑交互模式。
Method: 提出动态多模态MoE框架，包含模态特异性和跨模态专家，以及Modality-Class MoE（MCoE）模块根据分类目标动态调整专家权重，结合时间感知的功能-结构编码。
Result: 在三个二分类任务上，该框架持续优于静态融合基线；可解释性分析进一步揭示了有意义的感兴趣区（ROI）交互。
Conclusion: 该动态多模态专家框架能有效捕捉类别依赖的脑交互模式，为PTE诊断和风险分层提供可解释的方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Representation Costs in Data Science: Foundations and the Quasi-Banach Spaces of Deep Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: We develop a general framework for analyzing representation costs of parametric data-fitting methods through their parameter-space regularizers. From this abstract perspective, we define representation costs for arbitrary parametric models and reveal their induced (native) function spaces. This unifies recent function-space views of data-fitting methods. We also prove that many natural results hold in this abstract setting, including representer theorems for parametric methods on their native spaces. The framework also rigorously connects parametric methods with their equivalent nonparametric descriptions under sufficient overparameterization. Classical methods and their native spaces, such as kernel methods / reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces, wavelets / Besov spaces, and shallow neural networks / variation spaces emerge as special cases of our abstract framework. A byproduct of "axiomatizing" the study of representation costs is that we also immediately obtain new results for deep neural networks: For depth-$L$ feedforward ReLU networks, their induced native spaces are $p$-normable quasi-Banach spaces with $p = 2/L$. This reveals that the inductive bias of deep neural networks (as given by the representation cost) cannot be captured by norms for depths $L > 2$.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文建立了一个泛化框架分析参数化数据拟合方法的表示代价，通过参数空间正则化器定义任意参数模型的表示代价并揭示其原生函数空间。该框架统一了核方法、小波、浅层神经网络等经典方法的函数空间视角，并推导出深度前馈ReLU网络的原生空间是p-范数拟Banach空间（p=2/L），表明深度L>2时归纳偏差不能被范数捕获。
Motivation: 现有工作缺乏对参数化方法表示代价的统一函数空间分析，尤其对深度神经网络的归纳偏差理解不足。
Method: 通过参数空间正则化器抽象表示代价，定义原生函数空间，并建立表示定理以及与过参数化非参数描述的联系。
Result: 深度L前馈ReLU网络的原生空间是p-范数拟Banach空间（p=2/L），归纳偏差对于L>2不能由范数表示。
Conclusion: 该框架统一了经典方法的表示代价分析，并为深度神经网络的归纳偏差提供了新的数学刻画，但主要适用于前馈ReLU网络。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: When to Write and When to Suppress: Route-Specialized Dual Adapters for Memory-Assisted Knowledge Editing
papers.abstract_en: Knowledge editing systems must update selected facts while preserving nearby but irrelevant behavior. This paper studies this problem in a memory-assisted setting where an edit memory is retrieved at inference time and a parameter-efficient adapter corrects the model's object preference. We argue that the central design question is not only how to write an edit, but also when to suppress it. We introduce \method{}, a route-specialized dual-adapter editor. A relevance router first decides whether a prompt should receive an edit memory. Routed prompts use an edit adapter trained to prefer the new object over the original object; unrouted non-direct prompts use a separate locality adapter trained to preserve or restore the original-object preference. We evaluate \method{} on three 1,000-case protocols, \cf{}, \zsre{}, and \mquake{}, under the same memory protocol and two 7B/8B base models. On Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, \method{} obtains the best overall probability-preference accuracy on all three benchmarks: 0.8180 on \cf{}, 0.8946 on \zsre{}, and 0.9922 on \mquake{}. The same trend holds on Qwen3-8B. Router ablations show that the relevant memory boundary differs across datasets: a lexical neural router is safest on \cf{}, while BGE embedding routing is better on \zsre{} and \mquake{}. Component and module ablations show that the gain mainly comes from separating edit injection from off-route suppression rather than from simply increasing LoRA capacity.

papers.title: Running the Gauntlet: Re-evaluating the Capabilities of Agents Beyond Familiar Environments
papers.abstract_en: As agentic systems continue to evolve and are widely deployed in real-world scenarios, there is a growing demand to faithfully evaluate their capabilities. However, current benchmarks are typically built on popular applications with relatively simple tasks and focus on a narrow set of capabilities while overlooking broader dimensions, resulting in saturated performance on modern agents and failing to probe their limitations. To this end, we introduce GauntletBench, a web-based benchmark for evaluating agent generalisation in challenging scenarios, focusing on three underexplored capabilities (temporal perception, graphical understanding, and 3D reasoning), across five less-covered professional applications (Video Editor, Workflow Builder, 3D Modeller, Flight Analyser, and Circuit Designer), each with 20 vision-intensive tasks (100 in total). Our benchmark provides a modular pipeline that comprises an environment compatible with both open- and closed-source agent frameworks, a controlled web-based application, a well-structured task suite, and an automated evaluation engine with diverse metrics. Contrary to widespread expectations, our empirical results reveal that frontier agentic systems remain far from achieving human-level performance. Even the state-of-the-art agent achieves only a 19.1% success rate on our GauntletBench, highlighting the limitations in these overlooked capabilities and generalisation. By comparison, non-expert human annotators achieve over 80% success on our challenging yet feasible tasks, revealing the substantial gap between current agent capabilities and those required for complex real-world scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 GauntletBench，一个基于 Web 的基准测试，用于评估智能体在挑战性场景中的泛化能力。该基准聚焦于三个未充分探索的能力（时间感知、图形理解和 3D 推理）以及五个专业应用（视频编辑器、工作流构建器、3D 建模器、飞行分析器和电路设计器），共包含 100 个视觉密集型任务。实验表明，最先进的智能体仅达到 19.1% 的成功率，而非专家人类超过 80%，揭示了当前智能体与人类在复杂现实场景中的巨大差距。
Motivation: 现有基准通常基于简单任务且只关注狭隘的能力集，导致性能饱和，无法探测现代智能体的局限性。
Method: 构建了模块化流水线，包括兼容开源和闭源智能体框架的环境、受控 Web 应用、结构化任务套件以及自动评估引擎，并采用多样化指标。
Result: 最先进的智能体在 GauntletBench 上仅取得 19.1% 的成功率，而非专家人类超过 80%，显示巨大差距。
Conclusion: 当前智能体系统远未达到人类水平，在时间感知、图形理解和 3D 推理等被忽视的能力上存在显著不足。

papers.title: Position: Align AI to Our Aspirations, Not Our Flaws
papers.abstract_en: We argue that aligning AI to aggregated human preferences is the wrong target. With current technology, one can train AIs to share the values of a Silicon Valley techno-optimist, a degrowth environmentalist, a national-conservative culture warrior, a single-party state cadre, or a devout religious traditionalist. We should not. Human values produce societies that thrive or fail on the merits of those values - from failed states and extreme inequality to declining happiness, political polarization, and government dysfunction in the world's wealthiest democracies. The pluralistic-alignment program correctly diagnoses that there is no single "humanity" to align with, but is dangerous if taken as the main directive. We argue that AI should be trained to a non-negotiable floor of objective alignment goals - competence, bounded by the constraints of factual accuracy, honesty, and lawfulness and that pluralism belongs at the surface (language, register, conventions, missing-context defaults) and across the wide band of legitimate value tradeoffs that respect the floor, but not at the level of values that violate it. We highlight the empirical reality of unfiltered pluralistic values, propose four commitments as a constructive alternative, and engage six credible objections: commercial pressure and practical feasibility, democratic legitimacy, regulatory compliance, over-reliance on institutionalist explanations, the charge that the floor itself is culturally laden, and the limits of Coherent Extrapolated Volition.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文认为将AI对齐到聚合的人类偏好是错误的，主张AI应训练到客观对齐目标（能力、事实准确性、诚实和合法性）的不可协商基准，而多元性应限于表面层面（语言、习惯等）和不违反基准的合法价值权衡。
Motivation: 当前AI对齐方法试图聚合人类偏好，但人类价值观本身可能导致社会失败（如失败国家、不平等、政治极化等），因此需要重新定义对齐目标。
Method: 提出四个建设性承诺作为替代方案，并回应六个可信的反对意见（商业压力、民主合法性、监管合规等）。
Result: 论文没有实验性结果，而是提出论点和对未来对齐方向的建议。
Conclusion: AI应基于不可协商的客观基准对齐，多元性只能在尊重该基准的范围内存在。

papers.title: Automated reproducibility assessments in the social and behavioral sciences using large language models
papers.abstract_en: Reproducibility in the social and behavioral sciences is typically evaluated by independent researchers who reanalyze the original data to assess whether the published findings can be recovered. However, such approaches are resource-intensive and difficult to scale. Here, we show that large language models (LLMs) can automate reproducibility assessments. Using N = 180 published studies with predefined claims from the behavioral and social sciences, we compare LLM-generated analyses with the original findings. For 11 studies, the LLM pipeline could not produce a viable effect size estimate. For the remaining studies, the LLM reached the same qualitative conclusion as the original study in 80% of cases, and recovered the original effect sizes (using a +/-0.05 tolerance in Cohen's d) in 24% of studies. In a subset with human reanalyses, the LLM reached the same qualitative conclusion as the original study in 95% of studies, similar to human reanalysts (83%), and the LLM recovered the original effect sizes using a +/-0.05 tolerance in 40% of studies, again broadly similar to human reanalysts (28%). Given the current capabilities and limitations of LLMs, the findings show that LLMs can support systematic audits of empirical results rather than substitute expert judgment. As such, LLMs can serve as a scalable screening tool to improve the rigor and reproducibility in empirical research.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文探讨使用大型语言模型（LLM）自动化社会科学和行为科学中的可重复性评估。通过对180篇已发表研究进行测试，LLM在80%的情况下得出与原研究一致的定性结论，24%的研究恢复原始效应量（Cohen's d 误差±0.05）。在与人类再分析对比的子集中，LLM表现与人类再分析者相当（95% vs 83%定性一致；40% vs 28%效应量恢复）。结果表明LLM可作为可扩展的筛选工具支持实证结果审计，但尚不能替代专家判断。
Motivation: 传统可重复性评估依赖独立研究者重新分析数据，资源消耗大且难以规模化。因此需要一种自动化、可扩展的方法来评估社会科学和行为科学研究的可重复性。
Method: 使用LLM对180篇已发表研究（含预定义声明）自动生成分析，并与原始发现对比。LLM管道包括从论文中提取信息、生成分析代码、执行并报告效应量。
Result: 在180篇研究中，11篇无法产生可用效应量估计。其余研究中，LLM在80%的研究中得出与原研究一致的定性结论，24%的研究恢复了原始效应量（Cohen's d 误差±0.05）。在有人类再分析的子集中，LLM在95%的研究中定性一致（人类83%），40%恢复效应量（人类28%）。
Conclusion: LLM当前能力和局限表明，它们可支持实证结果的系统审计，而非替代专家判断。作为可扩展的筛选工具，LLM有助于提高实证研究的严谨性和可重复性。

papers.title: Augmentation techniques for video surveillance in the visible and thermal spectral range
papers.abstract_en: In intelligent video surveillance, cameras record image sequences during day and night. Commonly, this demands different sensors. To achieve a better performance it is not unusual to combine them. We focus on the case that a long-wave infrared camera records continuously and in addition to this, another camera records in the visible spectral range during daytime and an intelligent algorithm supervises the picked up imagery. More accurate, our task is multispectral CNN-based object detection. At first glance, images originating from the visible spectral range differ between thermal infrared ones in the presence of color and distinct texture information on the one hand and in not containing information about thermal radiation that emits from objects on the other hand. Although color can provide valuable information for classification tasks, effects such as varying illumination and specialties of different sensors still represent significant problems. Anyway, obtaining sufficient and practical thermal infrared datasets for training a deep neural network poses still a challenge. That is the reason why training with the help of data from the visible spectral range could be advantageous, particularly if the data, which has to be evaluated contains both visible and infrared data. However, there is no clear evidence of how strongly variations in thermal radiation, shape, or color information influence classification accuracy. To gain deeper insight into how Convolutional Neural Networks make decisions and what they learn from different sensor input data, we investigate the suitability and robustness of different augmentation techniques...

TL;DR: 本文研究可见光和热红外光谱下的多光谱CNN目标检测，重点分析不同增强技术的适用性和鲁棒性。摘要指出热红外数据集获取困难，尝试利用可见光数据辅助训练，但缺乏温度辐射、形状或颜色信息变化对分类精度影响的明确证据。

Method: 使用多种增强技术处理可见光和热红外图像，通过CNN分析不同传感器输入对决策的影响。
Result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果，仅提到研究增强技术的适用性和鲁棒性。
Conclusion: 作者强调需要进一步理解CNN如何从不同传感器输入中学习，以及温度辐射、形状、颜色信息变化对分类精度的影响。

papers.title: Graph Reinforcement Learning for Calibration-Aware Quantum Circuit Routing
papers.abstract_en: Quantum circuit routing is a key step in compiling programs for noisy intermediate-scale quantum processors. Routes that appear efficient by standard overhead metrics can still lose fidelity when they pass through poorly calibrated couplers. We study a calibration-aware graph reinforcement-learning router that uses same-day IBM Heron r2 calibration data to choose hardware-edge SWAPs. We train the policy with proximal policy optimization and evaluate it with exact simulated fidelity across nine Munich Quantum Toolkit (MQT) Bench circuits and three calibration snapshots. Across these evaluations, pooled mean exact fidelity is $0.727$, compared with $0.440$ for SABRE-best20 and $0.481$ for target-aware SABRE. We observed that fidelity gains came with higher routed two-qubit counts and were concentrated in 5 qubit and 8 qubit circuit families; under the fixed tree action graph, all 10 qubit families favored SABRE-best20. Overall, our results show that calibration-aware learned routing can improve fidelity beyond gate-count-driven compilation.
papers.comment: Submitted to IEEE Quantum Week International Workshop on AI for Circuit Synthesis, Optimization, and Discovery 2026. Code is available: https://github.com/YTomar79/calibration-aware-rl-routing
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究基于图强化学习的量子电路路由方法，利用每日IBM Heron r2校准数据选择硬件边缘SWAP操作，以提升量子电路保真度。在九个MQT基准电路和三个校准快照上评估，平均精确保真度0.727，优于SABRE-best20的0.440和目标感知SABRE的0.481。保真度增益伴随更高的双量子门数量，且集中在5和8量子比特电路上；10量子比特电路上SABRE-best20更优。
Motivation: 现有量子电路路由方法主要优化门计数等标准开销指标，但未考虑校准不良耦合器导致的保真度损失，需要校准感知的路由策略。
Method: 提出校准感知的图强化学习路由器，使用近端策略优化训练策略，基于同一天IBM Heron r2校准数据选择硬件边缘SWAP操作。
Result: 在九个MQT基准电路上，平均精确保真度0.727，高于SABRE-best20的0.440和目标感知SABRE的0.481；保真度提升集中在5和8量子比特电路，但10量子比特电路上SABRE-best20更优。
Conclusion: 校准感知的强化学习路由可以超越传统门计数驱动编译的保真度，但增益受限于电路规模和拓扑结构。

summary_sections.result: 在九个MQT基准电路上，平均精确保真度0.727，高于SABRE-best20的0.440和目标感知SABRE的0.481；保真度提升集中在5和8量子比特电路，但10量子比特电路上SABRE-best20更优。
summary_sections.conclusion: 校准感知的强化学习路由可以超越传统门计数驱动编译的保真度，但增益受限于电路规模和拓扑结构。

papers.title: SymQNet: Amortized Acquisition for Low-Latency Adaptive Hamiltonian Learning
papers.abstract_en: Adaptive Hamiltonian learning is central to calibrating and characterizing quantum devices. In an adaptive controller, choosing the next experiment is itself a computation. Bayesian design rules are recomputed after every posterior update, and that step can take seconds. Across hundreds of shots, those seconds become a significant wall-clock cost for adaptivity. We introduce SymQNet, an amortized reinforcement-learning approach for low-latency adaptive Hamiltonian learning. SymQNet learns a posterior-conditioned acquisition policy offline, then uses a fast policy forward pass online while retaining Bayesian posterior feedback. On transverse-field Ising benchmarks, SymQNet substantially reduces acquisition latency relative to bounded Fisher-information search and bounded two-step Bayesian active learning by disagreement (BALD). At five qubits, it reduces acquisition-only decision latency by $47.1\times$ and $72.6\times$ relative to these online baselines; at twelve qubits, full simulated steps take $1.02$ s for SymQNet versus $13.27$ s for bounded two-step BALD. Overall, we show that learned acquisition can make adaptive Hamiltonian learning practical for repeated low-latency workloads.
papers.comment: Submitted to IEEE QCE Quantum Week International Workshop on Quantum Computing and Reinforcement Learning 2026. Code is available: https://github.com/YTomar79/symqnet_quantum
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: SymQNet 是一种基于摊销强化学习 (amortized reinforcement learning) 的低延迟自适应哈密顿量学习方法，用于量子设备校准。它通过离线学习后验条件采集策略，在线快速执行策略前向传播，同时保留贝叶斯后验反馈。在横场伊辛模型基准测试上，SymQNet 相比有界费舍尔信息搜索和有界两步 BALD，显著降低了采集延迟：5 量子位时决策延迟降低 47.1 倍和 72.6 倍，12 量子位时完整模拟步骤仅需 1.02 秒（对比 13.27 秒）。
Motivation: 自适应哈密顿量学习中，每次贝叶斯更新后重新计算实验选择耗时数秒，累积数百次实验后成为显著的墙钟开销，限制了低延迟应用中的实用性。
Method: 提出 SymQNet，一种摊销强化学习方法：离线训练一个后验条件采集策略，在线使用时仅需一次快速策略前向传播，同时利用贝叶斯后验反馈进行更新。
Result: 在横场伊辛模型基准上，5 量子位时采集决策延迟相比有界费舍尔信息搜索和有界两步 BALD 分别降低 47.1 倍和 72.6 倍；12 量子位时完整模拟步骤耗时 1.02 秒（对比 13.27 秒）。
Conclusion: 学习式采集策略能够使自适应哈密顿量学习在重复低延迟工作负载中变得实用，大幅减少在线计算时间。

papers.title: A-Evolve-Training: Autonomous Post-Training of a 30B Model
papers.abstract_en: Post-training a frontier model is normally weeks of human work: proposing data and recipe changes, launching runs, reading evals, deciding what to keep. We report an autonomous system that runs this loop with no human in the loop, post-training a 30B Nemotron across four rounds over multiple weeks. The autonomously produced model reaches a held-out score of 0.86 against the top human submission's 0.87 on the public NVIDIA Nemotron-Reasoning Challenge leaderboard, placing 8th of ~4000 at the time of writing. More striking than the number: the loop detected that its own dev metric had stopped tracking external performance on the weakest domain -- candidates drove dev to record highs without moving the external target -- and revised its own search policy, no longer maximizing dev but seeking interventions that lowered the now-misleading proxy while improving the external target. We treat this as direct, auditable evidence that a scaled autonomous loop can produce discovery, not only optimization: it detected that its measurement frame had become misleading and changed what counted as evidence. We take the operational view that any system worth the "recursive self-improvement" label must eventually perform end-to-end post-training of a frontier-class model; this is one datapoint of that bar being cleared. We do not claim a "first autonomous match" of human researchers. The claim we make is narrower and auditable: to our knowledge, this is the first publicly reported autonomous post-training run at this scale, where prior public autonomous-ML-research demonstrations sit at GPT-2-class (~124M) budgets. The same system also post-trains the 120B and 550B Nemotron; with no public human baseline there, this shows only that the loop closes at that scale, not that its output is competitive -- infrastructure evidence, with the effectiveness claim deferred until a comparable human anchor exists.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个无需人类干预的自主后训练系统，在30B Nemotron模型上进行了多轮后训练，最终在公共排行榜上达到0.86分，接近人类最高0.87分。系统还展现了自我修正能力：当发现自身开发指标与外部目标脱节时，自动调整搜索策略，不再最大化开发指标，而是寻找降低误导性代理指标同时改善外部目标的干预措施。这是首个公开报告的这种规模的自主后训练运行。
Motivation: 传统后训练需要数周人力进行数据、实验和评估的循环迭代，而本工作旨在构建一个完全自主的系统来替代这一过程。
Method: 提出一个自主循环系统，无需人类干预，自动提议数据与配方变化、启动实验、读取评估并决定保留哪些改进，在30B模型上进行了四轮迭代。
Result: 自主训练出的模型在NVIDIA Nemotron-Reasoning Challenge排行榜上达到0.86分（人类提交最高0.87分），在约4000个提交中排名第8。系统还检测到开发指标在弱领域不再跟踪外部性能，并自动修订搜索策略。
Conclusion: 论文认为这是可审计的证据，表明大规模自主循环不仅能进行优化，还能产生发现——系统检测到测量框架具有误导性并改变了证据标准。这是首个公开报告的这种规模的自主后训练运行，但有效性声明需等到有可比人类基线时才成立。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: When Role-playing, Do Models Believe What They Say?
papers.abstract_en: Language models can state that "the Earth orbits the Sun" and, when role-playing Aristotle, assert the opposite. Recent work argues that persona adoption is fundamental to how language models behave, with models selecting the most appropriate persona for a given context. Does such role-playing merely change the model's outputs, or does it also affect what the model internally represents as truthful? We study this question using the role-play of characters whose beliefs differ from the modern consensus, and induce personas with a number of different methods: prompting, in-context learning (ICL), supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and Open Character Training (OCT), and Emergent Misalignment (EM). We measure belief internalization across these approaches with truth probes and with behavioral tests, finding a broad spectrum of belief internalization. Prompting, ICL, and SFT change what the model says with little representational change. EM creates a large, broad shift in the model's truth representation, and OCT a smaller shift that is clearest on the larger model. Understanding when training changes a model's worldview rather than merely its behavior may become increasingly important as AI systems are entrusted with greater autonomy and influence.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过让语言模型扮演与当代共识不符的古代角色，研究角色扮演是否改变模型内部对真理的表示。实验采用提示、上下文学习、监督微调、开放角色训练和涌现失调等方法，发现不同方法导致不同程度的信念内化：提示、上下文学习和监督微调仅改变输出而不影响内部表示，而涌现失调和开放角色训练则引起表示层面的显著变化。
Motivation: 现有研究认为角色扮演是语言模型行为的基础，但尚不清楚这种扮演是否仅改变输出，还是也影响模型内部对真理的表示。理解这一点对AI系统的自主性和影响力愈发重要。
Method: 使用多种角色诱导方法（提示、上下文学习、监督微调、开放角色训练、涌现失调）让模型扮演信念与当代共识不同的角色，通过真理探针（truth probes）和行为测试衡量信念内化程度。
Result: 发现不同方法导致信念内化的广泛差异：提示、上下文学习和监督微调几乎不改变内部表示；涌现失调引起大面积表示偏移；开放角色训练在更大模型上产生较小但清晰的偏移。
Conclusion: 某些训练方法能改变模型的世界观而不仅仅是行为，这随着AI系统自主性增强而愈发重要，但不同方法的效果差异显著。

papers.title: Bellman-sufficient Information Complexity
papers.abstract_en: We develop Bellman-sufficient information complexity, a formal representation-level framework for sequential decision making. The primitive benchmark is a fixed-truth environment space $Ω$ with unrestricted nonanticipating algorithms. The intrinsic object is a Bellman-sufficient state representation, serving as an interactive notion of sufficient statistics, together with an information index $Y=χ(Ω)$, often the optimal decision or value object rather than the full environment. On the upper-bound side, learning is organized as a dynamic program on the sufficient state, equipped with a logarithmic information potential for the index. On the lower-bound side, a Bellman-Fano certificate uses the same state representation and information index, but propagates separate Bellman recursions for information gain and ghost mass. The central matching statement is therefore a conditional Bellman information-risk sandwich: when the log-penalized Bellman upper value and the ghost-quantile lower certificate close at the same radius, they certify the same complexity scale. Popular algorithms then appear as tractable certificates or relaxations of this common log-potential Bellman program, rather than as separate notions of information complexity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了贝尔曼充分信息复杂度（Bellman-sufficient information complexity），一个用于序贯决策的形式化表示框架。该框架以固定真实环境空间Ω为基准，定义了贝尔曼充分状态表示（一种交互式充分统计量概念）和信息索引Y=χ(Ω)。在上界方面，学习被组织为对充分状态的动态规划，并配备了对数信息势；在下界方面，贝尔曼-法诺证书使用相同的状态表示和信息索引，但通过独立的贝尔曼递归传播信息增益和幽灵质量。中心结论是条件贝尔曼信息-风险夹逼定理：当对数惩罚贝尔曼上界值与幽灵分位数下界证书在同一半径闭合时，它们证明了相同的复杂度尺度。
Motivation: 序贯决策问题中缺乏一个统一的表示级框架来刻画信息复杂度，现有算法常被视为独立的信息复杂度概念而非统一框架下的实例。
Method: 定义贝尔曼充分状态表示和信息索引，利用动态规划构建上界学习过程，并引入贝尔曼-法诺证书传播信息增益和幽灵质量，通过条件贝尔曼信息-风险夹逼定理匹配上下界。
Result: 该框架将流行算法统一为同一个对数势贝尔曼程序的可处理证书或松弛，而非独立的信息复杂度概念。
Conclusion: 论文提供了一个形式化框架，使序贯决策中的信息复杂度分析可以通过贝尔曼递归统一处理，但未提供具体实验验证。

papers.title: CheXanatomy: Anatomy-Aware Vision-Language Modeling for Chest Radiographs
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) pretrained on large-scale image-text pairs demonstrate strong image-level understanding, but are primarily optimized for global alignment and do not explicitly encode fine-grained anatomical structure, limiting their suitability for spatially precise tasks such as segmentation. We introduce CheXanatomy, a framework that integrates explicit anatomical knowledge into a pretrained VLM through autoregressive token-space supervision. Instead of adding task-specific decoder heads, the model is trained to generate anatomical segmentation masks via next-token prediction. To enable scalable supervision, we synthesize realistic chest radiographs from CT volumes and forward-project CT segmentation labels to obtain anatomically consistent 2D masks. We evaluate the approach on synthetic and real chest radiographs against a U-Net baseline, including ablations on model scale, input resolution, and vision encoder fine-tuning. Autoregressive anatomical supervision achieves performance comparable to specialized convolutional models in-distribution and demonstrates improved geometric robustness under domain shift to real CXR data. In addition, anatomy-pretrained models exhibit improved sample efficiency when adapting to novel localization tasks under limited supervision. Larger models and higher input image resolution improve performance, while vision encoder fine-tuning has limited effect. These results show that embedding anatomical structure directly into the generative objective promotes spatially grounded representations and supports anatomy-aware medical vision-language modeling.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CheXanatomy 框架，通过自回归标记空间监督将显式解剖知识融入预训练视觉语言模型，无需特定任务解码头即可生成解剖分割掩码。方法利用 CT 体数据合成逼真的胸片并前向投影 CT 分割标签获得 2D 掩码，在合成和真实胸片上与 U-Net 基线比较，显示与专用卷积模型性能相当且在域偏移下几何鲁棒性更好，解剖预训练模型在少样本定位任务中样本效率更高。
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型主要优化全局图像-文本对齐，无法显式编码细粒度解剖结构，限制了其在分割等空间精确任务中的适用性。
Method: 将解剖知识集成到预训练视觉语言模型中，通过自回归下一词元预测训练生成解剖分割掩码；利用 CT 体数据合成胸片并前向投影 CT 分割标签获得一致的 2D 掩码进行可扩展监督。
Result: 在合成和真实胸片上，该方法与 U-Net 基线性能相当，在向真实胸片域迁移时表现出更好的几何鲁棒性；解剖预训练模型在少样本适应新定位任务时样本效率更高；更大模型和更高输入分辨率提升性能，视觉编码器微调影响有限。
Conclusion: 将解剖结构嵌入生成目标可促进空间有根表示，支持解剖感知的医学视觉语言建模，但方法基于合成数据，需进一步验证在真实临床环境中的适用性。

summary_sections.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型主要优化全局图像-文本对齐，无法显式编码细粒度解剖结构，限制了其在分割等空间精确任务中的适用性。
summary_sections.method: 将解剖知识集成到预训练视觉语言模型中，通过自回归下一词元预测训练生成解剖分割掩码；利用 CT 体数据合成胸片并前向投影 CT 分割标签获得一致的 2D 掩码进行可扩展监督。
summary_sections.result: 在合成和真实胸片上，该方法与 U-Net 基线性能相当，在向真实胸片域迁移时表现出更好的几何鲁棒性；解剖预训练模型在少样本适应新定位任务时样本效率更高；更大模型和更高输入分辨率提升性能，视觉编码器微调影响有限。
summary_sections.conclusion: 将解剖结构嵌入生成目标可促进空间有根表示，支持解剖感知的医学视觉语言建模，但方法基于合成数据，需进一步验证在真实临床环境中的适用性。

papers.title: MODIS Thermal Infrared Sounding (MOTIS): Estimating Tropical Cyclone Central Pressure from Warm-Core Anomalies
papers.abstract_en: This study presents a novel framework for estimating the central sea-level pressure ($P_\mathrm{c}$) of tropical cyclones (TCs) using infrared radiometers. We leverage the long-overlooked combination of high spatial resolution and sounding capability of the Moderate Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer (MODIS) to measure warm-core anomalies in TC eyes. We develop the MODIS Thermal Infrared Sounding (MOTIS) framework, which performs instrument-specific preprocessing and estimates $P_\mathrm{c}$ using multiple linear regression. MOTIS yields $r^2 = 0.945$ and RMSE = 4.3 hPa for high-intensity TCs with observed clear eyes (mean $P_\mathrm{c} = 937$ hPa), outperforming all existing methods for intense TCs. We construct a dataset of 3288 (1082 clear-eye) MOTIS estimates from 2002 to 2025 and demonstrate its potential to improve the quality of Best Track $P_\mathrm{c}$, roughly halving uncertainties in the absence of pressure observations. Although MODIS is nearing the end of its mission, the MOTIS framework could be extended to next-generation geostationary sounders to provide accurate real-time $P_\mathrm{c}$ estimation for high-intensity TCs.
papers.comment: 16 pages, 13 figures, 6 tables; submitted to Bulletin of the American Meteorological Society
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文提出MOTIS框架，利用MODIS红外辐射计的热芯异常估计热带气旋中心海平面气压，通过多线性回归方法，在高强度热带气旋中实现了高精度，r²=0.945，RMSE=4.3 hPa。研究基于2002-2025年的3288个样本，证明该方法可改善最佳路径气压数据质量。
Motivation: 现有热带气旋中心气压估计方法精度有限，尤其在高强度气旋中，而MODIS的高空间分辨率和探测能力未被充分利用。
Method: 开发MOTIS框架，包括MODIS特定预处理，并使用多线性回归从红外辐射计观测的热芯异常中估计中心气压。
Result: 对于具有清晰眼区的高强度热带气旋，MOTIS达到r²=0.945，RMSE=4.3 hPa，优于所有现有方法。数据集包含3288个估计值，其中1082个清晰眼区样本，可将气压不确定性减半。
Conclusion: MOTIS框架虽基于即将退役的MODIS，但可推广到新一代地球静止探测仪，为实时高强度热带气旋提供准确的中心气压估计。

papers.title: Dynamic Multi-Pair Trading Strategy in Cryptocurrency Markets with Deep Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract_en: This study aims to determine whether the application of Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) as a specialized execution overlay can enhance pair trading in highly volatile cryptocurrency markets. Although classical implementations of the strategy have proven successful in traditional equities, they frequently exhibit rigidity and suffer from severe divergence risks when applied to high-variance environments. To address this need, this research introduces novel concepts. To construct a robust system, we developed a hierarchical "Filter-then-Rank" pair selection methodology and a proprietary "Fixed Risk, Adaptive Mean" execution model. The system employs a Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) agent with a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) layer to govern execution decisions within strict deterministic risk management boundaries. Evaluated on 1-hour interval data from the Binance USD-M Futures market, the optimized RL policy achieved an out-of-sample performance that substantially outperformed the heuristic baseline. A stationary circular block bootstrap robustness check confirms that the agent's risk-adjusted outperformance is statistically significant at the 10 percent level. Although falling marginally short of the stricter 5 percent threshold, this result highlights the extreme idiosyncratic variance characteristic of digital assets. Ultimately, this thesis contributes to the quantitative finance literature by introducing a hybrid architecture that combines statistical arbitrage with DRL execution policies. Furthermore, it delivers a novel framework for safe reinforcement learning via deterministic shielding, proving that anchoring a neural policy to statistically robust boundaries successfully mitigates severe divergence risks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究深度强化学习（DRL）作为执行层能否提升加密货币市场中的配对交易策略。提出层级式“过滤-排序”配对选择方法和“固定风险、自适应均值”执行模型，使用带LSTM层的PPO智能体在严格风险管理边界内控制执行决策。在Binance USD-M期货1小时间隔数据上，优化后的RL策略在样本外表现显著优于启发式基线，经平稳循环块自举检验，风险调整后超额收益在10%水平上统计显著。
Motivation: 经典配对交易策略在传统股票市场有效，但在高波动加密货币市场中常出现僵化和严重发散风险，亟需一种更鲁棒的执行机制。
Method: 提出“过滤-排序”层级式配对选择方法和“固定风险、自适应均值”执行模型；采用带LSTM层的PPO智能体，通过确定性风险管理边界（屏蔽）来保证安全强化学习。
Result: 在Binance USD-M期货1小时数据上，RL策略样本外表现大幅优于启发式基线；平稳循环块自举检验显示风险调整后超额收益在10%水平显著（未达5%阈值），表明数字资产的极端异质方差。
Conclusion: 提出一种结合统计套利与DRL执行策略的混合架构，并证明通过确定性屏蔽将神经策略锚定在统计稳健边界上可有效缓解严重发散风险。

papers.title: How Many Trees in a Random Forest? A Revisited Approach with Plateau Search and Optuna Integration
papers.abstract_en: Hyperparameter optimization (HPO) for Random Forest faces a specific difficulty in tuning the number of trees: the predictive score typically improves monotonically with ensemble size, so standard methods such as Tree-structured Parzen Estimator (TPE) and Hyperband require a predefined search range and often drive the estimate toward its right boundary. Early-stopping strategies avoid fixing such a range, but can be sensitive to score noise and prone to premature stopping. To address this, we propose an integrated triplet-based plateau-search algorithm that removes the number of trees from the direct TPE search space and still exploits information accumulated across HPO trials. The method adaptively tracks a near-minimal sufficient ensemble size by monitoring relative changes in the out-of-bag (OOB) score across a triplet of forest sizes and shifting this triplet accordingly. This yields an automated and user-interpretable procedure based on a tolerance parameter. We also provide a theoretical analysis: we relate the proposed relative OOB-score criterion to the gap between the current and limiting scores, and derive an asymptotic variance estimate for the corresponding OOB-based absolute relative difference. Experiments show that the selected number of trees can differ substantially from the common heuristic: for most classical benchmark datasets it is smaller, whereas for some high-dimensional bioinformatics datasets, such as Arcene and Dorothea, it is larger. The source code and reproducible experiments are available at https://github.com/lange-am/rf_plateau_hpo.
papers.comment: 24 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Author-prepared preprint of the article published in IEEE Access. The published article is licensed under CC BY 4.0
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于三重奏平台搜索（triplet-based plateau search）的随机森林树数量自动确定方法，将树数量从TPE搜索空间中移除，通过监控袋外（OOB）分数的相对变化自适应地找到接近最小充分集成大小。理论部分推导了OOB绝对相对差异的渐近方差估计，实验表明该方法选出的树数量与常见启发式方法差异较大。
Motivation: 随机森林超参数优化中，树的数量通常单调提升性能，导致标准HPO方法（如TPE和Hyperband）倾向于选择搜索空间右边界，而早期停止策略易受噪声影响提前停止。需要一种无需预设搜索范围且鲁棒的自适应方法。
Method: 提出三重奏平台搜索算法：维护三个不同大小的随机森林，监控相邻大小间OOB分数的相对变化，当变化低于容忍阈值时认为达到平台，从而确定最小充足树数量。该过程与TPE优化分离，但仍利用HPO trial积累的信息。
Result: 在多数经典基准数据集上选出的树数量小于常见启发式值，而在一些高维生物信息学数据集（如Arcene和Dorothea）上则更大。理论部分给出了OOB绝对相对差异的渐近方差估计。
Conclusion: 本文提供了一种自动化、可解释的随机森林树数量选择方法，基于容忍参数，避免了预设搜索范围的缺点，并能在不同数据集上自适应调整。

papers.title: VLMs are Good Teachers for Video Reasoning via Adaptive Test-Time Optimization
papers.abstract_en: The recent "Reasoning with Video" paradigm utilizes Video Generation Models (VGMs) to generate temporally coherent visual trajectories to complete reasoning tasks. Although state-of-the-art VGMs excel at visual quality, they often struggle to understand and follow task-specific rules, leading to logical failures across diverse reasoning scenarios. Existing efforts try to utilize Vision-Language Models (VLMs) as problem pre-solvers to produce or refine textual guidance for the VGM. However, textual descriptions fail to capture intricate spatiotemporal details, and VGMs often struggle to faithfully execute fine-grained or long-tail instructions even with a valid plan. While VLMs struggle as solvers, they possess strong perception capabilities to evaluate process-constraint satisfaction and final-goal achievement. Leveraging this strength, we introduce a paradigm shift that transitions the role of VLMs to "teachers". Specifically, a VLM teacher extracts task-specific rules to formulate differentiable rewards, guiding a VGM Reasoner via test-time online optimization of a lightweight LoRA module. This strategy enables adaptive test-time optimization and extends the reasoning capabilities beyond the VGM's intrinsic boundaries. Evaluations on symbolic (VBVR-Bench) and general-purpose (RULER-Bench) video reasoning benchmarks show that the proposed method yields a 16.7-point average performance gain, outperforming the VLM-as-Solver paradigm (+0.4 points) and Best-of-N scaling (+2.2 points) by a large margin at comparable test-time cost. These findings reveal that integrating VLMs as test-time teachers offers a promising paradigm for achieving generalizable video reasoning. Project Page: https://VLM-as-Teacher.github.io/
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出将视觉语言模型(VLM)作为“教师”，通过测试时在线优化引导视频生成模型(VGM)进行视频推理。VLM教师提取任务规则并形式化为可微分奖励，在线优化VGM中的轻量LoRA模块，实现自适应优化。在VBVR-Bench和RULER-Bench上平均提升16.7点，大幅超越现有范式。
Motivation: 现有VGM生成视觉轨迹时难以理解任务规则导致逻辑失败，而VLM作为求解器时文本描述无法捕捉时空细节，VGM难以执行细粒度指令。
Method: 将VLM角色转变为“教师”，利用其感知能力评估过程约束和最终目标满足度，提取任务规则构建可微分奖励函数，通过测试时在线优化VGM中的轻量LoRA模块进行引导。
Result: 在符号视频推理基准VBVR-Bench和通用视频推理基准RULER-Bench上，平均性能提升16.7点，优于VLM-as-Solver范式(+0.4点)和Best-of-N缩放(+2.2点)，且测试时成本相当。
Conclusion: 将VLM作为测试时教师为实现通用视频推理提供了有前景的范式，可扩展VGM的推理能力超越其固有边界。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Beyond Independent Manipulation: Individual Fairness-aware Strategic Classification with Peer Imitation
papers.abstract_en: Strategic classification (SC) investigates scenarios where agents manipulate their features to obtain favorable decisions from predictive models. Existing fairness-aware SC approaches primarily focus on group fairness and typically assume that agents respond independently. However, when individual fairness is required, ensuring similar individuals receive similar outcomes, agents' manipulation becomes interdependent: an agent's preferred manipulation depends on the neighborhoods' outcomes. This induces a mismatch between classical SC formulations and fairness-aware decision settings, where independent models no longer accurately characterize strategic manipulations. To address this issue, we introduce individual fairness-aware strategic classification (IFSC), a framework that models peer-driven manipulation arising from individual fairness, where agents imitate nearby positively decided peers to obtain favorable outcomes. IFSC characterizes strategic manipulation as similarity-based imitation toward visible accepted peers and learns classifiers under the resulting post-manipulation distributions. To account for uncertainty in peer observability, IFSC employs a robust learning process that introduces stochastic perturbations during manipulation simulation. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that IFSC improves individual-fairness consistency and mitigates imitation-induced distortions.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出个体公平感知战略分类（IFSC）框架，考虑个体公平性要求下智能体之间的相互模仿行为，而非独立操纵。IFSC通过相似性模仿向附近被接受的同伴学习，并引入随机扰动处理同伴可观测性不确定性。实验表明IFSC提升个体公平一致性并减轻模仿导致的失真。
Motivation: 现有公平感知战略分类主要关注群体公平且假设智能体独立响应，但个体公平性要求导致智能体操纵相互依赖，传统模型无法准确刻画这种策略操纵。
Method: 构建IFSC框架，将战略操纵建模为基于相似性的同伴模仿，学习后操纵分布下的分类器，并在模拟操纵中引入随机扰动以处理同伴可观测性不确定性。
Result: 在合成和真实数据集上，IFSC提升了个体公平一致性并减轻了模仿诱导的失真。
Conclusion: IFSC框架有效地结合了个体公平性与战略分类中同伴模仿的现实场景，但摘要未提及局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Qwen-Image-Bench: From Generation to Creation in Text-to-Image Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-Image generation has evolved from basic image synthesis into a frequently used core capability in professional creative workflows, where simple text-image alignment can no longer satisfy users' pressing demands for faithful real-world reconstruction and genuine creative expression. Existing benchmarks, however, remain anchored in these foundational criteria and do not yet capture the nuanced capabilities that matter in authentic artistic practice, making it difficult to reliably distinguish state-of-the-art T2I models. To address the gap, we introduce Qwen-Image-Bench, a creator-centric benchmark co-designed with professional artists and grounded in real-world creation scenarios. Qwen-Image-Bench enriches conventional evaluation with two application-driven dimensions: Real-world Fidelity and Creative Generation. Drawing on the staged reasoning inherent in professional artistic workflows, we organize these five pillars into a top-down hierarchical taxonomy that further decomposes into 23 second-level sub-capabilities and 56 third-level verifiable rubrics. To ensure broad coverage, we curate 1000 stratified prompts with each prompt jointly exercising more than four fine-grained facets across multiple pillars. We train a unified judge model Q-Judger based on Qwen3.6-27B, supervised by 80 professional annotators from global art academies under blind labeling and triple-review protocols, that scores every image across all 56 verifiable facets, producing fine-grained, rubric-grounded, and fully attributable diagnostics rather than a single opaque score. Empirically, Qwen-Image-Bench reliably distinguishes leading T2I models, achieving the greatest separation on the two application-driven dimensions of Real-world Fidelity and Creative Generation where existing benchmarks provide little insight, while also providing a trustworthy optimization signal for production-level T2I development.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Qwen-Image-Bench，一个面向创作者的文生图评估基准，补充了真实世界保真度和创意生成两个应用驱动维度，并构建了五支柱层次化分类体系，涵盖23个二级子能力和56个三级可验证指标。通过收集1000个分层提示，并训练基于Qwen3.6-27B的统一评判模型Q-Judger，由80名专业标注员进行盲标和三重审核，在56个指标上打分。实验表明该基准能有效区分领先T2I模型，特别是在现有基准缺乏洞察的两个应用维度上。
Motivation: 现有文生图评估基准仍停留在基础图文对齐等标准，无法满足专业创作中对真实世界重建和创意表达的需求，难以可靠区分最先进模型。

Conclusion: 该基准填补了文生图评估中面向创作的实际能力缺口，提供细粒度、可归因的诊断而不是单一分数。

papers.title: CALIBURN: Operationally Calibrated Streaming Intrusion Detection with Regime-Dependent Conformal Risk Control
papers.abstract_en: Streaming intrusion detection systems must process flows continuously under bounded memory, yet most leave alerting-threshold selection as a post-hoc tuning problem incompatible with production, where operators commit in advance to alert budgets, misclassification costs, and Service Level Objectives. We present CALIBURN, a streaming alerting pipeline that derives its decision threshold from these operational inputs rather than a label-dependent search. CALIBURN composes five layers on one streaming substrate: truncated Bayesian online change-point detection; isotonic calibration of the posterior to a conditional attack probability; cost-sensitive thresholding from operator costs; a Conformal Risk Control (CRC) wrapper mapping an alert budget alpha to a false-positive-bounded threshold under exchangeability; and multi-window burn-rate alerting from Site Reliability Engineering. Each layer is established; the contribution is the integration and a falsifiable finding about it: the behaviour of calibration and conformal risk control is strongly regime-dependent across attack prevalence. Across three regimes -- LITNET-2020 (5.2%), CICIDS2017 (22%), UNSW-NB15 (64%) -- CALIBURN reaches AUC-PR 0.943 in the rare-attack regime it targets, beating the best streaming baseline by 2.21x and the best batch reference by 4.12x, with isotonic calibration cutting Brier score 30%; it stays strongest among streaming methods at moderate prevalence; and all converge to the prevalence floor under base-rate inversion. A TTL-feature ablation shows this high-prevalence collapse is intrinsic to streaming, not a dataset artifact. We further identify two mechanisms -- a theoretical CRC overshoot 2B/(n0+1) and an empirical-density degeneracy -- collapsing conformal alerting at very small alpha, and propose both as pre-deployment checks. Code and artifacts: Apache 2.0, Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20074590.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CALIBURN 是一个针对流式入侵检测系统的在线告警管道，它从操作输入（告警预算、误分类成本、服务等级目标）中直接导出决策阈值，而非依赖后验标签搜索。系统由五层组成：截断贝叶斯在线变点检测、等渗校准、成本敏感阈值化、基于共形风险控制（CRC）的误报率边界保证，以及多窗口燃尽率告警。在三个攻击流行率不同的数据集上（LITNET-2020 5.2%, CICIDS2017 22%, UNSW-NB15 64%），CALIBURN 在目标稀有攻击场景下 AUC-PR 达 0.943，比最佳流式基线高 2.21 倍，比最佳批处理方法高 4.12 倍；等渗校准使 Brier 分数降低 30%。论文还揭示了高流行率下所有方法收敛于基率反转下限、以及极小 alpha 下 CRC 理论过冲和密度退化两种失效机制，并提供了部署前检查建议。
Motivation: 现有流式入侵检测系统大多将告警阈值选择作为后处理调参问题，难以与生产环境中预先承诺的告警预算、误分类成本和服务等级目标兼容。
Method: 提出 CALIBURN 管道，在单一流处理基座上集成五层：截断贝叶斯在线变点检测、等渗校准将后验概率映射为条件攻击概率、操作成本驱动的成本敏感阈值化、基于共形风险控制的包装器在可交换性假设下将告警预算 alpha 映射为有界的误报率阈值，以及来自站点可靠性工程的多窗口燃尽率告警。
Result: 在 LITNET-2020（稀有攻击 5.2%）、CICIDS2017（中等 22%）、UNSW-NB15（高 64%）三个数据集上，CALIBURN 在稀有攻击场景 AUC-PR 达 0.943，优于最佳流式基线 2.21 倍、最佳批处理参考 4.12 倍；等渗校准使 Brier 分数降低 30%；在中等流行率下仍为最强流式方法；所有方法在高流行率下收敛于基率反转下限。TTL 特征消融表明该高流行率塌缩是流式固有特性。
Conclusion: CALIBURN 验证了基于操作输入进行校准阈值调整的可行性，同时也揭示了校准和共形风险控制在攻击流行率变化下的强依赖行为；识别了极小 alpha 下 CRC 的理论过冲和密度退化两种机制，并给出了部署前检查方法。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: From One-Pass SGD to Data Reuse: Mini-Batch Scaling Laws in Sketched Linear Regression
papers.abstract_en: Scaling laws provide compact descriptions of how prediction error varies with compute, model size, and data, but existing theory mainly treats single-sample SGD or full data reuse, leaving the role of mini-batching unclear. We study batch scaling laws for sketched linear regression under a power-law covariance spectrum and a source condition on the target parameter. We analyze one-pass batch SGD, multi-pass batch SGD with replacement, and multi-pass batch SGD without replacement. Our first result is a risk decomposition: all three procedures share the same irreducible and approximation terms, while their stochastic terms depend on the sampling protocol. One-pass batch SGD splits into bias and variance, whereas the two multi-pass methods split into GD bias, GD variance, and a fluctuation term around a common GD reference trajectory. We then prove source-condition scaling laws for one-pass and multi-pass mini-batch methods. For one-pass batch SGD, mini-batching preserves the approximation and optimization-bias exponents, while the variance scales as $O(\min(M,(T_{\mathrm{eff}}γ)^{1/a})/(B T_{\mathrm{eff}}))$. Thus the usual $1/B$ covariance reduction holds at fixed update count $T$, but in the one-pass regime $T=N/B$ it is partly offset by the shorter optimization horizon. For multi-pass batch SGD, with- and without-replacement sampling have identical approximation and GD bias/variance terms; they differ only in the fluctuation covariance prefactor, which is $1/B$ with replacement and $ρ_{N,B}=(N-B)/(B(N-1))$ without replacement. Hence without-replacement sampling is less noisy for $B>1$, and when $B=N$ the fluctuation vanishes, recovering deterministic gradient descent. These results place batch size on the same theoretical footing as compute, data, and model dimension in sketched linear regression.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究素描线性回归中不同批处理策略的学习率缩放规律，推导出一遍批SGD、多遍有放回批SGD和多遍无放回批SGD的风险分解，并给出在幂律协方差谱和目标参数源条件下的缩放定律。结果表明批大小在计算量、数据和模型维度中具有同等的理论地位。
Motivation: 现有缩放定律理论主要关注单样本SGD或全数据重放，批处理的作用尚不明确。
Method: 通过风险分解，将一遍批SGD分为偏差和方差项，多遍方法分为GD偏差、GD方差和围绕GD参考轨迹的波动项。然后在源条件下证明缩放律，分析批大小对各项指数和系数的影响。
Result: 一遍批SGD中，批处理保持逼近和优化偏差指数，方差缩放为O(min(M,(T_effγ)^{1/a})/(B T_eff))；多遍批SGD中，无放回采样在B>1时噪声更小，B=N时退化为确定性梯度下降。
Conclusion: 将批大小与计算量、数据和模型维度置于同等理论基础，明确了批处理在素描线性回归缩放定律中的作用。

papers.title: Symbolic Reasoning Frameworks Trigger Memory-Mediated Ecosystem Dynamics in Multi-Agent LLM Systems
papers.abstract_en: Large language models exhibit a risk-averse "turtle" bias as strategic agents. We show that injecting a symbolic reasoning framework as a per-round reflective prompt into one agent acts as a small perturbation whose consequences are not per-decision but emergent: the agent's risk posture is unchanged in isolation, yet over a campaign of accumulating memory and multi-agent interaction the conditions settle into distinct, condition-associated winner ecosystems. In a 7-player Warring States Diplomacy variant (61 games, 6 conditions), the winner distribution differs sharply across the four primary conditions (41 games; permutation omnibus p approximately 0.001): control -> Yan (7/11); I-Ching yarrow -> Yan/Chu co-dominance with Qin fully suppressed (0/10); Tarot -> Qin (5/10); scrambled-text ablation -> Qi (5/10). The scrambled->Qi attractor is robust (vs. pooled and control alone, p = 0.006 and 0.012); tarot->Qin is denominator-dependent (0.006 pooled, 0.064 vs. control). Han never wins and shows no survival difference (Fisher p = 1.0); neither framework's content predicts actions (chi-squared p = 0.95 hexagram, 0.69 Tarot). A memory-free decision-isolation probe (960 calls) shows the process does not change the agent's risk posture in isolation (Friedman p = 0.45; I-Ching p = 0.60; Tarot perturbs move content but not risk, p = 0.021). A 2x2 factorial separating yarrow's decision-time and learning-time components reveals a non-additive interaction: each alone freezes the board (50-60% stalemates), combined they produce zero (permutation p ~ 5e-5). Testing relocates Qin suppression to rival (Chu) expansion governed by campaign memory depth, not the oracle (p = 0.55). We present this as an observation paper: agent-level framework choice produces distinctive, non-additive system-level consequences, transmitted through emergent memory and multi-agent dynamics, not per-decision effects.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过7玩家战国外交变体实验，发现向一个智能体注入符号推理框架（如易经、塔罗牌）会通过累积记忆和多智能体交互产生突现的、条件依赖的获胜者生态系统分布，而单个智能体的风险态度在隔离时不变。不同框架导致显著不同的获胜者模式，且框架效果是非加性的，其机制涉及记忆动态而非决策级影响。
Motivation: 研究符号推理框架作为微小扰动在多智能体LLM系统中是否会产生系统级突现后果，以及这些后果是否通过记忆和交互动力学而非决策级效应传递。
Method: 在7玩家Warring States Diplomacy变体（61局游戏，6种条件）中，为一个智能体注入不同符号推理框架（易经、塔罗牌、乱序文本对照）作为逐轮反思提示，分析获胜者分布，并通过记忆隔离探针和2x2因子分解分离决策时间和学习时间成分。
Result: 四种主要条件下的获胜者分布显著不同（排列检验p≈0.001）：控制组→燕（7/11）；易经→燕/楚共治，秦被完全压制（0/10）；塔罗→秦（5/10）；乱序文本→齐（5/10）。记忆隔离探针显示框架不改变智能体单件风险姿态（Friedman p=0.45）。秦的压制归因于楚的扩张，由战役记忆深度而非神谕内容决定。
Conclusion: 智能体级别框架选择通过突现记忆和多智能体动力学产生非加性的系统级后果，而非通过改变单个决策或风险姿态。

summary_sections.conclusion: 智能体级别框架选择通过突现记忆和多智能体动力学产生非加性的系统级后果，而非通过改变单个决策或风险姿态。

papers.title: Chebyshev Policies and the Mountain Car Problem: Reinforcement Learning for Low-Dimensional Control Tasks
papers.abstract_en: We analytically solve the Mountain Car problem, a canonical benchmark in RL, and derive an optimal control solution, closing a gap after 36 years. This enables us to reveal two surprising insights: The optimal control is quite simple, yet modern RL agents display a large gap to optimality. Motivated by the analysis of the optimal control, we introduce Chebyshev policies as a universal (i.e. dense) class of RL policies from first principles. They can be trained as drop-in replacements of neural nets, reducing the regret by a factor of 4.18, while requiring 277 times fewer parameters, fostering sample efficiency, explainability and realtime capability. Chebyshev policies are evaluated on further RL tasks, including a real-world nonlinear motion control testbed. They consistently improve performance over neural nets with PPO, ARS and REINFORCE. Our results demonstrate how Chebyshev policies offer a compelling and lightweight alternative or addition to neural nets for low-dimensional control tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文在36年后首次解析求解了强化学习标准基准Mountain Car问题的最优控制，揭示了两个惊人发现：最优控制非常简单，但现代RL智能体与最优解之间存在巨大差距。受最优控制分析启发，作者从第一性原理引入切比雪夫策略（Chebyshev policies）作为通用（稠密）的RL策略类，可作为神经网络的即插即用替代品，在低维控制任务上显著减少遗憾并大幅降低参数量。
Motivation: Mountain Car问题自提出36年来一直缺少解析最优解，导致无法准确评估RL算法的最优性差距；现有神经策略在低维控制任务上往往过参数化且可解释性差。
Method: 首先通过解析方法推导Mountain Car问题的最优控制解；然后基于最优控制的分析，设计切比雪夫策略类，利用切比雪夫多项式作为基函数构建参数化策略，可替换神经网络并用于PPO、ARS、REINFORCE等算法。
Result: 在Mountain Car任务上，切比雪夫策略将遗憾降低4.18倍，同时所需参数减少277倍；在多个低维控制任务（包括真实世界非线性运动控制测试平台）上，一致优于使用神经网络的PPO、ARS和REINFORCE。
Conclusion: 切比雪夫策略为低维控制任务提供了比神经网络更轻量、更高效、更具可解释性的替代方案，尤其在样本效率、实时性和可解释性方面具有优势。

papers.title: Sutra: Tensor-Op RNNs as a Compilation Target for Vector Symbolic Architectures
papers.abstract_en: Sutra is a typed, purely functional programming language whose compiled forward pass is a PyTorch neural network. The compiler beta-reduces the whole program -- primitives, control flow, string I/O -- to one fused tensor-op graph over a frozen embedding substrate. Rotation binding, unbind, bundle, polynomial Kleene three-valued logic, and tail-recursive loops all lower to tensor operations; the Kleene connectives are Lagrange-interpolated polynomials exact on the {-1, 0, +1} truth grid. Validation is one fact tested two ways. (1) The same program runs on four frozen embeddings spanning two modalities -- three text encoders (nomic-embed-text, all-minilm, mxbai-embed-large) and one protein language model (ESM-2) -- and decodes bundles at 100% accuracy through width k=8 on every substrate, where the textbook Hadamard product has already collapsed (2.5% on mxbai-embed-large, 7.5% on all-minilm). (2) PyTorch autograd flows through the actually compiled graph: a fuzzy-rule classifier written in .su trains from random init (18.7 +/- 9.5%; chance = 20%, five classes) to 100.0 +/- 0.0% (three seeds) by backpropagating through the emitted graph, the symbolic source unmodified. A weighted variant additionally trains a scalar cosine gain and writes it back into the .su source as a numeric literal; recompiling reproduces the trained behaviour to ~2e-7 per logit, so the trained model is itself legible, recompilable code. The same artifact is therefore both a logic program and a trainable neural network.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Sutra 是一种类型化纯函数式编程语言，其编译后的前向传播是一个 PyTorch 神经网络。编译器将整个程序（包括原语、控制流、字符串 I/O）通过 beta 归约融合为单个张量运算图，运行在冻结的嵌入基座上。旋转绑定、解绑、捆绑、多项式 Kleene 三值逻辑和尾递归循环均被降低为张量操作；Kleene 连接符通过 Lagrange 插值多项式在 {-1,0,+1} 真值网格上精确实现。验证通过两种方式：同一程序在四种不同嵌入（三个文本编码器和一个蛋白质语言模型）上以宽度 k=8 实现 100% 解码准确率，而传统的 Hadamard 乘积在这些嵌入上早已失效（如 mxbai-embed-large 上仅 2.5%）；PyTorch 自动求导可流过实际编译的图，一个用 .su 编写的模糊规则分类器通过反向传播从随机初始化（18.7±9.5%，五类中随机为 20%）训练至 100.0±0.0%（三个种子），且符号源码未经修改。加权变体额外训练一个标量余弦增益并将其写回 .su 源码作为数值字面量，重新编译可复现训练后的行为（每个 logit 约 2e-7 误差），因此同一工件既是逻辑程序又是可训练的神经网络。
Motivation: 传统向量符号架构（VSA）中的 Hadamard 乘积在多种现代嵌入（如 mxbai-embed-large、all-minilm）上解码准确率极低（分别仅 2.5% 和 7.5%），亟需一种更鲁棒的编译方法使得符号操作在通用嵌入基座上可靠工作。
Method: 提出 Sutra 语言，编译器将整个程序通过 beta 归约融合为单个张量运算图，使用旋转绑定（rotation binding）替代 Hadamard 乘积，并采用多项式形式的 Kleene 三值逻辑（通过 Lagrange 插值在 {-1,0,+1} 上精确实现）支持逻辑运算。所有操作均降低为可微张量操作，支持 PyTorch 自动求导。
Result: 在四种不同嵌入（nomic-embed-text、all-minilm、mxbai-embed-large、ESM-2）上，以编码宽度 k=8 实现 100% 解码准确率；一个五类模糊规则分类器通过反向传播从随机初始化（18.7±9.5%）训练至 100.0±0.0%（三个种子），且符号源码未修改。加权变体训练后的权重可写回源码并重新编译，误差约 2e-7 每 logit。
Conclusion: Sutra 证明了一种可区分的符号编译方法，使得同一程序同时作为可训练神经网络和可解释逻辑代码，且训练后的数值可重新注入源码，实现符号与神经的深度融合。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Library Drift: Diagnosing and Fixing a Silent Failure Mode in Self-Evolving LLM Skill Libraries
papers.abstract_en: Self-evolving skill libraries face a silent failure mode we term \emph{library drift}: unbounded skill accumulation without outcome-driven lifecycle management causes retrieval degradation, false-positive injections, and performance stagnation. Recent evaluation confirms the symptom (LLM-authored skills deliver +0.0pp gain while human-curated ones deliver +16.2pp (SkillsBench)), yet the underlying mechanism has not been isolated. We provide (1) a \textbf{reproducible trigger}: ablations that isolate drift: one disables skill injection (flat floor, +0.002), one imposes premature retirement (active harm, $-$0.019); (2) \textbf{trace-level diagnostics}: an append-only evidence log with per-skill contribution scores, attribution verdicts, and router engagement metrics that make the failure visible before it reaches end-task scores; and (3) a \textbf{verified fix}: a minimal governance recipe (outcome-driven retirement + bounded active-cap + meta-skill authoring prior) that lifts held-out pass@1 from a 0.258 baseline to a late-window mean of 0.584 (rolling gain $+$0.328) on MBPP+ hard-100 over 100 rounds. Eight ablations decompose which governance mechanisms are load-bearing and which are subsumed, providing a concrete playbook for diagnosing library drift in any self-evolving agent.
papers.comment: Accepted to the ICML 2026 Workshop on Failure Modes in Agentic AI (FAGEN@ICML 2026), Seoul, South Korea
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文揭示自进化LLM技能库中的静默失败模式“库漂移”：无结果驱动的生命周期管理导致技能无限积累，引发检索退化、误注射和性能停滞。作者通过可重复的触发消融、痕迹级诊断日志（包含每技能贡献分、归因判定和路由器参与度）以及最小治理方案（结果驱动退役+有界活跃容量+元技能创作先验）在MBPP+ hard-100上将保留pass@1从0.258提升至0.584（+0.328），并通过8组消融分解机制负荷。
Motivation: 自进化技能库存在无限制技能积累导致的性能退化问题，但底层机制未被隔离，症状（LLM自创技能0增益 vs 人工技能+16.2pp）已有证据。
Method: 提供三类贡献：可重复触发（禁用技能注射/过早退役消融）、痕迹级诊断（仅追加日志记录技能贡献分、归因和路由器参与度）、验证修复（结果驱动退役+有界活跃容量+元技能创作先验）。
Result: 在MBPP+ hard-100上100轮后，保留pass@1从0.258基线提升至0.584（滚动增益+0.328），8组消融分解了各治理机制的负载。
Conclusion: 提供了诊断任何自进化智能体库漂移的具体方案，强调最小治理配方适用于广泛场景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Semantic Generative Tuning for Unified Multimodal Models
papers.abstract_en: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) strive to consolidate visual understanding and visual generation within a single architecture. However, prevailing training paradigms independently optimize understanding via sparse text signals and generation through dense pixel objectives. Such a decoupled strategy yields misaligned representation spaces, isolating visual understanding from generation and hindering their mutual reinforcement. This work presents the first systematic investigation into generative post-training, where we formulate hierarchical visual tasks as generative proxies to bridge the isolation in UMMs. Our empirical investigation reveals that high-level semantic tasks, particularly image segmentation, serve as optimal proxies. Unlike low-level tasks that distract models with texture details, segmentation provides structural semantics that significantly enhance both vision-centric perception and generative layout fidelity. Building upon these insights, we introduce Semantic Generative Tuning (SGT), a novel paradigm that leverages segmentation as a generative proxy to align and synergize multimodal capabilities. Mechanistic analyses further demonstrate that SGT fundamentally improves feature linear separability and optimizes visual-textual attention allocation pattern. Extensive evaluations show that SGT consistently improves both multimodal comprehension and generative fidelity across mainstream benchmarks. Our code is available on the https://song2yu.github.io/SGT/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究统一多模态模型（UMM）的生成式后训练，发现高层语义任务（如图像分割）是最优的生成代理，能够弥合视觉理解与生成之间的表征隔离。提出的语义生成微调（SGT）方法利用分割作为生成代理，改善了特征线性可分性和视觉-文本注意力分配，在多模态理解和生成基准上均取得一致提升。
Motivation: 现有UMM的训练策略将视觉理解（稀疏文本信号）和视觉生成（密集像素目标）独立优化，导致表征空间错位，无法相互促进。
Method: 提出语义生成微调（SGT），将图像分割等高层语义任务作为生成代理，通过生成式后训练对齐和协同多模态能力。
Result: 在主流多模态基准上，SGT一致提升了多模态理解和生成保真度；机制分析表明其根本改善了特征线性可分性和视觉-文本注意力分配模式。
Conclusion: 图像分割作为生成代理能有效桥接视觉理解与生成的隔离，为统一多模态模型的训练提供了新范式。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Evaluating Deep Research Agents on Expert Consulting Work: A Benchmark with Verifiers, Rubrics, and Cognitive Traps
papers.abstract_en: Frontier deep research agents (DRAs) are being deployed in enterprise workflows faster than they are being evaluated. Existing benchmarks measure factual recall, single-hop QA, or generic agentic skill, and miss the multi-document, decision-grade deliverables DRAs are asked to produce. We introduce a benchmark of 70 SME-authored management consulting prompts, each embedding cognitive traps that penalize surface-pattern reasoning. Three frontier agents, namely Claude Opus~4.6, OpenAI o3-deep-research and Gemini~3.1~Pro deep-research, are scored on two complementary layers: deterministic binary verifiers (mean 14.9 per task) and a five-criterion 0--3 SME rubric (Data Integrity, Analytical Rigor, Relevance \& Focus, Execution Precision, Format \& Deliverability), combined into a Verifier-Rubric Score (VRS, 0--100). Acceptance under a joint threshold (rubric mean $\geq 2.5$ and verifier pass rate $\geq 80\%$) is uniformly low: o3 15.7\%, Claude 12.9\%, Gemini 12.9\%. Pairwise differences are statistically indistinguishable. On the continuous VRS, o3 leads (61.4~[CI: 55.2,\,67.5]), followed by Gemini (52.6) and Claude (38.5); the o3--Claude gap ($Δ{=}22.9$, $p{<}0.001$) survives Bonferroni correction. No agent averages above the rubric's ``adequate'' threshold of 2.0; no agent's mean verifier pass rate reaches the 80\% acceptance floor. Each agent fails distinctively: Claude leads on data fabrication and file-access failures; o3 propagates cascading computation errors; Gemini oscillates between the highest perfect-verifier rate and the most catastrophic collapses. The benchmark, evaluation code, and full prompt corpus are publicly released.

papers.title: Weak-to-Strong Elicitation via Mismatched Wrong Drafts
papers.abstract_en: We consider whether off-policy experience from a smaller, weaker model can elicit capability in a stronger learner that on-policy RL fine-tuning (e.g., GRPO) does not reach. We find that injecting mathematically wrong drafts from a smaller but more domain-trained model -- mismatched to the current problem -- into a stronger learner's GRPO context consistently outperforms standard on-policy GRPO on held-out MATH-500 and out-of-distribution AIME 2025/2026. Concretely, we use Mathstral-7B as the learner, Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B as the draft model, 8.8K Level 3--5 MATH problems (with MATH-500 held out), and train with Dr. GRPO. Mismatch is an active ingredient: shuffling drafts to mismatched problems while holding everything else constant yields $+1.62$pp on MATH-500 (greedy pass@1) over the matched-wrong variant ($n=10$ seeds, $p=0.0015$, Welch's $t$). In fact, the mismatched-wrong variant leads all other variants we tested on MATH-500 across both greedy pass@1 and sampling pass@$k$. On out-of-distribution AIME 2025 and 2026, the mismatched-wrong variant uniquely lifts pass@$k$ above both Mathstral-7B (in its native [INST] format) and the Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B draft model at every sample budget from $k=1$ to $k=1024$ across 2 seeds ($+14.2$pp on 2025 and $+9.0$pp on 2026 at pass@1024 over Mathstral-7B), and at pass@1024 also leads no-draft, matched-wrong, and mismatched-correct variants on both years. All variants use the same prompt with no draft injection at test time. The recipe -- trained on a single GPU with no SFT, no reward models, no synthesized data, and no produce-critique-revise inner loop -- reaches 71.98% MATH-500 on Mathstral-7B-v0.1, the highest published result on this model to our knowledge, surpassing the heavier WizardMath pipeline at 70.9% on full MATH (SFT + PPO with process/instruction reward models).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出通过错配错误草稿（mismatched wrong drafts）来激发强模型能力的方法，实验表明在线GRPO中注入来自较小领域模型的错误草稿，在MATH-500和AIME上显著提升性能。
Motivation: 标准在线RL微调（如GRPO）可能无法充分激发强模型的能力，而弱模型的离策略经验可能提供额外信号。
Method: 使用Dr. GRPO训练，将来自较小但领域训练更充分的模型的错误草稿（与当前问题不匹配）注入强学习器的GRPO上下文。
Result: 在MATH-500上，错配错误变体相比匹配错误变体提升+1.62pp（greedy pass@1），在AIME 2025/2026上pass@1024提升+14.2pp/+9.0pp，无需SFT、奖励模型等，达到71.98% MATH-500，最高已知结果。
Conclusion: 错配是主动成分，该方法简单有效，仅需单GPU训练。

papers.title: Turbophoresis of inertial particles in inhomogeneous turbulence produced by oscillating grids
papers.abstract_en: Turbophoresis in inhomogeneous turbulent flows leads to the formation of large-scale nonuniform particle number density distributions of inertial particles. This effect is associated with an effective drift velocity directed toward regions of lower turbulence intensity. It depends on the Stokes and Reynolds numbers and on the spatial gradient of the turbulence intensity. In the present study, turbophoretic transport is experimentally investigated in air turbulent flows generated by one-grid and two-grid oscillating systems. The flow velocity field is measured using Particle Image Velocimetry, and the particle spatial distribution is obtained applying image processing techniques. To isolate the effect of particle accumulation due to turbophoresis from that associated with mean fluid flow, the measured particle number density of inertial particles is normalized by the corresponding distribution obtained for noninertial tracer particles under identical flow conditions. The measurements show preferential accumulation of inertial particles in regions of minimum mean-square turbulent velocity, consistent with the expected behavior of turbophoretic transport.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过振荡网格实验研究了非均匀湍流中惯性粒子的湍流迁移（turbophoresis）现象。实验测量了流场和粒子数密度分布，发现惯性粒子优先聚集在均方湍流速度最小的区域，验证了湍流迁移的预期行为。
Motivation: 湍流迁移导致惯性粒子在非均匀湍流中形成大尺度非均匀分布，但实验研究尚不充分，尤其是对空气湍流中由振荡网格产生的非均匀湍流。
Method: 使用单网格和双网格振荡系统产生空气湍流，采用粒子图像测速（PIV）测量流场，通过图像处理技术获取粒子空间分布，并用非惯性示踪粒子的分布对惯性粒子数密度进行归一化，以分离湍流迁移与平均流的影响。
Result: 实验观察到惯性粒子在均方湍流速度最小的区域优先积累，与湍流迁移的理论预测一致。
Conclusion: 研究证实了湍流迁移效应在振荡网格产生的非均匀湍流中起主导作用，为解释惯性粒子在湍流中的输运提供了实验依据。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: Random test functions, $H^{-1}$ norm equivalence, and stochastic variational physics-informed neural networks
papers.abstract_en: The dual norm characterisation of weak solutions of second-order linear elliptic partial differential equations is mathematically natural but computationally intractable: evaluating the $H^{-1}$ norm of the residual requires a supremum over an infinite-dimensional test space. We prove that the $H^{-1}$ norm of any functional is equivalent to its expected squared evaluation against a random test function whose probability distribution depends only on the domain. Crucially, realisations of this random test function have negative Sobolev regularity for $d \geq 2$, yet this roughness is not an obstacle: averaging over the distribution exactly recovers the correct weak topology, independently of the differential operator, and no supremum evaluation is necessary. This equivalence introduces the notion of stochastically weak solutions, which coincide with classical weak solutions, and motivates stochastic variational physics-informed neural networks (SV-PINNs): neural networks trained by minimising an empirical approximation of the stochastic norm of the PDE residual. Although instantiated here with neural networks, the underlying principle is independent of the trial space and suggests a broader paradigm for numerical methods based on stochastic rather than deterministic test spaces. The framework extends naturally to higher-order elliptic, parabolic and hyperbolic equations and to abstract operator equations on Hilbert spaces. As a proof of concept, we present numerical experiments on eight challenging second-order linear elliptic problems spanning high-frequency and multi-scale solutions, indefinite operators, variable coefficients, and non-standard domains, in which SV-PINNs consistently and significantly outperform standard PINNs, recovering solutions to within one percent relative error in hundreds of L-BFGS steps.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文证明对于二阶线性椭圆型偏微分方程，残差的H^{-1}范数与随机测试函数（其分布仅依赖于域）的期望平方范数等价，无需计算上确界。基于该等价性提出随机变分物理信息神经网络（SV-PINNs），通过最小化PDE残差的随机范数经验近似来训练。数值实验在八个挑战性二阶椭圆问题上（包括高频/多尺度解、不定算子、变系数、非标准域）表明，SV-PINNs一致且显著优于标准PINNs，在数百次L-BFGS步内达到1%相对误差。该方法可自然推广至高阶椭圆型、抛物型和双曲型方程以及希尔伯特空间上的抽象算子方程。
Motivation: 弱解的对偶范数表征在数学上自然但计算困难：评估残差的H^{-1}范数需要在无穷维测试空间上求上确界。
Method: 证明任意泛函的H^{-1}范数与其对随机测试函数（分布仅依赖于域）的期望平方评估等价，无需上确界。据此提出SV-PINNs，通过蒙特卡洛近似随机范数并最小化来训练神经网络。
Result: 在八个二阶线性椭圆型基准问题上，SV-PINNs始终优于标准PINNs，相对误差低至1%以内（数百次L-BFGS步）。
Conclusion: 引入随机弱解概念（与经典弱解一致），提出基于随机测试空间而非确定性测试空间的数值方法范式，可推广至更广泛的PDE和算子方程。

papers.title: Closed-Loop CO2 Storage Control With History-Based Reinforcement Learning and Latent Model-Based Adaptation
papers.abstract_en: Closed-loop management of geological CO2 storage requires control policies that adapt to uncertain reservoir behavior while relying on observations that are realistically available during operation. This work formulates CO2 injection and brine-production control as a partially observable sequential decision problem and studies deployable deep reinforcement-learning controllers trained with high-fidelity reservoir simulation. We first compare privileged-state, well-only, history-conditioned, masking-curriculum, and asymmetric teacher-student model-free policies in order to quantify the value of temporal well-response information and training-time privileged simulator states. We then evaluate a latent model-based adaptation pipeline that reuses nominal latent dynamics and retunes controllers under known injector failure, leakage-induced dynamics and reward shift, and compartmentalized reservoir connectivity. The results show that history-conditioned policies recover nearly all of the privileged-state performance while using only deployable well-level information, and that latent model-based retuning outperforms direct model-free retuning under the same scenario-specific real-simulator budget in the abnormal operating cases. The proposed framework therefore provides a simulator-budget-aware alternative to repeated online history matching and re-optimization for closed-loop CO2 storage control.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究地质CO2存储的闭环控制策略，将CO2注入和盐水开采问题建模为部分可观测的序贯决策问题，并研究基于高保真油藏模拟训练的深度强化学习控制器。对比了多种无模型策略（特权状态、仅井口数据、历史条件等），并提出了基于潜变量模型的适应方法用于处理异常工况。结果表明历史条件策略能恢复几乎全部特权状态性能，且潜变量模型再训练优于直接无模型再训练。
Motivation: 地质CO2存储需要能适应不确定油藏行为的控制策略，且只能依赖实际可获得的观测数据（如井口响应），现有方法可能依赖无法实时获取的特权状态信息。
Method: 将问题形式化为部分可观测序贯决策问题，训练深度强化学习控制器。对比了不同无模型策略，提出基于潜变量模型的适应框架，重用名义潜动态并在异常工况下再调控制器。
Result: 历史条件策略在仅使用井口数据时能恢复几乎全部特权状态性能。在注入井故障、泄漏和储层连通性变化等异常情况下，基于潜变量模型的再训练在相同模拟预算下优于直接无模型再训练。
Conclusion: 提出了一种在模拟预算约束下替代重复在线历史匹配和再优化的方法，适用于闭环CO2存储控制。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.conclusion: 提出了一种在模拟预算约束下替代重复在线历史匹配和再优化的方法，适用于闭环CO2存储控制。

papers.title: To Use AI as Dice of Possibilities with Timing Computation
papers.abstract_en: The dominant noun-based modeling paradigm has fundamentally constrained AI development, precluding any adequate representation of the future as an open temporal dimension. This paper introduces a verb-based paradigm, together with precise definitions of \emph{timing computation} and \emph{causal factum}, that enables AI to function as an instrument for spontaneously constructing a causal-reasoning world model. Applied to longitudinal EHR data from 3,276 breast cancer patients, the framework empirically demonstrates: (1) automatic discovery of clinically significant patient trajectories, and (2) counterfactual timing deduction, that is, a \emph{What-If Machine}. Both results are achieved in a purely data-driven manner, without recourse to prior domain knowledge, and represent, to our knowledge, the first such demonstrations in the machine learning literature.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出基于动词的建模范式，取代传统名词范式，通过定义时序计算和因果事实，使AI能构建因果推理世界模型。在3276名乳腺癌患者的纵向电子健康记录数据上，该方法纯数据驱动地自动发现临床显著的患者轨迹，并实现反事实时序推断（What-If Machine），据称是机器学习文献中的首次。

Method: 提出基于动词的范式，精确定义时序计算和因果事实，使AI能自发构建因果推理世界模型。
Result: 在3276名乳腺癌患者数据上，自动发现临床显著的患者轨迹，并实现反事实时序推断，纯数据驱动，无领域知识。

papers.title: Small edits, large models: How Wikipedia advocacy shapes LLM values
papers.abstract_en: Can a small group of volunteers shape how AI systems discuss animal welfare, just by editing Wikipedia? We show that they can. Wikipedia appears in nearly every major language model training dataset and is weighted more heavily than web-crawled text. The Pro-Animal Wikipedians (PAW), a group of advocates who add sourced animal welfare content to relevant articles, have made 125 edits across 115 pages. Using gradient-based data attribution (Bergson; MAGIC), we traced how these edits influence language model behavior. TrackStar retrieval attribution on Llama 3.1 8B found that PAW-edited sections made up 68 percent of the highest-attributed documents for animal welfare queries (p < 0.0001) but only 52 percent for unrelated queries about the same companies (p = 0.53): the model links PAW content specifically to animal welfare topics, not to the entities in general. MAGIC counterfactual influence estimation on Llama-3.2-1B, run across five random training-order seeds, gave the same picture even more sharply: in every seed, the top-10 most influential documents on animal welfare queries were all PAW edits (10 of 10, 5 of 5 seeds), while on general queries the same top-10 sat at chance (4 to 6 of 10). Mean PAW influence exceeded mean control influence on animal welfare queries with p < 0.0001 in every seed, an effect 6 to 30 times larger than on general queries. Leave-subset-out validation gave Spearman rho = 1.00 for all 10 runs. When we fine-tuned separate models on PAW content versus control content, each model performed better specifically on the type of text it was trained on: the PAW-trained model cut perplexity on animal welfare text from 12.4 to 8.4, while the control-trained model cut perplexity on control text from 16.1 to 11.4. A small, coordinated Wikipedia editing campaign therefore measurably shapes how language models handle the topics those edits address.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究维基百科上一个小型倡导团体（Pro-Animal Wikipedians, PAW）的编辑如何影响语言模型在动物福利话题上的价值观。通过梯度归因（Bergson; MAGIC）和检索归因（TrackStar）等方法，作者发现PAW的125次编辑在Llama模型中对动物福利查询的归因文档占比显著高于无关查询，且微调实验表明PAW内容降低动物福利文本的困惑度。
Motivation: 维基百科是语言模型训练数据的关键来源，但其中少数志愿者的编辑可能系统性影响模型价值观。现有工作缺乏对小型协调编辑活动影响力的量化研究。
Method: 使用梯度归因（Bergson; MAGIC）和检索归因（TrackStar）追踪PAW编辑对Llama 3.1 8B和Llama-3.2-1B的影响，并通过微调实验验证编辑内容的特异性影响。
Result: PAW编辑在动物福利查询中占最高归因文档的68%（p<0.0001），而无关查询仅52%（p=0.53）；MAGIC在5个随机种子中均显示动物福利查询前10文档全部来自PAW编辑，而无关查询为随机水平；微调后PAW模型使动物福利文本困惑度从12.4降至8.4。
Conclusion: 小型协调的维基百科编辑活动能够可测量地塑造语言模型在特定话题上的输出，凸显了训练数据中细粒度编辑的社会影响。

papers.title: OmniRobotHome: A Multi-Camera Home Platform for Real-Time Human-Robot Interaction
papers.abstract_en: Robots in homes must continuously sense the people around them, yet most prior work relies on limited or offline perception. We argue that perception quality is the dominant factor governing what interaction is achievable at home, and build a testbed to test this claim. OmniRobotHome instruments a furnished home with 48 hardware-synchronized cameras and three manipulators in a unified world frame, delivering real-time markerless full-body human pose, 6D object pose, anticipatory motion forecasting, and a social avatar agent that converses with residents. Using the platform, we treat perception quality as an experimental variable across safety, human assistance, and social interaction, and find that interaction quality degrades measurably as real-timeness, granularity, coverage, accuracy, forecasting, or memory is weakened. All code and data will be released.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出OmniRobotHome，一个配备48个硬件同步摄像头和3个机械臂的家庭机器人平台，实现实时无标记全身人体姿态估计、6D物体姿态追踪、运动预测和社交化身对话。通过系统性实验，该平台将感知质量作为自变量，证明实时性、粒度、覆盖范围、精度、预测和记忆等维度的退化会显著降低人机交互质量。所有代码和数据将开源。
Motivation: 家庭机器人需要持续感知周围人类，但现有工作多依赖有限或离线感知，缺乏系统研究感知质量与交互能力关系的测试平台。
Method: 搭建OmniRobotHome平台：在统一世界坐标系下集成48个硬件同步摄像头和3个机械臂，实现实时无标记全身人体姿态、6D物体姿态与运动预测，并集成社交化身智能体。将感知质量分解为实时性、粒度、覆盖、精度、预测、记忆等维度，通过控制变量实验评估各维度退化对交互的影响。
Result: 实验表明，当实时性、粒度、覆盖、精度、预测或记忆任一维度被削弱时，人机交互质量（安全性、辅助、社交）出现可测量的下降。
Conclusion: 感知质量是决定家庭人机交互可行性的主导因素，OmniRobotHome为系统研究感知-交互关系提供了基础平台。
