papers.title: Mitigating Hallucinations via Inter-Layer Consistency Aggregation in Large Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Despite the impressive capabilities of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs), they remain susceptible to hallucinations, where generated content is inconsistent with the input image. Existing training-free hallucination mitigation methods often suffer from unstable performance and high sensitivity to hyperparameter settings, which limits their practicality and broader adoption. In this paper, we propose Decoding with Inter-layer Consistency via Layer Aggregation (DCLA), a training-free decoding mechanism that requires no retraining, fine-tuning, or access to external knowledge bases. Specifically, DCLA constructs a dynamic semantic reference by aggregating representations from previous layers and uses it to correct semantically deviated layers, thereby enforcing inter-layer consistency. Experiments across seven LVLMs and multiple benchmarks demonstrate the generality of DCLA: it surpasses standard decoding by 28.58 MME points on LLaVA1.5-7B and 42.6 MME points on Qwen2.5-VL, while improving POPE accuracy by 2.74 percentage points in the strongest setting.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出DCLA，一种无需训练的跨层一致性聚合解码方法，用于缓解大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）中的幻觉问题。通过聚合前层表示构建动态语义参考，并修正语义偏差层，在七个LVLM和多个基准上一致提升性能，例如在LLaVA1.5-7B上MME提升28.58分，POPE准确率提升2.74个百分点。
Motivation: 现有无训练幻觉缓解方法性能不稳定且超参数敏感，限制了实用性。本文旨在开发一种稳定、无需外部知识的解码机制，以有效减少LVLM的幻觉。
Method: 提出解码时跨层一致性聚合（DCLA），利用前几层表示的聚合构建动态语义参考，并以此为基准修正语义偏离的中间层，强制层间一致性，无需重新训练或微调。
Result: 在七个LVLM和多个基准上验证：标准解码相比，LLaVA1.5-7B的MME提升28.58分，Qwen2.5-VL提升42.6分；最强设置下POPE准确率提升2.74个百分点。
Conclusion: DCLA作为一种通用、无需训练的解码策略，能够通过强制层间一致性有效缓解LVLM幻觉，且对超参数鲁棒。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Circular Quasiconformal Deturbulence: Geometry-Based Restoration from Multiple Turbulent Frames
papers.abstract_en: Imaging through inhomogeneous media often results in severe distortions, posing significant challenges to downstream image-processing tasks. The lack of clean paired images makes supervised learning impractical, motivating unsupervised restoration approaches. In this work, we propose the Circular Quasi-Conformal Deturbulence (CQCD) framework, an unsupervised approach that reconstructs distortion-free images from multiple frames using a circular architecture. The framework minimizes reconstruction errors by jointly estimating forward and backward transformations between distorted observations and the restored image. A key advancement of CQCD is the integration of computational quasi-conformal geometry, which encourages bijective non-rigid deformations and improves the well-posedness of both forward and inverse mappings for cycle consistency. The deformation field is further regularized to preserve structural coherence and reduce non-physical artifacts such as folding or tearing. Additionally, tight-frame blocks are employed to effectively encode distortion-sensitive features, enhancing the precision of the restoration process. To assess the effectiveness of the proposed framework, extensive evaluations are conducted on synthetic and real-world image datasets. Experimental findings indicate that CQCD not only surpasses existing state-of-the-art deturbulence techniques in restoration quality but also achieves highly accurate deformation field estimation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Circular Quasi-Conformal Deturbulence (CQCD) 框架，一种无监督方法，利用循环架构从多帧湍流图像中恢复无失真图像。该方法结合计算拟共形几何保证双射非刚性变形，并使用紧框架编码失真敏感特征。实验表明，CQCD 在合成和真实数据集上优于现有去湍流技术。
Motivation: 成像通过非均匀介质会产生严重失真，且缺乏干净配对图像使得监督学习不实用，亟需无监督复原方法。
Method: 提出循环拟共形去湍流 (CQCD) 框架，通过循环架构联合估计失真观测与复原图像之间的前向和后向变换。集成拟共形几何确保双射非刚性变形并改善循环一致性；变形场正则化防止折叠等伪影；紧框架块编码失真敏感特征。
Result: 在合成和真实图像数据集上的实验表明，CQCD 不仅在复原质量上超越现有最先进去湍流技术，还实现了高精度的变形场估计。
Conclusion: CQCD 是一种有效的无监督去湍流方法，通过几何约束和特征编码提升了复原效果。
Relevance: 25

papers.title: TF-TI2I: Training-Free Text-and-Image-to-Image Generation via Multi-Modal Implicit-Context Learning in Text-to-Image Models
papers.abstract_en: Text-and-Image-To-Image (TI2I), an extension of Text-To-Image (T2I), integrates image inputs with textual instructions to enhance image generation. Existing methods often partially utilize image inputs, focusing on specific elements like objects or styles, or they experience a decline in generation quality with complex, multi-image instructions. To overcome these challenges, we introduce Training-Free Text-and-Image-to-Image (TF-TI2I), which adapts cutting-edge T2I models such as SD3 without the need for additional training. Our method capitalizes on the MM-DiT architecture, in which we point out that textual tokens can implicitly learn visual information from vision tokens. We enhance this interaction by extracting a condensed visual representation from reference images, facilitating selective information sharing through Reference Contextual Masking -- this technique confines the usage of contextual tokens to instruction-relevant visual information. Additionally, our Winner-Takes-All module mitigates distribution shifts by prioritizing the most pertinent references for each vision token. Addressing the gap in TI2I evaluation, we also introduce the FG-TI2I Bench, a comprehensive benchmark tailored for TI2I and compatible with existing T2I methods. Our approach shows robust performance across various benchmarks, confirming its effectiveness in handling complex image-generation tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 TF-TI2I，一种无需额外训练即可将文本到图像模型（如 SD3）扩展为文本和图像到图像生成的方法，利用 MM-DiT 架构中文本标记隐式学习视觉信息的能力，并通过参考上下文掩码和胜者全拿模块改善生成质量。同时引入 FG-TI2I Bench 基准。
Motivation: 现有 TI2I 方法要么仅部分利用图像输入（如仅关注物体或风格），要么在处理复杂多图像指令时生成质量下降，缺乏无训练且鲁棒的解决方案。
Method: 利用 MM-DiT 架构中文本标记隐式学习视觉信息的特性，提取参考图像的紧凑视觉表示，通过参考上下文掩码（Reference Contextual Masking）限制上下文标记仅用于指令相关的视觉信息，并使用胜者全拿（Winner-Takes-All）模块优先选择最相关的参考以缓解分布偏移。
Result: 在多个基准上展示鲁棒性能，证明其在复杂图像生成任务中的有效性。
Conclusion: 无训练方法能够适配现有 T2I 模型实现 TI2I，且 FG-TI2I Bench 填补了 TI2I 评估的空白。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Bayesian Optimization for General Reaction Conditions
papers.abstract_en: General chemical reaction conditions that achieve consistently high performance across multiple substrates are important for practical applications such as library synthesis and high-throughput experimentation. However, identifying such conditions efficiently has been a longstanding challenge, as it requires decision making under uncertainty with respect to both conditions and substrates, while minimizing the number of required experiments. Here, we introduce CurryBO, a high-level framework for generality-oriented optimization. By formalizing the problem as Bayesian optimization over curried functions, CurryBO provides a unified framework that accommodates different generality definitions (e.g., mean yield across substrates), and supports a range of substrate and condition selection strategies. We evaluate this framework on four benchmark tasks in experimental reaction optimization, and systematically analyze key algorithmic components. Our results show that efficient experiment planning can be achieved by emphasizing exploration when selecting reaction conditions, followed by the uncertainty-guided prioritization of substrates in a sequential decison-making scheme. Based on these insights, we design and validate an optimization policy that substantially improves sample efficiency relative to previously reported approaches across all benchmarks. Overall, the flexibility and modularity of CurryBO facilitate the integration of generality-oriented optimization into experimental settings, enabling more efficient identification of solutions that perform robustly across diverse tasks.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CurryBO 框架，将通用反应条件优化形式化为 curried 函数上的贝叶斯优化，支持不同通用性定义（如跨底物的平均产率）和多种底物/条件选择策略。在四个实验反应优化基准上评估，通过强调条件选择的探索和不确定性引导的底物优先级排序，提高了样本效率。
Motivation: 在合成化学中，寻找在不同底物上均表现良好的通用反应条件至关重要，但传统方法需要大量实验，且需同时处理条件和底物的不确定性。
Method: 提出 CurryBO 框架，将通用反应条件优化问题建模为 curried 函数的贝叶斯优化，统一不同通用性定义，支持多种条件和底物选择策略，并通过探索性条件选择和不确定性引导的底物顺序决策来提高样本效率。
Result: 在四个实验反应优化基准上，CurryBO 相比先前方法显著提高了样本效率，实现了跨底物稳健性能的快速识别。
Conclusion: CurryBO 的灵活性和模块化使其易于集成到实验设置中，有助于高效识别在多样任务中表现稳健的通用反应条件。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning to Explain Air Traffic Situation
papers.abstract_en: Understanding how air traffic controllers construct a mental 'picture' of complex air traffic situations is crucial but remains a challenge due to the inherently intricate, high-dimensional interactions between aircraft, pilots, and controllers. Previous work on modeling the strategies of air traffic controllers and their mental image of traffic situations often centers on specific air traffic control tasks or pairwise interactions between aircraft, neglecting to capture the comprehensive dynamics of an air traffic situation. To address this issue, we propose a machine learning-based framework for explaining air traffic situations. Specifically, we employ a Transformer-based multi-agent trajectory model that encapsulates both the spatio-temporal movement of aircraft and social interaction between them. By deriving attention scores from the model, we can quantify the influence of individual aircraft on overall traffic dynamics. This provides explainable insights into how air traffic controllers perceive and understand the traffic situation. Trained on real-world air traffic surveillance data collected from the terminal airspace around Incheon International Airport in South Korea, our framework effectively explicates air traffic situations. This could potentially support and enhance the decision-making and situational awareness of air traffic controllers.

papers.title: Communication-Efficient, 2D Parallel Stochastic Gradient Descent for Distributed-Memory Optimization
papers.abstract_en: Distributed-memory implementations of numerical optimization algorithm, such as stochastic gradient descent (SGD), require interprocessor communication at every iteration of the algorithm. On modern distributed-memory clusters where communication is more expensive than computation, the scalability and performance of these algorithms are limited by communication cost. This work generalizes prior work on 1D $s$-step SGD and 1D Federated SGD with Averaging (FedAvg) to yield a 2D parallel SGD method (HybridSGD) which attains a continuous performance trade off between the two baseline algorithms. We present theoretical analysis which show the convergence, computation, communication, and memory trade offs between $s$-step SGD, FedAvg, 2D parallel SGD, and other parallel SGD variants. We implement all algorithms in C++ and MPI and evaluate their performance on a Cray EX supercomputing system. Our empirical results show that HybridSGD achieves better convergence than FedAvg at similar processor scales while attaining speedups of $5.3\times$ over $s$-step SGD and speedups up to $121\times$ over FedAvg when used to solve binary classification tasks using the convex, logistic regression model on datasets obtained from the LIBSVM repository.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种2D并行随机梯度下降方法HybridSGD，统一了1D s-step SGD和1D FedAvg，实现性能的连续权衡。理论分析给出收敛性、计算、通信和内存的权衡，实验在Cray EX超算上显示，HybridSGD在类似处理器规模下收敛优于FedAvg，相比s-step SGD加速5.3倍，相比FedAvg加速121倍（基于LIBSVM的二分类逻辑回归任务）。
Motivation: 分布式内存的数值优化算法（如SGD）每次迭代都需要处理器间通信，而现代集群中通信成本高于计算，限制了可扩展性和性能。现有1D方法（s-step SGD和FedAvg）各有优劣，缺乏灵活的折中方案。
Method: 将1D s-step SGD和1D FedAvg推广为2D并行SGD（HybridSGD），通过在处理器网格的行和列两个维度上分别进行局部更新和周期性平均，实现了通信-计算权衡的连续谱。
Result: 理论分析了HybridSGD与s-step SGD、FedAvg等变体的收敛性、计算、通信和内存权衡。实验在Cray EX上采用LIBSVM的二分类逻辑回归任务，HybridSGD收敛优于FedAvg，加速比达5.3倍（vs s-step SGD）和121倍（vs FedAvg）。
Conclusion: HybridSGD作为2D并行SGD框架，能在通信效率和收敛性能之间灵活调整，适用于大规模分布式优化场景。论文的适用范围限于凸逻辑回归模型和LIBSVM数据，未涉及非凸或深度学习场景。

papers.title: Towards Consistent and Efficient Dataset Distillation via Diffusion-Driven Selection
papers.abstract_en: Dataset distillation provides an effective approach to reduce memory and computational costs by optimizing a compact dataset that achieves performance comparable to the full original. However, for large-scale datasets and complex deep networks (e.g., ImageNet-1K with ResNet-101), the vast optimization space hinders distillation effectiveness, limiting practical applications. Recent methods leverage pre-trained diffusion models to directly generate informative images, thereby bypassing pixel-level optimization and achieving promising results. Nonetheless, these approaches often suffer from distribution shifts between the pre-trained diffusion prior and target datasets, as well as the need for multiple distillation steps under varying settings. To overcome these challenges, we propose a novel framework that is orthogonal to existing diffusion-based distillation techniques by utilizing the diffusion prior for patch selection rather than generation. Our method predicts noise from the diffusion model conditioned on input images and optional text prompts (with or without label information), and computes the associated loss for each image-patch pair. Based on the loss differences, we identify distinctive regions within the original images. Furthermore, we apply intra-class clustering and ranking on the selected patches to enforce diversity constraints. This streamlined pipeline enables a one-step distillation process. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods across various metrics and settings.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对大规模数据集蒸馏中优化空间巨大、现有扩散生成方法存在分布偏移和多步蒸馏的问题，提出利用扩散先验进行patch选择而非生成的新框架。该方法通过扩散模型预测噪声并计算损失差来识别原始图像中的独特区域，再通过类内聚类和排序保证多样性，实现一步蒸馏。实验在多个基准上一致优于现有方法。
Motivation: 现有数据集蒸馏方法在大规模数据集上优化困难，而基于扩散模型生成图像的方法存在分布偏移且需要多步蒸馏，限制了实际应用。
Method: 提出利用扩散先验进行patch选择：通过扩散模型预测输入图像和可选文本提示的噪声，计算每对图像-patch的损失差，据此识别判别性区域；再对所选patch进行类内聚类和排序以增强多样性，实现一步蒸馏。
Result: 实验表明该方法在多种指标和设置下一致优于当前最先进方法，尤其在大规模数据集上表现突出。
Conclusion: 本文提出的与现有扩散蒸馏正交的patch选择框架，通过避免生成分布偏移和减少蒸馏步骤，为高效数据集蒸馏提供了新思路，且易于扩展。

papers.title: Adversarial Robustness of AI-Generated Image Detectors in the Real World
papers.abstract_en: The rapid advancement of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) capabilities is accompanied by a concerning rise in its misuse. In particular the generation of credible misinformation in the form of images poses a significant threat to the public trust in democratic processes. Consequently, there is an urgent need to develop tools to reliably distinguish between authentic and AI-generated content. The majority of detection methods are based on neural networks that are trained to recognize forensic artifacts. In this work, we demonstrate that current state-of-the-art classifiers are vulnerable to adversarial examples under real-world conditions. Through extensive experiments, comprising four detection methods and five attack algorithms, we show that an attacker can dramatically decrease classification performance, without internal knowledge of the detector's architecture. Notably, most attacks remain effective even when images are degraded during the upload to, e.g., social media platforms. In a case study, we demonstrate that these robustness challenges are also found in commercial tools by conducting black-box attacks on HIVE, a proprietary online GenAI media detector. In addition, we evaluate the robustness of using generated features of a robust pre-trained model and showed that this increases the robustness, while not reaching the performance on benign inputs. These results, along with the increasing potential of GenAI to erode public trust, underscore the need for more research and new perspectives on methods to prevent its misuse.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究当前最先进的AI生成图像检测器在真实世界条件下的对抗鲁棒性。通过四项检测方法和五种攻击算法的广泛实验，作者表明攻击者无需知晓检测器内部结构即可显著降低其分类性能，且多数攻击在图像经社交媒体平台降质后仍然有效。针对商业工具HIVE的黑盒攻击也验证了同样的脆弱性。使用鲁棒预训练模型的特征可提升鲁棒性，但无法达到对良性输入的检测性能。
Motivation: 生成式AI的快速发展带来图像伪造滥用问题，尤其威胁民主进程中的公众信任。需要可靠工具区分真实与AI生成内容，但现有基于神经网络的检测器易受对抗样本攻击。
Method: 在真实世界条件下对四种检测器（分类器）进行对抗攻击实验，使用五种攻击算法，包括黑盒攻击和考虑图像上传至社交媒体平台后的降质情况，并评估使用鲁棒预训练模型特征对鲁棒性的影响。
Result: 攻击可大幅降低检测性能，多数攻击在图像降质后仍有效；商业工具HIVE的黑盒攻击同样成功。使用鲁棒预训练模型的特征可提升鲁棒性，但性能仍不及对良性输入的检测。
Conclusion: 现有AI生成图像检测器在真实世界中的对抗鲁棒性不足，需更多研究从新视角防止生成式AI的滥用。

papers.title: Byzantine-Robust Aggregation for Securing Decentralized Federated Learning
papers.abstract_en: Federated Learning (FL) emerges as a distributed machine learning approach that addresses privacy concerns by training AI models locally on devices. Decentralized Federated Learning (DFL) extends the FL paradigm by eliminating the central server, thereby enhancing scalability and robustness through the avoidance of a single point of failure. However, DFL faces significant challenges in optimizing security, as most Byzantine-robust algorithms proposed in the literature are designed for centralized scenarios. In this paper, we present a novel Byzantine-robust aggregation algorithm to enhance the security of Decentralized Federated Learning environments, coined WFAgg. This proposal handles adverse conditions and strengthens the robustness of dynamic decentralized topologies at the same time by employing multiple filters to identify and mitigate Byzantine attacks. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm in maintaining model accuracy and convergence in the presence of various Byzantine attack scenarios, outperforming state-of-the-art centralized Byzantine-robust aggregation schemes (such as Multi-Krum or Clustering). These algorithms are evaluated on an IID image classification problem in both centralized and decentralized scenarios.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种名为WFAgg的拜占庭鲁棒聚合算法，用于增强去中心化联邦学习（DFL）的安全性。该算法通过多个过滤器识别和缓解拜占庭攻击，在动态去中心化拓扑中保持鲁棒性。实验表明，在多种拜占庭攻击场景下，WFAgg在IID图像分类任务上优于Multi-Krum和Clustering等集中式拜占庭鲁棒方案。
Motivation: 大多数现有的拜占庭鲁棒算法针对集中式联邦学习设计，而去中心化联邦学习（DFL）缺乏有效的安全机制，且面临动态拓扑的挑战。
Method: 提出WFAgg算法，采用多个过滤器（filters）来识别并减轻拜占庭攻击，同时适应动态去中心化拓扑。
Result: 在IID图像分类任务中，WFAgg在多种拜占庭攻击场景下保持模型准确率和收敛性，优于Multi-Krum和Clustering等集中式方案。
Conclusion: WFAgg能有效提升去中心化联邦学习的安全性，但论文仅评估了IID数据，非IID场景和更复杂的攻击模式有待进一步研究。

papers.title: Decentralized Best-Response-Based Learning in Two-Player Zero-Sum Stochastic Games: A Finite-Sample Analysis
papers.abstract_en: We present a finite-sample analysis of decentralized learning in two-player zero-sum matrix games and stochastic games, with a focus on best-response-based learning algorithms. In matrix games, the learning algorithm is payoff-based and symmetric: each player updates its policy using only its own payoff observations, incrementally moving toward an estimated smoothed best response to the opponent's latest policy. For stochastic games, we build on this matrix-game primitive to develop a learning algorithm called value iteration with smoothed best response (VI-SBR), which combines smoothed-best-response learning in induced matrix games with a decentralized, model-free approximation of minimax value iteration. We establish finite-sample guarantees in both settings. For matrix games, our results imply a sample complexity of $\mathcal{O}(ε^{-1})$ for finding an $ε$-Nash distribution and, with explicit exploration, $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(ε^{-8})$ for finding an $ε$-Nash equilibrium. For stochastic games, we prove that the exploration-enhanced VI-SBR algorithm achieves a sample complexity of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(ε^{-8})$ for finding an $ε$-Nash equilibrium. Technically, our analysis develops a coupled Lyapunov-drift framework. This framework simultaneously handles stochastic iterative algorithms with multiple interacting stochastic iterates, the non-zero-sum auxiliary games generated by independently updated value functions, and the time-inhomogeneous Markovian noise induced by time-varying policies. The resulting tools may be useful more broadly for analyzing learning algorithms with coupled stochastic iterates and nonstationary sampling processes.
papers.comment: A preliminary version [arXiv:2303.03100] of this paper, with a subset of the results that are presented here, was presented at NeurIPS 2023
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对两人零和矩阵博弈和随机博弈中的去中心化学习进行了有限样本分析，聚焦于基于最佳响应的学习算法。在矩阵博弈中，算法仅使用自身收益观测更新策略，逐步逼近对手最新策略的平滑最佳响应。在随机博弈中，提出了结合平滑最佳响应学习与去中心化无模型近似minimax值迭代的VI-SBR算法。证明了矩阵博弈中寻找ε-纳什分布的样本复杂度为O(ε^{-1})，寻找ε-纳什均衡的样本复杂度为Õ(ε^{-8})；随机博弈中探索增强的VI-SBR算法达到Õ(ε^{-8})的样本复杂度。技术贡献包括开发了耦合Lyapunov漂移框架，可处理多个交互随机迭代、非零和辅助博弈及非平稳马尔可夫噪声。
Motivation: 现有去中心化多智能体强化学习算法的有限样本分析不足，尤其是基于最佳响应方法的非渐进收敛保证缺乏。
Method: 提出基于平滑最佳响应的去中心化学习算法，包括矩阵博弈中的对称收益驱动更新和随机博弈中的VI-SBR算法，后者结合诱导矩阵博弈中的平滑最佳响应学习与去中心化无模型minimax值迭代。
Result: 矩阵博弈中，算法以O(ε^{-1})样本复杂度找到ε-纳什分布，增加显式探索后以Õ(ε^{-8})找到ε-纳什均衡。随机博弈中，探索增强的VI-SBR算法以Õ(ε^{-8})找到ε-纳什均衡。
Conclusion: 本文建立了去中心化基于最佳响应学习在零和博弈中的有限样本保证，其耦合Lyapunov漂移框架可能推广至其他具有耦合随机迭代和非平稳采样的学习算法分析。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Over-parameterization and Adversarial Robustness in Neural Networks: An Overview and Empirical Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Thanks to their extensive capacity, over-parameterized neural networks exhibit superior predictive capabilities and generalization. However, having a large parameter space is considered one of the main suspects of the neural networks' vulnerability to adversarial example -- input samples crafted ad-hoc to induce a desired misclassification. Relevant literature has claimed contradictory remarks in support of and against the robustness of over-parameterized networks. These contradictory findings might be due to the failure of the attack employed to evaluate the networks' robustness. Previous research has demonstrated that depending on the considered model, the algorithm employed to generate adversarial examples may not function properly, leading to overestimating the model's robustness. In this work, we empirically study the robustness of over-parameterized networks against adversarial examples. However, unlike the previous works, we also evaluate the considered attack's reliability to support the results' veracity. Our results show that over-parameterized networks are robust against adversarial attacks as opposed to their under-parameterized counterparts.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对过度参数化神经网络对对抗样本的鲁棒性展开实证研究。之前文献存在矛盾结论，可能是因为攻击算法不可靠导致鲁棒性被高估。作者不仅评估模型鲁棒性，还验证攻击算法的可靠性，发现过度参数化网络比欠参数化网络更鲁棒。
Motivation: 现有关于过度参数化网络对抗鲁棒性的结论相互矛盾，可能源于评估所用的攻击算法失效，导致鲁棒性被高估。
Method: 采用实证方法，同时评估模型对抗鲁棒性和所用攻击算法的可靠性，以支持结论的准确性。
Result: 过度参数化网络对对抗攻击表现出鲁棒性，而欠参数化网络则脆弱。
Conclusion: 过度参数化网络比欠参数化网络更鲁棒，在评估鲁棒性时需验证攻击算法的可靠性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Wearable Device-Based Real-Time Monitoring of Physiological Signals: Evaluating Cognitive Load Across Different Tasks
papers.abstract_en: This study employs cutting-edge wearable monitoring technology to conduct high-precision, high-temporal-resolution (1-second interval) cognitive load assessment on electroencephalogram (EEG) data from the FP1 channel and heart rate variability (HRV) data of secondary vocational students. By jointly analyzing these two critical physiological indicators, the research delves into their application value in assessing cognitive load among secondary vocational students and their utility across various tasks. The study designed two experiments to validate the efficacy of the proposed approach: Initially, a random forest classification model, developed using the N-BACK task, enabled the precise decoding of physiological signal characteristics in secondary vocational students under different levels of cognitive load, achieving a classification accuracy of 97%. Subsequently, this classification model was applied in a cross-task experiment involving the National Computer Rank Examination (Level-1), demonstrating the method's significant applicability and cross-task transferability in diverse learning contexts. Conducted with high portability, this research holds substantial theoretical and practical significance for optimizing teaching resource allocation in secondary vocational education, as well as for cognitive load assessment methods and monitoring. Currently, the research findings are undergoing trial implementation in the school.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文使用可穿戴设备监测FP1通道脑电图和心率变异性（HRV）数据，以1秒间隔高精度评估中职学生的认知负荷。通过N-BACK任务构建随机森林分类模型，准确率达97%，并在国家计算机等级考试（一级）的跨任务实验中展示了方法的可迁移性。研究对优化中职教育资源分配和认知负荷监测具有理论和实践意义。
Motivation: 现有认知负荷评估方法大多依赖主观问卷或实验室设备，缺乏便携、高时间分辨率的实时监测手段，且针对中职学生的研究不足。
Method: 采用可穿戴技术采集FP1通道EEG和HRV数据，联合分析两种生理指标；利用N-BACK任务训练随机森林分类模型，并在跨任务场景中验证模型迁移能力。
Result: 随机森林分类模型在N-BACK任务中达到97%的分类准确率；跨任务实验证明该方法在不同学习任务中具有适用性和可迁移性。
Conclusion: 研究提出的可穿戴监测方法能实时、准确地评估认知负荷，有助于优化中职教育资源配置，但摘要未明确提及局限性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Gradient Testing and Estimation by Comparisons
papers.abstract_en:
We study gradient testing and gradient estimation of smooth functions using only a comparison oracle that, given two points, indicates which one has the larger function value. For any smooth $f\colon\mathbb R^n	o\mathbb R$, $\mathbf{x}\in\mathbb R^n$, and $\varepsilon>0$, we design a gradient testing algorithm that determines whether the normalized gradient $
abla f(\mathbf{x})/\|
abla f(\mathbf{x})\|$ is $\varepsilon$-close or $2\varepsilon$-far from a given unit vector $\mathbf{v}$ using $O(1)$ queries, as well as a gradient estimation algorithm that outputs an $\varepsilon$-estimate of $
abla f(\mathbf{x})/\|
abla f(\mathbf{x})\|$ using $O(n\log(1/\varepsilon))$ queries which we prove to be optimal. Furthermore, we study gradient estimation in the quantum comparison oracle model where queries can be made in superpositions, and develop a quantum algorithm using $O(\log (n/\varepsilon))$ queries.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究仅使用比较 oracle（给定两点，返回哪个函数值更大）的平滑函数梯度测试与梯度估计问题。对于平滑函数，设计了梯度测试算法判断归一化梯度方向与给定向量的接近程度，以及最优的梯度估计算法，并给出了量子比较 oracle 模型下的加速算法。
Motivation: 在许多优化场景中，只能获得函数值的比较信息（如人类偏好、A/B 测试），无法直接获取梯度。本文旨在仅利用比较 oracle 实现高效的梯度测试与估计。
Method: 提出基于比较 oracle 的梯度测试算法（O(1) 查询）和梯度估计算法（O(n log(1/ε)) 查询，并证明最优）；还开发了量子比较 oracle 模型下的算法，查询复杂度为 O(log(n/ε))。
Result: 梯度测试算法可在常数级查询内判断归一化梯度方向是否 ε-接近给定向量；梯度估计算法达到最优查询复杂度；量子算法实现指数级加速。
Conclusion: 本文展示了仅通过函数值比较即可有效进行梯度测试与估计，并为量子设置下的优化提供了新工具。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Consistent Distributed Ranking of Generative Models via Kernel Distances
papers.abstract_en: Ranking generative models based on the fidelity and diversity of their outputs is required to identify the best generator in a group of candidate generative AI models. To rank a group of models in a conventional centralized setting, a standard score is commonly evaluated for each involved model. The selection and design of reference-based evaluation scores have been extensively studied in centralized settings, where the reference samples are drawn from a single probability distribution. However, in practical scenarios including distributed learning contexts, reference samples are distributed across multiple clients, each potentially with a heterogeneous data distribution. In this work, we investigate the ranking of generative models in such distributed settings with heterogeneous data distributions across clients. We focus on the widely used family of kernel distance (KD) evaluation metrics. We prove that, for every kernel function, ranking models by the averaged KD scores of individual clients yields the same ordering as a centralized KD evaluation using the combined reference data from all the clients. We further extend our analysis to other popular metrics, including the Fréchet Distance (FD), for which the individual client scores could be insufficient for accurate model ranking. We present the numerical results of several experiments on standard image datasets and generative models to validate our theoretical findings regarding distributed ranking using various evaluation scores.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究在分布式设置下，各客户端数据分布异构时，如何对生成模型进行排名。作者证明，对于核距离（KD）评估指标，各客户端平均KD得分得到的排名与使用所有客户端合并参考数据的集中式KD评估排名一致。进一步分析了Fréchet距离（FD）等指标，指出个体客户端得分可能不足以准确排名。在标准图像数据集和生成模型上进行了实验验证。
Motivation: 现有生成模型排名方法多假设参考样本来自单一分布，但在分布式学习等实际场景中，参考数据分布在多个具有异构数据分布的客户端上。需要研究在此类分布式异构设置下如何可靠地排名生成模型。
Method: 针对核距离（KD）评估指标，从理论上证明分布式平均KD得分排名与集中式KD排名的一致性；并推广到Fréchet距离（FD）等指标，分析其在分布式设置下的局限性。
Result: 理论证明对所有核函数，分布式平均KD得分排名与集中式KD排名相同；实验验证了该结论，并指出FD等指标在分布式异构设置下可能失效。
Conclusion: 分布式设置下，核距离指标可通过平均各客户端得分实现一致排名，但其他常用指标（如Fréchet距离）需谨慎使用。

papers.title: NervePool: A Simplicial Pooling Layer
papers.abstract_en: For deep learning problems on graph-structured data, pooling layers are important for down sampling, reducing computational cost, and to minimize overfitting. We define a pooling layer, nervePool, for data structured as simplicial complexes, which are generalizations of graphs that include higher-dimensional simplices beyond vertices and edges; this structure allows for greater flexibility in modeling higher-order relationships. The proposed simplicial coarsening scheme is built upon partitions of vertices, which allow us to generate hierarchical representations of simplicial complexes, collapsing information in a learned fashion. NervePool builds on the learned vertex cluster assignments and extends to coarsening of higher dimensional simplices in a deterministic fashion. While in practice the pooling operations are computed via a series of matrix operations, the topological motivation is a set-theoretic construction based on unions of stars of simplices and the nerve complex.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 NervePool，一种用于单纯复形（simplicial complexes）数据的池化层。该层基于顶点划分生成层次表示，并通过确定性方式粗化高维单纯形，旨在降低计算成本与过拟合。方法通过矩阵运算实现，其拓扑动机源于星形并集和神经复合体（nerve complex）概念。
Motivation: 现有图深度学习中的池化层无法处理高阶关系，而单纯复形能更好地建模复杂结构，但缺乏专用的池化操作。
Method: 定义一种单纯复形的粗化方案，基于学习到的顶点聚类分配，通过确定性方式将信息从低维单纯形扩展到高维，并利用矩阵运算高效实现。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Learning from a Biased Sample
papers.abstract_en: The empirical risk minimization approach to data-driven decision making requires access to training data drawn under the same conditions as those that will be faced when the decision rule is deployed. However, in a number of settings, we may be concerned that our training sample is biased in the sense that some groups (characterized by either observable or unobservable attributes) may be under- or over-represented relative to the general population; and in this setting empirical risk minimization over the training set may fail to yield rules that perform well at deployment. We propose a model of sampling bias called conditional $Γ$-biased sampling, where observed covariates can affect the probability of sample selection arbitrarily much but the amount of unexplained variation in the probability of sample selection is bounded by a constant factor. Applying the distributionally robust optimization framework, we propose a method for learning a decision rule that minimizes the worst-case risk incurred under a family of test distributions that can generate the training distribution under $Γ$-biased sampling. We apply a result of Rockafellar and Uryasev to show that this problem is equivalent to an augmented convex risk minimization problem. We give statistical guarantees for learning a model that is robust to sampling bias via the method of sieves, and propose a deep learning algorithm whose loss function captures our robust learning target. We empirically validate our proposed method in a case study on prediction of mental health scores from health survey data and a case study on ICU length of stay prediction.

papers.title: Theory of the Frequency Principle for General Deep Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Along with fruitful applications of Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) to realistic problems, recently, some empirical studies of DNNs reported a universal phenomenon of Frequency Principle (F-Principle): a DNN tends to learn a target function from low to high frequencies during the training. The F-Principle has been very useful in providing both qualitative and quantitative understandings of DNNs. In this paper, we rigorously investigate the F-Principle for the training dynamics of a general DNN at three stages: initial stage, intermediate stage, and final stage. For each stage, a theorem is provided in terms of proper quantities characterizing the F-Principle. Our results are general in the sense that they work for multilayer networks with general activation functions, population densities of data, and a large class of loss functions. Our work lays a theoretical foundation of the F-Principle for a better understanding of the training process of DNNs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对深度神经网络（DNN）的频率原理（F-Principle）进行了严格的理论分析，即网络在训练过程中从低频到高频学习目标函数的普遍现象。作者针对一般DNN的训练动力学，在初始、中间和最终三个阶段分别给出了定量定理，这些定理适用于多层网络、通用激活函数、任意数据分布和多种损失函数，为理解DNN训练过程奠定了理论基础。
Motivation: 频率原理已在实验中被广泛观察到并用于解释DNN的行为，但其严格的理论基础尚不完善。本文旨在为一般DNN的频率原理提供数学上的严格证明，填补理论空白。
Method: 通过理论分析，针对DNN训练的初始、中间和最终三个阶段，引入适当的量来刻画频率原理，并证明相应的定理。理论框架覆盖多层网络、一般激活函数、一般数据分布和多种损失函数。
Result: 给出了训练各阶段频率原理的严格数学定理，证实了DNN从低频到高频学习目标函数的普遍现象。
Conclusion: 该工作为频率原理提供了理论依据，有助于更深入地理解DNN的训练过程。

papers.title: Finding the Time to Think: Learning Planning Budgets in Real-Time RL
papers.abstract_en: Deliberating takes time. In real-time settings, that time is not free. Standard reinforcement learning (RL) sidesteps this as the environment waits indefinitely for the agent's decision. Instead, we study real-time RL environments where the environment progresses while waiting for the agent's action. Building on prior real-time formalizations, we introduce variable-delay real-time RL, where the agent chooses how long to deliberate at each decision point since the environment progresses. For the planning agents we use, the right delay is state-dependent, and naively planning how long to plan can paralyze the agent. We instead approach this setting by training a lightweight gating policy on top of a planner to select state-dependent planning budgets. Across real-time Pac-Man, Tetris, Snake, Speed Hex, and Speed Go, our gating policy outperforms fixed-budget and heuristic baselines, and transfers to a real-time setup where the environment and agent run on two different GPUs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种在实时强化学习环境中让智能体自主选择规划时间预算的方法，通过轻量级门控策略（gating policy）在规划器之上动态调整决策延迟，在多种实时游戏中超越固定预算和启发式基线。
Motivation: 标准强化学习假设环境在智能体决策期间停滞，而实时环境会持续推进，因此需要智能体在行动前自适应地分配规划时间。
Method: 引入可变延迟实时强化学习框架，训练一个轻量级门控策略，基于状态选择规划预算（planning budget），避免全面搜索规划时长带来的计算瘫痪。
Result: 在实时Pac-Man、Tetris、Snake、Speed Hex和Speed Go中，门控策略优于固定预算和启发式基线，并能迁移到环境与智能体运行在不同GPU的真实实时场景。
Conclusion: 通过元学习规划预算可以显著提升实时强化学习中规划型智能体的决策效率与性能。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: auto-psych: Automating the science of mind using agent-driven theory discovery and experimentation
papers.abstract_en: AI-based scientific automation is increasingly possible by using agents to generate hypotheses, design experiments, and analyze data. Data collection is a major bottleneck in this pipeline, however. Psychology, and computational cognitive science in particular, is well-positioned to benefit from AI experimentation because theories are often represented as code and crowdsourcing platforms enable programmatic human data collection at scale. Here, we apply automated discovery techniques to the project of generating theories in computational cognitive science, with an agent-based system collecting human data independently through crowdsourced survey experiments. As a testbed, we use a classic case study from cognitive psychology: judging which sequences of coin flips seem subjectively more random. Our system, auto-psych, uses nested agent-based discovery loops to generate explanatory theories of human behavior. The inner loop conjectures, fits, and critiques probabilistic cognitive models; the outer loop designs experiments to test these models, launches them online, and analyzes the data. This system can quickly and reliably recover ground-truth theories from synthetic data via systematic experimentation, but the nested structure is critical to model performance. Further, in three independent sequences of human experiments, the system finds theories that fit the data better than theories generated from the scientific literature. This work thus demonstrates the feasibility of automated data collection and theory discovery in computational cognitive science.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出auto-psych系统，使用基于主体的嵌套发现循环自动生成认知科学理论，并通过众包实验收集人类数据。在判断硬币序列随机性的经典案例中，系统能从合成数据中恢复真实理论，并在人类实验中产生比文献模型更好的拟合。
Motivation: 心理学的理论发展常依赖手工实验，数据收集是自动化科学的主要瓶颈。计算认知科学中的理论通常表示为代码，且众包平台可实现大规模人类数据收集，但自动化理论发现与实验的闭环尚未实现。
Method: 提出auto-psych系统，采用嵌套的基于主体的发现循环。内环负责猜想、拟合和批评概率认知模型；外环设计实验、在线启动并分析数据。系统通过迭代改进模型。
Result: 在合成数据上，系统能快速可靠地恢复真实理论，嵌套结构对性能关键。在三个独立人类实验序列中，系统发现的理论比文献中的理论对数据拟合更好。
Conclusion: 该工作展示了在计算认知科学中自动化数据收集和理论发现的可行性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: MKG-RAG-Bench: Benchmarking Retrieval in Multimodal Knowledge Graph-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over knowledge graphs has emerged as a promising approach for grounding large language models, yet existing benchmarks largely overlook the challenges of retrieval in multimodal knowledge graph RAG (MKG-RAG). In practice, retrieval is a critical bottleneck: multimodal knowledge is heterogeneous, difficult to align across modalities, and often poorly served by retrievers designed for unstructured corpora. To address this gap, we introduce MKG-RAG-Bench, a cross-domain benchmark explicitly designed to evaluate retrieval in MKG-RAG. MKG-RAG-Bench is constructed from two multimodal knowledge graphs spanning general and medical domains, and includes carefully aligned question-answering datasets that support controlled evaluation of both retrieval and downstream generation. The benchmark is built using an LLM-based curation pipeline that filters low-utility knowledge, generates structurally grounded queries with exact supervision, and systematically covers diverse modality configurations. Through extensive experiments across representative retriever families and modality settings, we show that effective multimodal retrieval remains challenging yet crucial for end-to-end MKG-RAG performance, and that retrieval quality strongly determines generation outcomes. By isolating retrieval as a first-class evaluation target, MKG-RAG-Bench provides a principled foundation for diagnosing current limitations and advancing multimodal knowledge graph RAG systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了MKG-RAG-Bench，一个专门用于评估多模态知识图谱增强生成（MKG-RAG）中检索环节的跨领域基准。该基准涵盖通用和医学领域，通过LLM驱动的流程构建了结构化的问答数据集，支持对检索和生成进行控制性评估。实验表明，有效的多模态检索对端到端MKG-RAG性能至关重要，且检索质量强烈影响生成结果。
Motivation: 现有知识图谱RAG基准主要关注生成，忽视了检索在多模态场景下的挑战：多模态知识异构、跨模态对齐困难，且现有检索器设计用于非结构化语料，难以处理结构化多模态数据。
Method: 基于两个多模态知识图谱（通用和医学领域），使用LLM驱动的筛选流程构建基准：过滤低效用知识、生成有精确监督的结构化查询、系统覆盖不同模态配置。
Result: 实验显示，当前代表性检索器在多模态设置下仍面临挑战，有效的多模态检索对端到端MKG-RAG性能至关重要，检索质量强烈决定生成结果。
Conclusion: MKG-RAG-Bench将检索作为独立评估目标，为诊断当前多模态知识图谱RAG系统的局限性并推动其发展提供了基础。

papers.title: A probabilistic framework for online test-time adaptation
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents a probabilistic framework for online test-time adaptation problems. In them, a model is trained on labeled data but must adapt to unlabeled data at test time under the assumption that training and test distributions potentially differ, that is, there might have been a distributional shift. The framework is based on a state-space modelling architecture from which parameter learning, parameter time evolution, prior tuning, and prediction can be characterized.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个概率框架，用于在线测试时适应问题，其中模型在标记数据上训练，但必须在测试时适应未标记数据，且训练和测试分布可能存在差异。该框架基于状态空间建模架构，能够描述参数学习、参数时间演化、先验调整和预测。
Motivation: 现有测试时适应方法缺乏统一的概率视角，难以处理分布偏移下的在线自适应问题。
Method: 采用状态空间模型（state-space model）架构，将参数学习、时间演化和预测统一在概率框架中。
Result: 摘要未报告具体实验结果或数值指标。
Conclusion: 该框架为在线测试时适应提供了理论化的概率基础，但未验证实际应用效果。

papers.title: Active Adversarial Perturbation-driven Associative Memory Retrieval for RGB-Event Visual Object Tracking
papers.abstract_en: RGB-Event tracking improves localization robustness by fusing RGB appearance textures and dense temporal motion cues from event sensors. While this multi-modal scheme broadens tracking applicability, real-world scenes suffer diverse structured signal degradations that hinder traditional multi-modal fusion. In harsh environments, either modality can lose reliability drastically, and targets frequently appear incomplete due to occlusion, edge truncation and foreground clutter.To tackle the above challenges, we present a hierarchical perturbation and retrieval framework tailored for RGB-Event tracking with robustness against partial target missing and modal degradation, termed APRTrack. To mimic real-world signal corruption, APRTrack constructs structured degradation via two adversarial perturbation branches at the modality and spatial levels, which separately simulate full-modal failure and localized target region absence. A hierarchical routing mechanism is designed to disentangle the training pipelines of the two perturbation types, effectively eliminating feature collapse induced by superimposed degradation constraints. Furthermore, we devise Footprint-guided Channel-calibrated Hopfield Retrieval (FCHR) for reliable historical information compensation. This module evaluates retrieval confidence based on association footprints between queries and memory banks, and calibrates the retrieval metric space prior to Hopfield matching, realizing controllable historical feature compensation bounded to target regions. Extensive experiments on FE108, COESOT, VisEvent, and FELT datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed strategies for the RGB-Event visual object tracking. The source code and pre-trained models will be released on https://github.com/Event-AHU/OpenEvTracking

Motivation: RGB-Event跟踪中，真实场景存在结构化信号退化（如模态失效、目标遮挡），传统融合方法鲁棒性不足。现有方法难以同时应对模态缺失和目标局部缺失问题。
Method: 提出APRTrack：1) 构建模态级和空间级对抗扰动分支，分别模拟全模态失效和局部目标区域缺失；2) 设计层次化路由机制解耦两种扰动训练，避免特征坍塌；3) 提出足迹引导的通道校准Hopfield检索（FCHR），基于查询与记忆库的关联足迹评估检索置信度，校准度量空间后再进行Hopfield匹配，实现可控的历史特征补偿。
Result: 在FE108、COESOT、VisEvent、FELT数据集上验证了APRTrack的有效性，具体性能指标见论文。
Conclusion: APRTrack通过层次化扰动和检索机制提升了RGB-Event跟踪在部分目标缺失和模态退化下的鲁棒性。代码和预训练模型将开源。

papers.title: Data-driven Machine Learning Cannot Reach Symbolic-level Logical Reasoning -- The Limit of the Scaling Law
papers.abstract_en: Sphere neural networks have achieved symbolic level syllogistic reasoning without training data, raising the question of where the limit of the scaling law for logical reasoning lies, i.e., whether data-driven machine learning systems can achieve the same level by increasing training data and training time. We show two methodological limitations that prevent supervised deep learning from reaching the symbolic-level syllogistic reasoning: (1) training data can not distinguish all 24 types of valid syllogistic reasoning; (2) end-to-end mapping from premises to conclusion introduces contradictory training targets between neural components for pattern recognition and logical reasoning. Beside theoretical analysis, we experimentally illustrate that Euler Net cannot achieve rigorous syllogistic reasoning. We further challenge the most recent ChatGPTs (GPT-5-nano and GPT-5) to determine the satisfiability of syllogistic statements in four surface forms (patterns): words, double words, simple symbols, and long random symbols, showing that surface forms affect the reasoning performance and that ChatGPT GPT-5 may reach 100% accuracy but still provide incorrect explanations. As empirical training processes are stopped after achieving 100% accuracy, we conclude that supervised machine learning systems will not attain the rigour of symbolic logical reasoning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文探讨数据驱动的机器学习是否能够达到符号级别的逻辑推理能力。作者指出监督深度学习存在两个方法论局限：训练数据无法区分所有24种有效的三段论推理类型；从前提到结论的端到端映射引入了模式识别与逻辑推理之间的矛盾训练目标。实验表明Euler Net无法实现严格的三段论推理，且ChatGPT（GPT-5-nano和GPT-5）在四种表面形式下的推理性能受表面形式影响，即使达到100%准确率仍可能提供错误解释。论文结论是监督机器学习系统无法达到符号逻辑推理的严谨性。
Motivation: 探讨缩放定律在逻辑推理方面的极限，即数据驱动的机器学习系统能否通过增加训练数据和训练时间达到符号级别的三段论推理。
Method: 通过理论分析指出监督深度学习的两大方法论局限，并通过实验验证：用Euler Net进行三段论推理测试，以及用ChatGPT（GPT-5）在四种表面形式下测试三段论语句的可满足性。
Result: 实验表明Euler Net无法实现严格的推理；ChatGPT在单词、双词、简单符号和长随机符号四种形式下的性能受表面形式影响，GPT-5可能达到100%准确但解释错误。
Conclusion: 由于训练在达到100%准确率后即停止，监督机器学习系统不会达到符号逻辑推理的严谨性。

papers.title: Optimizing CUDA like a Human: Micro-Profiling Tools as Expert Surrogates for LLM-Based GPU Kernel Optimization
papers.abstract_en: We present KernelPro, a closed-loop multi-agent system that automatically generates, profiles, and iteratively optimizes GPU kernel code by integrating large language model (LLM) code generation with hardware profiler feedback and pluggable bottleneck detection tools. KernelPro introduces four contributions: (1) a semantic feedback operator that encodes expert heuristics as pluggable micro-profiling tools, transforming raw hardware metrics into actionable natural language guidance; (2) a two-stage tool invocation architecture where roofline-based bottleneck classification filters which specialized analysis tools execute, combining kernel-level (ncu), instruction-level (SASS), and system-level (nsys) profiling; (3) a domain-adapted MCTS with progressive widening, asymmetric branching, log-reward calibration, dead-end pruning, and search memory for cross-iteration learning; and (4) direct CuTe source-level code generation via autonomous code search over the CUTLASS/CuTe codebase. On KernelBench, KernelPro achieves geometric mean speedups of 2.42x/4.69x/5.30x on Levels 1/2/3, establishing state-of-the-art performance across all difficulty levels. On VeOmni's expert-optimized MoE training kernels, KernelPro achieves 1.23x over hand-tuned Triton by generating a from-scratch raw-CUDA+CuTe Hopper WGMMA kernel. Ablation studies demonstrate that each design component independently and significantly improves optimization quality: micro-profiling tools (p < 0.0001 vs raw metrics), MCTS search (26% higher geometric mean vs greedy, p = 0.004), and proactive tool orchestration (23% improvement, p = 0.035). Finally, KernelPro is the first CUDA kernel coding agent to optimize energy efficiency beyond the speed-only focus of prior systems, demonstrating an 11.6% measured energy reduction at matched speed.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出KernelPro，一个闭环多智能体系统，利用LLM生成GPU kernel代码，并结合硬件性能分析器反馈和可插拔瓶颈检测工具进行自动迭代优化。在KernelBench上，KernelPro在Level 1/2/3上分别实现几何平均加速2.42x/4.69x/5.30x，并在VeOmni的MoE训练kernel上超越人工调优的Triton，实现1.23x加速。
Motivation: GPU kernel优化通常依赖专家手工调优，耗时且难以扩展。现有自动化方法缺乏对硬件性能计数器深层语义的利用，且优化搜索效率低下。
Method: KernelPro包含四个核心贡献：将专家启发式编码为可插拔微性能分析工具的语义反馈算子；基于roofline瓶颈分类的两阶段工具调用架构；领域适应的MCTS搜索（含渐进式拓宽、非对称分支、对数奖励校准、死胡同剪枝和搜索记忆）；以及通过自主代码搜索直接生成CuTe源码。
Result: 在KernelBench Level 1/2/3上达到几何平均加速2.42x/4.69x/5.30x，超越此前最优系统。在VeOmni的MoE训练kernel上，生成原始CUDA+CuTe Hopper WGMMA kernel，比人工调优Triton快1.23x。消融实验表明各组件均显著提升优化质量。此外，KernelPro是首个同时优化能效的CUDA kernel编码代理，在同等速度下降低11.6%能耗。
Conclusion: KernelPro展示了将领域特定微性能分析工具与LLM代码生成及高级搜索策略结合的有效性，在多个难度的kernel优化任务上达到最优，并能兼顾能耗优化。

papers.title: Listening Like a Judge: A Music-Aware Framework for Automatic Singing Performance Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Automatic singing quality assessment (SQA) requires evaluating lyrical correctness and musical fidelity while handling expressive variations. However, existing systems largely rely on either acoustic cues or lyric transcriptions exclusively, limiting holistic performance evaluation. Furthermore, their integration is non-trivial due to challenges in robust singing transcription amid melisma, vibrato, and tempo elasticity. To this end, we propose MusicJudge, a modality-guided framework for automated SQA that performs block-aligned multimodal analysis by coupling lyric correctness with pitch-rhythm fidelity. It detects semantically meaningful lyric blocks using multi-signal matching that integrates semantic embeddings, lexical similarity, and phonetic alignment. To improve singing audio transcription, we introduce Modality-Guided LoRA for ASR fine-tuning. Experiments across datasets demonstrate strong agreement with human expert judgments and validate the generalizability of MusicJudge.
papers.comment: Accepted at Interspeech 2026. Supplementary material: https://neelam472.github.io/MusicJudge/Supp.pdf (backup mirror: https://sourav-ghosh.github.io/MusicJudge/Supp.pdf )
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 MusicJudge，一个模态引导的自动歌唱质量评估框架。它通过块对齐多模态分析，结合歌词正确性和音高-节奏保真度，并引入 Modality-Guided LoRA 微调 ASR 以提升歌唱音频转录。实验表明该方法与人类专家判断高度一致。
Motivation: 现有歌唱质量评估系统要么依赖声学线索，要么依赖歌词转录，缺乏整体评估；而将两者整合面临颤音、装饰音和节奏弹性等带来的鲁棒转录挑战。
Method: 提出 MusicJudge，采用多信号匹配（语义嵌入、词汇相似度、语音对齐）检测语义歌词块，并引入 Modality-Guided LoRA 对 ASR 进行微调，以改进歌唱音频转录。
Result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，MusicJudge 与人类专家判断有强一致性，并验证了其泛化能力。
Conclusion: MusicJudge 通过块对齐多模态分析有效耦合歌词正确性与音高-节奏保真度，为自动歌唱质量评估提供了新框架。

papers.title: ProvenAI: Provenance-Native Traces of Evidence in Generated Answers
papers.abstract_en: Retrieval-augmented systems routinely present citations alongside generated answers, yet a citation does not confirm that the corresponding source meaningfully shaped the output. This paper introduces ProvenAI, a framework that decomposes transparency in multi-hop question answering into three independently measurable layers: answer correctness, citation fidelity against benchmark supporting evidence, and per-document influence under leave-one-resource-out intervention. Targeting the HotpotQA distractor benchmark through a seven-stage pipeline covering data normalisation, retrieval indexing, citation-aware answer generation, attribution auditing, ablation-based influence estimation, batch evaluation, and interactive inspection, ProvenAI evaluates 7,405 validation examples drawn from a canonical corpus of 509,300 passages. The system achieves 53.53% answer accuracy alongside a mean citation-fidelity score of 71.55%, and a worked example surfaces what we call the citation-influence gap: a clean citation audit co-occurring with a profile in which one cited source registers only weak influence while seven uncited sources demonstrably shift the output. We formalise the relationship between the implemented surface proxy and a token-level KL-divergence target through a stated faithfulness condition, ground the framework in causal-mediation analysis and database-provenance theory, and discuss how the three measurement layers compose with cryptographic provenance architectures emerging in autonomous scientific discovery. ProvenAI establishes that meaningful transparency in retrieval-grounded QA requires traceable links across retrieved, cited, and behaviourally influential evidence as three distinct, independently measured layers.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 ProvenAI 框架，将多跳问答中的透明度分解为三个独立可测量的层：答案正确性、引用忠实性（对基准支持证据）、以及每篇文档在留一资源干预下的影响。在 HotpotQA 上使用 509,300 段落的语料库评估了 7,405 个验证样本，达到 53.53% 的答案准确率和 71.55% 的平均引用忠实性分数，并揭示了“引用-影响缺口”：被引来源影响弱，而未引来源却显著改变输出。框架基于因果中介分析和数据库溯源理论，并讨论了与密码学溯源架构的组合。
Motivation: 现有检索增强系统在生成答案时附上引用，但引用并不能证明对应来源真正影响了输出。需要更细粒度的透明度度量。
Method: 提出由七阶段流水线构成的框架：数据标准化、检索索引、引用感知的答案生成、归属审计、基于消融的影响估计、批量评估和交互式检查。通过 leave-one-resource-out 干预估计每篇文档的影响，并形式化表面代理与 token 级 KL 散度目标之间的忠实条件。
Result: 在 HotpotQA 上，答案准确率为 53.53%，平均引用忠实性为 71.55%。一个工作示例展示了引用-影响缺口：被引来源影响弱，而七个未引来源可测量的改变输出。
Conclusion: 有意义的透明度要求将检索、引用和行为影响证据作为三个独立层进行可追踪链接，这需要超越表面引用审计，结合因果分析和溯源架构。

papers.title: Closing the Loop to Discover Psychological Theories with an Automated Cognitive Scientist
papers.abstract_en: Across the sciences, autonomous systems are increasingly being used in closed-loop discovery, proposing new theories and designing and running experiments to test them. This approach is yet to be applied in the field of cognitive science, where the central bottleneck is theory-building: the creative step of turning the accumulated failures of existing models into better ones. Theory generation has remained manual even as data collection, modeling, and experiment design have been automated. We present the Automated Cognitive Scientist (AutoCog), a fully autonomous agentic-AI system that closes this loop. Large-language-model agents advocate competing theories, each expressed as an executable cognitive model, design experiments that best discriminate them, collect behavioral data from participants recruited online, score theories against collected data based on their generative performance, diagnose why they fail, and synthesize a better successor. Repeating this cycle allows them to search the space of theories, models, and experiments. In the domain of decision-making, AutoCog recovered known decision-making strategies from simulated behavior, including unconventional ones, showing that its discoveries are ultimately driven by the data rather than strictly bound by the priors of the underlying language models. When run with human participants, it produced theories that outperformed the established theories it was seeded with and generalized to held-out studies in two different experimental settings. It also surfaced a novel theory of multi-cue decision-making in which choices show diminishing sensitivity to feature values. The distinctive predictions of this theory were confirmed in a preregistered study with new participants. AutoCog demonstrates how an automated discovery system can be used to turn cognitive theory-building into an explicit, executable, and cumulative science.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个名为AutoCog的全自主AI系统，它通过大语言模型代理生成可执行认知模型、设计判别性实验、在线收集人类行为数据、评估模型并合成更优后继理论，从而在决策领域实现了理论发现的闭环自动化。在模拟和人类实验中，AutoCog成功恢复了已知决策策略，发现了新的多线索决策理论（对特征值呈现递减敏感性），并在预注册研究中得到验证。
Motivation: 认知科学的核心瓶颈是理论构建，即从现有模型的失败中创造更好的理论，而这一过程至今仍依赖人工。尽管数据收集、建模和实验设计已实现自动化，但理论生成环节尚未被自动化覆盖。
Method: AutoCog采用多个大语言模型代理分别倡导不同的竞争理论，每个理论以可执行认知模型表示；代理设计能最佳区分这些理论的实验，在线招募参与者收集行为数据，基于生成性能对理论评分，诊断失败原因，并综合出更好的后继理论，通过循环迭代搜索理论、模型和实验空间。
Result: 在决策领域，AutoCog从模拟行为中恢复了已知决策策略（包括非常规策略），表明其发现由数据驱动而非受限于语言模型先验。与人类参与者运行时，它产生的理论优于初始种子理论，并泛化到两个不同实验设置中的保留研究。此外，它发现了一个新的多线索决策理论，其中选择对特征值呈现递减敏感性，该理论在预注册研究中得到确认。
Conclusion: AutoCog展示了自动化发现系统如何将认知理论构建转变为显式、可执行和累积的科学，但摘要未明确讨论局限性。

papers.title: WatchAct: A Benchmark for Behavior-Grounded Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: A robot working alongside people must reason about what they have done, in what order, and with what intent. Video carries the spatial layouts, object histories, and gestures that language leaves underspecified, yet today's manipulation benchmarks pair an instruction with a single current image, offering no way to evaluate reasoning over observed human behavior. We introduce WatchAct, a benchmark for robot manipulation grounded in observed human behavior. Each instance pairs a real-world human-action video and a language instruction with an aligned simulator scene and an executable LIBERO task, enabling scalable and reproducible evaluation. WatchAct comprises 3,000 long-horizon instances across 14 tasks in four capability domains drawn from the cognitive demands of watching another agent: parsing events (Event Grounding), recovering procedural structure (Procedural Reasoning), inferring unstated intent (Implicit Intent Inference), and tracking how the scene was changed (Episodic Reasoning). We further propose a disentangled evaluation protocol that separately measures (i)~video-to-plan reasoning by vision-language models, (ii)~policy execution under oracle plans, and (iii)~full task completion by integrated planner--policy pipelines. In both simulation and on a Franka Research 3 robot, current systems remain far from solving WatchAct. The best pipeline, Gemini-3.1-Pro with $π_{0.5}$, reaches only 16.3% Success Rate (SR) in simulation and 14.0% on the real robot. Gemini-3.1-Pro attains just 36.8% Plan SR (vs. 97.1% for humans), while $π_{0.5}$ reaches only 21.5% Task SR under oracle plans and drops to 10.6% on out-of-domain scenarios. Dataset and code are available at https://baiqi-li.github.io/watchact_page/.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出WatchAct基准，用于评估机器人基于观察人类行为进行推理的能力，包含3000个长时域实例，覆盖事件解析、程序推理、隐式意图推理和情景推理四个认知领域。在仿真和真实机器人上，最佳流水线（Gemini-3.1-Pro + π₀.₅）成功率仅16.3%（仿真）和14.0%（真实），表明当前系统远未解决该问题。
Motivation: 现有机器人操作基准仅将指令与单张当前图像配对，无法评估模型对人类行为推理的能力，而视频能提供语言未指定的空间布局、物体历史和手势信息。
Method: 构建一个包含真实人类动作视频、语言指令、对齐的仿真场景和可执行LIBERO任务的基准，并提出解耦评估协议，分别测量视频到规划的推理、在oracle规划下的策略执行以及完整流水线的任务完成率。
Result: 最佳流水线Gemini-3.1-Pro + π₀.₅在仿真中任务成功率为16.3%，真实机器人上为14.0%；Gemini-3.1-Pro的规划成功率仅36.8%（人类为97.1%），π₀.₅在oracle规划下任务成功率为21.5%，域外场景下降至10.6%。
Conclusion: 当前视觉-语言模型和策略在基于人类行为推理的机器人操作任务上表现不足，基准揭示了显著的改进空间。

papers.title: AXLE: A Cloud Infrastructure for Lean 4 Theorem Proving Utilities
papers.abstract_en: We present AXLE (Axiom Lean Engine), a cloud service for Lean 4 proof manipulation, extraction, and verification. Recent progress in AI for mathematics -- reinforcement learning pipelines, agentic proving workflows, dataset curation -- demands Lean 4 tooling that scales to millions of requests while remaining correct and robust; existing infrastructure offers parallel compilation but not scalable proof verification, higher-level proof manipulation, multi-version support, or per-request isolation at the throughput modern AI workflows require. AXLE provides 14 Lean 4 metaprogramming tools spanning strict proof verification, declaration metadata extraction, semantic source manipulation, deterministic proof repair and simplification, and lemma extraction. The service runs as a multi-tenant cloud deployment with per-request isolation and concurrent support for multiple Lean 4 and Mathlib versions, accessible via a Python SDK, command-line interface, web UI, MCP server, and raw HTTP API. AXLE is publicly available and free to use at https://axle.axiommath.ai and via the axiom-axle PyPI package, with no local Lean 4 installation required. It has served over 500 million requests to date and is the underlying infrastructure for Axiom Math's proving efforts, including its 12/12 score on the 2025 Putnam competition.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 3rd AI for Math Workshop, ICML 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: AXLE 是一个面向 Lean 4 定理证明的云基础设施，提供 14 个元编程工具，涵盖严格证明验证、声明元数据提取、语义源码操作、确定性的证明修复与简化、引理提取等功能。该服务支持多租户、每请求隔离、多版本 Lean 4 和 Mathlib 并发支持，已处理超过 5 亿次请求，并作为 Axiom Math 证明工作的底层基础设施，助力其在 2025 年 Putnam 竞赛中获得 12/12 的满分成绩。
Motivation: 现有的 Lean 4 工具链支持并行编译，但缺乏可扩展的证明验证、高级证明操作、多版本支持以及现代 AI 工作流所需的高吞吐量下的每请求隔离。
Method: AXLE 基于多租户云部署，提供 14 种 Lean 4 元编程工具，通过 Python SDK、CLI、Web UI、MCP 服务器和原始 HTTP API 访问，无需本地安装 Lean 4。
Result: 该服务已处理超过 5 亿次请求，并支持 Axiom Math 在 2025 年 Putnam 竞赛中获得 12/12 满分。
Conclusion: AXLE 填补了 Lean 4 在大规模 AI 驱动数学工作流中可靠且可扩展的证明基础设施的空白，并已在实际应用中验证了其有效性。

papers.title: ConflictScore: Identifying and Measuring How Language Models Handle Conflicting Evidence
papers.abstract_en: Existing metrics for factuality and faithfulness evaluate whether an answer is supported or contradicted by its grounding documents, but they fail to capture when both supporting and contradicting evidence coexist. We introduce ConflictScore, a novel metric that quantifies how well a model's response acknowledges conflicting evidence in its grounding documents. Our framework decomposes responses into atomic claims, labels each claim against each grounding document, and then aggregates these labels into two complementary measures: ConflictScore-Count (CS-C), the proportion of claims exhibiting conflicts, and ConflictScore-Ratio (CS-R), the balance between supporting and contradicting evidence. We develop ConflictBench, a benchmark covering diverse forms of conflicts such as ambiguity, contradiction, and divergent opinions, to systematically evaluate our metric. Experiments show that ConflictScore effectively detects overconfident claims across domains and can serve as a corrective feedback mechanism that improves truthfulness on TruthfulQA.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 针对现有事实性指标无法评估答案同时存在支持和矛盾证据的问题，提出 ConflictScore 指标，将回答分解为原子声明并对每个声明与证据文档进行标注，通过两个互补度量（CS-C 和 CS-R）量化模型处理冲突证据的能力。构建 ConflictBench 基准，实验表明该指标可有效检测过度自信的声明，并作为纠正反馈机制提升 TruthfulQA 上的真实性。
Motivation: 现有指标只判断答案是支持还是矛盾，未能捕捉证据共存时的冲突情况，导致对模型盲目自信的检测不足。
Method: 将回答拆解为原子声明，对每个声明与各证据文档进行正/负/中立标注，然后聚合为 ConflictScore-Count（冲突声明比例）和 ConflictScore-Ratio（支持与矛盾证据的平衡度）两个互补度量。
Result: 在多个领域上 ConflictScore 能有效检测模型生成中过度自信的声明，作为反馈信号可改善 TruthfulQA 上的真实性。
Conclusion: ConflictScore 提供了一种细粒度衡量模型处理冲突证据的能力，但摘要未说明其在更复杂场景下的泛化性或潜在局限性。

papers.title: Embedding Foundation Model Predictions in Discrete-Choice Models with Structural Guarantees
papers.abstract_en: Tabular foundation models achieve strong accuracy on choice prediction tasks, but their predictions often violate the economic logic those tasks require: raising a price can increase predicted demand, implied willingness-to-pay estimates are frequently negative or implausible, and unavailable alternatives receive nonzero probability. We propose a two-stage adapter that takes a foundation model's predicted choice probabilities as a precomputed feature and embeds them inside a multinomial logit's utility. In Stage 1, we fit the multinomial logit's structural coefficients by maximum likelihood with sign constraints; in Stage 2, we freeze those coefficients and fit a small neural correction operating on the foundation model's predictions. We prove that this composition exactly preserves the multinomial logit's marginal rate of substitution, so analytically computable value-of-time becomes a mathematical guarantee rather than an empirical accident. Across three datasets and two foundation models, the adapter gains 6.4 percentage points (pp) of test accuracy on average over the multinomial logit and up to 12.8 pp, maintains 100% cost monotonicity, and produces values of time within the published transportation-economics range on the transportation datasets. Performance degrades gracefully under foundation-model context restriction, retaining at least 6 pp of accuracy gain even at 10% of the original foundation-model context.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个两阶段适配器，将表格基础模型（tabular foundation model）的预测嵌入到多项logit模型中，同时保持边际替代率、成本单调性等结构保证。实验表明在三个数据集上平均提升6.4个百分点准确率（最高12.8pp），且时间价值估计符合交通经济学范围。
Motivation: 表格基础模型在离散选择预测中准确，但预测常违反经济逻辑（如价格上涨导致需求增加、愿意支付为负），需要结构约束以符合经济学要求。
Method: 两阶段适配器：第一阶段用带符号约束的最大似然估计多项logit的结构系数；第二阶段冻结系数，训练小型神经网络修正基础模型预测。该组合精确保持多项logit的边际替代率，使时间价值可解析计算。
Result: 在三个数据集和两个基础模型上，平均准确率提升6.4pp（最高12.8pp），保持100%成本单调性，时间价值在交通经济学范围内。基础模型上下文限制下性能优雅下降，即使仅10%上下文仍保持至少6pp提升。
Conclusion: 该方法在保留基础模型预测能力的同时，确保了离散选择模型的经济学结构保证，且对不同上下文长度具有鲁棒性。

papers.title: Revealing Mammographic Phenotypes in Deep Learning Breast Cancer Risk Models
papers.abstract_en: Mammogram-based deep learning models have improved breast cancer risk prediction, but the learned imaging patterns remain underexplored. Existing interpretability methods rely on single-image saliency maps, failing to identify recurring mammographic phenotypes across large patient cohorts. By clustering patch embeddings from a pre-trained model, Mirai, we isolate recurring phenotypes linked to 5-year cancer risk. Analyses show risk-increasing phenotypes capture complex structures (e.g., dense tissue, microcalcifications) and shortcut artifacts (e.g., clips). These phenotypes correlate strongly with older age and higher BI-RADS density. Our framework connects tissue patterns to AI risk scores, revealing clinical signatures and potential latent model confounders.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文利用预训练的乳腺摄影深度学习模型Mirai的嵌入向量进行聚类，识别与5年乳腺癌风险相关的复现影像表型。风险增加的表型包括致密组织、微钙化等复杂结构以及夹子等伪影，并与年龄和BI-RADS密度相关。该方法揭示了AI风险评分背后的组织模式和潜在混杂因素。
Motivation: 现有可解释性方法依赖单张图像的显著性图，无法在大规模患者群体中发现复现的乳腺摄影表型，导致对深度学习模型学到的影像模式理解不足。
Method: 从预训练的Mirai模型中提取乳腺摄影图像的补丁嵌入，通过聚类识别复现的表型，然后分析这些表型与5年癌症风险、年龄、BI-RADS密度的关联。

papers.title: DualEval: Joint Model-Item Calibration for Unified LLM Evaluation
papers.abstract_en: Current LLM evaluation relies on two complementary but often disconnected signals: static benchmarks with objective correctness labels and arena-style preference data that better reflect open-ended user interactions. We introduce DualEval, a latent model-item calibration framework that represents models and evaluation items in a shared space, jointly estimating model ability together with item difficulty and sharpness. We apply DualEval across four domains: coding, math, miscellaneous domain-knowledge tasks, and generic everyday user queries. Our evaluation uses 18 frontier LLMs, static benchmark labels, and reward-model scores validated against held-out human preferences for open-ended model responses. Empirically, our framework produces reliable and balanced model rankings, and its learned item-level profiles support downstream applications such as benchmark compression for sample-efficient evaluation and anomaly detection for contamination or outlier analysis. Overall, DualEval unifies static and arena-style evaluation through joint model-item calibration, producing model rankings and item-level diagnostics that support more sample-efficient, interpretable, and auditable evaluation pipelines.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: DualEval是一个联合模型-项目校准框架，将LLM评估中的静态基准与偏好数据统一到一个共享空间，同时估计模型能力、项目难度和尖锐度。在18个前沿LLM和四个领域（编码、数学、领域知识、日常查询）上验证，产生可靠且平衡的模型排名，并支持基准压缩和异常检测。该方法通过联合校准实现了更样本高效、可解释和可审计的评估管道。
Motivation: 当前LLM评估依赖两种互补但常常脱节的信号：带有客观正确性标签的静态基准和反映开放端用户交互的竞技场式偏好数据。这种分离限制了评估的统一性和可解释性。
Method: 提出DualEval，一个潜在模型-项目校准框架，将模型和评估项目表示在共享空间中，联合估计模型能力、项目难度和尖锐度。使用静态基准标签和奖励模型评分，并通过保留的人类偏好验证。
Result: 在18个前沿LLM和四个领域的评估中，DualEval产生可靠且平衡的模型排名。其学习的项目级配置文件支持基准压缩（样本高效评估）和异常检测（污染或离群分析）。
Conclusion: DualEval通过联合模型-项目校准统一了静态和竞技场式评估，提供模型排名和项目级诊断，支持更样本高效、可解释和可审计的评估管道。

papers.title: Play2Perfect: What Matters in Dexterous Play Pretraining for Precise Assembly?
papers.abstract_en: Multi-fingered robots promise the speed and dexterity of human hands, yet challenging problems such as precise assembly have remained out of reach. These tasks are contact-rich, making data collection for imitation learning difficult, and sparse-reward, making direct exploration with reinforcement learning (RL) intractable. Consequently, prior work has made progress by structuring the problem with specialized grippers, tool attachments, and environment fixtures. In this work, we argue that before a robot can perfect precise assembly, it must first learn to play. We further ask the question: what factors in the process of learning to play matter for precise assembly? We propose Play2Perfect, an RL framework for task-agnostic pretraining through play on diverse objects and goals, which is then perfected on precise assembly. The goal of play is to acquire reusable manipulation priors, such as grasping, in-hand reorientation and pose reaching. Finetuning then adapts this general prior to assembly, focusing exploration on the final contact-rich, high-precision interactions needed for success. We systematically study key design choices in play pretraining, including object diversity, training objective, trajectory diversity, and goal precision. We show that our prior is 33x more sample-efficient than RL training from scratch, even when provided with dense, multi-stage rewards. We demonstrate zero-shot sim-to-real transfer, achieving 60% success on tight insertions with only 0.5 mm contact clearance, and over 50% success on long-horizon multi-part assembly and screwing.
papers.comment: 22 pages, 12 figures, 4 tables. Project page: https://play2perfect.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 Play2Perfect，一个通过任务无关的玩耍预训练（play pretraining）获取可复用操作先验，再微调用于精密装配的强化学习框架。在多种物体和目标上预训练后，在紧密装配任务上实现零样本 sim-to-real 迁移，成功率 60%（间隙 0.5 mm），多部件装配和拧螺丝成功率超 50%。
Motivation: 多指灵巧手在精密装配等接触密集、奖励稀疏的任务中面临数据收集困难和探索不可行的问题，现有方法依赖专用夹爪、工具和环境固定装置。
Method: 提出 Play2Perfect，包括两个阶段：1）任务无关的玩耍预训练，学习抓取、手内重定向、位姿到达等先验；2）微调阶段将先验适配到具体装配任务，聚焦高精度交互。系统研究了物体多样性、训练目标、轨迹多样性和目标精度等设计选择。
Result: 预训练先验使样本效率比从零开始的强化学习提升 33 倍（即使有密集多阶段奖励）。零样本 sim-to-real 迁移在 0.5 mm 间隙的紧插入任务上成功率达 60%，多部件装配和拧螺丝成功率超 50%。
Conclusion: 玩耍预训练获得的通用操作先验可有效加速精密装配学习，并实现零样本迁移。未来可探索更广泛的接触丰富任务。

papers.title: Rethinking Training & Inference for Forecasting: Linking Winner-Take-All back to GMMs
papers.abstract_en: Trajectory forecasting for autonomous driving has advanced rapidly, yet representative models often produce uninformative posteriors over forecast modes, causing problems for mode pruning. We trace this to a modeling-training mismatch: forecasters are typically modeled as conditional Gaussian mixture models (GMMs) but trained with a winner-take-all (WTA) loss that assigns each sample to its nearest mode. We argue that this K-means-like hard assignment (one-hot), while preventing mode collapse, is the source of uninformative mode probabilities: it over-segments the trajectory space, ignores relatedness among nearby modes, and yields assignment instability under small perturbations. Guided by this lens, we introduce two post-hoc treatments: (1) test-time posterior-weighted merging that aggregates nearby candidate trajectories; and (2) a one-step expectation-maximization (EM) update that replaces hard labels with soft responsibilities, sharing probability mass across neighboring modes. Across several WTA-trained architectures, these lightweight steps produce more informative, faithfully ranked mode posteriors and strengthen final forecasts on popular displacement metrics -- without retraining. Our analysis unifies recent design choices through a GMM-vs-K-means perspective and offers principled, practical corrections that better align training objectives with inference.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文指出轨迹预测模型使用 winner-take-all (WTA) 损失训练条件高斯混合模型 (GMM) 会导致模式后验无信息，提出两种测试时后处理：聚合邻近轨迹和后验加权 EM 更新，以得到更可靠的模式概率，并在多个 WTA 训练架构上提升位移指标。
Motivation: 现有 WTA 训练产生硬分配（类似 K-means），导致模式后验不可靠，影响裁剪和最终预测。
Method: 提出测试时后处理：1) 后验加权合并邻近轨迹；2) 单步 EM 更新，用软责任替代硬标签。
Result: 在不重训练情况下，方法在多个 WTA 训练架构上提升了位移指标，产生更信息量的模式后验。
Conclusion: GMM 与 K-means 视角统一了近期设计选择，为对齐训练与推理提供了原理性修正。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: CoStream: Composing Simple Behaviors for Generalizable Complex Manipulation
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon, contact-rich complex manipulation tasks, such as seating a GPU into a PCIe slot, demand both millimeter high precision and out-of-the-box generalization to new tasks. Existing paradigms struggle to satisfy both: classical pipelines use brittle, task-specific interfaces to achieve high-precision control but require costly pipeline redesigns to adapt to new tasks, whereas monolithic end-to-end policies provide better generalization but lack high precision on complex, out-of-distribution tasks unless retrained with new data. Both paradigms share an implicit assumption: once a manipulation capability is acquired, it must be deployed as a rigid pipeline or monolithic whole, rather than being freely decomposed and recomposed. In this paper, we show that complex manipulation capabilities can emerge naturally from the composition of simple, independent behaviors. Rather than deploying a monolithic policy or a rigid pipeline, we propose \ourshort, a framework orchestrating foundation models and diverse sensing modalities into multiple composable core behaviors: a semantic behavior extracting spatial constraints via foundation models; a predictive behavior forecasting trajectories by tracking keypoints in imagined videos; and a reactive behavior providing high-frequency tactile and force corrections. On a shared $SE(3)$ interface, these outputs compose by right-multiplication into a single pose command at each control step, executed by a compliant controller. We demonstrate \ourshort on 8 real-world tasks spanning everyday manipulation and precision assembly, with the strongest gains in contact-rich assembly and object transfer, and show robust recovery from manual perturbations during execution. {Website:} https://costream-simple.github.io
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 CoStream 框架，通过组合简单独立的行为（语义行为、预测行为、反应行为）来实现复杂的长时序接触-rich操作任务（如将 GPU 插入 PCIe 插槽）。这些行为在共享的 SE(3) 接口上通过右乘法组合成单个位姿命令，并由柔顺控制器执行。在 8 个真实世界任务上展示了对接触-rich装配和物体转移的显著改进，并能从手动扰动中稳健恢复。
Motivation: 现有范式要么使用脆弱且任务特定的经典流程实现高精度但难以泛化到新任务，要么使用端到端策略实现良好泛化但缺乏高精度。两种范式都隐含假设操作能力一旦获得就必须作为刚性流水线或整体部署，无法自由分解和重组。
Method: CoStream 框架编排基础模型和多种传感模态为三个可组合的核心行为：语义行为通过基础模型提取空间约束；预测行为通过跟踪想象视频中的关键点预测轨迹；反应行为提供高频触觉和力校正。所有行为在 SE(3) 接口上通过右乘法组合成单个控制步的位姿命令，由柔顺控制器执行。
Result: 在 8 个真实世界任务上展示了对接触-rich装配和物体转移的最强增益，并能从手动扰动中稳健恢复。
Conclusion: 复杂的操作能力可以通过简单独立行为的组合自然涌现，无需刚性流水线或整体策略。

papers.title: Estimating Uncertainty in Classifier Performance with Applications to Large Language Models and Nested Data
papers.abstract_en: Researchers increasingly use text classification--supervised models or large language models--to measure constructs from natural language, providing metrics such as recall and precision as evidence of their validity. Yet, though these metrics are point estimates subject to sampling variation, measures of uncertainty are inconsistently reported alongside them. Further, when they are reported, they are often estimated with methods that are not appropriate when relevant labelled datasets are small or performance is high. To increase and improve confidence interval reporting in the field, this paper evaluates confidence interval methods for performance metrics under conditions typical of social science text classification: small to moderate sample sizes, infrequent constructs, and texts nested within individuals. Across simulations, default methods such as the Wald interval and the basic percentile bootstrap are the least accurate, with coverage sometimes far below the nominal 95% level. Accuracy is improved with the use of Agresti-Coull, Wilson, Clopper-Pearson, and a novel pseudo-count regularized bootstrap (which is particularly relevant to the calculation of F1). When texts are nested within individuals, we demonstrate that adjustment for both effective N and the appropriate degrees of freedom is necessary for producing accurate analytic intervals. Among bootstrap intervals, the hierarchical bootstrap is more accurate than the cluster bootstrap when individuals produce a moderate number of texts but overly conservative when individuals produce only a few. By providing guidance to the field on appropriate interval estimation, we aim to improve the transparency of machine learning applications, and to encourage greater attention to the validation sample size at the design stage.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文评估了在社会科学文本分类典型条件下（小样本、低频构造、文本嵌套于个体）分类器性能指标（如召回率、精确率）的置信区间方法。模拟表明，Wald区间和基本百分位自助法准确性最差，而Agresti-Coull、Wilson、Clopper-Pearson以及一种新颖的伪计数正则化自助法（尤其适用于F1计算）准确性更高。对于嵌套文本，需调整有效样本量和自由度。
Motivation: 分类器性能指标（如召回率、精确率）是点估计，存在抽样变异，但置信区间报告不一致且方法不当，尤其当标注数据集小或性能高时。
Method: 通过模拟研究，评估多种置信区间方法（包括Wald、Agresti-Coull、Wilson、Clopper-Pearson、基本百分位自助法、伪计数正则化自助法、层次自助法等）在社会科学文本分类典型条件下的表现。
Result: 默认方法（Wald区间和基本百分位自助法）覆盖度常远低于95%；Agresti-Coull、Wilson、Clopper-Pearson和伪计数正则化自助法更准确；嵌套数据下需调整有效样本量和自由度；层次自助法在个体产生中等数量文本时更准确，但个体仅产生少量文本时过于保守。
Conclusion: 本文为领域提供了适当的区间估计指南，旨在提高机器学习应用的透明度，并鼓励在设计阶段关注验证样本量。

summary_sections.method: 通过模拟研究，评估多种置信区间方法（包括Wald、Agresti-Coull、Wilson、Clopper-Pearson、基本百分位自助法、伪计数正则化自助法、层次自助法等）在社会科学文本分类典型条件下的表现。
summary_sections.result: 默认方法（Wald区间和基本百分位自助法）覆盖度常远低于95%；Agresti-Coull、Wilson、Clopper-Pearson和伪计数正则化自助法更准确；嵌套数据下需调整有效样本量和自由度；层次自助法在个体产生中等数量文本时更准确，但个体仅产生少量文本时过于保守。
summary_sections.conclusion: 本文为领域提供了适当的区间估计指南，旨在提高机器学习应用的透明度，并鼓励在设计阶段关注验证样本量。

papers.title: Otter Weather: Skillful and Computationally Efficient Medium-Range Weather Forecasting
papers.abstract_en: State-of-the-art medium-range AI weather models can outperform traditional Numerical Weather Prediction (NWP) but require massive training budgets. This restricts usage for under-resourced groups and severely limits fast model iteration. Here we develop Otter Weather, a highly efficient spatiotemporal forecasting model designed to democratise high-performance weather prediction with AI. Evaluated on ERA5 reanalysis data at 1.5° resolution using standard WeatherBench protocols, the Otter family significantly advances the skill-compute Pareto frontier. The deterministic version outperforms the best NWP baseline by 9.6% at a 24-hour lead time while requiring fewer than 3.5 A100-days for training. It provides a 2x efficiency gain over lightweight AI models and a 100-fold reduction in compute compared to resource-intensive frontier architectures. We extend these efficiency gains into probabilistic forecasting by training via the Continuous Ranked Probability Score (CRPS). Scaling to a larger architecture, Otter-XL achieves a 9.7% CRPS improvement over the IFS ENS baseline. This yields an almost two-fold increase in predictive skill over comparable lightweight models at similar compute budgets. Otter-XL also outperforms frontier architectures like GenCast by over 2%, while using an order of magnitude less compute. Finally, Otter is applied out-of-the-box to a complex acoustic scattering PDE task where it outperforms a state-of-the-art foundation modelling approach, suggesting that the advances made here might apply across a range of scientific domains.

papers.title: Unbiased Canonical Set-Valued Oracles Via Lattice Theory
papers.abstract_en: A non-agentic "oracle" AI that estimates probabilities of future events faces a self-reference problem: once its answer is learned and acted upon, it can change the very probability it was asked to report. One response, advocated for the Scientist AI programme, is to ask only counterfactual questions, evaluated as if the answer had no influence. We observe that such answers tend to become irrelevant the moment they are learned, precisely because their premise is then false. We therefore explore a self-referential alternative in which the oracle reports not a single probability but a credal set that is simultaneously unbiased and self-consistent with the consequences of being learned. The naive self-consistency requirement is satisfied by too many sets (including the useless answer $[0,1]$), so the problem is to single out a canonical, nontrivial member. We do so with the Knaster--Tarski fixed-point theorem on the complete lattice of closed credal sets, taking the least fixed point of a suitably defined isotone operator; a variant instead reports the least fixed point that contains every self-consistent point estimate. We prove existence, self-consistency, and nonemptiness, show that the construction collapses to the classical point answer for non-performative questions, and that for a binary event the canonical answer is, under a natural hull-factoring assumption, an interval. The development is purely lattice-theoretic and extends unchanged from a binary event $B$ to an arbitrary random variable $X$, with $P(B\mid A,C)$ replaced by the conditional law $\mathcal{L}(X\mid A,C)$. We close with open questions, including whether the interval characterization itself survives that generalization.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于格论的规范集合值预言机（canonical set-valued oracle）方法，解决自我指涉概率估计问题。通过Knaster–Tarski不动点定理在闭credal集完全格上取最小不动点，得到无偏且自洽的规范答案，并证明其存在性、自洽性和非空性，且对二元事件在自然凸包分解假设下退化为区间。
Motivation: 传统概率预言机面临自我指涉问题：答案被学习后会改变所预测的概率，而反事实问题又因前提虚假而失效。需要一种自洽且非平凡的概率集合回答。
Method: 在闭credal集构成的完全格上定义保序算子，利用Knaster–Tarski不动点定理取其最小不动点作为规范答案；另有一变体取包含所有自洽点估计的最小不动点。整个构造基于纯格论，可从二元事件推广到任意随机变量。
Result: 证明了规范credal集的存在性、自洽性和非空性；对于非表演性问题（non-performative），构造退化为经典点估计；二元事件在自然凸包分解假设下，规范答案是一个区间。
Conclusion: 该格论框架提供了一种无偏且自洽的自我指涉预言机，但区间特性在推广到一般随机变量后是否保持尚为开放问题。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Methane-Plume Segmentation From Hyperspectral Satellite Imagery Via Multimodal Deep Learning
papers.abstract_en: Efficient detection of methane plumes is crucial for understanding and mitigating global warming, as accurately identifying and segmenting them in earth observation imagery remain essential for large-scale monitoring. In this work, we propose a multimodal deep learning model that integrates a feature-guided methane enhancement (FGME) mechanism which injects physically meaningful methane cues into transformer-based RGB representations at multiple semantic scales. Our method is evaluated on the MPDataset, where it outperforms the state-of-the-art with improvements of +0.92 in MIoU, +0.87 in MPrecision and +1.01 in Recall. Notably, these gains are obtained with a substantially lower computational cost than other high-performing architectures, resulting in a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off for large-scale methane monitoring. These results highlight the potential of efficient multimodal fusion strategies for accurate and scalable methane plume segmentation in real-world remote sensing applications.
papers.comment: Accepted at IEEE International Geoscience and Remote Sensing Symposium (IGARSS) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种多模态深度学习模型，用于从高光谱卫星图像中分割甲烷羽流。该方法引入特征引导的甲烷增强 (FGME) 机制，将物理意义的甲烷线索注入到基于Transformer的RGB表示中，并在MPDataset上以较低计算成本超越了现有方法，MIoU提升0.92、Precision提升0.87、Recall提升1.01。
Motivation: 准确检测和分割甲烷羽流对大规模监测全球变暖至关重要，现有方法在精度或效率上存在不足。
Method: 提出多模态深度学习模型，包含特征引导的甲烷增强 (FGME) 机制，在不同语义尺度上将甲烷线索注入到Transformer处理的RGB图像表示中。
Result: 在MPDataset上，模型在MIoU、Precision和Recall上分别提升0.92、0.87和1.01，且计算成本显著低于其他高性能架构。
Conclusion: 高效的 multimodal 融合策略在现实遥感应用中可实现准确且可扩展的甲烷羽流分割，展示了精度与效率的良好平衡。
