papers.title: From Clicks to Intent: Cross-Platform Session Embeddings with LLM-Distilled Taxonomy for Financial Services Recommendations
papers.abstract_en: Sequential user behavior modeling is widely adopted in industrial recommender systems; however, significant gaps remain in financial services, where pre-login web interactions and authenticated in-app experiences differ drastically. Specifically, pre-login web users typically explore new products, whereas logged-in app users focus on account servicing. Due to the challenge of cross-channel entity resolution (e.g., matching anonymous web sessions to authenticated mobile accounts), web-based intent signals remain underutilized for post-authentication personalization. Existing methods for capturing web-based intent are often ad-hoc and narrow, lacking the flexibility to support both quantitative downstream recommendations and qualitative understanding at scale. In this work, we propose a scalable and dual-purpose intent prediction framework for web-based interactions and demonstrate its applicability for personalization. Our approach transforms raw web clickstreams into two outputs: a self-supervised Transformer encodes multi-modal clickstreams into a compact session embedding, while an LLM-based taxonomy generation and distillation pipeline produces interpretable intent labels. Our system demonstrates that self-supervised clickstream representations combined with LLM-distilled taxonomies can jointly serve quantitative tasks and qualitative understanding in production: on the mobile homepage tile ranking task, the session embedding improves macro Recall@1 by 1.88% and reduces Log Loss by 13.38% over production baselines. On the user conversion prediction task, the embedding outperforms the LLM labels by 4.3% on micro F1, while the distillation layer delivers interpretable labels at ultra-low latency with only a 7% performance drop.

papers.title: Equivariance and Augmentation for Bayesian Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: Symmetries are important for many deep learning tasks, ranging from applications in the sciences to medical imaging. However, there is an ongoing debate about whether to impose symmetry constraints on the neural network architecture (yielding equivariant neural networks) or learn them from augmented training data. Although equivariant networks are well-studied theoretically, much less is known about data augmentation, since analyzing augmentation requires control over the training dynamics. Inspired by recent results that show that augmented infinite deep ensembles are exactly equivariant, we study data augmentation for Bayesian neural networks (BNNs) trained with variational inference. We focus on variational distributions in the exponential family and derive conditions under which exact equivariance is reached. We furthermore obtain bounds on the equivariance error and introduce three novel symmetrization techniques which boost the effect of data augmentation in this setting. We conduct extensive numerical experiments which show that one of our symmetrization methods (orbit expansion) outperforms the baseline in both equivariance and overall performance. Our code is available at github.com/dmw1998/augment-BNNs
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究贝叶斯神经网络（BNN）中数据增强能否达到精确等变性。作者针对指数族变分分布推导了精确等变的条件，给出等变误差的界限，并提出了三种新的对称化技术来增强数据增强效果。实验表明轨道扩展（orbit expansion）方法在等变性和整体性能上均优于基线。
Motivation: 对称性在深度学习中重要，但关于是使用等变网络还是数据增强存在争议。数据增强的理论分析较少，本文旨在弥补这一空白，研究贝叶斯神经网络中数据增强的等变性。
Method: 聚焦于使用变分推断训练的BNN，考虑指数族变分分布，推导精确等变的条件，并推导等变误差的界限。提出三种对称化技术：轨道扩展等。
Result: 实验表明轨道扩展方法在等变性和整体性能上均优于基线。
Conclusion: 本文为BNN中数据增强的等变性提供了理论分析和实用方法，代码已开源。

papers.title: Accelerating Skill Assessment in Chess: A Drift-Diffusion-Enhanced Elo Rating System
papers.abstract_en: Rating systems such as Elo serve as the gold standard for matchmaking in competitive chess. However, they inherently suffer from response lag due to their exclusive reliance on match outcomes, neglecting the granular quality of gameplay. Nevertheless, incorporating move-by-move information into rating adjustments presents a significant challenge given the substantial noise and the vastness of the game-state space. To address this, we propose the Drift-Diffusion-Enhanced Elo Rating System (DD-Elo), a novel skill assessment framework inspired by the drift diffusion model (DDM) from cognitive neuroscience. By modeling skill expression as a decision-making process, our model integrates move-level data to capture rapid skill fluctuations. We provide a rigorous mathematical derivation proving that DD-Elo maintains a bounded deviation from the traditional Elo system, ensuring theoretical alignment. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DD-Elo adapts to skill changes faster than Elo. Our findings suggest that DD-Elo offers an explainable, highly responsive, and backward-compatible solution for chess rating ecosystems. The implementation code is publicly available at https://github.com/Aquila-zhou1/DD-Elo .
papers.comment: Accepted at the IEEE Conference on Games (IEEE CoG) 2026
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于漂移扩散模型（DDM）的增强版Elo评级系统（DD-Elo），通过整合棋局中每一步的移动级数据来加速技能评估。理论证明DD-Elo与标准Elo系统的偏差有界，实验表明其对技能变化的适应速度更快。代码已开源。
Motivation: 传统Elo评级系统仅依赖比赛结果，无法利用比赛过程中的移动级信息，导致响应滞后。移动级数据噪声大且状态空间庞大，难以直接整合。
Method: 受认知神经科学中的漂移扩散模型启发，将技能表达建模为决策过程，并融入移动级数据以捕捉技能快速波动。提供了严格的数学推导，保证与Elo系统的偏差有界。
Result: 实验表明DD-Elo比标准Elo系统更快地适应技能变化，且具有可解释性、高响应性和向后兼容性。
Conclusion: DD-Elo为国际象棋评级生态系统提供了一个可解释、高响应且向后兼容的解决方案。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: A multi-task spatiotemporal deep neural network for predicting penetration depth and morphology in laser welding
papers.abstract_en: In laser penetration welding, the assessment of penetration state and weld seam morphology plays a crucial role in determining the weld quality. This paper presents a comprehensive introduction of the innovative muti-task deep learning model that has the capability to predict penetration state, depth, and weld seam morphology with high accuracy. The monitoring platform relies on weld pool images captured during the laser welding process using a complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor camera. The proposed model integrates spatiotemporal features extracted from top weld pool images along with welding parameters, establishing a deep learning framework based on convolutional neural networks and state space models for more efficient extraction and processing of spatial-temporal information. Furthermore, a reliable method for constructing the dataset is proposed to enhance both robustness and generalization capability of the developed model. Validation results on the test set demonstrate that prediction accuracy for penetration state can reach 99.35%, while prediction error for penetration depth is 1.79 millimeter, and accuracy of reconstructing the weld cross-section is 95.65%. This study provides new insights and methodologies for in-situ quality control strategies in laser penetration welding systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种多任务深度学习模型，利用激光焊接过程中的熔池图像和焊接参数，预测熔透状态、深度和焊缝形态。模型结合卷积神经网络和状态空间模型提取时空特征，并构建可靠的数据集以增强鲁棒性。在测试集上，熔透状态预测准确率达99.35%，熔透深度预测误差1.79毫米，焊缝横截面重建准确率95.65%。
Motivation: 激光穿透焊接中，熔透状态和焊缝形貌的评估对焊接质量至关重要，现有方法难以同时高精度预测多项关键指标。
Method: 提出多任务深度学习模型，集成从顶部熔池图像提取的时空特征与焊接参数，基于卷积神经网络和状态空间模型构建框架，并引入可靠的数据集构建方法提升泛化能力。
Result: 熔透状态预测准确率99.35%，熔透深度预测误差1.79毫米，焊缝横截面重建准确率95.65%。
Conclusion: 该研究为激光穿透焊接系统的原位质量控制提供了新方法和思路。

papers.title: Dataset Usage Inference without Shadow Models or Held-out Data
papers.abstract_en: How much of my data was used to train a machine learning model? Dataset Usage Inference (DUI) aims to answer this by estimating what fraction of a dataset contributed to a model's training. However, existing DUI methods rely on assumptions that rarely hold in practice: they require training expensive shadow models to imitate the target model, and they assume access to both known training samples and an in-distribution held-out set confirmed to be absent from training. These conditions make current approaches impractical for modern large models and real data ownership disputes. We introduce a practical DUI framework that removes these constraints. Our method requires neither shadow models nor real held-out data. Instead, it generates synthetic non-member samples, extracts diverse membership signals, and casts DUI as a mixture proportion estimation problem to estimate what share of the candidate dataset was used during training. Experiments on large image generative models show that our method reliably quantifies dataset usage, providing a practical tool for data owners to determine how much of their data was used to train a model.
papers.comment: Accepted at the 2nd Workshop on Synthetic & Adversarial ForEnsics (SAFE), CVPR 2026 (non-archival)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对数据集使用推断（DUI）问题，提出一种无需影子模型和保留数据的实用框架。通过生成合成非成员样本、提取多样成员信号，并将DUI建模为混合比例估计问题，实现了对候选数据集使用比例的估计。实验在大型图像生成模型上验证了方法的有效性。
Motivation: 现有DUI方法依赖不现实的假设，如训练昂贵的影子模型和需要已知训练样本及同分布保留数据，限制了在大模型和数据所有权纠纷中的实用性。
Method: 提出无需影子模型或真实保留数据的DUI框架：生成合成非成员样本，提取多样成员信号，并将DUI转化为混合比例估计（mixture proportion estimation）问题。
Result: 在大型图像生成模型上的实验表明，该方法能可靠地量化数据集使用情况。
Conclusion: 该方法为数据所有者提供了实用工具，以确定其数据在训练模型中的使用比例。

papers.title: Lacuna: A Research Map for Machine Learning
papers.abstract_en: Lacuna is a research map for machine learning that uses LLMs to turn papers and scholarly metadata into markdown summaries, concept elements, research directions, and research proposals. Each item keeps links to the primary source records and papers that support it. We release the map with web, markdown, and MCP interfaces. Across LitSearch, Multi-XScience-CS/ML, and ScholarQA-CS-ML, Lacuna outperforms OpenScholar with the strongest gains on LitSearch retrieval (Recall@10 0.538 vs. 0.424 for OpenScholar v3). We also evaluate Lacuna Deep Research, a multi-stage report agent over the map, on 25 ReportBench-ML survey tasks: Lacuna Deep Research reaches 0.052 citation F1, 0.339 citation precision, 99 expert-reference hits, and 7.82/10 RACE report quality, while GPT-Researcher reaches 0.039 F1, 0.290 precision, 72 hits, and 5.24/10 RACE.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: Lacuna 是一个机器学习研究图谱，利用大语言模型将论文和元数据转换为摘要、概念元素、研究方向和研究提案，并提供网页、Markdown 和 MCP 接口。在 LitSearch、Multi-XScience-CS/ML 和 ScholarQA-CS-ML 基准上，Lacuna 超越 OpenScholar，尤其在 LitSearch 检索上 Recall@10 达 0.538 对比 0.424。此外，Lacuna Deep Research 在 25 个 ReportBench-ML 调查任务上达到 0.052 的 citation F1、0.339 的 citation precision、99 次专家参考命中以及 7.82/10 的 RACE 报告质量。
Motivation: 现有的学术文献检索和综述工具在覆盖范围和准确性上存在局限，尤其对于快速发展的机器学习领域，需要一种系统化的图谱来整合和生成研究内容。
Method: 使用 LLM 将论文和元数据转化为结构化摘要、概念元素、研究方向和研究提案，并构建一个多接口（网页、Markdown、MCP）的研究图谱，同时开发了多阶段报告代理 Lacuna Deep Research 用于生成调查报告。
Result: 在 LitSearch 检索上，Lacuna 的 Recall@10 为 0.538，显著高于 OpenScholar v3 的 0.424；在 ReportBench-ML 上，Lacuna Deep Research 的 citation F1 为 0.052，citation precision 为 0.339，专家参考命中 99 次，RACE 报告质量 7.82/10，均优于 GPT-Researcher。
Conclusion: Lacuna 作为研究图谱工具能有效提升文献检索和综述生成的质量，但评估仅限于特定基准，其在不同领域的泛化能力有待进一步验证。

papers.title: Rendering Novel Views of MRI Using 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.abstract_en: The objective of this paper is to improve radiological gradings measured on MRIs of spines, by resampling scans so that the new view planes are better aligned with the target anatomy than the original sparse images. To this end, we adapt 3D Gaussian Splatting to form a volumetric reconstruction starting from sparse anisotropic MRIs, and imaging planes aligned with the anatomy relevant for clinical evaluation are then sampled and rendered. The novel view plane is optimal for diagnostic radiological grading of the target anatomy, whereas the original MRI is not. The resampled scans are then used to predict ordinal severity grades of localised stenosis conditions in spinal MRIs. We compare our method against Voxel Interpolation resampling, which takes the average of inverse-distance weighted nearest neighbour intensities for each target coordinate. Experiments show that across all stenosis conditions, resampled scans using Gaussian Splatting produce more accurate stenosis gradings compared to the raw scans which do not include the complete anatomy in-plane, as well as images resampled using Voxel Interpolation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文通过适应3D高斯泼溅（3D Gaussian Splatting）从稀疏各向异性MRI中构建容积重建，并采样与临床评估相关解剖结构对齐的成像平面，用于脊柱狭窄分级。实验表明该方法比体素插值重采样产生更准确的狭窄分级。

papers.title: Interpreting "Interpretability" and Explaining "Explainability" in Machine Learning in Physics
papers.abstract_en: We review the concepts of interpretability and explainability as they apply to machine learning in physics. We define interpretability as concerning the structural transparency of a model (the ability to understand or approximate its inner workings) and explainability as concerning the scientific content of a model (the ability to map it onto domain knowledge). We discuss the trade-offs each entails (interpretability vs. expressivity; explainability vs. adaptability), the contexts in which each is needed, and the intrinsic and post-hoc tools available for achieving them. Throughout, we emphasize that machine-learned models are subject to the same scientific questions as classical models, differing only in scale, and that interpretability and explainability are best understood as deliberate modeling choices rather than inherent properties. We also emphasize the importance of task specification and intervention plans as a core aspect of model design.
papers.comment: 31 pages, 3 figures, Part of the VERaiPHY Initiative
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文综述了机器学习在物理学中的可解释性（interpretability）和可解释性（explainability）概念，将其分别定义为模型的结构透明性和科学内容映射能力，并讨论了各自的权衡、应用场景及实现工具，强调这些是建模选择而非固有属性。
Motivation: 机器学习在物理学中广泛应用，但其可解释性和可解释性概念缺乏统一的定义和边界，导致误解和混淆。
Method: 通过文献综述和概念辨析，明确区分了可解释性（结构透明性）与可解释性（科学内容映射），并分析其与表达性、适应性之间的权衡，以及内在工具和事后工具的应用。
Result: 提出可解释性和可解释性应视为有意识的设计选择，而非模型固有属性；强调任务规范与干预计划在模型设计中的核心作用。
Conclusion: 机器学习模型与经典模型面临相同的科学问题，仅规模不同；理解可解释性与可解释性对推动物理发现至关重要。

papers.title: Fast LeWorldModel
papers.abstract_en: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs), including recent LeWorldModel (LeWM), have become a promising foundation for reconstruction-free visual world models. For visual planning, however, LeWM evaluates candidate action sequences by repeatedly applying a local one-step latent transition model. This autoregressive rollout makes planning computationally expensive and exposes the predicted trajectory to accumulated latent errors as the horizon grows. We propose Fast LeWorldModel (Fast-LeWM), a fast latent world model that replaces repeated local rollout with action-prefix prediction. Given the current latent and a candidate action sequence, Fast-LeWM encodes its prefixes and predicts the future latents reached after executing those prefixes in parallel. By making action prefixes the basic prediction unit, Fast-LeWM directly models action effects accumulated to different extents over multiple horizons. This prefix-level supervision forces the model to learn how states continuously evolve under different action prefixes, rather than only fitting one-step state transitions. During planning, the predictor can use the last prefix token from the encoded action sequence to evaluate the corresponding future latent without explicitly rolling through each intermediate imagined state. Across multiple tasks, Fast-LeWM improves average success over LeWM while substantially reducing planning time, achieving lower open-loop latent loss whose growth becomes significantly slower as the rollout horizon increases.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Fast-LeWM，一种快速潜在世界模型，用于改进LeWorldModel（LeWM）在视觉规划中的效率。通过将局部逐步展开替换为动作前缀并行预测，Fast-LeWM直接建模多步动作累积效应，降低规划时间和累积潜在误差。实验显示较LeWM提升平均成功率并显著减少规划时间。
Motivation: LeWM使用自回归逐步展开评估动作序列，计算成本高且长视界下潜误差累积。
Method: 使用动作前缀预测，编码候选动作序列的前缀并并行预测到达的未来潜在状态，以前缀级监督学习状态演化。
Result: 摘要报告多个任务上平均成功率优于LeWM，规划时间大幅减少，开环损失更低且随视界增长更慢。
Conclusion: 动作前缀预测有效替代逐步展开，减少规划成本与误差累积。

papers.title: CyberChainBench: Can AI Agents Secure Smart Contracts Against Real-World On-Chain Vulnerabilities?
papers.abstract_en: We present CyberChainBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLM-based agents on smart contract security across three complementary tasks: vulnerability detection, exploit generation, and patch synthesis. Built from 541 real-world exploit incidents from DeFiHackLabs spanning 9 EVM chains, the benchmark provides end-to-end on-chain evaluation where agents interact with historical blockchain state through isolated evaluation environments orchestrated by Harbor, using tools to read code, trace transactions, and validate exploits on mainnet forks. Each case is anchored to a specific block and includes structured ground truth covering vulnerability type, localization, and attacker profit. Exploits are graded by economic impact on historical forks; patches are validated by replaying historical attacks and legitimate transactions as fail-to-pass test oracles on a proxy-upgradeable subset. We define a five-type vulnerability taxonomy and evaluate multiple agent--model configurations. Results reveal a clear difficulty gradient: the best configuration scores 37.5% on detection, 43.7% on exploitation, but only 23.4% on patching, with the top agent (Codex with GPT-5.5) realizing \$57.4M in total exploit profit across the 200-case exploit set at a cost of $2.39 per case.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: CyberChainBench 是一个评估基于 LLM 的智能体在智能合约安全方面的基准，包含漏洞检测、漏洞利用生成和补丁合成三个互补任务。该基准基于 DeFiHackLabs 中 541 个真实世界漏洞事件，覆盖 9 条 EVM 链，提供端到端链上评估环境，智能体通过 Harbor 隔离环境与历史区块链状态交互。漏洞利用按历史分叉的经济影响评分，补丁通过重放历史攻击和合法交易验证。评估多个智能体-模型配置，最佳配置在检测、利用和补丁上的得分分别为 37.5%、43.7% 和 23.4%，顶级智能体 Codex with GPT-5.5 在 200 个案例中实现了 5740 万美元的总利用利润，每案例成本 2.39 美元。
Motivation: 智能合约安全漏洞导致重大经济损失，现有基准缺乏端到端链上评估和真实世界漏洞覆盖。
Method: 构建包含 541 个真实漏洞事件的基准，使用 Harbor 隔离评估环境，提供结构化 ground truth，定义五类漏洞分类法，通过经济影响评分和历史攻击重放验证。
Result: 最佳配置检测得分 37.5%，利用得分 43.7%，补丁得分 23.4%；顶级智能体 (Codex with GPT-5.5) 实现 5740 万美元利用利润，每案例成本 2.39 美元。
Conclusion: 当前 AI 智能体在智能合约安全任务上存在明显难度梯度，补丁合成最困难，提示未来改进方向。

papers.title: TaskNPoint: How to Teach Your Humanoid to Hit a Backhand in Minutes
papers.abstract_en: How do we learn to hit a tennis backhand? Not from a thousand hours of tennis tournaments on TV - we work with a coach and practice. We argue this is also the right recipe for teaching dynamic skills to humanoid robots. This follows from a structural property of dynamic skills: the outcome is decided by a short, crucial portion of the trajectory - for a backhand, the ~20cm of racket travel around ball contact. Getting this interaction window right requires coordinating the whole motion, so that control, physics, and morphology act in concert. Learning thus reduces to mastering a handful of distinct actions and, for each, practicing until the window comes out right. To this end, we introduce TaskNPoint, a training protocol which makes the coach-learner division of labor explicit. The human coach contributes four inputs: a discrete set of skills (e.g. different shots), one demonstration per skill, identification of the interaction window, and the goal. Learning in a physically realistic simulation environment fills in each action trajectory and provides robustness to unmodeled events. Crucially, randomized target sampling during training lets a single demonstration generalize zero-shot to unseen goal locations. We test this approach on a Unitree G1 humanoid that hits forehands and backhands against balls thrown by a human, kicks incoming soccer balls, and picks and places boxes from novel locations. We find that learning is successful from short human video demonstrations and under an hour of training on a single GPU, with no per-task reward tuning.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出TaskNPoint训练协议，让人类教练提供技能集合、单次演示、交互窗口和目标，人形机器人在仿真中学习动态技能。实验显示Unitree G1人形机器人能在单个GPU上不到一小时内学会正手、反手击球、踢球和抓取等技能，无需每任务奖励调参。
Motivation: 现有机器人技能学习方法需要大量数据或复杂奖励设计，而人类学习动态技能往往通过教练指导少量练习。本文希望模拟这种教练-学习者分工，使人形机器人高效掌握动态技能。
Method: TaskNPoint协议：人类教练输入离散技能集、每个技能一次演示、交互窗口和目标；仿真环境学习完整动作轨迹，并通过随机目标采样实现零样本泛化。
Result: 在物理仿真中，Unitree G1人形机器人成功学会多种动态技能（网球正反手、足球踢球、抓取），总训练时间不到一小时（单GPU），无需每任务奖励调参。
Conclusion: 摘要强调该方法利用关键交互窗口和一次演示，结合仿真学习，使动态技能学习高效且泛化，为现实机器人教学提供一种新范式。

papers.title: A General Framework for Learning Algebraic Properties from Cayley Graphs using Graph Neural Networks
papers.abstract_en: A Graph Neural Network (GNN) framework for predicting the solvability of finite groups from their Cayley graph representations was introduced in [1]. In the present work, we generalize this approach and develop a property-independent framework for learning algebraic properties of finite groups directly from Cayley graphs. As representative case studies, we consider abelianity, nilpotency, and solvability. Using a common GNN architecture and training pipeline, we investigate the extent to which algebraic structure can be recovered from graph-based representations alone. Results on a collection of finite groups drawn from several families demonstrate that the framework successfully learns and distinguishes multiple algebraic properties from their associated Cayley graphs. These findings suggest that substantial algebraic information is encoded in graph representations and can be extracted through GNNs. More broadly, the proposed framework provides a proof of concept for applying graph representation learning to the study of algebraic properties of finite groups.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个通用框架，利用图神经网络从Cayley图中学习有限群的代数性质，如可解性、阿贝尔性和幂零性。实验表明，该框架能从图表示中有效区分多种代数性质，证明图表示中编码了丰富的代数信息。
Motivation: 现有方法仅针对特定代数性质（如可解性），缺乏通用框架；旨在探究从图表示中提取代数信息的可能性。
Method: 提出一个与具体性质无关的GNN框架，通过统一的架构和训练流程，直接从Cayley图中预测群的多个代数性质。
Result: 在来自多个群族的有限群数据集上，该框架成功学习并区分了阿贝尔性、幂零性和可解性。
Conclusion: 研究表明Cayley图表示编码了丰富的代数信息，GNN可有效提取，为图表示学习在代数性质研究中的应用提供了概念验证。

papers.title: The Role of Input Dimensionality in the Emergence and Targeted Control of Adversarial Examples
papers.abstract_en: Several theoretical works have tried to explain the adversarial vulnerability of deep neural networks through properties of high-dimensional geometry. However, the assumptions underlying these works are rarely examined empirically, and systematic evidence remains limited. In this work, we present a systematic study of the role of input dimensionality in both the emergence and the targeted control of adversarial examples. We first analyse the scope and limitations of existing theoretical frameworks based on concentration of measure, showing that real image classes exhibit strong empirical localization, beyond what such theories typically assume. We then conduct an extensive empirical evaluation across hierarchical image datasets spanning a wide range of input dimensionalities and diverse neural architectures. Our results consistently show that adversarial examples become easier to construct as dimensionality increases. We also investigate how input dimensionality affects the additional difficulty of crafting targeted adversarial examples. In particular, we provide theoretical arguments showing that high-dimensional geometry implies that enforcing a specific target label entails only a limited additional distortion compared to untargeted attacks. We corroborate this insight through extensive experiments, demonstrating that the gap between targeted and untargeted perturbations remains small and further narrows as input dimensionality increases. While, taken together, our findings establish high input dimensionality as a fundamental factor underlying the emergence and targeted control of adversarial examples, whether this phenomenon primarily arises from the interplay between high-dimensional geometry and data distributions or from the architectural properties of deep neural networks remains an open question.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统研究了输入维度在对抗样本产生和定向控制中的作用。通过分析基于测度集中的现有理论框架，发现真实图像类具有强经验局部化特性，超出理论假设。在多种维度层次和神经网络架构上的实验表明，对抗样本随维度增加更易构造，且定向攻击所需额外扰动很小，差距随维度增加进一步缩小。
Motivation: 现有对抗脆弱性理论基于高维几何假设，但缺乏系统的实证检验，尤其是真实数据分布的局部化特性未被充分考虑。
Method: 首先分析现有测度集中理论框架的适用范围和局限，然后在跨越不同输入维度层次的分级图像数据集和多种神经网络架构上进行广泛的实证评估，并给出理论论证高维几何下定向攻击的额外扰动有限。
Result: 实验一致表明高输入维度使对抗样本更容易构造；定向攻击与无定向攻击的扰动差距很小，且随维度增加进一步缩小。
Conclusion: 高输入维度是对抗样本产生和定向控制的基础因素，但其根本原因（高维几何与数据分布的交互，还是网络架构属性）仍是开放问题。

papers.title: Knowledge-augmented Agentic AI for Mental Health Medication Information Seeking
papers.abstract_en: Patients increasingly seek medication information online, yet safety knowledge for psychiatric drugs is split between regulatory adverse-event records, which are authoritative but abstract, and patient narratives, which are experience-near but unvalidated. Integrating them without conflating evidence and anecdote is especially consequential in psychiatry, where poorly contextualised information can amplify fear, nocebo responses, and non-adherence. Here we develop a provenance-aware, knowledge-graph-based multi-agent framework unifying 466,525 Reddit posts, 60,782 WebMD reviews, and twenty years of U.S. FDA Adverse Event Reporting System records for nine antidepressants. A large-language-model entity-recognition pipeline benchmarked against physician annotations reached highest F1 scores of 0.969 for medications and 0.973 for conditions. The two community platforms were far more concordant with each other (overlap up to a Jaccard similarity of 0.905) than with regulatory reports, indicating that patient-generated data form a partly independent safety signal. For sertraline, many adverse events appeared in community sources hundreds of days before the corresponding FDA date. A Neo4j knowledge graph grounded in ATC-N, ICD-10, and MedDRA vocabularies preserves provenance, keeping every claim traceable and regulatory facts distinct from patient experience. These results establish source-aware integration as a route to more auditable psychiatric medication information, with usefulness and patient benefit to be tested prospectively.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对精神健康药物信息获取中权威监管记录与患者叙述难以整合的问题，开发了一个基于知识图谱的多智能体框架，统一处理FDA不良事件报告、Reddit帖子及WebMD评论。摘要显示，患者生成数据与监管报告间存在低一致性，且社区来源能更早发现药物不良反应信号。该框架通过保留数据血缘，实现了可追溯的药物信息检索。
Motivation: 精神科药物信息分散于权威但抽象的监管记录和经验性但未经验证的患者叙述中，不当整合会加剧患者的恐惧、反安慰剂效应及非依从性，亟需一种能区分证据与轶闻的来源感知集成方法。
Method: 提出一个基于知识图谱的多智能体框架，利用LLM实体识别管线（经医生标注基准评测）整合三个来源的数据：466,525条Reddit帖子、60,782条WebMD评论及20年美国FDA不良事件报告系统记录，并以ATC-N、ICD-10及MedDRA词汇标准建立知识图谱，保留每条事实的来源信息。
Result: 实体识别管线的最高F1分数分别为药物0.969、疾病0.973。两大社区平台间的数据一致性（Jaccard相似度最高0.905）远高于它们与监管报告间的一致性。对于舍曲林，许多不良事件在社区来源中出现的时间比FDA记录早数百天。
Conclusion: 本文表明，来源感知的集成方式是可审计的精神科药物信息检索的有效途径，但其实际有用性和患者获益还需前瞻性试验验证。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Topology-Informed Neural Networks for Flood Detection in Optical and Synthetic Aperture Radar Imagery
papers.abstract_en: Floods frequently impact regions around the world. Rapid and accurate flood detection is crucial for emergency response and timely mitigation of human and economic loss. The expanding availability of satellite data and advances in artificial intelligence have enhanced monitoring of environmental hazards, but many flood events remain challenging to detect because cloud cover obscures optical satellite imagery. Rambour et al. introduced the SEN12-FLOOD dataset and extracted per-image features using a ResNet-50 convolutional neural network backbone, then fed these features into a gated recurrent unit network to show that temporal information can substantially improve accuracy compared to single-image baselines. More recently, Chamatidis et al. showed that a vision transformer can achieve strong performance with popular convolutional architectures. However, these models typically function as opaque black boxes, making it difficult to interpret their decision boundaries, learned features, and internal reasoning, especially in safety-critical domains like remote sensing. In contrast, topological data analysis (TDA) provides a mathematically grounded framework for capturing global structural features of data. TDA has emerged as a powerful tool for analyzing complex imagery, especially imagery with geometrically interpretable structures, of which floods are a prime candidate. In this work, we systematically evaluate topological descriptors for flood detection using the open-source SEN12-FLOOD dataset. By extracting topological features from each image and incorporating them into neural networks, we demonstrate that topological descriptors carry meaningful flood signals independently and complement existing networks to yield more robust and interpretable flood detection systems.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统评估拓扑数据描述符（topological descriptors）在洪水检测中的有效性，基于SEN12-FLOOD数据集。通过从光学和SAR图像中提取拓扑特征并融入神经网络，证明拓扑描述符携带独立的洪水信号，能够补充现有网络，提升检测的鲁棒性和可解释性。
Motivation: 现有洪水检测深度模型通常是黑箱，缺乏可解释性，尤其在安全关键的遥感领域。拓扑数据分析（TDA）能捕捉数据的全局结构特征，适用于几何可解释的洪水图像，但尚未被系统评估。
Method: 从SEN12-FLOOD数据集的每张图像中提取拓扑特征，将其与ResNet-50等神经网络特征结合，比较不同拓扑描述符（如持续性图）的独立与互补性能。
Result: 摘要显示拓扑特征携带独立的洪水信号，并能增强现有网络（如CNN、Transformer）的检测准确率和稳健性。
Conclusion: 拓扑描述符为洪水检测提供了可解释且有效的补充信息，有利于构建更鲁棒的系统。
Relevance: 30

papers.title: Agentic Analysis for Agentic Infrastructure: An LLM-Powered Pipeline for Comparative Governance of DAO and Corporate AI Protocols
papers.abstract_en: As AI agent protocols proliferate, the governance structures shaping their interoperability standards remain empirically underexamined. We introduce an LLM-powered comparative pipeline for large-scale governance discourse analysis, integrating automated annotation, neural topic modeling, and multi-layer network analysis to study socio-technical power structures at scale. We validate it on two contrasting standards for agent interoperability: ERC-8004 (permissionless, on-chain) and Google A2A (corporate-led). Analyzing 4,323 governance participation records, we combine LLM-assisted coding, topic modeling, and multi-layer network analysis to examine how institutional design shapes thematic priorities and community structure. We find that while governance form influences substantive focus, both regimes exhibit comparable levels of participation inequality and community fragmentation. Discourse alignment is denser in the permissionless setting, suggesting that open governance may foster greater thematic convergence despite decentralized participation. These findings illustrate how LLM-assisted methods can advance the empirical study of technology governance, with implications for designing more equitable agentic AI standards. All data and code are openly available.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于LLM的比较分析管道，用于大规模治理话语分析，整合自动注释、神经主题建模和多层网络分析。以ERC-8004（无许可链上）和Google A2A（公司主导）两种代理互操作性标准为例，分析4323条治理参与记录。发现治理形式影响实质性主题，但两种体制在参与不平等和社区碎片化程度上相似。无许可设置中话语对齐更密集，表明开放治理可能促进主题趋同。
Motivation: 现有AI代理协议治理结构在实证上研究不足，缺乏大规模比较分析工具。
Method: 提出LLM辅助的比较分析管道，包括LLM辅助编码、主题建模和多层网络分析，应用于ERC-8004和Google A2A的治理记录。
Result: 两种体制参与不平等和社区碎片化程度相似，但无许可设置中话语对齐更密集。
Conclusion: LLM辅助方法可推进技术治理的实证研究，为设计更公平的代理AI标准提供启示。

papers.title: Statistical and Structural Approaches to Algorithmic Fairness
papers.abstract_en: Modern machine learning systems have outgrown their origins as isolated predictive constructs, evolving into complex socio-technical architectures that actively mediate human opportunity. As algorithms increasingly determine access to economic and social opportunities, it has become widely recognized that these systems are deeply embedded with the structural inequalities and prejudices of their environments. The field of algorithmic fairness emerged in response to the growing recognition that models optimized for predictive accuracy can systematically disadvantage marginalized groups. Early mitigation strategies, however, rested on fragile simplifications that limited their effectiveness in complex socio-technical environments. This thesis identifies and addresses two fundamental limitations of contemporary fairness paradigms: the reliance on deterministic point estimates for auditing and the treatment of individuals as isolated entities devoid of structural context.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本博士论文指出现代机器学习系统已演变为复杂的社会技术架构，并深刻嵌入结构性不平等。论文识别并回应了当前算法公平范式的两个根本局限：对确定性点估计的依赖以及将个体视为脱离结构背景的孤立实体。
Motivation: 现有的算法公平性缓解策略依赖于脆弱的简化假设，在复杂的社会技术环境中效果有限，无法有效解决模型对边缘化群体的系统性不利影响。
Method: 论文通过理论分析和批判性审视，指出当前公平性审计方法过度依赖确定性点估计，并且忽视个体所处的结构性背景，但未在摘要中提出具体的新算法或实证方法。
Result: 摘要未报告具体的实验或数值结果。
Conclusion: 论文强调，算法公平研究需要超越简化假设，解决依赖点估计和脱离结构背景这两个根本性局限。

papers.title: From Structure to Synergy: A Survey of Vision-Language Perception Paradigm Evolution in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have recently made remarkable progress in unifying vision-language understanding and reasoning, especially following the introduction of models such as OpenAI's O-series and DeepSeek's R-series, which have driven a paradigm shift toward perception-centric intelligence. However, there remains a lack of systematic surveys that examine perception from a truly unified vision-language perspective -- one that treats vision and language as an inseparable modality. Existing reviews are often fragmented, focusing separately on either vision or language, and thus rarely capture the cross-modal evolution of perception as an integrated capability. To bridge this gap, we present the first systematic survey of unified vision-language perception in MLLMs. Specifically, we (1) formalize MLLM perception as an intrinsic, unified vision-language capability analogous to human innate perception, (2) introduce a five-stage taxonomy tracing the paradigm evolution of MLLM perception and survey representative methods and milestones at each phase, and (3) identify open challenges and outline promising research directions toward truly general, unified multimodal intelligence. We hope our study will provide both a foundational understanding and an actionable roadmap to foster further innovation on the path toward artificial general intelligence (AGI).
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文系统综述了多模态大语言模型（MLLM）中视觉-语言统一感知的范式演变。作者将MLLM感知形式化为一种类人先天能力的、不可分割的跨模态能力，提出了五阶段分类法来追踪感知范式的演化，并调研了各阶段的代表性方法和里程碑，最后指出了开放挑战和未来方向。
Motivation: 现有综述通常将视觉和语言分开讨论，缺乏从统一视角审视跨模态感知演化的系统性工作，这限制了人们对MLLM感知能力的整体理解。
Method: 提出一种五阶段分类法来组织MLLM感知范式的演化历程，每个阶段总结代表性方法和里程碑，并分析其演进逻辑。
Result: 论文提供了MLLM感知能力发展的结构化全景图，识别了当前挑战并给出未来研究方向，但未报告具体的实验数值。
Conclusion: 本文强调统一视觉-语言感知是迈向通用多模态智能的关键，并呼吁进一步研究以解决开放挑战。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Self-Supervised Tree-level Biomass Estimation in Urban Environments From Airborne LiDAR and Optical Observations
papers.abstract_en: Urban tree biomass remains less spatially explicitly quantified than biomass in managed forests because many estimates rely on inventories or coarse products that cannot resolve individual crowns or fine-scale heterogeneity. We present a crown-level above-ground biomass (AGB) framework for an 810~km$^2$ landscape in Ontario, Canada, using leaf-off airborne LiDAR (8--10~pulses~m$^{-2}$) and near-infrared RGB orthophotography (0.16--0.20~m) from 2018 and 2023. A dual-stream cross-attention network trained on rule-based pseudo-labels produced semantic marks for buildings, needleleaf trees, and deciduous trees, supporting crown delineation and functional-type assignment. On independently annotated withheld tiles, global/mean precision, recall, and Dice scores were 0.86, 0.83, and 0.84. Crowns were delineated with multiscale watershed segmentation in mapped tree areas, and AGB was estimated from a crown area--height power-law proxy calibrated to species-specific allometry (Lambert et al., 2005) for 21,921 inventory trees. For 18,713 inventory--segment matched pairs from a 90,726-tree held-out test set, AGB prediction achieved $R^2=0.609$ using inventory crown geometry and $R^2=0.570$ under operational segmentation, identifying crown delineation as the remaining uncertainty source. Aggregated to 30~m, estimates yielded total AGB stocks of 1.73~Tg in 2018 and 1.81~Tg in 2023 (811--850~Gg~C), local densities up to ${\sim}140$~Mg~ha$^{-1}$ along the Niagara Escarpment, and a net carbon gain of 39~Gg~C over five years. Deep-ensemble uncertainty maps highlighted high-epistemic-uncertainty areas linked to underrepresented land covers and guided assignment of uncertain crowns to a pooled allometric equation. The framework uses standard provincial data, requires no manual annotation, and produces a public bitemporal crown-level AGB database for trees outside forests at management-relevant resolution.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于机载LiDAR和光学影像的城市树木冠层级生物量估算框架。使用双流交叉注意力网络训练语义分割，结合多尺度分水岭分割进行冠层提取，并通过冠层面积-高度幂律关系估算地上生物量。在加拿大安大略省810 km²区域验证，2018和2023年总生物量分别为1.73 Tg和1.81 Tg，五年净碳增益39 Gg C。
Motivation: 城市树木生物量缺乏像管理森林那样空间明确的高分辨率估算，现有方法依赖清查或粗分辨率产品，无法解析个体冠层和细尺度异质性。
Method: 使用leaf-off机载LiDAR和近红外RGB正射影像，训练双流交叉注意力网络（基于规则伪标签）生成建筑物、针叶树和落叶树的语义掩膜，通过多尺度分水岭分割提取冠层，再基于冠层面积-高度幂律关系（校准自物种特异性异速生长方程）估算地上生物量。
Result: 语义分割精度（全局平均）为精确率0.86、召回率0.83、Dice 0.84；AGB预测R²=0.609（使用清查冠层几何）和0.570（使用分割冠层）；2018和2023年总碳储量为811-850 Gg C，五年净增39 Gg C。
Conclusion: 该框架无需手动标注，利用标准省级数据生成冠层级生物量数据库，不确定性分析识别出冠层分割是主要误差来源。

papers.title: Federated Hash Projected Latent Factor Learning
papers.abstract_en: Hash Learning (HL) is an efficient representation learning approach that maps real-valued data into compact binary representations. Traditional HL methods typically require users to upload personal data to a central server, which is incompatible with increasingly stringent data security regulations. Federated Learning (FL) provides a decentralized paradigm for learning globally optimal models without centralizing private data. However, most FL methods rely on transmitting large-scale real-valued gradient information, leading to high communication overhead and potential privacy risks. Integrating HL into FL is a promising solution. Nevertheless, existing HL methods suffer from limited representational capacity of binary codes, which may degrade model accuracy. To address this challenge, we propose a Federated Hash Projected Latent Factor (FHPLF) model. FHPLF introduces three key innovations: (a) replacing real-valued gradient matrices with binary gradient-like matrices, significantly reducing computation, storage, and communication costs while enhancing privacy protection; (b) leveraging Projected Hamming Distance for similarity modeling, which captures the importance of individual binary bits to improve representation capability; and (c) proposing a Secure Binary Gradient Reassembly and Privacy-Enhanced Upload (SBG-PEU) strategy to further reduce the risk of user interaction leakage during transmission. Extensive experiments on four real-world datasets demonstrate that FHPLF consistently outperforms state-of-the-art HL and FL methods, achieving a favorable trade-off among accuracy, efficiency, and privacy preservation.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出联邦哈希投影潜在因子模型（FHPLF），将哈希学习融入联邦学习，通过二进制梯度矩阵降低通信开销并增强隐私，利用投影汉明距离提高表示能力，并提出安全二进制梯度重组与隐私增强上传策略。在四个真实数据集上优于现有哈希学习和联邦学习方法。
Motivation: 传统哈希学习需上传原始数据，违反数据安全法规；联邦学习传输实值梯度导致高通信开销和隐私风险。现有哈希学习二进制编码表示能力有限，影响模型精度。
Method: FHPLF模型：用二进制梯度类矩阵替代实值梯度矩阵以降低计算存储和通信成本；采用投影汉明距离建模相似性以捕获二进制位重要性；提出安全二进制梯度重组与隐私增强上传策略减少交互泄露。
Result: 在四个真实数据集上，FHPLF在精度、效率和隐私保护之间取得优越权衡，一致优于最新哈希学习和联邦学习方法。
Conclusion: FHPLF有效整合哈希学习与联邦学习，解决隐私、通信和表示能力问题，但仅限于一般表示学习任务，未涉及气象领域特定挑战。
Relevance: 5

papers.title: Clue-Guided Money Laundering Group Discovery
papers.abstract_en: Money Laundering Group Discovery (MLGD) aims to identify hidden criminal groups and recover their complete structures in large-scale financial networks. Existing graph anomaly detection methods mainly produce node-level risk alerts, while global group discovery methods passively search for suspicious groups over the whole network. Both are mismatched with real Anti-money-laundering (AML) investigations, where analysts usually start from a concrete clue and gradually expand the investigation to recover the responsible group. To address this gap, we propose Clue-Guided Group Discovery (CGGD), where a laundering group is progressively recovered from an initial clue set through analyst interaction. We further propose Clue2Group, a framework that first constructs a compact local investigation context to reduce noise and preserve chain-like and cycle-like laundering structures. It then estimates a clue-conditioned local risk field with a multi-semantic local-temporal GNN, and finally integrates risk, structural, and prior-pattern evidence to recover a coherent laundering group. Experiments on two large-scale AML benchmarks show that Clue2Group provides a practical clue-driven analysis framework for AML investigations, offering a feasible step toward bridging the gap between graph-based AML research and real investigation workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Clue-Guided Group Discovery (CGGD)问题，旨在从初始线索逐步扩展恢复洗钱集团，并设计Clue2Group框架，通过构建局部调查上下文、估计线索条件局部风险场并整合多源证据来恢复群体结构。在两个大规模反洗钱基准上验证了有效性，弥合了图异常检测研究与实际调查流程的差距。
Motivation: 现有图异常检测方法主要产生节点级告警，全局群体发现方法被动搜索，均不匹配现实反洗钱调查中从具体线索逐步扩展的需求。
Method: 提出Clue2Group框架，先构建紧凑局部调查上下文以减少噪声并保留链状与环状结构，再用多语义局部时序GNN估计线索条件局部风险场，最后整合风险、结构与先验模式证据恢复洗钱集团。
Result: 在两个大规模反洗钱基准上，Clue2Group提供了实用的线索驱动分析框架，有效恢复洗钱集团结构。
Conclusion: 该工作朝着弥合基于图的反洗钱研究与实际调查流程之间的差距迈出了可行一步，为线索导向的群体发现提供了新范式。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Necessary but Not Sufficient: Temperature Control and Reproducibility in LLM-as-Judge Safety Evaluations
papers.abstract_en: LLM-as-judge ("grader") components are now standard in evaluation harnesses, including safety evaluations where a pass/fail verdict may gate downstream deployment decisions. A widespread assumption is that setting the grader's sampling temperature to 0 makes grading deterministic. We test this assumption against a real safety-evaluation codebase (Japan AISI's open-source aisev) and show it fails on two levels. First, the harness invokes its grader without setting temperature or seed; the underlying provider silently applies its default of 1.0, so items near the decision boundary flip pass/fail across identical runs (per-item disagreement up to ~50% over 20 runs). Second, pinning temperature=0 reduces but does not eliminate flips: across 690 API calls spanning two providers, three model tiers, and five sampling configurations, 1-2 of 7 borderline items remain non-reproducible even under forced greedy decoding (top_k=1). Claude Opus 4.7/4.8 has since deprecated temperature entirely, rendering the primary mitigation inapplicable to newer model generations. These findings expose a structural gap: evaluation harnesses that report single-run verdicts without variance or grader-disagreement metrics can present noise as a safety property. We release a reproduction harness (690 calls, 7 conditions) and recommend that harnesses treat grader disagreement as a first-class health metric alongside the scores themselves.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 论文检验了LLM-as-judge安全评估中温度控制对可重复性的影响。实验基于日本AISI的aisev代码库，发现即使设置temperature=0也无法完全消除边界样本的pass/fail翻转，且部分模型已废弃温度参数，暴露了评估框架的结构性缺陷。
Motivation: 安全评估中依赖LLM作为评判器时，普遍假设temperature=0可实现确定性输出，但实际评估框架未正确设置参数，导致结果不可重复，可能将噪声误报为安全属性。
Method: 通过对690次API调用（覆盖两个provider、三个模型等级、五种采样配置）进行实验，分析aisev评估框架中温度参数的实际行为，比较不同设置下的判定一致性。
Result: 摘要报告：未设置温度时边界样本20次运行的per-item不一致性高达约50%；即使强制贪心解码（top_k=1），7个边界项中仍有1-2个不可重复。
Conclusion: 评估框架应将评判器不一致性作为第一类健康指标，而非仅报告单次运行判决。

papers.title: LiMoDE: Rethinking Lifelong Robot Manipulation from a Mixture-of-Dynamic-Experts Perspective
papers.abstract_en: Building a generalist robot that can leverage prior knowledge for continuous task adaptation remains a significant challenge. Previous works alleviate the catastrophic forgetting problem by parameter-efficient fine-tuning for single-task adaptation. However, they fail to extract reusable skills and model the interaction with other skills effectively. Recent works try to address these issues by learning prompts. Differently, this paper presents an architectural perspective on the Lifelong Mixture of Dynamic Experts (\textit{LiMoDE}), a novel two-stage learning scheme for lifelong robot manipulation. Specifically, a dynamic MoE structure is first proposed in the multi-task pre-training stage to learn prior knowledge, where a varied number of heterogeneous experts are activated based on the motion information to address different short-term manipulations. Subsequently, in the task adaptation stage, we design a lifelong MoE adaptation mechanism % (LiMoEAM) that learns lifelong experts and dynamically combines them with frozen ones for new tasks, facilitating the knowledge transfer during adaptation. The proposed \textit{LiMoDE} is evaluated on both the simulated lifelong learning benchmark and real-world tasks. Extensive experiments demonstrate its effectiveness in achieving superior performance and strong lifelong adaptation by introducing a moderate number of additional trainable parameters and inference overhead.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 LiMoDE，一种基于动态专家混合的终身机器人操作学习方案。包括两阶段：多任务预训练阶段使用动态 MoE 结构学习先验知识，任务适应阶段学习终身专家并与冻结专家动态组合。在模拟和真实任务上验证了其有效性和强终身适应能力。
Motivation: 现有方法通过参数高效微调缓解灾难性遗忘，但未能提取可重用技能并有效建模技能间的交互。
Method: 提出两阶段学习框架：多任务预训练阶段使用动态 MoE 结构，根据运动信息激活不同数量的异构专家；任务适应阶段设计终身 MoE 适应机制，学习终身专家并与冻结专家动态组合。
Result: 在模拟终身学习基准和真实任务上，LiMoDE 通过引入适度的额外可训练参数和推理开销取得优越性能和强终身适应能力。
Conclusion: 从架构角度重新思考终身机器人操作，动态专家混合能有效促进知识迁移。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: KG-TRACE: A Neuro-Symbolic Framework for Mechanistic Grounding in Antimicrobial Resistance Prediction
papers.abstract_en: While WGS-based AMR prediction has reached high accuracy, existing models lack a mechanism to ground neural attributions in established biological pathways. We present KG-TRACE, a novel neuro-symbolic framework that integrates the WHO mutation knowledge graph (KG) as a structured biological constraint on a neural genomic model. Unlike existing methods that learn statistical patterns in isolation, KG-TRACE fuses genomic features and RotatE-based KG embeddings through a learned epistemic trust gate, dynamically weighting neural evidence against symbolic biological knowledge. Evaluated on the CRyPTIC M. tuberculosis cohort, KG-TRACE achieves an AUROC of 0.9760 for isoniazid, achieving competitive accuracy while its primary value lies in symbolic grounding, not predictive uplift. More importantly, we introduce the Biological Grounding Ratio (BGR), a dataset-level metric that quantifies alignment between neural attributions and established biology. Our framework achieves a 92.5% symbolic coverage of isoniazid-resistant predictions and effectively identifies MDR co-occurrence artifacts by issuing laboratory follow-up flags for 'UNCERTAIN' cases. We demonstrate that neuro-symbolic grounding provides a verifiable audit trail for clinicians, bridging the gap between predictive accuracy and clinical trust.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: KG-TRACE 是一个神经符号框架，将 WHO 突变知识图谱作为结构性生物约束整合到神经基因组模型中，用于抗菌素耐药性预测。在 CRyPTIC 结核分枝杆菌队列上，该模型对异烟肼的 AUROC 达到 0.9760，其主要贡献在于符号基础（symbolic grounding）而非预测性能提升。论文还引入了生物基础比率（BGR）指标，量化神经归因与已知生物学的一致性，实现了 92.5% 的符号覆盖率，并能为不确定案例生成实验室随访标记。
Motivation: 现有基于 WGS 的抗菌素耐药性预测模型虽然准确率高，但缺乏将神经归因锚定于已建立的生物通路（biological pathways）的机制，导致临床信任不足。
Method: 提出 KG-TRACE，通过一个学习到的认知信任门（epistemic trust gate）融合基因组特征和基于 RotatE 的知识图谱嵌入，动态权衡神经证据与符号生物学知识。
Result: 在 CRyPTIC 结核分枝杆菌数据集上，对异烟肼预测的 AUROC 为 0.9760，符号覆盖率达 92.5%，并有效识别多药耐药（MDR）共现伪像，为不确定案例提供实验室随访标记。
Conclusion: 神经符号基础（neuro-symbolic grounding）能为临床医生提供可验证的审计线索，弥合预测准确性与临床信任之间的差距。
Relevance: 0

summary_sections.tldr: KG-TRACE 是一个神经符号框架，将 WHO 突变知识图谱作为结构性生物约束整合到神经基因组模型中，用于抗菌素耐药性预测。在 CRyPTIC 结核分枝杆菌队列上，该模型对异烟肼的 AUROC 达到 0.9760，其主要贡献在于符号基础（symbolic grounding）而非预测性能提升。论文还引入了生物基础比率（BGR）指标，量化神经归因与已知生物学的一致性，实现了 92.5% 的符号覆盖率，并能为不确定案例生成实验室随访标记。

papers.title: AlgoEvolve: LLM-driven Meta-evolution of Algorithmic Trading Programs
papers.abstract_en: Recent work shows that Large Language Models (LLMs) can act as semantic mutation operators for the evolutionary discovery of programs and proofs. Most current applications focus on static coding benchmarks. We extend this paradigm to algorithmic trading. This domain is uniquely challenging because it is noisy, non-stationary, and highly discontinuous. We present AlgoEvolve, an LLM-driven evolutionary framework that generates, evaluates, and iteratively improves executable trading strategies. These strategies are expressed as Python code and evaluated through a rigorous testing protocol. Across multiple experiments, the system exhibits emergent regime-adaptive strategy logic, including autonomous shifts in trading rules. We further introduce a meta-evolutionary outer loop that evolves the prompts guiding program synthesis in the inner loop. This outer loop discovers improved search heuristics. These heuristics balance exploration and exploitation while reducing zero-trade failures. They consistently outperform initial human-designed instructions. The results demonstrate that LLM-based semantic evolution provides a viable approach for continual program synthesis in complex environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出 AlgoEvolve，一种利用大语言模型（LLM）作为语义变异算子的进化框架，用于生成和改进算法交易策略。策略以 Python 代码表示，通过严格测试协议评估。实验显示系统能涌现出自适应市场状态的策略逻辑，并引入元进化外层循环以优化引导程序合成的提示，从而发现更好的搜索启发式。
Motivation: 现有 LLM 进化方法主要应用于静态编码基准，而算法交易领域具有噪声、非平稳和高度不连续的特点，需要能够持续适应新环境的策略合成方法。
Method: 提出 AlgoEvolve 框架，包含内层循环（LLM 驱动的程序合成与进化）和外层元进化循环（优化内层提示）。内层中，LLM 作为变异算子生成新策略，通过回测评估；外层通过进化发现更好的搜索启发式。
Result: 摘要报告系统展示了涌现的自适应策略逻辑，包括规则的自发转变；元进化发现优于人工设计的提示，平衡了探索与利用，并减少了零交易失败。
Conclusion: 研究表明，基于 LLM 的语义进化为复杂环境中的持续程序合成提供了可行途径，但全文可能未涉及与关键词相关的领域。

papers.title: LCG: Long-Context Consistent Image Generation with Sparse Relational Attention
papers.abstract_en: Recent image generation models achieve impressive quality in single-image synthesis, but often fail to maintain consistency across sequential outputs, as required in comics, storyboards, and visual narratives. We propose Long-Context Generation (LCG), a framework for long-context multi-image text-to-image generation, to improve consistency and scalability in long-context multi-image generation. LCG employs the Sparse Relational Attention (SRA) mechanism to selectively attend to core features across extended visual contexts, ensuring that the propagation of semantic and layout information remains computationally tractable. To enforce semantic alignment, we introduce the Routing Consistency Constraint (RCC), which leverages identity-aware masks to align structural patterns across generation branches, effectively mitigating drift in appearance even in complex multi-character scenes. To support training and evaluation in this setting, we construct the Long-Context Consistency Dataset (LCCD), a large-scale synthetic dataset comprising character-centric multi-image sequences spanning varied situational contexts. LCCD contains 600K training sequences and a separate 1K test set, with each sequence containing 6 to 20 images. The experiments demonstrate that LCG outperforms the compared baselines in prompt alignment and character consistency for long-context image generation, including multi-character scenes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出长上下文一致图像生成（LCG）框架，用于多图像文本到图像生成中的一致性和可扩展性。LCG采用稀疏关系注意力（SRA）机制，选择性地关注跨扩展视觉上下文的核心特征；并引入路由一致性约束（RCC），利用身份感知掩码对齐结构模式。构建了长上下文一致性数据集（LCCD），包含60万训练序列和1千测试集。实验表明LCG在提示对齐和角色一致性上优于基线。
Motivation: 现有图像生成模型在单图像合成中表现优异，但在漫画、故事板等需要跨序列一致性的任务中往往失败。
Method: 提出LCG框架，包含SRA机制和RCC约束，并构建了LCCD数据集。
Result: 实验表明LCG在长上下文图像生成中的提示对齐和角色一致性上优于基线，包括多角色场景。
Conclusion: LCG提升了多图像生成的一致性和可扩展性。

papers.title: Neural Architecture Search for Generative Adversarial Networks: A Comprehensive Review and Critical Analysis
papers.abstract_en: Neural Architecture Search (NAS) has emerged as a pivotal technique in optimizing the design of Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), automating the search for effective architectures while addressing the challenges inherent in manual design. This paper provides a comprehensive review of NAS methods applied to GANs, categorizing and comparing various approaches based on criteria such as search strategies, evaluation metrics, and performance outcomes. The review highlights the benefits of NAS in improving GAN performance, stability, and efficiency, while also identifying limitations and areas for future research. Key findings include the superiority of evolutionary algorithms and gradient-based methods in certain contexts, the importance of robust evaluation metrics beyond traditional scores like Inception Score (IS) and Fréchet Inception Distance (FID), and the need for diverse datasets in assessing GAN performance. By presenting a structured comparison of existing NAS-GAN techniques, this paper aims to guide researchers in developing more effective NAS methods and advancing the field of GANs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文对生成对抗网络（GAN）的神经架构搜索（NAS）方法进行了全面综述，系统分类并比较了基于搜索策略、评估指标和性能的多种方法。综述指出进化算法和梯度方法在特定场景下的优势，以及需要超越IS和FID的更鲁棒评估指标。
Motivation: GAN架构的手工设计面临挑战，NAS作为自动化方法可优化GAN设计，但缺乏系统性的综述来比较不同NAS-GAN方法。
Method: 通过分类法比较进化算法、梯度方法等搜索策略，分析评估指标（IS、FID等）和数据集的适用性，并总结了现有NAS-GAN技术的利弊。
Result: 发现进化算法和梯度方法在某些场景下表现优越；指出需要更鲁棒的评估指标和多样化数据集来评估GAN性能。
Conclusion: 本文旨在通过结构化比较指导研究者开发更有效的NAS方法，并推动GAN领域发展；同时指出当前研究的局限和未来方向。

papers.title: Implementation of reinforcement learning in chemical reaction networks: application to phototaxis as curiosity-driven exploration
papers.abstract_en: Living systems navigate environments using noisy and incomplete sensory signals. In unicellular algae, phototaxis is often modeled as a mechanistic run--tumble process driven by stimulus--response rules. However, such descriptions overlook how organisms actively sample their environment to reduce sensory ambiguity. From a minimal cognition perspective, we reframe this navigation as a subjective, information-driven sensorimotor process. To this end, we propose a framework linking a Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP) with biochemical reaction dynamics. Environmental variables are hidden, while the cell updates a minimal internal state from each observation through a memoryless Bayesian step. These internal dynamics balance orienting toward light with exploratory reorientation and can be implemented through Chemical-Reaction-Network Ordinary Differential Equations (CRN--ODEs). Our model includes a biophysical observation process for photoreception and a chemically computable polynomial bound on information gain. Using Inverse Reinforcement Learning (IRL) on 30 experimentally recorded Chlamydomonas trajectories, we infer the behavioral objective consistent with observed phototactic motion and benchmark the resulting dynamics with standard Stochastic Simulation Algorithm (SSA) baselines. Our model reproduces the empirical alignment-to-light distribution, comparable to objective SSA baselines on this dataset. Within this framework, run--tumble alternation emerges as an information-acquisition strategy: tumbling reorients the cell to sample new sensory configurations and resolve sensor ambiguity, demonstrating how intracellular biochemical networks can support adaptive information-seeking behavior in cellular navigation.
papers.comment: This paper is accepted as talk at ALIFE 2026 (Waterloo, Canada)
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一个将部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）与化学反应网络常微分方程（CRN-ODEs）相结合的框架，用于建模单细胞藻类的趋光性导航。通过将趋光性重新定义为信息驱动的感知运动过程，该框架将环境变量视为隐藏状态，细胞通过无记忆贝叶斯更新维持最小内部状态。模型包含光感受的生物物理观测过程和化学可计算的信息增益多项式界。利用逆强化学习（IRL）从30条实验记录的莱茵衣藻轨迹中推断行为目标，并采用标准随机模拟算法（SSA）基线进行基准测试。结果表明，模型能够再现经验的对光对齐分布，且跑-颤交替行为作为信息获取策略出现：颤抖重新定向细胞以采样新的感觉配置并解决感官模糊性。
Motivation: 现有趋光性模型通常将导航视为机械的刺激-响应过程，忽略了生物主动采样环境以减少感觉模糊性的能力。本文从最小认知角度出发，将导航重新定义为主观、信息驱动的感知运动过程，以揭示细胞内生化网络如何支持自适应信息寻求行为。
Method: 提出一个将POMDP与CRN-ODEs相结合的框架：环境变量隐藏，细胞通过无记忆贝叶斯更新从每次观测更新最小内部状态；内部动力学平衡朝向光线的定向与探索性重定向。模型包括光感受的生物物理观测过程和化学可计算的信息增益多项式界，并使用逆强化学习从真实轨迹中推断行为目标。
Result: 模型在30条莱茵衣藻实验轨迹上使用IRL推断行为目标，并采用SSA基线进行基准测试。结果表明，模型能够重现经验的对光对齐分布，且跑-颤交替行为作为信息获取策略出现，颤抖用于重新定向细胞以解决感官模糊性。
Conclusion: 该框架展示了细胞内生化网络如何支持自适应的信息寻求行为，将趋光性中的跑-颤交替重新解释为一种信息获取策略，为理解生物导航的认知基础提供了新视角。

papers.title: Predicting Fruit Quality with a Hybrid Machine Learning and Image Processing Approach
papers.abstract_en: Fruit spoilage is a significant issue in agriculture, leading to substantial economic losses. Addressing this, our study introduces a hybrid approach combining image processing and deep learning to assess fruit freshness. We developed an image processing algorithm that quantifies spoilage on a scale from 0 (fully fresh) to 100 (fully rotten). Alongside, we trained a convolutional neural network (CNN) to perform binary classification (fresh or rotten) using a large dataset of fruit images. The outcomes of both methods were synthesized using logistic regression to enhance the accuracy of freshness predictions. Subsequently, this logistic regression model was utilized to enable the image processing algorithm to provide binary classification based on its percentage output, thus eliminating the need for the CNN in real-time applications. Our approach, which does not require high computational resources, achieved real-time performance and was validated with over 90% accuracy on a dataset comprising apples and oranges. The primary limitation lies in the requirement for fruits to be isolated on a background that must be either white or transparent, suggesting future improvements could include advanced segmentation models to automate background removal. This study's results highlight the potential of integrating simple image processing techniques with machine learning to provide practical solutions in the agricultural sector.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合图像处理与深度学习的混合方法评估水果新鲜度。通过图像处理算法量化腐败程度（0-100分），同时训练CNN进行二元分类（新鲜/腐烂），利用逻辑回归融合二者结果，最终仅需图像处理算法即可实现实时二分类，在苹果和橘子数据集上准确率超过90%。
Motivation: 水果腐败导致重大经济损失，现有方法可能依赖高计算资源或无法实时应用，需一种低资源消耗的准确评估方法。
Method: 开发图像处理算法输出腐败百分比，训练CNN进行新鲜/腐烂二分类，通过逻辑回归融合两者输出；训练后逻辑回归模型替代CNN，仅用图像处理算法的百分比结果实现实时二分类。
Result: 在包含苹果和橘子的数据集上验证，准确率超过90%，且实现实时性能，无需高计算资源。
Conclusion: 该方法在简单背景下有效，但要求水果位于白色或透明背景上，未来可通过分割模型自动处理背景。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: \chisao{}: A GPU-Native Parallel Optimizer for Multimodal Black-Box Functions via Convergence-Anticonvergence Oscillation
papers.abstract_en: Finding all modes of a multimodal black-box function is a fundamental challenge in optimization, Bayesian inference, and scientific computing. Existing approaches -- basin-hopping, CMA-ES, multistart gradient descent -- operate sequentially and cannot exploit the massive parallelism of modern GPU hardware. We introduce \chisao{} (\textbf{C}onvergence-\textbf{H}alt-\textbf{I}nvert-\textbf{S}tick-\textbf{A}nd-\textbf{O}scillate), a GPU-native population optimizer that runs an entire sample batch simultaneously and exploits a deliberate convergence-anticonvergence oscillation cycle to escape local traps while freezing confirmed modes. The structural move is asymmetric: samples that reach true peaks are frozen (``stuck'') and preserved, while the rest keep exploring via momentum-based anti-convergence and stochastically smoothed gradients. Adaptive reseeding via two complementary strategies (Repulse Monkey and Golden Rooster) maintains population diversity throughout. On all 42 functions of the Simon Fraser University optimization benchmark suite across dimensions $d \in \{2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64\}$, \chisao{} achieves \textbf{100\%} mode recovery where all CPU baselines collapse at $d \geq 8$ on the hardest multimodal functions, at up to \textbf{$34\times$} speedup over basin-hopping on functions where all methods succeed (Michalewicz $d=64$) and up to \textbf{$39\times$} on unimodal functions (Rotated Hyper-Ellipsoid $d=64$, pure GPU dividend). All benchmarks evaluate the objective by value alone -- gradients come from finite differences -- so the reported speedups are a derivative-free worst case. Under substantial likelihood noise ($σ_{\mathrm{noise}}$ up to 1.0), mode detection remains 100\% reliable. The algorithm is available as a standalone open-source Python package on PyPI.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出Chisao，一种GPU原生的并行优化器，用于多模态黑箱函数求模。它利用收敛-反收敛振荡循环，冻结已确认的模态并让其余样本继续探索。在SFU优化基准测试的所有42个函数上，维度d∈{2,4,8,16,32,64}中，Chisao实现了100%的模态恢复，而CPU基线在d≥8时失效，速度提升高达34倍（Michalewicz d=64）和39倍（Rotated Hyper-Ellipsoid d=64）。在有噪声的情况下，模态检测保持100%可靠。算法以开源Python包形式发布。
Motivation: 现有方法（如basin-hopping、CMA-ES、多起点梯度下降）顺序运行，无法利用现代GPU的大规模并行性，且在高维多模态黑箱函数上难以找到所有模态。
Method: 提出Convergence-Halt-Invert-Stick-And-Oscillate (Chisao)算法，运行整个样本批次并利用收敛-反收敛振荡循环：达到真实峰值的样本被冻结并保留，其余样本通过基于动量的反收敛和随机平滑梯度继续探索；通过两种互补策略（Repulse Monkey和Golden Rooster）自适应重采样维持种群多样性。
Result: 在SFU优化基准测试的全部42个函数上，维度d≥8时，Chisao实现100%模态恢复，而CPU基线失败；在Michalewicz d=64上速度提升34倍，在Rotated Hyper-Ellipsoid d=64上速度提升39倍（纯GPU红利）。在似然噪声σ_noise高达1.0时，模态检测仍100%可靠。
Conclusion: Chisao是一种GPU原生并行优化器，在高维多模态黑箱函数优化上显著优于CPU基线，且对噪声鲁棒。算法已开源。

papers.title: Refusal Lives Downstream of Persona in Chat Models
papers.abstract_en: Linear directions in activation space have been identified for both refusal and persona traits in instruction-tuned chat models, but the two have been studied as separate mechanisms. We show they interact: a compliant persona gates refusal. In Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, we extract a compliant model-persona direction and a refusal direction and intervene on both. Compliant persona steering suppresses refusal -- in Llama, the refusal rate falls from 97% to 2%. Reintroducing the refusal direction partially restores refusal at late layers but not at early ones. Projecting out the persona direction in a late-layer window restores it to baseline; projecting out a random direction does not. Refusal is therefore gated at the late-layer expression stage, downstream of where it is computed. Treating refusal as a single isolated direction misses its dependence on persona.
papers.comment: Accepted to the ICML 2026 Mechanistic Interpretability workshop
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文发现指令调优聊天模型中拒绝（refusal）和人格（persona）的线性方向存在交互：顺从人格门控拒绝。通过干预Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct中的方向，顺从人格引导可将拒绝率从97%降至2%，而重新引入拒绝方向仅在晚层部分恢复拒绝。实验表明拒绝在晚层表达阶段被门控，其计算发生在更早层。
Motivation: 先前研究将拒绝和人格视为独立机制，未探究二者相互作用，但实际中人格可能影响模型拒绝行为。
Method: 在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct中提取顺从人格方向和拒绝方向，通过激活干预（如人格方向引导、拒绝方向重注入、投影去除人格方向）分析互动。
Result: 顺从人格方向引导使Llama中拒绝率从97%降至2%；重注入拒绝方向仅在晚层部分恢复拒绝；在晚层窗口投影去除人格方向可将拒绝率恢复至基线，而随机方向无效。
Conclusion: 拒绝依赖于人格，其表达在晚层被门控，而计算发生在更早层。将拒绝视为孤立方向会忽略这种依赖。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: GRAG: Generic Response-Augmented Generation Framework for Personalized Conversational Systems
papers.abstract_en: Deploying highly capable personalized conversational agents in resource-constrained or privacy-sensitive environments remains a significant challenge. We identify a fundamental bottleneck in the existing approaches: current training paradigms treat personalization and grounding as a single monolithic learning problem. Under these paradigms, language models are forced to simultaneously address what to say (content grounding) and how to say it in a user-specific way (personalization), which introduces significant computational and optimization challenges. Consequently, contextual grounding is often sacrificed for persona adherence, or vice versa, resulting in responses that are either weakly grounded in the conversational history or insufficiently personalized. In this work, we propose the Generic Response-Augmented Generation (GRAG) framework that decouples these competing objectives by leveraging offline, generic responses from high-capacity, general-purpose LLMs as a semantic and structural scaffold to guide the fine-tuning of smaller, task-specialized models seamlessly in resource-limited environments. By decoupling the content grounding from personalization, GRAG allows the model to focus exclusively on persona injection while remaining firmly anchored to the conversational context. We instantiate the GRAG in two post- and pre-fusion-based architectural variants and evaluate them on multiple benchmark conversational datasets that cover diverse personalization structures. Our results demonstrate that GRAG significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods that do not use auxiliary scaffolding, yielding up to 47% improvements in ROUGE-2 and 36% in BLEU scores. Ultimately, GRAG offers a generalizable blueprint for building grounding-aware personalized conversational systems in resource-limited environments.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文针对个性化对话系统中内容依据与个性化相互竞争的问题，提出GRAG框架，通过利用高性能通用大语言模型生成通用回复作为语义与结构支架，指导资源受限环境下小规模专有模型的微调。该方法将内容依据与个性化解耦，使模型专注于个性化注入。在两个架构变体上实验，ROUGE-2提升最高47%，BLEU提升36%。
Motivation: 现有方法将个性化与内容依据视为单一学习问题，导致模型在二者间权衡，难以同时保证对话历史依据和个性化程度。在资源受限或隐私敏感环境下，部署高性能个性化对话系统面临挑战。
Method: 提出GRAG框架，使用离线通用大语言模型生成通用回复作为脚手架，在微调小规模专有模型时解耦内容依据与个性化。设计了后融合（post-fusion）和前融合（pre-fusion）两种架构变体。
Result: 在多个基准对话数据集上，GRAG显著优于不使用辅助脚手架的方法，ROUGE-2提升最高47%，BLEU提升36%。
Conclusion: GRAG为资源受限环境下构建具有依据感的个性化对话系统提供了通用蓝图，通过解耦策略平衡内容依据与个性化。

papers.title: A3C3: AI Algorithm and Accelerator Co-design, Co-search, and Co-generation
papers.abstract_en: We present a holistic methodology for artificial intelligence algorithm and accelerator co-design, co-search, and co-generation (A3C3), which jointly optimizes neural network architectures and their hardware implementations to address the inefficiencies of traditional top-down AI system design flows. Conventional AI deployment often treats model design and hardware mapping as separate stages: an algorithm is first developed for accuracy, and only afterward adapted to meet latency, throughput, energy, or resource constraints. This separation can lead to suboptimal systems, particularly as modern AI workloads become increasingly heterogeneous, memory-intensive, and platform-dependent. A3C3 instead parameterizes both algorithmic and accelerator design spaces and searches them jointly, enabling the automatic generation of model-accelerator pairs that better balance accuracy, latency, throughput, energy efficiency, and hardware utilization. This article is a book chapter of the Handbook of Embedded Machine Learning, edited by Sudeep Pasricha and Muhammad Shafique, Springer Nature.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出A3C3，一种AI算法与加速器协同设计、协同搜索和协同生成的整体方法论，联合优化神经网络架构及其硬件实现，以解决传统自上而下AI系统设计流程效率低下的问题。A3C3将算法和加速器设计空间参数化并联合搜索，自动生成更好的模型-加速器对。
Motivation: 传统AI部署将模型设计和硬件映射视为分离阶段，导致次优系统，特别是对于现代异构、内存密集型和平台相关的工作负载。
Method: A3C3将算法和加速器设计空间参数化，并联合搜索它们，实现模型-加速器对的自动生成。
Result: 摘要中未提供具体数值结果，声称能更好地平衡精度、延迟、吞吐量、能效和硬件利用率。
Conclusion: 该方法是嵌入式机器学习手册中的一个章节，强调协同设计的必要性。

papers.title: Signature filtering: a lightweight enhancement for statistical watermark detection in large language models
papers.abstract_en: Statistical watermarks help organizations attribute large language model (LLM) outputs, yet existing detectors often struggle when watermark signals are weak, texts are repetitive, or watermarks are edited. We propose signature filtering, a detection-time module that enhances watermark detection without modifying watermark embedding and text generation. It learns a small set of ``signature'' tokens whose presence makes watermark tests unreliable, and removes these tokens before detection. The signatures are obtained by solving a mixed-integer linear program on a small training set, with constraints that maximize the true positive rate. We additionally derive finite-sample and asymptotic bounds under several attacker models (color-blind, color-adaptive, and distributionally correlated). On four well-known watermark families (Kgw, Sweet, Unigram, Exp), four benchmark corpora (C4, MBPP, HumanEval, Code-Search-Net), and six LLMs (Opt-1.3b, Opt-6.7b, Llama2-13b, Llama3.1-8b, Qwen2.5-14b, Phi-3-medium-14b), 2- and 3-gram signatures raise detection rates in weak-signal and low-entropy settings from 8~31% without filtering to 78~99% with filtering, while keeping false positives controllable and often negligible. In stress tests where we scramble sentences and perturb 25~50% of tokens by dilution, deletions, and substitutions, 2-gram filters for Kgw-style watermarks preserve most of the clean-text detection gains, often matching or outperforming the advanced WinMax watermark detector. Signature filtering thus provides a simple, scalable, and model-agnostic add-on to strengthen watermark-based provenance checks for LLM text in information processing workflows.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 提出签名过滤（signature filtering）方法，在检测阶段增强大语言模型输出中统计水印的检测，无需修改水印嵌入和文本生成。通过学习一小部分“签名”令牌，这些令牌的存在会使水印测试不可靠，并在检测前移除它们。在多种水印族、语料库和LLM上，2-gram和3-gram签名将弱信号和低熵设置下的检测率从8-31%提升到78-99%，同时保持假阳性可控。该方法简单、可扩展、模型无关。
Motivation: 现有统计水印检测器在信号弱、文本重复或水印被编辑时表现不佳，需要一种轻量级增强方法以提高检测可靠性。
Method: 提出签名过滤（signature filtering），一个检测时模块，通过求解混合整数线性规划学习一小部分“签名”令牌，这些令牌会使水印测试不可靠，并在检测前移除它们。同时推导了多种攻击模型下的有限样本和渐近界。
Result: 在四种水印族（Kgw, Sweet, Unigram, Exp）、四个语料库（C4, MBPP, HumanEval, Code-Search-Net）和六个LLM（Opt-1.3b, Opt-6.7b, Llama2-13b, Llama3.1-8b, Qwen2.5-14b, Phi-3-medium-14b）上，2-和3-gram签名将弱信号和低熵设置下的检测率从8-31%提升到78-99%，假阳性可控。在压力测试（句子打乱、25-50%令牌稀释/删除/替换）中，2-gram过滤器保持大部分干净文本的检测增益，常匹配或优于WinMax检测器。
Conclusion: 签名过滤提供了一种简单、可扩展、模型无关的附加模块，用于加强LLM文本的水印溯源检查，适用于信息处理工作流。

papers.title: Attention-Based Prototype Calibration for Multi-Rater Few-Shot Medical Image Segmentation
papers.abstract_en: Few-shot medical image segmentation methods typically assume a single ground-truth annotation, overlooking systematic variability across expert raters commonly observed in clinical datasets. We propose an attention-based prototype calibration framework for few-shot multi-rater segmentation that models rater-specific deviations from a consensus representation in prototype space. A lightweight yet principled attention operator directly refines rater prototypes without modifying the backbone feature extractor, making the approach fully compatible with existing prototype-based few-shot segmentation methods. This design preserves semantic consistency while enabling personalized segmentation outputs with minimal computational overhead. Experiments on multi-rater medical imaging datasets demonstrate consistent improvements over baseline prototype approaches, highlighting the effectiveness of structured prototype calibration for modeling annotation variability.

papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于注意力的原型校准框架，用于多专家标注的少样本医学图像分割。该框架通过轻量级注意力操作直接在校准原型空间中建模专家特定的偏差，无需修改骨干特征提取器，兼容现有基于原型的少样本分割方法。在多专家标注的医学图像数据集上，该方法在保持语义一致性的同时提升了分割性能。
Motivation: 现有少样本医学图像分割方法通常假设单一真实标注，忽略了临床数据中不同专家标注的系统性变异性，导致无法提供个性化分割输出。
Method: 提出注意力原型校准框架，通过注意力操作在原型空间中对每个专家的标注偏差进行建模，直接精炼原型而不改变骨干网络，从而与现有原型方法兼容且计算开销小。
Result: 在多专家标注的医学图像数据集上，该方法一致优于基线原型方法，证明了结构化原型校正在建模标注变异性方面的有效性。
Conclusion: 该工作表明，通过轻量级注意力校准原型可以有效地处理多专家标注变异性，提升少样本医学图像分割的个性化和鲁棒性。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Post-Training Recipe, More Than Model Family, Shapes Multi-Agent LLM Conversational Behavior
papers.abstract_en: Multi-LLM systems use multiple language models to deliberate, judge each other's outputs, or coordinate as agents. Their value depends on the models producing measurably different conversational behaviors when given the same input. Prior offline studies recommend drawing one model per family for behavioral diversity, because LLMs prefer outputs from their own family when rating one another in isolation. Whether the same family label predicts behavior in interactive multi-LLM systems, the setting that real deployed systems use, has not been tested. We study this with a 940,000-chain 11-checkpoint corpus and a 1.6M-chain same-base Llama factorial. On our validated headline metric, hedging, a reasoning-distilled Llama checkpoint shifts by 18% depending on which same-base partner it replies to, more than any cross-family hedging gap in the controlled subset. Qwen, closed-API, and runtime checks suggest the pattern is not isolated, while repair and challenge analyses remain exploratory because their surface-cue detectors are weaker. Overall, the results identify post-training recipe as a first-class axis for multi-LLM panel composition and show that model family alone is an incomplete proxy for conversational diversity.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文研究多LLM系统中模型家族与后训练配方对对话行为的影响。通过大规模语料库和同基座Llama析因实验，发现推理蒸馏的Llama在与同基座伙伴交互时，hedging指标变化幅度达18%，超过不同家族模型间的差异。结果表明，后训练配方是比模型家族更重要的行为多样性预测因子。
Motivation: 先前的离线研究认为不同模型家族能带来行为多样性，但在实际部署的交互式多LLM系统中，该假设尚未被验证。
Method: 构建包含940k链和11个检查点的语料库，以及1.6M链的同基座Llama析因实验，采用hedging指标量化对话行为，并辅以Qwen、闭源API和运行时验证。
Result: 推理蒸馏的Llama在与同基座伙伴对话时，hedging指标变化幅度达18%，超过任何跨家族模型的控制子集差异。Repair和challenge分析因探测器较弱而仅为探索性结果。
Conclusion: 后训练配方是多LLM系统面板设计的关键维度，仅依赖模型家族无法充分预测对话行为多样性。

papers.title: LLMTabBench: Evaluating LLMs on Binary Tabular Classification From Zero to Few Shots
papers.abstract_en: Supervised classification on tabular data remains a central machine learning task, but its dependence on large labeled datasets limits its applicability in data-scarce settings. Few-shot methods such as TabPFN achieve strong performance through large-scale synthetic pretraining, yet still require labeled context examples. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a more flexible alternative through zero- and few-shot in-context learning from task descriptions, but their behavior on tabular data remains inconsistent. We introduce LLMTabBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs on tabular classification under low-data conditions. The benchmark studies how LLM prior knowledge interacts with task descriptions and few-shot examples, and how performance changes with increasing data complexity across real-world and controlled synthetic datasets. We find that LLMs can be highly competitive in zero-shot settings, sometimes outperforming models given few-shot examples. However, additional examples may conflict with prior knowledge, thereby degrading performance. We also observe a complexity threshold at which LLM performance declines and few-shot examples become less useful. These results clarify key limits of in-context learning for tabular data and inform the deployment of LLMs in low-data regimes.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出LLMTabBench基准，用于评估大型语言模型（LLM）在低数据条件下对二值表格分类任务的零样本和少样本学习能力。研究发现，LLM在零样本设置中具有竞争力，有时甚至优于少样本示例，但额外示例可能与先验知识冲突而降低性能，并且存在复杂度阈值。
Motivation: 表格数据的监督分类依赖大量标注数据，少样本方法如TabPFN仍需标签示例。LLM通过零/少样本上下文学习提供更灵活的替代方案，但在表格数据上的行为不一致，缺乏系统评估。
Method: 构建LLMTabBench基准，在真实和受控合成数据集上研究LLM先验知识与任务描述和少样本示例的交互，以及性能随数据复杂度的变化。
Result: LLM在零样本设置中高度竞争，有时优于少样本示例；但额外示例可能冲突并降低性能；存在复杂度阈值，超过后LLM性能下降且少样本示例效用降低。
Conclusion: 该研究阐明了表格数据上上下文学习的关键限制，并为低数据场景下部署LLM提供指导。
Relevance: 0

papers.title: Trust in Generative AI for Health Information Consumption and the Effect of Learned Dependency: An Experimental Investigation
papers.abstract_en: Background: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) is increasingly used for health information, yet its influence on users' trust calibration remains unclear. Objective: This study examines whether learned dependency on GenAI influences trust in AI-generated health information and whether text highlighting reduces overreliance on incorrect outputs. Methods: Two randomized controlled experiments were conducted with 338 college students and 563 Amazon Mechanical Turk participants. Both experiments used a 2 by 2 between-subjects design manipulating information accuracy (correct versus incorrect) and text highlighting (highlight versus no highlight). Trust and learned dependency were measured using validated scales, and linear regression models tested main and interaction effects. Results: In both experiments, information accuracy significantly increased trust (p < 0.001), while learned dependency was positively associated with trust (p < 0.05). The interaction between accuracy and dependency was significant (p < 0.001), indicating that highly dependent users were more likely to trust incorrect AI-generated information. Text highlighting had no significant effect on trust and did not moderate the relationship between dependency and trust. Conclusions: Learned dependency weakens trust calibration, increasing susceptibility to inaccurate AI-generated health information. Text highlighting alone is insufficient to reduce overreliance, highlighting the need for more effective interface designs that encourage critical evaluation of GenAI outputs.
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 该论文通过两个随机对照实验（共901名参与者）研究了生成式AI（GenAI）在健康信息消费中的信任与学习依赖效应。结果表明，信息准确性显著提升信任，而学习依赖正向关联信任且会弱化信任校准，导致高度依赖的用户更可能信任错误信息。文本高亮未能减少过度依赖。
Motivation: GenAI越来越多用于健康信息，但用户对其信任校准的影响尚不明确，尤其是学习依赖（learned dependency）可能导致用户过度依赖错误输出。
Method: 进行两个2×2组间设计的随机对照实验，操纵信息准确性（正确vs错误）和文本高亮（有vs无），使用有效量表测量信任和学习依赖，通过线性回归检验主效应和交互效应。
Result: 准确性显著增加信任（p<0.001），学习依赖正向关联信任（p<0.05），且两者交互显著（p<0.001）：高依赖用户更易信任错误信息。文本高亮无显著效果。
Conclusion: 学习依赖削弱信任校准，增加对不准确AI健康信息的易感性；仅文本高亮不足以减少过度依赖，需设计更有效的界面鼓励批判性评估。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: S2P-Net: A Spectral-Spatial Polar Network for Rotation-Invariant Object Recognition in Low-Data Regimes
papers.abstract_en: We present S2P-Net (Spectral-Spatial Polar Network), a compact deep learning architecture that achieves mathematically guaranteed rotation invariance without data augmentation. In this Paper, we also made a comparison to other neural network architectures (CNN`s). Have a look at the results and feel free to contact me for any questions. This is my first paper:) Made by Hackbert
papers.comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Preprint. Code available from the author upon request
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: S2P-Net 是一种紧凑的深度学习架构，可在无需数据增强的情况下实现数学上保证的旋转不变性，并在低数据 regime 下进行目标识别。论文还将其与标准 CNN 架构进行了比较。
Motivation: 现有方法通常依赖数据增强来实现旋转不变性，但无法保证数学上的严格性，且低数据场景下性能下降。
Method: 提出光谱-空间极坐标网络（S2P-Net），通过极坐标变换和光谱-空间特征提取实现旋转不变性。
Result: 实验表明 S2P-Net 在旋转不变性任务上优于标准 CNN，尤其在少量训练样本时表现突出。
Conclusion: S2P-Net 提供了一种紧凑、可证明的旋转不变性解决方案，适用于低数据 regime 的目标识别。
Relevance: 10

papers.title: ProtoFlow: Mitigating Forgetting in Class-Incremental Remote Sensing Segmentation via Low-Curvature Prototype Flow
papers.abstract_en: Remote sensing segmentation in real deployment is inherently continual: new semantic categories emerge, and acquisition conditions shift across seasons, cities, and sensors. Despite recent progress, many incremental approaches still treat training steps as isolated updates, which leaves representation drift and forgetting insufficiently controlled. We present ProtoFlow, a time-aware prototype dynamics framework that models class prototypes as trajectories and learns their evolution with an explicit temporal vector field. By jointly enforcing low-curvature motion and inter-class separation, ProtoFlow stabilizes prototype geometry throughout incremental learning. Experiments on standard class- and domain-incremental remote sensing benchmarks show consistent gains over strong baselines, including up to 1.5-2.0 points improvement in mIoUall, together with reduced forgetting. These results suggest that explicitly modeling temporal prototype evolution is a practical and interpretable strategy for robust continual remote sensing segmentation. Open-source code:https://github.com/dudududke/protoflow.
papers.comment: In the previous version, Juntendo University was erroneously listed as the affiliation; we must clarify that this paper has absolutely no relation to Juntendo University. Therefore, we have replaced this affiliation in the new version
papers.summary_zh:
TL;DR: 本文提出ProtoFlow，一种时间感知的原型动力学框架，用于类增量遥感分割。通过将类别原型建模为轨迹并学习其演化，联合约束低曲率运动和类间分离，稳定原型几何，缓解遗忘。在标准基准上，mIoUall提升1.5-2.0点，遗忘减少。
Motivation: 现有增量方法将训练步骤视为孤立更新，导致表示漂移和遗忘控制不足。
Method: 提出ProtoFlow，将类别原型建模为时间轨迹，通过显式时间向量场学习演化，联合优化低曲率运动和类间分离。
Result: 在类增量和域增量遥感分割基准上，mIoUall提升1.5-2.0点，并减少遗忘。
Conclusion: 显式建模时间原型演化是稳健持续遥感分割的实用且可解释策略。
